ui.eyebrow: US coups, interference and covert operations · 1900 → 2026
ui.canvas_aria: Animated world map: each arc runs from Washington to the site of a coup, armed intervention, assassination, interference operation, espionage case or cyberattack attributed or imputed to the United States, from 1900 to 2026.
ui.detail_meta: Click a point on the map or a row in the table
ui.detail_text: Date, place, countries targeted and level of attribution: acknowledged by the United States or a court, documented by historians, journalists or leaks, or merely alleged.
ui.notes_p1: {n} distinct facts. Wars are broken down into separate facts: each massacre, each bombing campaign, each program or state lie has its own line. The count aims to be as broad as possible, but it remains a selection of publicly documented facts.
ui.notes_p2: The arcs start from Washington by graphic convention and strike the capital of the targeted country, or the precise site of the operation when it matters (Playa Girón, Natanz, Abbottabad). Countries are tinted as they are targeted.
ui.notes_p3: Three levels of attribution. Acknowledged (solid dot): open operation, or US role admitted by Washington, established by Congress, a court or declassified official archives. Documented (circle): established by historians, journalists or leaked documents, without official acknowledgment. Alleged (dotted circle): accusation by the targeted country or third parties, with no public evidence of a decisive US role. This level concerns the US role, not the legal characterization of the facts.
ui.notes_p4: The “color revolutions” are classified as “alleged”: NGOs received US funds, but no source shows that Washington caused these mobilizations.
ui.notes_p5: The “Allies” view keeps only the facts targeting an official US ally on the date of the fact: NATO members (from their accession) and members of the EEC and then the EU, treaty allies in the Asia-Pacific (Japan, South Korea, the Philippines, Australia, Thailand, New Zealand until 1986, Taiwan from 1954 to 1979), Iran and Pakistan until 1979, members of the Rio Pact (TIAR) from 1948 until any withdrawal (Cuba in 1962, Mexico in 2004, Bolivia, Venezuela, Nicaragua and Ecuador in 2012-2014), and “major non-NATO allies” from their designation. The “Europe” view follows the framing of “The Grey War”.
ui.notes_p6: For the two world wars, only controversial facts are included (bombings of cities, nuclear weapons), not battles. The purple waves represent public broadcasting abroad: Voice of America (1942), then Radio Free Europe and Radio Liberty, secretly funded by the CIA until 1971.
ui.scale_p1: Political scientist Lindsey O'Rourke counts 64 covert and 6 overt regime-change attempts during the Cold War (1947-1989).
ui.scale_p2: Dov Levin counts 81 US interventions in foreign elections between 1946 and 2000, against 36 for the USSR and then Russia.
ui.scale_p3: The Senate's Church Committee (1975-1976) documented the assassination plots against Castro, Lumumba, Trujillo, Diệm and Schneider. An executive order has banned political assassinations since 1976.
ui.src_li1: Church Committee, report on assassination plots (1975)
ui.src_li2: State Department, Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
ui.src_li3: National Security Archive, George Washington University
ui.src_li5: Dov Levin, Meddling in the Ballot Box, 2020
ui.src_li8: Snowden and WikiLeaks documents, via Le Monde, Der Spiegel, Libération, Mediapart
ui.sources_p1: Each row of the table links to its source: a press article or an official document for the 2026 facts, sanctions, military aid and the WikiLeaks and Snowden leaks, otherwise a Wikipedia search on the incident, an entry point to primary sources.
ui.sources_p2: Open data (JSON, CSV), source documents, method, videos and scripts: github.com/Frequence-Populaire/Projets-divers. Corrections welcome, with a source.
ui.footer: Modeled on the map “The Grey War”. Timeline closed at the end of September 2026.
ui.legend_att: ● solid: acknowledged · ○ circle: documented · ◌ dotted: alleged
ui.note_europe: Framing of “The Grey War”: only facts targeting Europe are shown.
ui.note_allies: Only facts targeting an official US ally on the date of the fact (NATO, EU, Rio Pact, treaty allies, major non-NATO allies).
ui.footer_project: A Fréquence Populaire project

000b8e1184: Strike on the port of Ras Isa
US strikes on the oil terminal kill about 80 people according to the Houthis, including port employees. The Pentagon confirms it targeted the port.
001f51bb70: Marine Captain Charles Merckle is accused of torturing and murdering prisoners in the East. He commits suicide before his trial. The case is examined by the 1921 Senate inquiry.
004824c967: Clinton withdraws Colombia's anti-drug certification to punish President Ernesto Samper, accused of having been funded by the Cali cartel. The sanction is renewed in 1997.
00675182ba: Three weeks after a public condemnation of Iraqi chemical weapons, Rumsfeld meets Tariq Aziz with instructions to say that the statement changes nothing in relations, according to State Department archives.
007ef5faf0: Goïta coup, partner of US forces
Colonel Assimi Goïta, who overthrows Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta, had worked with US special forces and taken part in Flintlock exercises, AFRICOM confirms.
008b843098: Washington announces 100% duties on 520 million dollars of European products to punish the EU's banana regime, which favours ACP countries. The WTO then reduces the authorised amount to 191.4 million a year.
009c6141d9: The grandson of Theodore Roosevelt, the CIA agent enters Iran clandestinely to lead the operation on the ground. He recounts it in 1979 in his book “Countercoup.”
00d242aebb: B-26s of the Permesta rebel air force, supplied by the CIA and partly flown by its mercenaries, attack the port of Balikpapan and sink the British tanker San Flaviano.
00d69742e2: Strikes and “Black Friday” riots against Cheddi Jagan's government. Unions linked to the CIA through the AFL-CIO support them.
00e4ed7524: First special forces on the ground in Syria
Obama authorizes the deployment of about fifty special forces members alongside Kurdish and Arab militias. It is the start of a ground presence that reaches about 2,000 soldiers in 2017.
00f8946358: Guided by a CIA aircraft, a Peruvian fighter shoots down a plane carrying American missionaries. Veronica Bowers and her daughter die. The CIA inspector general finds repeated violations of procedures.
00f9eea34d: Somali forces accompanied by US soldiers kill ten civilians, including children, in this village in Lower Shabelle. Elders blame the raid; AFRICOM rejects any wrongdoing.
010766add4: According to the “Drone Papers” published by The Intercept, nearly 90% of the people killed by strikes over five months of this campaign were not the intended targets.
011a4d439c: The CIA funds the Christian Democrats and a propaganda campaign to prevent a victory by the Popular Front. Washington threatens to cut off Marshall Plan aid.
013c31a0ea: Ortega accuses Washington of having financed a coup attempt; the NED was funding opposition NGOs. The repression leaves more than 300 dead.
0148c87475: The CIA arms and funds a Tibetan force based in the Kingdom of Mustang, in Nepal, which carries out raids into Tibet. Aid ends in 1969 and the base is dismantled in 1974.
014f946392: Weapons for the Royal Nepalese Army
During the war against the Maoists, Washington supplies the royal army with thousands of M16 rifles and military aid, despite the disappearances and executions documented by the UN.
01584e4f10: Arrested in Kabul at around 14 to 17, Mohammed Jawad is mistreated at Bagram and then sent to Guantánamo. A military judge throws out his confessions obtained under torture. He is released in 2009.
016dc399d1: Al-Rawi and el-Banna abducted in Gambia

Arrested in Banjul on British intelligence, these two British residents are handed over to the CIA and transferred to Bagram and then Guantánamo. A British parliamentary committee confirms the sequence of events.
0183922fc6: Washington obtains from the OAS the creation of an inter-American force, dominated by American troops, to give a multilateral framework to the 1965-1966 occupation.
0196232b09: Burma renounces American aid and brings the presence of Chinese Nationalist troops on its soil to the UN, troops supplied from Taiwan with CIA support.
0196563f85: According to Amnesty and Reprieve, rendition aircraft file flight plans to Helsinki, such as a flight from Bagram in 2004, while actually landing in Lithuania, home to secret prisons. The Finnish ministry counts about 150 landings.
01ebadef83: A BND agent was spying for the CIA
A BND employee is arrested for selling more than 200 documents to the CIA. He is sentenced to eight years in prison in 2016.
01f539ea73: Pressure on the Pound During Suez
Eisenhower blocks the United Kingdom's access to the IMF and lets the pound collapse until London accepts the ceasefire. The Eden government gives in and withdraws its troops.
020ff9ea08: A $250 million drawdown, the last possible before available funds run out for lack of a vote in Congress.
022103bbed: Lacking new funding, the Pentagon announces a $300 million drawdown financed by savings on contracts.
023cabf78b: The United States leaves the 1987 Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty, accusing Russia of violating it with the 9M729 missile.
0243f74769: First American combat units in Vietnam. Troop numbers reach more than 500,000 by 1968.
025eb1c0ad: Capture of Abu Zubaydah in Faisalabad
The CIA, the FBI and the ISI storm a house. Abu Zubaydah, wounded, is sent to a black site. The 2014 Senate report details his detention.
02828ccf28: Clinton signs the Iran and Libya Sanctions Act, which sanctions foreign companies investing in Libyan or Iranian oil. The European Union contests this extraterritorial reach.
028c6a13b6: Fresenius Medical Care settles with the Justice Department and the SEC charges of bribing doctors and health officials in at least 17 countries, and must accept an independent monitor.
029c17b462: Marines and the army besiege Muqtada al-Sadr's Mahdi Army, entrenched in the old city and around the shrine of Imam Ali. The fighting kills hundreds before a truce brokered by Ali al-Sistani.
02a6c19dd2: CIA Takes Over the Gehlen Organization
The CIA takes over from the Army the funding and oversight of Reinhard Gehlen's network, which employs former SS and Wehrmacht officers. The organization becomes the BND in 1956.
02af3b5911: Netherlands and Japan join the embargo
Under US pressure, The Hague and Tokyo agree to restrict sales of chip-making machines to China, including those of ASML, according to Bloomberg.
02b07ee966: Bombing campaign against the North until November 1968, with about 860,000 tonnes of bombs. It hits roads, bridges, factories and cities.
02b47836af: An agreement with Ethiopia gives the U.S. Army the Kagnew station, a major NSA listening post on the Middle East and Africa, in exchange for military aid to Haile Selassie.
02b9d00be8: Bill Clinton bans all new American investment in Burma to sanction the junta.
02c3ee24d3: Burundian soldiers airlifted to the Central African Republic
U.S. military aircraft transport Burundian troops to the Central African Republic for the African Union force. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
02d0749317: Agent Orange in the demilitarized zone

In 1968 and 1969, Agent Orange and other herbicides are sprayed along the DMZ by South Korean soldiers, with Washington's agreement and equipment. Washington acknowledges the exposure of military personnel.
02e6b64119: The American navy destroys two oil platforms and sinks several Iranian ships. In 2003, the International Court of Justice rules that these attacks were not self-defense.
02ee592604: After rumors of a coup by General Esteban Huertas, Washington pushes the Panamanian government to dissolve its army.
03211197c5: The “Liberating Revolution” overthrows Perón. Peronists see the hand of Washington and oil interests; no decisive American role is proven.
033173c9af: A strike destroys a Koranic school and kills about 80 people, many of them teenagers. Islamabad claims responsibility, but several sources attribute it to the CIA.
033762cb8c: According to the Pike report, after the rebellion collapses, more than 200,000 Kurds flee to Iran; Washington refuses any humanitarian aid and grants asylum to none of them. Iran forcibly sends back more than 40,000.
035179aa6f: Washington refuses to recognize Grau's reformist government and has warships cruise around the island. Envoy Jefferson Caffery backs Batista, who overthrows him.
036417ceea: With the EU, the United Kingdom and Canada, Washington sanctions two Xinjiang officials, Wang Junzheng and Chen Mingguo.
0365d3e224: Rabinder Singh, CIA mole in RAW
This Indian intelligence officer, suspected of working for the CIA, flees to the United States via Nepal before being arrested. India says he was spirited away by the CIA.
0372369f53: The Shadow Brokers leaks show that the NSA penetrated EastNets, a SWIFT service provider for Middle Eastern banks, to track financial flows.
03742affcc: Anti-drug naval deployment in the Caribbean
Trump announces a reinforcement of military ships and aircraft in the Caribbean, presented as anti-drug a few days after Maduro's indictment.
038e7aa146: The CIA pays millions of dollars to the King of Jordan starting in 1957. The Washington Post reveals it in 1977 and the Carter administration ends the payments.
03b14bee39: A document published by The Intercept shows that Ramstein base relays American drone links by satellite. In 2019, a Münster court rules that the base plays a “central role” in the strikes in Yemen.
03c7dadf86: Operation Tulip: aid to Libyan exiles

Covert component of the Flower plan according to Bob Woodward: the CIA supports exiled Libyan opponents, including the NFSL, to overthrow Gaddafi. The Washington Post reveals in November 1985 that Reagan approved a CIA plan against Gaddafi.
03ef401285: American soldiers open fire on North Korean prisoners in Compound 62 of Koje camp during a control operation. Several dozen prisoners are killed.
040e158aee: The NSA penetrated the network of the Brazilian state oil company, TV Globo reveals, in the middle of the auction of the pre-salt fields.
0420e5dd50: Ambassador John Peurifoy publicly declares that American aid depends on electoral reform. Greece adopts the majority voting system, which gives Marshal Papagos a large victory in November.
043ba73664: U.S. soldiers fire on the car taking freed journalist Giuliana Sgrena to the airport and kill Italian secret agent Nicola Calipari. The U.S. investigation clears the soldiers.
044526ab74: Order No. 39: economy opened to foreigners
The Provisional Authority allows 100% foreign ownership of Iraqi companies and full repatriation of profits, outside the oil sector. Legal experts see a violation of the law of occupation.
04639a0c2a: Kurds dropped after the Algiers Agreement
The Shah signs an agreement with Baghdad and Washington cuts off aid. The Iraqi army crushes the Kurds and Kissinger ignores their appeals, according to the Pike report.
048bf844c2: South Africa invades Angola (Operation Savannah). Former agent John Stockwell claims the CIA coordinated its action with Pretoria, which Washington has denied.
04a7092ac3: According to L'Espresso, documents from Edward Snowden show the collection of metadata on nearly 46 million calls in Italy in one month. The NSA chief disputes this and speaks of data collected with NATO allies.
04a8192a57: Last CIA parachute drops in Estonia

Three Estonian agents are dropped into Estonia, the last known air operations of the REDSOX programme in the USSR. They are quickly captured or killed. The Estonian resistance was in fact controlled by the KGB.
04b396c505: Visiting Budapest, Mike Pompeo warns that Huawei's presence could lead Washington to reduce its cooperation with Hungary. The Orbán government maintains its contracts with the Chinese group.
04e10533a8: U.S. Navy ships escort Nationalist supply convoys to Quemoy, then pounded by Chinese artillery.
05013d8000: In line with the recommendations of the Yarborough mission, a decree authorizes the army to arm civilians. It serves as the legal basis for the first paramilitary groups.
0517bcd7cd: Listening station at the Kuala Lumpur embassy
The NSA map published by Der Spiegel in 2013 lists the U.S. embassy in Kuala Lumpur among the Special Collection Service sites tasked with intercepting communications.
0527eef854: After designating the Islamic State in Mozambique as terrorist, Washington sends Green Berets, at Maputo's request, to train Mozambican marines fighting the Cabo Delgado insurgency.
052a0550e0: The Southern Cone dictatorships coordinate the hunting down and assassination of opponents. The CIA is informed and a US Army communications network in Panama is used, according to archives.
0532e15151: Creation of CoCom Against the Soviet Bloc
Washington founds with its allies a committee that bans the export of strategic technologies to the USSR and its allies. The embargo remains in place until 1994.
05359c426c: Depleted uranium shells in Iraq and Kuwait
American forces fire depleted uranium munitions extensively for the first time, about 300 tonnes according to common estimates. Their health effects remain debated.
0538c27a9a: Washington claims that Libyan commandos were sent to kill Reagan and asks Americans to leave Libya. No commando is found; the press later attributes the information to an unreliable informant, Manucher Ghorbanifar.
054c06367d: Detainees beaten to death at Bagram
Detainees Habibullah and Dilawar, a taxi driver, die after repeated blows from U.S. soldiers. Light sentences are handed down.
055726a208: Formaldehyde dumped into the Han River
On the orders of a U.S. Army civilian employee, Albert McFarland, hundreds of bottles of formaldehyde are poured into the sewers of Yongsan base. He receives a suspended sentence in 2005.
05aaa711c2: Two American F-14s shoot down two Libyan MiG-23s over the Mediterranean.
05b7045af5: A rocket fired from an aircraft hits the cave where villagers were sheltering. About 374 people are killed, according to Lao authorities and witnesses.
05ee44d954: OPEC infiltrated by the NSA and GCHQ

The NSA penetrates the network of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries; GCHQ hacks the computers of nine employees using the Quantum Insert method. The intelligence goes to the CIA and the State and Energy departments. Revealed by Der Spiegel in November 2013.
061992b848: Manley and former agents, including Philip Agee, accuse the CIA of having armed and funded violence before the 1976 elections. Washington denies it.
0620b33925: Diplomatic cables revealed in 2010 show the U.S. embassy acting to have the prosecutions dropped against the soldiers who killed journalist José Couso in Baghdad.
062318c98a: The Justice Department finds that Ericsson breached its 2019 agreement by concealing facts in Djibouti, China and Iraq. The group pleads guilty and pays a further 206 million dollars.
063e6bde9a: George H. W. Bush's administration releases Orlando Bosch, whom the Justice Department had called a terrorist and whom Venezuela had tried for the Cubana Flight 455 bombing. He is not deported.
065b8cdbc6: The State Department approves the sale to Ukraine of 210 Javelin anti-tank missiles and 37 launchers, for about $47 million.
0663f30707: American warships cruise off Santo Domingo to prevent the assassinated dictator's brothers from regaining power. They leave the country shortly after.
0670e246a0: The United States bombs military sites on Kharg, the terminal for 90% of Iran's oil exports, including naval mine depots. Trump later mentions seizing the island.
0678413b5f: Bombing of the village of Kama Ado
U.S. bombers strike this village near Tora Bora. Residents and the press report dozens of civilians killed.
068103771a: Support for the Opposition in the Civil War

During the short civil war of 1948, the United States supports José Figueres's opposition against the camp of Calderón and President Picado, allied with the Communists and backed by Somoza's Nicaragua. The government falls in April.
068792c00c: The island's police, under the authority of the governor appointed by Washington, kill four Nationalist activists near the university.
068d2fff50: The NSA obtains in advance the UN secretary-general's talking points for his April 11, 2013 meeting with Barack Obama. Revealed by the New York Times in November 2013.
0698bcc562: U.S. forces again fire depleted uranium munitions, including in urban areas such as Baghdad. Their health effects remain debated.
06ad1fe6e8: The 8th Air Force bombs the port, filled with refugees fleeing the Red Army. The toll is heavily disputed, from a few thousand to more than 20,000 dead.
06d3d3a341: About 1,400 exiles trained by the CIA land. They are defeated in three days. More than 1,100 are captured.
06d48ddb55: Poisoned Pills Given to Juan Orta
Through the Mafia, the CIA passes botulinum toxin pills to Juan Orta, a Castro associate. He backs out. The Church Committee documents this attempt.
06f66876fb: The CIA's Hmong army, backed by American air power, takes the Plain of Jars. The populations are forcibly evacuated.
071fe18ca9: Syria placed on the terror list
The State Department places Syria on the list of state sponsors of terrorism from its creation. The listing entails lasting trade and financial restrictions.
07526e4edb: The Reagan administration suspends economic aid to the Sandinista government, including credits for the purchase of wheat.
0755d059fd: A US drone kills Iranian general Soleimani and Iraqi militia leader Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis at Baghdad airport, on Trump's order. The Iraqi Parliament votes for US troops to leave.
0767b07c32: Law strengthening sanctions on the North
Obama signs the North Korea Sanctions and Policy Enhancement Act, which makes sanctions mandatory against persons linked to weapons programs, mineral trade and human rights violations.
077513c264: Iran recovers a U.S. RQ-170 Sentinel stealth drone on a reconnaissance mission over its territory. Washington acknowledges the loss and asks for its return.
07a95f5b0b: Tom Harkin and two members of Congress reveal cells where prisoners are crammed together and mistreated, in a prison funded and advised by the United States.
07b323d6f7: Secret funds for the Italian elections

In late 1975, the Ford administration approves about 6 million dollars for anti-communist parties before the June 1976 legislative elections. The leak is published by the American press in January 1976.
07bab16321: Chester Crocker's policy brings Washington closer to the apartheid regime and links Namibia's independence to the departure of the Cubans from Angola. Its critics see it as a brake on Namibian independence, achieved in 1990.
07bc9c21ca: The CIA funds an alliance of warlords against the Islamic courts, according to the New York Times. The alliance is defeated in June 2006.
08154213e3: Arms for the Western Sahara war
Carter approves the sale of OV-10 aircraft and helicopters to Morocco to fight the Polisario. Reagan expands military aid.
083b493a3f: Trump cancels his visit over Greenland
After Mette Frederiksen called the idea of selling Greenland “absurd”, Donald Trump postpones the state visit planned for 2 and 3 September and calls the Prime Minister “nasty”.
086b77e026: An American Military Assistance Advisory Group (MAAG) sets up in Saigon to manage arms deliveries to French and associated forces.
087b614aed: A cargo plane resupplying the Contras is shot down. Survivor Eugene Hasenfus reveals the covert network, the starting point of Iran-Contra.
08c9c62ece: Officers revolt against Ydígoras, partly because of the CIA camp. B-26s from the Retalhuleu base, flown by Cuban exiles, help crush the revolt, from which the MR-13 guerrilla will emerge.
08f05ac744: The CIA makes several Mexican presidents, including Díaz Ordaz and Echeverría, paid sources. During the Tlatelolco massacre (1968), it mainly relays the government's version.
08fa32393f: Trump says the United States will “run” Venezuela and announces that Caracas must hand over tens of millions of barrels of oil to them, sold under US control.
08fe5d511c: Five days before the transfer of power, the Treasury and the State Department target about 250 individuals and entities, including Chinese suppliers to the Russian defense industry.
08ff7f8ad8: Chávez expels the U.S. ambassador in solidarity with Bolivia and says he foiled a military plot backed by Washington. No public evidence is presented; Washington expels the Venezuelan ambassador.
094690df14: In the name of the “Roosevelt Corollary,” Washington takes control of Dominican customs to repay foreign creditors.
0989bc7ced: At the Inter-American Conference, John Foster Dulles gets a resolution adopted that opens the way to collective action against a state “dominated by communism.” Guatemala, the target, votes against.
09a1e3a763: Arms to the mujahideen via Pakistan
After the Soviet invasion, the CIA supplies lethal weapons to the mujahideen, channeled through Pakistan's ISI, with Saudi funding on a matching basis.
09e60f4b44: An executive order suspends US aid in reaction to an expropriation law and to South Africa's case against Israel before the International Court of Justice.
09e872fa9e: The president is removed in less than two days. WikiLeaks cables show that the embassy knew of the opposition's plans as early as 2009; a U.S. role is not demonstrated.
09eadfbedb: Ambassador Richard Grenell writes to German companies involved in the Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline to warn them that they expose themselves to American sanctions. Berlin denounces interference.
0a188abcf0: Operation Commando Hunt on the Ho Chi Minh Trail
Massive air campaign against the Ho Chi Minh Trail in Laos, with electronic sensors and B-52s. It lasts until 1972.
0a2fd9532d: B-29s bomb the port of Rashin, very close to the Soviet border, after a long political ban on striking so near the USSR.
0a40f2301a: Diplomatic cables published by WikiLeaks show that the State Department funded exiled Syrian opposition figures and the Barada TV channel, to the tune of about $6 million.
0a7faa3eab: Crowds paid by the CIA and army units seize the radio station and besiege Mossadegh's house. The fighting kills hundreds according to estimates. Zahedi becomes prime minister.
0a8ca668ba: According to the Financial Times, Washington has been helping Kyiv since the summer plan its drone strikes on Russian refineries: trajectories, timing and vulnerabilities of targets.
0a97a1616a: More than 25,000 American soldiers overthrow Noriega. The UN General Assembly condemns the invasion.
0aa6698604: The army takes power. According to journalist Mehmet Ali Birand, Paul Henze, former CIA station chief in Ankara and then on the National Security Council, reportedly said “our boys did it”. Henze denied it.
0ae0452c48: Last of the three Baltic states, Lithuania signs with Washington the joint 5G declaration of the “Clean Network” programme, which aims to exclude Huawei.
0aedff5437: After African swine fever, a program funded mainly by USAID has all Haitian pigs slaughtered. Peasants lose their main savings; the replacement pigs are poorly suited.
0b19414204: After Sandino refuses to disarm, the Marines wage a counterguerrilla war in the north of the country until 1933, with air support.
0b2ed6755a: In exchange for the use of the Lajes base, Washington grants Caetano's Portugal hundreds of millions of dollars in aid, during its wars in Africa.
0b30063137: From a British base in Cyprus, GCHQ and the NSA capture the images from Israeli drones and combat aircraft, notably over Gaza. Revealed by The Intercept, Der Spiegel and Yedioth Ahronoth in January 2016.
0b7941510a: The FSB arrests a U.S. embassy diplomat, described as a CIA agent, with wigs and cash, while recruiting an officer. He is expelled.
0b948c51fc: Sailors land to protect the consulate and the steamship wharf during a revolution, according to Congress's official list.
0bb716391c: The CIA director travels to Kyiv just before the launch of the “anti-terrorist” operation in the Donbas. Moscow sees a green light; the CIA denies any role.
0bb772b9ec: In the Polish secret prison, a CIA officer threatens Abd al-Rahim al-Nashiri with a power drill and cocks a pistol near his head. The CIA Inspector General's report (2004) describes these unauthorised methods.
0be402d95a: The Manhattan in the Northwest Passage
A reinforced American tanker crosses the passage without asking Ottawa's permission; Ottawa claims these waters as internal.
0be4da8f58: NATO air campaign, conducted mainly by American aircraft, against Bosnian Serb forces after the shelling of the Markale market.
0bec4f3244: Marines land to protect American property during the revolt of the Independent Party of Color. The Cuban army kills thousands of Afro-Cubans.
0c06e838a6: Two Chinese Fighters Shot Down Near Hainan
U.S. Navy aircraft searching for survivors of an airliner shot down by China three days earlier shoot down two Chinese fighters.
0c1af91098: The CIA opens a secret prison near Kabul where detainees are kept in the dark, chained, and deprived of sleep. The Senate described it in 2014.
0c289a6b1f: In the midst of the Koreagate affair, the American press reveals that American services wiretapped the South Korean presidency of Park Chung-hee.
0c30b70095: The American navy escorts Kuwaiti tankers reflagged under the American flag, which engages it in clashes with Iran until 1988.
0c3dd0d80d: The CIA prepares for Castro a diving suit impregnated with a fungus and a breathing apparatus contaminated with the tuberculosis bacillus, via the lawyer James Donovan. Donovan offers a different suit. The Church Committee reports it.
0c59a64d69: After a WTO ruling on aid to Airbus, Washington taxes 7.5 billion dollars of European products: 10% on aircraft, 25% on French wines, cheeses and whiskies.
0c7ade85f6: A leaked call shows Victoria Nuland and Ambassador Pyatt choosing the future prime minister (“Yats is the guy”). Washington does not dispute its authenticity.
0c89141d95: U.S. helicopters and an AC-130 attack two Pakistani border posts and kill 24 soldiers. Islamabad closes the NATO supply routes for seven months.
0ca728db77: Konrad Mizzi and Keith Schembri barred

The State Department bars from entering the United States former Maltese minister Konrad Mizzi, his family and ex-chief of staff Keith Schembri, for “significant corruption” linked to a power plant contract.
0cd2c9acc7: According to the European report on Echelon, American intercepts helped Raytheon take from Thomson-CSF the Brazilian Amazon surveillance contract.
0ce80d8c9f: The CIA and the British networks of the Rashidian brothers pay money to deputies to make them oppose Mossadegh. Payments documented by the CIA's internal history and the 2017 FRUS volume.
0d65f00dc9: The Bush administration presents aluminum tubes imported by Iraq as parts for nuclear centrifuges. Department of Energy experts judged them intended for rockets.
0d9148f90f: The Cyberspace Administration summons Nvidia over tracking and remote shutdown risks in the H20s. Nvidia denies it.
0d9b982a85: Repeated plebiscites on the Palau Compact

The 1979 Constitution bans nuclear weapons in Palau. The American Compact requires circumventing it; a series of plebiscites fail to reach the 75 percent majority before its adoption in 1993, with the threshold lowered.
0da0e77070: The U.S. Air Force transports French troops to Mali and refuels their aircraft in flight. Washington also provides intelligence.
0db8a58008: Armored vehicles for the UN held up in Rwanda
After Resolution 918, Washington negotiates for weeks the rental price of the armored vehicles promised to UNAMIR II. They arrive only after the genocide is over.
0dba6b6527: Washington orders the Chinese consulate in Houston closed within 72 hours, accusing it of espionage and intellectual property theft.
0dcdad37b5: An American electronic intelligence aircraft is shot down by Soviet fighters. All 17 crew members are killed.
0e017e01b7: Pyongyang accuses American troops of having killed 35,000 civilians at Sinchon from October to December 1950. Historians attribute the killings mainly to Korean anti-Communist militias.
0e35797660: Iraqi soldiers buried alive by bulldozer
Bulldozer tanks of the 1st Infantry Division fill in Iraqi trenches, burying hundreds of soldiers. Revealed by Newsday, the tactic has been confirmed by the army.
0e43e0594c: Snowden documents show that the NSA pushed a weakened random number generator standard, adopted by NIST and ISO. Reuters reveals that it paid RSA $10 million to use it.
0e4c074fd0: Threat of 200% duties on French champagne
After Emmanuel Macron's refusal to join the “Board of Peace” on Gaza, Donald Trump threatens to tax French wines and champagnes at 200% to force him to join.
0e5d586529: Strikes on pro-Iranian militias in Iraq
Unclaimed strikes, attributed to the United States, target Iraqi Shiite militias after February 28. Abu Ali al-Askari, a Kataib Hezbollah official, is killed in Baghdad on March 14.
0e5f89ec1b: Raid on the North Korean embassy in Madrid

A commando of the Free Joseon group, led by Adrian Hong, ties up the staff and takes computers and documents, later handed to the FBI. The Spanish press reports links between two of the assailants and the CIA, without public proof.
0e6da4c4a0: Chávez is removed for 47 hours. Washington knew of the preparations and funded opponents through the NED; a direct role is not established.
0e93fe462b: The exposed inhabitants of Rongelap and Utirik become the subjects of a medical study on the effects of radiation, Project 4.1, without informed consent.
0e99ee7c1a: An Israeli strike on a displacement camp kills about 45 people. CNN identifies fragments of US-made GBU-39 bombs.
0e9b17143c: A video released in January 2012 shows Marine snipers urinating on Taliban corpses. Disciplinary sanctions follow.
0eaafc719e: An NSA intercept reports the German foreign minister's relief at not having received any response from Condoleezza Rice on the CIA's secret flights. Published by WikiLeaks in July 2015.
0ebaa9cc77: A 1946 act of Congress validates the military's expropriation of vast Chamorro lands. Between 1945 and 1950, about a third of the island comes under military control, often for derisory compensation.
0ecf1963e2: According to Snowden documents broadcast by TV Globo, the NSA intercepts the president's communications. Rousseff cancels her state visit to Washington.
0eeeb582b7: NATO helicopters kill nine boys who were collecting firewood. General Petraeus makes a public apology.
0f093ed8f7: Washington dissuades Berlin from prosecuting the CIA
Cables revealed by WikiLeaks show that the U.S. embassy warned Berlin of the consequences of arrest warrants against the CIA agents involved in the abduction of el-Masri.
0f319297a1: Wedding party bombed at Haska Meyna
A U.S. air strike on a wedding procession kills 47 civilians, including the bride, according to an Afghan commission. The U.S. military first said it had targeted fighters.
0f466be66d: According to historian Alfred McCoy, American funds channeled through Irving Brown are used to pay Corsican underworld thugs to break Communist strikes at the port.
0f5fdff5ef: After the death of three soldiers in Jordan, bombers strike 85 targets in Iraq and Syria, including al-Qaim and Akashat. Baghdad reports 16 dead, including civilians.
0f657e0e86: During the revision of the security treaty, a secret agreement allows American ships carrying nuclear weapons to call at Japan, despite the stated principles. Tokyo acknowledged it in 2010.
0f80e8820a: Knox Note and Fall of Zelaya
Secretary of State Knox breaks with President Zelaya and backs the Conservative rebellion. Zelaya resigns two weeks later.
0fbad88f89: US special forces support Ecuadorian operations against groups described as terrorist, including a camp of FARC dissidents near the Colombian border.
0fc2074b8e: The Philippines, dependent on American aid, grant some twenty bases for 99 years, including Clark and Subic, with American jurisdiction over crimes committed inside them.
0fe2e9b505: Bounty on Maduro raised to $25 million
On the day of Maduro's disputed inauguration, the State Department raises the reward for his capture to $25 million.
0fead738c7: Trump announces an agreement giving the United States majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan reserves, negotiated with Delcy Rodríguez, whose oil revenues Washington already controls.
0ff20f5793: The Army builds a nuclear-powered base under the ice, officially scientific. The secret Project Iceworm envisages hundreds of missiles there, without Copenhagen being informed.
0ff3e204fd: Radio Free Asia, funded by Congress, begins broadcasting in Mandarin to China, then in Tibetan and Uyghur.
1000da9f3f: Exemption from the embargo for factories
The Bush administration exempts American-owned assembly plants from the embargo against the junta. Critics see it as weakening the pressure on the putschists.
106fa35c1d: Ukraine strikes occupied airfields at Berdiansk and Luhansk with ATACMS missiles secretly delivered by the United States.
10a90f6411: According to the Pike Committee report, Ambassador Graham Martin hands 800,000 dollars to the head of Italian military intelligence, Vito Miceli, on the sidelines of the CIA's party funding.
10c3f0be10: A $500 million drawdown including HIMARS ammunition, drones and armored vehicles.
10e421a4b1: Filipino soldiers in Vietnam paid by Washington
The Senate Symington Committee hearings in 1969 reveal that Washington financed the allowances and equipment of the Philippine Civic Action Group (PHILCAG) sent to Vietnam.
1107073787: Resolution 883 freezes Libyan assets abroad and bans the sale of oil equipment to Libya, again to obtain the handover of the Lockerbie suspects.
110948bf91: Six Hungarian officials barred from entry

Washington bars six Hungarian officials from entry for corruption, including tax chief Ildikó Vida. Orbán accuses the United States of using corruption as a lever of influence; Vida denies any involvement.
110dafce24: The United States, with the United Kingdom and France, vetoes four resolutions that provided for sanctions against South Africa for its illegal occupation of Namibia.
110f78022d: 7th Fleet Deployed in the Taiwan Strait
At the start of the Korean War, Truman interposes the 7th Fleet between mainland China and Taiwan, preventing the People's Republic from invading the island.
1118edcaf8: The CIA has deliberately flawed nuclear weapon plans delivered to Iran via a Russian scientist. The operation, revealed by James Risen, is confirmed at the trial of Jeffrey Sterling.
11315e7874: In a documentary, Putin claims that the FSB caught CIA agents in Baku helping North Caucasus fighters. No evidence has been published.
114caf4aba: The Hindu reveals, based on the Snowden documents, that the NSA collected 6.3 billion pieces of Indian data in one month, including items on nuclear and space matters.
114d9c612d: Haitian rebels trained in the Dominican Republic
Rebels who bring down Aristide in February 2004 were reportedly trained by U.S. special forces in the Dominican Republic. Aristide and Haitian and French officials accuse Washington.
1160d06460: Washington sanctions four ICC members, including French judge Nicolas Guillou and Canadian judge Kimberly Prost.
116450b3f1: NED smuggles émigré journals into the USSR
Between 1984 and 1986, the National Endowment for Democracy, funded by Congress, subsidizes émigré journals smuggled into the Soviet Union.
11a5dbc9d8: Washington signs a withdrawal agreement with the Taliban, without the Afghan government. It requires Kabul to release 5,000 Taliban prisoners.
11b276e874: U.S. commandos free two hostages, including American Jessica Buchanan, and kill their captors. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
11d972aabf: Senator Mel Martinez and the chargé d'affaires warn Madrid of the consequences of Baltasar Garzón's proceedings against six Bush administration officials and over CIA flights. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
11e00f47fb: An American aircraft mistakenly bombs the Richmond Hill psychiatric hospital and kills about 18 patients. The Pentagon acknowledges the strike.
11e1b5b5f8: Reagan freezes Panamanian assets in the United States and suspends canal payments to bring down Noriega. The Panamanian economy collapses.
11e73a99d5: Biden bans imports of Russian oil, gas and coal into the United States.
11ed332faa: Signed under occupation, the treaty gives the United States control of customs and finances and the creation of a gendarmerie. The Haitian Senate ratifies it in November 1915 under pressure.
120f1c3601: Chinese bank of Dandong cut off from the dollar
The Treasury cuts the Bank of Dandong off from the US financial system for money laundering on behalf of North Korea.
121ef801ea: An Afghan raid backed by US strikes against the Taliban kills about forty civilians gathered for a wedding, according to Afghan authorities.
12415792cf: The State Department publishes the Foreign Relations of the United States volume on Iran from 1951 to 1954, which details the CIA's role.
1244005543: American Green Berets train the Bolivian 2nd Ranger Battalion to hunt down Ernesto Guevara's guerrillas.
12489b6081: The United States vetoes a draft condemning Israeli raids in Lebanon and Syria after Munich. It is the first American veto on the Middle East.
126fecf445: Drones over the Kremlin: Moscow blames Washington
After two drones explode over the Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov says Washington is behind the attack. The White House denies it.
127b6e5d94: A cable published by The Intercept reports that diplomat Donald Lu wanted the prime minister gone. Khan is ousted a month later; Washington denies it.
12a1f4f263: Defectors from the Iraqi National Congress

Funded by the State Department and then the DIA, the Iraqi National Congress supplies the government and the press with defectors whose accounts of Iraqi weapons were fabricated, according to the Senate intelligence committee in 2006.
12b5781ea5: The CIA funds the opposition parties for the March 1973 legislative elections, in which they hope to win two thirds to remove Allende, according to the Church Committee.
12cce8a448: Sinde law dictated by the embassy

The embassy threatens to put Spain on the “Special 301” trade blacklist if it does not toughen its law against downloading. The Sinde law is passed in late 2011. Revealed by WikiLeaks and El País in 2010.
12f6df610f: Allende massacre after a DEA leak
Information passed by the DEA to a Mexican unit leaks to the Zetas, who kill dozens, even hundreds, of residents, according to ProPublica in 2017.
12f9f4a18a: Condoleezza Rice and the State Department push Benazir Bhutto and Musharraf toward a power-sharing arrangement, which allows Bhutto's return and amnesty under the National Reconciliation Ordinance.
13165fc123: A SEAL team led by Bob Kerrey kills about twenty civilians, mostly women and children. Revealed in 2001, Kerrey acknowledges civilian deaths.
132487c153: The NSA intercepts shipments of network equipment, implants beacons in them and then sends them on; a June 2010 note cites a successful operation against the Syrian state operator. Revealed by Glenn Greenwald in May 2014.
135823b6c1: The CIA creates and funds a Haitian intelligence service presented as anti-drug. According to the New York Times, it is used mainly against opponents.
135a5756fc: The New York Times reveals that U.S. drones fly over Mexico to track the cartels; Mexico City confirms the flights.
1363b15ad8: North Korean IT worker network targeted
The Treasury sanctions a Russian national and Chinese and North Korean companies that place fake IT workers in foreign firms to fund weapons.
136403dbd6: Washington sanctions six officials, including the police chief and the secretary for justice, for the pursuit of exiled activists.
13b13a3834: Battle of Bayang Against the Moros
An American column storms the Pandapatan forts. Several hundred Moros are killed, against about ten American soldiers.
13cb6c0c38: Trump writes that there will be “no deal with Iran except unconditional surrender,” followed by the choice of “acceptable” leaders.
13ee8a13a4: The CIA covertly funds the banned union: printing presses, radios, communications equipment, publications. The program lasts until the late 1980s.
13f08baf9f: The CIA plans to slip thallium salts into Castro's shoes during a trip, to make his beard fall out and ruin his image. The project does not come to fruition, according to the Church Committee.
140de2f843: After the war, Austria is divided into four Allied occupation zones. The United States controls notably Salzburg and Upper Austria, until the 1955 State Treaty.
14128c4148: A State Department office runs a pro-Contra propaganda campaign. The GAO finds in 1987 that it violated the law.
1415a0ded6: Intelligence from Delta Force, the CIA and the DEA passed to the Search Bloc reaches the “Pepes”, a squad that kills Escobar's relatives, according to declassified documents.
141ce23298: Emergency arms sales to the Gulf
Mike Pompeo invokes an Iran-related emergency to sell $8.1 billion in arms to Saudi Arabia and the Emirates without congressional approval. The inspector general later notes risks to civilians.
141fdb82e6: Plan to abduct Bin Laden at Tarnak
The CIA prepares with Afghan tribes a raid to abduct Osama bin Laden at his Tarnak camp. The plan is cancelled in May 1998 for fear of civilian casualties, according to the 9/11 Commission.
14561b8413: To enlarge the American air base, Denmark forcibly moves the Inughuit population from Uummannaq to Qaanaaq. The Danish Supreme Court rules the expulsion illegal in 2003.
1459d03130: Doe proclaims himself elected despite massive fraud. Before Congress, Assistant Secretary of State Chester Crocker defends the vote, and aid continues.
146343bb90: A $400 million drawdown of ammunition, NASAMS missiles and generators.
1486370f11: Threats over remittances to El Salvador
Before the presidential election, Bush administration officials suggest that an FMLN victory could jeopardize money transfers from Salvadoran emigrants.
14937a8ca8: The pro-Beijing press publishes photos of Julie Eadeh, of the US consulate, meeting leaders of the movement. Beijing sees a “black hand”; Washington denounces an intimidation campaign.
14a0abddf3: Special forces attack the home of the Islamic State leader, who blows himself up. Thirteen people die, including six children according to local rescuers; the Pentagon attributes most of the deaths to the jihadist leader.
14bee62546: Entire regions are declared zones where anyone can be considered an enemy and fired upon without prior authorization.
14d13cf7a9: Strikes on Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan
During the Israel-Iran war, B-2 bombers drop bunker-buster bombs on Iranian nuclear sites (Operation Midnight Hammer), without congressional authorization.
14eb06e66b: An electronic intelligence RB-50 is shot down by MiG-15s off Cape Gamov. Only one of the seventeen crew members survives.
14f21e95af: Trump withdraws from the Vienna agreement and reinstates sanctions. In 2019, Human Rights Watch documents medicine shortages that threaten Iranians' health.
1500cf9aca: Armed Pressure During the Coto War
After the Coto War against Costa Rica, Washington sends a battleship and Marines and forces Panama to cede the disputed territory.
151f29b96f: Biden expels ten diplomats and bars US banks from buying Russian sovereign debt at issuance, in response to the SolarWinds hack and election interference.
15403f8c7c: After a bombing, Marine commandos fire on cars and passersby over several kilometers; 19 civilians killed. A military investigation finds the response excessive, with no conviction.
155c987a05: With Ottawa's agreement, the US Army tests Agent Orange and other defoliants at the Canadian base in 1966 and 1967; exposed servicemen and local residents will be compensated.
1563920ab7: A $200 million drawdown of ammunition for air defense and artillery.
1563b6bff5: Cluster submunitions yellow like the rations
Cluster bombs are dropped; their small yellow cylinders resemble the humanitarian rations parachuted in. Washington broadcasts radio messages to help tell them apart.
158746fd6d: To break the island's guerrilla movement, the army herds the population into controlled zones and destroys villages and crops. Military historians see this as the first use of reconcentration in the Philippines.
159baeaac2: Mabini and Opponents Deported to Guam
The U.S. Army deports Apolinario Mabini, Artemio Ricarte and dozens of opponents who refuse to swear allegiance to the United States to Guam. Mabini is not released until 1903.
15c8508590: Implants in the Russian power grid
The New York Times reveals that Cyber Command implanted malware in the Russian power grid. Trump denounces the paper's “act of treason.”
15d9be0f21: Donald Trump confirms having authorized the CIA to carry out covert operations in Venezuela, revealed by the New York Times.
15e37b8e3c: Operation Meetinghouse: more than 300 B-29s drop incendiary bombs on Tokyo. About 100,000 civilians die in a single night.
15e79beb59: Massive aid to the Doe regime
After Samuel Doe's bloody coup, Liberia becomes one of the top recipients of American aid in Africa, about 500 million dollars over the decade.
15f783799c: Trump authorizes lethal weapons for Kyiv
The State Department confirms that the United States will provide “enhanced defensive capabilities” to Ukraine, paving the way for the sale of Javelin missiles refused under Obama.
1606e54f64: American bombers crush Saint-Lô on the night of June 6–7, 1944 to block German reinforcements. Several hundred civilians die and the town becomes the “capital of ruins.”
160af80f7e: The Allies put into circulation in Normandy “flag notes” printed in the United States, without the agreement of the GPRF. De Gaulle calls them “counterfeit money” and obtains their withdrawal.
1647517984: Taiwanese U-2 Shot Down at Nanchang
A U-2 of the “Black Cats” squadron, flown by a Taiwanese pilot for the CIA, is shot down by a missile over Nanchang. Overflights of mainland China cease in 1968 and the squadron is disbanded in 1974.
1684a615ad: Sweden hunts submarines in its naval base and accuses the USSR. Researchers and former officials, including Caspar Weinberger, have mentioned Western probing. Nothing is established.
168f87f473: Washington delivers OV-10 Bronco attack aircraft to Indonesia, used against areas held by the resistance in East Timor during the encirclement campaigns of 1977-1978.
16a904793f: American bombers aiming at the port hit the city center. The September raids kill more than a thousand civilians.
16c356f447: The Guatemalan government publishes documents on an armed plot supported by a “Northern power.” Washington denies it. CIA archives later confirm the plot's reality.
16cdce1743: The Vodafone Greece engineer, a key witness in the wiretapping of the Karamanlis government, is found hanged. First ruled a suicide, the case is reclassified as murder by Greek justice; no American link is established.
16de0fda39: The Swedish operator settles for $965 million with US, Dutch and Swedish authorities over bribes in Uzbekistan.
16e534ec0e: Four dead in a strike at sea
Pete Hegseth announces the destruction of a boat off Venezuela: four dead, described as “narco-terrorists” without public evidence.
16ea87f31c: Biden blocks $7 billion of the Afghan central bank's assets, half of it earmarked for the families of 9/11 victims, in the midst of a humanitarian crisis.
16f0b46db5: Aid to the non-communist Khmer resistance
As part of the Reagan Doctrine, Washington backs the Khmer People's National Liberation Front, an ally of the Khmer Rouge against the regime installed by Vietnam. Congress votes open aid in 1985.
16fba93538: Iceland is placed under American protection, with the agreement of its government, for strategic reasons. The Marines relieve British troops. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
16fdd6e69b: The Discoverer 14 mission brings back the first photos of the USSR taken from space. The Corona program is declassified in 1995.
170e0b7c1f: Officers led by Moisés Giroldi capture Noriega. American forces block two roads but refuse to take him into custody. He is released and Giroldi is executed.
171df6d1e3: On instructions from the occupation command, thousands of Communists and unionists are driven out of the civil service, the media and companies, as part of the occupation's “change of course.”
17239fdbb7: More than a thousand air sorties hit some thirty objectives in Pyongyang, after warning leaflets.
172ea835fc: Trump announces land strikes in Mexico
Trump says the United States will “start hitting land” against cartels, aiming at Mexico. Claudia Sheinbaum rejects any US military action on her soil.
1739c4565b: The American command prepares a plan to arrest Syngman Rhee and install another government if Seoul sabotages the armistice. The plan appears in American diplomatic archives. It is not carried out.
174c9b8f6f: A Soviet diplomat recruited by the CIA, he photographs Foreign Ministry cables. Arrested in 1977, he kills himself with a poison capsule supplied by the CIA.
17509b1b80: Trump calls Petro an “illegal drug leader” and announces the end of US aid and subsidies to Colombia.
175a119caf: Strikes on the Pale ammunition depot
American aircraft take part in NATO strikes on a Serb ammunition depot near Pale. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
176d72e2fc: U.S. aircraft twice strike the warehouses of the International Committee of the Red Cross in October. The Pentagon acknowledges errors.
17717a0ae2: Secret CIA program against the FARC
The Washington Post reveals a covert program launched in the early 2000s: NSA intelligence and bomb guidance kits to kill FARC leaders.
1774df43dd: Tens of millions of U.S. dollars funded the opposition, Otpor and polling, according to the Washington Post. Milošević falls after the presidential election.
177d921325: The UN fact-finding mission on Iran finds “reasonable grounds” to believe the United States committed indiscriminate attacks, war crimes, notably at Minab and Lamerd. Washington rejects the report.
17860ff648: Washington declares UN sanctions on Iran reinstated. Most members of the Security Council consider the move legally ineffective.
1786dc3e31: On the basis of a second North Vietnamese attack that did not take place, Congress authorizes Johnson to use armed force in Southeast Asia. This blank check serves as the legal basis for the escalation in Vietnam.
1793d84876: The State Department demands that the twelve F-16s sold by Israel be stripped of their Israeli equipment. The contract, worth about 500 million dollars, collapses; Croatia then turns to French Rafales.
17a80d6014: On the day of the invasion, the Treasury blocks VTB and other banks, cuts Sberbank off from the dollar, and Commerce imposes export controls on technologies bound for Russia and Belarus.
17d491dd6e: Second nuclear sensor placed on Nanda Kot
After the loss of the first device on Nanda Devi, a CIA and Intelligence Bureau team installs a plutonium sensor on Nanda Kot to monitor Chinese tests. The operation is revealed in 1978.
17d710dba7: The 303 Committee approves secret funds for Barrientos's 1966 presidential campaign, according to the official FRUS series.
182359b750: The Saudi-led coalition bombs a funeral and kills more than 100 people. Human Rights Watch identifies a U.S.-made guided bomb.
1830c7c66f: Landing on the Isthmus of Panama
U.S. forces land to protect American property and keep transit open during an insurrection against Colombia. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
18547e4ccc: Four days of American-British bombing of Iraqi military and power sites, launched without a UN vote after the withdrawal of inspectors.
18672a636d: Special forces abduct in Libya a suspect in the 2012 Benghazi attack and try him in the United States.
186f91c82c: Support for the Shah after “Black Friday”
Two days after the army fired on the crowd at Jaleh Square, Carter telephones the Shah to reaffirm his support.
18760428d5: The war between Bolivia and Paraguay kills tens of thousands. Senator Huey Long accuses Standard Oil of having pushed Bolivia into it; the accusation remains debated.
1877a5d54b: Veto during the siege of Beirut
The United States blocks a French draft calling for the disengagement of forces in Beirut and the Israeli withdrawal from the city's outskirts.
1878285c5e: The last inhabitants of Peros Banhos and Salomon are shipped to Mauritius. Between 1,500 and 2,000 people were expelled from the archipelago in total.
18a810fa0f: Cuba placed on the terror list
The State Department adds Cuba to the list of state sponsors of terrorism, for its support of Latin American guerrillas. Cuba remains on it until 2015.
18aabeba3a: Ambassador Henry Lane Wilson brings together Huerta and Félix Díaz, who overthrow Madero. He is assassinated a few days later. Wilson is recalled.
18b1bddd8b: Shelling of the Rosita de Hornedo Hotel
Launches of the Student Revolutionary Directorate fire on a hotel in the Miramar district housing Soviet bloc advisers. The group was then funded by the CIA, according to declassified archives.
18bee70e6c: After the bombing of Sakiet, Washington imposes an Anglo-American mediation between France and Tunisia. Acceptance of these “good offices” brings down the Gaillard government.
18c74c9445: Surrounded by the Macedonian army near Skopje, NLA fighters are evacuated with their weapons in KFOR convoys escorted by the US Army. Macedonian protesters attack the US embassy.
18ed8bbed0: Cartel de los Soles designated foreign terrorist
The State Department places the Cartel de los Soles on the list of foreign terrorist organizations, which directly targets Maduro and his circle.
190c8c1560: US destroyers escort merchant ships in the Strait of Hormuz, under air cover. The operation is suspended two days later.
197dcd77b4: Volvo agrees to pay nearly 20 million dollars to the SEC and the Justice Department for kickbacks paid to the Iraqi regime by subsidiaries under the UN programme.
198753bdbf: At the Rome conference, Condoleezza Rice opposes a call for an immediate ceasefire, supported by most participants. The war lasts until August 14.
19a3069382: Military aid suspended over the ICC

For lack of an immunity agreement for Americans before the ICC, Slovenia loses its military aid on 1 July 2003. In November Bush grants a limited waiver for NATO integration and for operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.
19c53d1911: Washington restricts visas for South Africans accused of supporting racial discrimination, expropriation without compensation and incitement to violence. Pretoria demands respect for its sovereignty.
19f68ae33d: After Iraqi troops enter Erbil, the United States fires dozens of cruise missiles at air defenses in the south and widens the no-fly zone.
1a108974d3: A congressional report shows that the base's jet fuel contracts benefited companies linked to the families of Presidents Akayev and Bakiyev.
1a4ce1c3fe: After missile fire on two warships, CENTCOM strikes three Iranian tankers, near Kharg, near Jask and in the Gulf of Oman, described as a “shadow fleet” financing the Guards.
1a53d85017: A memo from John Poindexter plans to make Gaddafi believe in an internal plot and new strikes. The American press is fed false information. The Washington Post reveals it in October.
1a5ab4f61e: Donald Trump proposes that the United States take control of Gaza and that its inhabitants be moved to other countries. The UN recalls the ban on forced transfers.
1a724fb254: GCHQ attaches probes to more than 200 fiber-optic cables landing in the United Kingdom and stores the traffic for up to 30 days; the NSA has access to it. Revealed by The Guardian in June 2013.
1a8111c2b8: Raymond Davis freed in exchange for blood money
The CIA agent is released after payment of $2.4 million in diya to the victims' families. Washington denies having paid. Families say they were pressured.
1a8faa356e: The USS Chafee shells Islamist fighters from the sea near Bargal, in Puntland. Washington says it is targeting al-Qaeda members.
1a92678564: The 1974 trade law deprives the USSR of normal trade status as long as it restricts emigration, notably of Jews. Russia only exits it in 2012.
1a93500d9b: The Treasury sanctions the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, a paramilitary conglomerate, for violations of Uyghur rights.
1ab3231999: A US bomb on a building in the al-Jadida district causes it to collapse. The Pentagon acknowledges 105 civilians killed, the deadliest of the campaign.
1ab9697407: American envoy Dean Acheson proposes to attach Cyprus to Greece, with a sovereign base and Turkish enclaves. Makarios rejects the plan, which in his view amounts to partition and the end of independence.
1ac3239cbe: At Camp King, the CIA subjects prisoners and suspected agents to interrogations under drugs as part of the Artichoke program, a forerunner of MK-Ultra.
1acd81952e: American sanctions against Lukoil threaten the largest refinery in the Balkans. Sofia appoints a special administrator to take control of it; the Treasury grants a temporary licence to Lukoil's Bulgarian entities.
1aed8672f6: Ethiopia invades Somalia to oust the Islamic courts, with U.S. intelligence and support. The occupation provokes deadly fighting in Mogadishu.
1af6de6e6e: American troops land at Chongqing to protect Americans during a political crisis. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1af945481c: Biden authorizes a first presidential drawdown (PDA) of $60 million, including Javelin missiles, announced during Zelensky's visit to Washington.
1b10427839: A US Navy F/A-18 shoots down a Syrian fighter jet that had bombed Syrian Democratic Forces positions. It is the first US air-to-air victory since 1999.
1b162fea82: CIA creates and pays the Greek KYP

The Greek intelligence service KYP is founded on the CIA model, with the help of Greek-American agents such as Thomas Karamessines. Until 1964, its agents are paid by the Americans, a practice that George Papandreou ends.
1b4684716d: Anonymous officials accuse France of having supplied passports to Iraqi dignitaries. The French embassy denounces a disinformation campaign in writing.
1b4c1ff4af: Rape of a schoolgirl in Okinawa
Three American servicemen abduct and rape a 12-year-old girl. They are convicted in Japan; the case provokes massive protests against the bases.
1b5e3f3819: Funds drawn from secret arms sales to Iran finance the Contras despite the congressional ban (Boland Amendment). A commission and a special prosecutor establish this.
1b631ad045: Condor communicates via the Canal Zone
Ambassador Robert White reports that the Operation Condor services communicate through an American facility in the Panama Canal Zone. Declassified cable.
1b9b61a00a: Nigerian soldiers transported by helicopters leased by Chevron kill two Ijaw protesters who were occupying the platform. An American jury finds Chevron not liable in 2008.
1bb4d1a0cc: Security forces in Aden after the USS Cole
After the attack on the destroyer USS Cole, U.S. military personnel are sent to Aden to provide security and support the investigation. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1bc1fe55b0: Donald Trump considers trade sanctions on Spain, which refuses the target of 5% of GDP for defense set at NATO.
1bcfabdc28: Badaber Listening Base Leased to the CIA and NSA
Pakistan leases the United States a station near Peshawar to intercept Soviet communications. Francis Gary Powers's U-2 takes off from there in 1960. The base closes in 1970.
1bdc3ffbe9: American bombers target the station and rail junction of Pisa. The bombs also hit neighboring districts and kill several hundred civilians.
1bfef04767: The State Department launches a campaign to keep any country from selling arms to Iran, then at war with Iraq.
1c06c0f8c7: Hakimullah Mehsud killed on the eve of talks
Dande Darpa Khel, North Waziristan, Pakistan
A CIA strike kills the leader of the Pakistani Taliban on the eve of the opening of negotiations with Islamabad, which accuses Washington of sabotaging peace.
1c17655199: Colonel Joseph Pendleton's Marines advance from Monte Cristi toward Santiago and crush resistance at Las Trencheras and then Guayacanes.
1c235e45c8: Piano Solo: CIA linked to the plan

General De Lorenzo, head of the carabinieri, prepares a plan to arrest the left at the request of President Segni. Historians claim it was devised with CIA station chief William Harvey and Vernon Walters; the American role remains debated.
1c34fb5fd8: General John Pershing attacks Moros entrenched on Mount Bagsak. Several hundred defenders are killed, including women and children.
1c77313423: The Atlacatl battalion kills nearly a thousand civilians, including many children. The UN Truth Commission establishes it. Washington had denied the facts.
1ca3a2c88d: Strike on the Minab girls' school

Tomahawk missiles hit a primary school next to a Revolutionary Guards base: about 156 dead, including some 120 children. A preliminary military inquiry points to the United States; a UN mission sees a possible war crime.
1cacbf7191: In 2002, strikes in the no-fly zone intensify to destroy Iraqi defenses before the invasion, as General T. Michael Moseley acknowledged in 2003.
1ccfea10b9: The CIA uses the Zairian base at Kamina, with Mobutu's agreement, to funnel arms to UNITA.
1d030dc444: Sami al-Saadi handed over to Gaddafi

Libyan opposition figure Sami al-Saadi, his wife and their four children are arrested in Hong Kong and sent back to Tripoli, where he is tortured. Libyan archives reveal the role of the CIA and MI6 in 2011; London compensates him in 2012.
1d1731ffd5: U.S. Navy Skyraider aircraft destroy the Hwacheon Dam's floodgates with torpedoes, to prevent the enemy from controlling the river's waters.
1d1b278c04: According to CNN and the New York Times, the CIA exfiltrates one of its informants inside the Russian presidential administration, described as close to Yuri Ushakov.
1d1e564a7a: A thousand troops sent to Panama

During the crisis with Noriega, Washington sends about 1,000 troops to Panama in March and April 1988, in addition to the 10,000 already stationed there. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1d299f0a73: RB-29 Shot Down Over the Sea of Japan
A U.S. Air Force RB-29 reconnaissance aircraft disappears after an attack by Soviet fighters. The twelve crew members are never found.
1d29eb0972: 95 million FCPA fine against Magyar Telekom

Magyar Telekom and its parent Deutsche Telekom pay 95 million dollars to the DOJ and the SEC for bribes in Macedonia and Montenegro. The SEC also sues three former Hungarian executives, including ex-CEO Elek Straub.
1d2ffbb0d8: After the invasion of Kuwait, Bush sends troops and aircraft to Saudi Arabia. The deployment reaches more than 500,000 soldiers. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1d6c1a5cb8: Abu Yahya al-Libi killed by a drone
A CIA strike kills al-Qaeda's number two. Islamabad protests a violation of its sovereignty.
1d7dc5b3bc: Sanofi pays 25 million under the FCPA
The SEC accuses Sanofi of bribes paid by its subsidiaries in Kazakhstan and the Middle East. The French pharmaceutical group agrees to pay 25.2 million dollars.
1d853d04c4: American and Canadian white supremacists, including Don Black, plan a coup to reinstall Patrick John. Arrested in New Orleans by federal agents, they claim to have believed in a tacit green light from Washington.
1d9443700e: Fugitives from Somalia handed over to Ethiopia
Dozens of people arrested in Kenya after the fall of the Islamic courts are sent back to Somalia and then to Ethiopia. U.S. agents interrogate them in secret detention, according to HRW and the AP.
1d9b7d0ae8: The B-29 Bockscar drops the “Fat Man” bomb. Between 40,000 and 80,000 people die by the end of 1945.
1dcc55103c: NATO helicopters against a Pakistani post
U.S. helicopters cross the border and kill two to three Pakistani soldiers. Pakistan closes the Torkham crossing. Washington apologizes.
1de5727687: Once the Soviets have left Afghanistan, Bush refuses to certify that Pakistan has no nuclear weapon. Military and economic aid is cut off and F-16s already paid for are not delivered.
1decfaa926: Patriots and F-16s kept in Jordan
After an exercise, Obama leaves Patriot batteries and F-16s in Jordan, with about 700 military personnel. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1dfc9a7f11: Washington funds, through the National Endowment for Democracy, the “No” campaign against Pinochet and the monitoring of the vote.
1e08a69d7b: Biden announces a $200 million drawdown during Zelensky's visit, while Congress blocks new funding.
1e0b0bc273: Paris acknowledges the past existence of a clandestine “stay-behind” network, presented as dissolved. It was coordinated with the CIA and MI6 by the Clandestine Planning Committee, attached to SHAPE, based near Paris until 1967.
1e0d28cb87: Articles and Cartoons Paid for by the CIA
According to the CIA's internal history, the station buys Iranian newspapers and journalists to publish articles and cartoons portraying Mossadegh as an ally of the Communists.
1e25eb7dbf: Faced with the Frente Amplio, Nixon and Médici's Brazil discuss discreet support; Nixon later tells Prime Minister Heath that Brazil “helped rig” the election, according to declassified archives.
1e26bf996a: After Olof Palme marches against the Vietnam War alongside the North Vietnamese ambassador to Moscow, Washington recalls its ambassador William Heath. The post remains vacant until 1970.
1e2a76afad: Austria files a complaint against the NSA and the BND
Selectors passed by the NSA to the BND targeted Austrian administrations and companies. The Interior Ministry files a complaint against persons unknown for espionage to the detriment of Austria.
1e35878381: Veto shielding the South African invasion
Washington stands alone in blocking in the Security Council a resolution condemning Operation Protea, a South African army incursion into Angola's Cunene province.
1e43c8b24d: US Air Force C-130s drop Belgian paratroopers on the city held by the Simba. Hundreds of hostages are freed, others are killed.
1e555b4eb1: Before the Incheon landing, U.S. Navy aircraft napalm the island of Wolmido. The Truth and Reconciliation Commission concludes in 2008 that civilians were killed indiscriminately.
1e55bf9e81: Washington justifies the invasion by the threat to American students at St. George's University. The school's leaders had said they were not in danger.
1eb0d4df1c: Wounded and captured at 15, Canadian Omar Khadr is held at Bagram and then Guantánamo, where he is tried by a military commission. Canada compensates him in 2017.
1ed40111fd: According to Reuters, citing intelligence sources, the United States tries to infect the North Korean nuclear program with a version of Stuxnet. The operation fails for lack of access to the targeted machines.
1ee2f095a7: According to Vanity Fair (2008), Washington secretly arms Fatah against Hamas, the election winner, which precipitates the battle of Gaza.
1f1778c6b3: Gulf Oil pressed to freeze royalties
Under pressure from the State Department, Gulf Oil suspends its activities in Cabinda and blocks its payments to the MPLA government installed in Luanda. The company resumes its payments in 1976.
1f232113f7: The US Trade Representative announces port fees on ships built or operated by Chinese companies, following a “Section 301” investigation.
1f43e1fdbe: A U.S. Navy P2V Neptune patrol aircraft on a reconnaissance mission is shot down by Soviet fighters off Vladivostok. All ten men on board disappear.
1f54db78f6: Soldier William Girard shoots dead Sakai Naka, a woman collecting shell casings on a firing range. Washington agrees to a Japanese trial that ends in a suspended sentence, then Girard returns to the United States.
1f5c1f410e: Secretary of State Stimson bans arms sales to Getúlio Vargas's insurgents and supplies arms to Washington Luís's government, overthrown a few days later.
1f6297e156: Nyerere's government expels two American diplomats, including Frank Carlucci, accusing them of subversive activities. Washington denies it.
1f6d58b228: As part of Project AERODYNAMIC, the CIA funds the Prolog publishing house, run by Mykola Lebed, which distributes books and magazines in Soviet Ukraine until 1991. The files have been declassified.
1f77933057: Herbicides sprayed from South Vietnam ravage rubber plantations and crops. An American mission concludes the spraying was deliberate.
1f9259dcef: The Treasury sanctions Rosneft Trading, a Swiss subsidiary of Rosneft, for its role in marketing Venezuelan oil.
1f9b7d476f: Four days before the invasion, Dick Cheney says on television that Saddam Hussein has “reconstituted nuclear weapons.” The International Atomic Energy Agency had found no trace of such a program.
1fc4837805: Green Berets open a regional military training center in Honduras to train Salvadoran and Honduran soldiers. It closes in 1985.
1fc7b5935a: An agreement concluded with France, without the sultan, allows the United States to build Strategic Air Command bases at Nouasseur, Sidi Slimane and Benguérir. Nuclear bombers are stationed there until 1963.
1fca57fbc8: The CIA holds prisoners in a former riding school near Vilnius in 2005 and 2006. The ECHR convicts Lithuania in 2018.
1fd47a6c5f: At the height of the Cuban crisis, Charles Maultsby's U-2 enters Soviet airspace. MiGs take off and Khrushchev denounces a provocation.
1fd98db37b: Iranian aircraft shot down with AWACS help
Saudi fighters, guided by an American AWACS and refueled by an American KC-10, shoot down two Iranian aircraft over the Gulf. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
1fdfbfdefa: According to Seymour Hersh (New Yorker, 2008), Bush signs a secret directive funding operations in Iran, including support for Baluch and Kurdish armed groups. Washington does not confirm it.
2010a58c65: Iranian oil seized and prize law
The tankers Tifani and Majestic X, seized in April with about $600 million of crude, head for the United States. Justice revives maritime prize law to confiscate them.
20122f02d5: Colonel Edward Lansdale of the CIA leads a covert warfare team to install and consolidate Ngô Đình Diệm. His report appears in the Pentagon Papers.
20285c7480: A $400 million drawdown with, for the first time, Avenger air defense systems and Stinger missiles.
2069c2b258: Assassination of Imad Mughniyeh in Damascus

The military chief of Hezbollah is killed by a car bomb. According to the Washington Post and Newsweek (2015), the operation was carried out jointly by the CIA and Mossad, with the bomb tested in the United States.
207aab2c2f: A B-29 on a leaflet-dropping mission is shot down near the Yalu. Eleven captured airmen are convicted of espionage in China and released in 1955.
2086fb5ebb: According to Snowden documents published by the South China Morning Post, the NSA hacks Chinese telephone operators to collect millions of text messages.
208f66377f: After the US Air Force shoots down a Chinese balloon, Beijing says American balloons have flown over China more than ten times since 2022. Washington denies it.
20959a35dc: Anthropologist Jeremy Keenan argues that the kidnapping of 32 European tourists by the GSPC was manipulated by Algerian services, with Washington's approval, to justify the militarization of the Sahel. The thesis is disputed.
20a4395bf5: After the sale of machine tools to the USSR by a Toshiba subsidiary, Congress bans government purchases from the group for three years. In 1987, lawmakers had smashed a Toshiba radio in front of the Capitol.
20b3ff8fff: Eisenhower claims “careful neutrality” at a press conference and speaks of “soldiers of fortune,” while the CIA arms and flies for the rebellion. Declassified archives have established the lie.
20c8bbc41a: In January, February and October 1914, American detachments land in Haiti during successive revolutions, according to Congress's official list.
20cad6f367: The generals overthrow Diệm with American agreement and money handed over by CIA agent Lucien Conein. Diệm and his brother are killed the next day.
20de26bc7e: Aid to UNITA maintained under Bush
George H. W. Bush continues aid to Jonas Savimbi, whose lobbyists at Black, Manafort and Stone press for more weapons. Savimbi meets Bush in 1990. Aid ends with the 1991 Bicesse Accords.
20e8b04ce2: The Wall Street Journal reveals that US agencies have been ordered to step up intelligence on the Greenlandic independence movement and on Denmark.
210f9914d1: The B-29 Enola Gay drops the “Little Boy” bomb. Between 70,000 and 140,000 people die by the end of 1945.
2131790802: Since 1950, the CIA has funded and supplied the WiN underground movement, in reality controlled by the Polish security service. Warsaw reveals the manipulation in December 1952.
2149df8a46: Navy Steps In at Puerto Plata
American ships intervene in the civil war and prevent government forces from bombarding Puerto Plata. Washington then imposes the “Wilson Plan” of supervised elections.
215368b194: The day after the invasion, Biden authorizes $350 million in weapons, including Javelins and Stinger anti-aircraft missiles.
21796724db: The head of ENI, who defied the oil majors, dies in the explosion of his plane. Italian justice concludes it was a bombing. CIA involvement, sometimes suggested, is not established.
2189c2b877: The US military drops hundreds of thousands of tonnes of napalm, including Dow Chemical's napalm B. It also supplies the South Vietnamese air force, which carried out the 1972 Trảng Bàng strike.
218e3b0bd4: According to the Snowden documents, the International Atomic Energy Agency is among the organizations targeted as a priority by the NSA. Revealed by Der Spiegel in August 2013.
2197d1da3b: Clare Boothe Luce Warns Italian Voters
Ten days before the elections, the ambassador warns in Milan that a victory by “anti-democratic” parties would have serious consequences for relations with Washington.
219940a777: During the first intifada, Washington blocks the dispatch of a Security Council commission to examine the situation of the Palestinians in the occupied territories.
21af031cdd: Remarks attributed to Hasina accuse Washington of wanting her gone in order to obtain Saint Martin's Island; her son denies she made them, and so does Washington.
21d1546fa9: Two American F-80s strafe the Soviet airfield at Sukhaya Rechka, near Vladivostok, about a hundred kilometers from the Korean border. Washington apologizes.
21d43b53f8: Operation Haik, Arms for the Rebels
The CIA arms the PRRI and Permesta regional rebellions against Sukarno, supplying aircraft and pilots. FRUS archives document the operation.
21ef80fb80: The State Department announces a complete halt to US funding of the UN agency for Palestinian refugees, of which it was the top donor.
21ffed48db: Trump reluctantly signs a law passed by Congress that toughens sanctions on Russia and threatens sanctions on countries that buy its weapons.
2203cd43a6: A NATO missile hits a bridge as a Niš-Pristina bus is crossing. About forty passengers are killed, according to Human Rights Watch.
221fce7406: Family visits limited to one every 3 years
