On the recommendation of the Commission for Assistance to a Free Cuba, Cuban Americans can visit their families only once every three years. Remittances are also restricted.
2235c34c82: According to historian John Prados, the CIA creates the Justice Party as a front organization for the 1964 elections against Cheddi Jagan, in addition to funding the rival parties.
2258ccc84f: Donald Trump says he is interested in the idea of making Venezuela the 51st US state; The New York Times then describes Marco Rubio as the country's de facto “viceroy.”
225d1fd7bf: The United States sets up an air base in Uzbekistan for the war in Afghanistan, in exchange for aid to the Karimov regime. Tashkent expels them in 2005.
225f038a52: Vance attacks European regulation in Paris

At the AI summit at the Grand Palais, Vice President J. D. Vance denounces European “excessive regulation”, targets the DSA and the GDPR and warns against partnerships with China. The United States refuses to sign the final declaration.
22699dc618: Food aid blocked during the famine
During the 1974 famine, Washington delays PL-480 wheat deliveries because Bangladesh is selling jute to Cuba. The country has to give up those sales. The famine kills at least tens of thousands.
227e021ca3: An elite unit kills hundreds of civilians, according to the Toledo Blade (2003). An army investigation conducted from 1971 to 1975 confirms crimes but leads to no prosecutions.
2280261668: According to Der Spiegel, the NSA spies on the Turkish government while cooperating with Ankara against the PKK.
2281332ff6: According to the New York Times (2024), the CIA funds and equips from 2014 a dozen secret Ukrainian intelligence bases along the Russian border.
2282dc38f9: The CIA operates a secret prison in a government building in Bucharest until 2005. The ECHR convicts Romania in 2018.
22af2349a7: Nigerien putschists trained in the US
Several officers of the junta that overthrows Mohamed Bazoum, including General Moussa Salaou Barmou, had been trained in the United States, The Intercept reveals.
22cff25afc: A German raid sinks the SS John Harvey, which is secretly carrying American mustard gas bombs. Sailors and civilians are poisoned; the information is long concealed.
22eddcadbf: Sami al-Hajj held to talk about Al Jazeera

His file shows that this Sudanese Al Jazeera cameraman is held at Guantánamo notably to provide information on the network and its interview with bin Laden. He is released without charge in 2008. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2011.
22eec75dfe: Obama lifts the partial freeze decided after Rabaa and releases F-16s, Harpoon missiles and Abrams tanks, despite the crackdown targeting tens of thousands of opponents.
2336285227: Decision to prevent an Iraqi defeat
According to a sworn statement by Howard Teicher, a former National Security Council staffer, Reagan decides to avoid an Iraqi defeat. The CIA helps Iraq obtain weapons, including cluster bombs.
2361bd843a: A landing force goes ashore for a few hours to protect lives during unrest at Jiujiang. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
236530253c: American aircraft based in Honduras and Panama fly over El Salvador and pass their intelligence to the army to guide its operations, which the Pentagon acknowledges.
2381e0ecf3: Reagan bans the import of Libyan crude oil and makes the export of American technology to Libya subject to license.
2397e9d429: Under the colonial administration, Law 116 legalizes sterilization for eugenic and demographic purposes. It paves the way for “La Operación,” performed on a massive scale in clinics partly funded by federal money.
23b28d59a4: General René Barrientos overthrows Paz Estenssoro. Historians establish his close ties with the US military attaché and Washington's encouragement.
23dca41d10: In February 1946, GHQ's Government Section drafts the constitution in about ten days, and the Japanese government is to adopt it. The American origin of the text remains a subject of debate in Japan.
23f6afc903: Aid cut to the Hamas government
After Hamas's election victory, the United States suspends direct aid to the Palestinian Authority and, with the European Union, obtains a boycott of the elected government.
24041b5977: The Macheteros independence leader is killed in an FBI assault and bleeds for hours. The Justice Department inspector general criticizes the delay.
2404bcff2f: The destroyer USS Nitze fires Tomahawk missiles at three Houthi radar sites, after missiles were fired at U.S. ships.
240d08da64: Senate report on arms sold to the Shah
A report by the Senate Foreign Relations Committee finds that Iran is the largest buyer of American arms and depends on thousands of American technicians.
241bef7644: Before the parliamentary elections, American officials and Ambassador Ronald Weiser make it known that a return of Vladimír Mečiar to power would jeopardise Slovakia's invitation to NATO.
24231ab1a6: Executive Order 13810 allows sanctions on any foreign bank or company doing business with North Korea.
2431905966: Beijing accuses the NSA of having hacked this defense-linked university and stolen sensitive data there.
24464d6897: 3.2 billion in military aid to Zia
The Reagan administration grants General Zia's military regime a 3.2 billion dollar aid program over six years, including F-16s, and has Congress waive the nuclear-related Symington Amendment.
244871f7b6: First delivery via Israel of TOW missiles to Iran, under embargo, in exchange for the hostages in Lebanon. The profits will fund the Contras. The Iran-Contra affair breaks in November 1986.
246484527a: Sweden spies on Russia for the NSA
Sweden's FRA supplies the NSA with “unique” collection on Russian leaders and domestic politics, thanks to its access to Baltic cables. Revealed by SVT television in December 2013.
249e4ca083: Dan Mitrione and torture in Uruguay
American public safety adviser Dan Mitrione trains the Uruguayan police. A former Cuban agent accuses him of having taught torture on prisoners. He is killed by the Tupamaros in 1970.
24b1a62657: On the night of March 11–12, 1945, nearly 300 B-29s drop incendiary bombs on Nagoya. Further raids follow until May and destroy much of the city.
24cd0db046: The UN Truth Commission attributes the order to Roberto D'Aubuisson, who was trained in the United States. Declassified cables show that Washington knew of his role as early as 1981.
24e27832db: Veto on the draft by the ten elected members
Alone against fourteen, the United States blocks a draft demanding an immediate and permanent ceasefire in Gaza.
24e92c2a62: For the fourth anniversary of the 2021 protests, the State Department bans President Miguel Díaz-Canel and the defense and interior ministers from receiving visas.
2512bdc2d5: This German citizen, mistaken for a namesake, is handed over to the CIA and held for four months in the Salt Pit. The ECHR convicts Macedonia in 2012.
253bd6a845: About 14,000 soldiers land at President Chamoun's request, the day after the Iraqi revolution.
25590438fa: Under occupation, Washington secretly aids the campaign of Joaquín Balaguer, who defeats Juan Bosch in the presidential election.
255f0ac226: A $300 million drawdown of ammunition for Patriot and HIMARS systems and artillery.
25dff0a1cc: The Marines leave Haiti in August 1934, but an American fiscal representative keeps control of Haitian finances until the loan is repaid, in 1947.
25e4bbfb0f: Harbin police name three alleged NSA agents, accused of attacking the Games' systems and Heilongjiang infrastructure.
2606b49968: Military advisers sent back to Iraq
Faced with the Islamic State's advance, Obama sends up to 300 military advisers to Iraq, three years after the withdrawal. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
260eacc053: The junta ends the military agreement with Washington after a visit by a US delegation, which it accuses of threats and condescension over its ties with Russia and Iran. US troops leave in August.
263b1b4565: American Lieutenant Colonel Robert Thierry helps organize Stroessner's Technical Affairs Directorate, a torture center, according to the “Archives of Terror.”
264bb361e4: The Trump administration freezes and then eliminates most USAID aid programs, including HIV treatments and food aid in dozens of countries.
264eff8fa2: The CIA's Donald Wilber and MI6's Norman Darbyshire draft the plan for Operation TPAJAX in Cyprus. The document is cited in the CIA's internal history revealed in 2000.
265600ab98: The United States drops 24 bombs over the ocean near Christmas Island, then a British colony. Gilbertese workers and military personnel are exposed to the tests.
26a6447bc4: General Frederick Funston captures President Emilio Aguinaldo by posing, with Macabebe scouts, as a column escorting American prisoners.
26a6bf3e92: Biden signs the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act, which eases the lending or leasing of military equipment to Ukraine and Eastern European countries.
26dbd1dabc: Marine Force During the Cuban Crisis
The 2nd Marine Ground Task Force is deployed to protect American nationals during the Cuban crisis, in 1959 and 1960. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
26fbb2a70a: Prosecuted in California over the disguised takeover of the insurer Executive Life, Crédit Lyonnais, the French state through the CDR and their partners agree to pay 771 million dollars to close the criminal case.
271a94ed36: In the middle of the oil strike, the White House calls for early elections in Venezuela, echoing the opposition's demand, before correcting its position.
2724a82799: The South Korean state organizes prostitution around American bases, with forced health checks, in coordination with the US military. In 2022, the Supreme Court orders the state to compensate the victims.
273bf2202d: The Senate committee chaired by Frank Church publishes its report on assassination plots. It establishes at least eight CIA plots against Fidel Castro between 1960 and 1965.
27476d61ef: American Green Berets oversee Colonel Arana Osorio's campaign against the guerrillas in the East. It kills thousands, mostly civilians.
27654872cc: Maduro blames a US cyberattack; experts point instead to poor maintenance of the grid linked to the Guri dam.
27b1a49314: The same day, the US air force bombs the stations and railway lines of Lyon. Bombs also fall on the Vaise and Guillotière districts and kill hundreds of civilians.
27b9e40135: During the Syrian crisis, Washington airlifts arms to Jordan, Lebanon and Iraq, deploys the 6th Fleet and encourages Turkey to mass troops on the Syrian border.
27c3b99443: Trump's budget law creates a 1% tax on cash transfers abroad, which first hits remittances from Mexicans to their families.
27d320709b: On Trump's order, who mentions a capacity of 30,000 places, the first migrants deported from the United States are sent to the base. Associations denounce detention outside the law.
27e0cf9f6a: Noriega offers to assassinate the Sandinistas
Noriega offers Oliver North to have Sandinista leaders killed in exchange for help polishing his image. North passes it to Poindexter. The proposal appears in the Iran-Contra files.
27e2e26380: Nuland and McCain on the Maidan
Victoria Nuland hands out food to protesters, then Senator John McCain addresses the crowd. Moscow sees direct interference.
28038adb20: Troops let ministries, hospitals and the National Museum be looted, while the Oil Ministry is guarded. Rumsfeld downplays it: “stuff happens.” The law of occupation requires protecting such sites.
280496c63b: The American fleet crosses the “line of death”: it strikes missile sites and sinks Libyan patrol boats. Dozens of Libyan sailors are killed.
282c7f4ccc: During the Laotian crisis, Kennedy deploys about 5,000 soldiers, including Marines, in northeastern Thailand. The country becomes the rear base for the war in Indochina.
284183f092: Manuel Contreras paid by the CIA
The CIA makes the head of the DINA secret police a contact and pays him money once, despite his known crimes. It acknowledged this in 2000.
285d8cf5fd: Navy SEAL commandos attack an al-Qaeda hideout. Hostages Luke Somers and Pierre Korkie, whose release by ransom was under negotiation, are killed.
28620d5943: Greece buys Crypto AG machines, a Swiss company secretly owned by the CIA and the BND. According to the 2020 revelations, the German services were surprised that the Americans also spied on NATO allies such as Greece.
2866bb7f50: According to several investigations, the CIA passes to the Iranian regime names of Tudeh communist party members supplied by a KGB defector. Arrests and executions follow.
2868bd6ccf: Al-Nashiri tortured at the Thai black site

Abd al-Rahim al-Nashiri is subjected to waterboarding at the CIA's “Site Green,” described in the Senate torture report. The report does not name the country; journalists and researchers place it in Thailand.
289aed6dd6: The CIA proposes an economic destabilization operation against Maurice Bishop's government. The Senate intelligence committee opposes it, according to the Washington Post.
28a4b4fb21: Alleged explosion of the Siberian pipeline
According to Thomas Reed's memoirs (2004), CIA-sabotaged software caused a huge explosion on a Siberian gas pipeline. No Soviet source confirms it and the account is disputed.
28f425cdb3: Arrested by the Tupamaros, police officer Nelson Bardesio claims that the death squad is linked to police officers trained by the OPS and to an American adviser. The accusation is not officially corroborated.
29079ede3a: The CIA funds the parties of Forbes Burnham and Peter D'Aguiar for the December 1964 elections, which remove Jagan from power, according to the FRUS archives.
29422143df: The destroyers USS Noa and Preston, with British ships, bombard Nanjing to cover the evacuation of foreigners. Chinese civilians are killed.
2966e20162: The Provisional Authority introduces protection for patented plant varieties, which bars farmers from replanting protected seeds. NGOs denounce a text favorable to foreign seed companies.
297b6917be: WTO complaint against the GMO moratorium
With Canada and Argentina, Washington challenges before the WTO the European moratorium on GMO authorisations. The panel rules in favour of the complainants in 2006.
297fe2db5b: France definitively abandons the sale and refunds Russia. The two ships are resold to Egypt. For France, it means lost revenue and an industrial crisis.
29ea311b6e: Washington raises to 35% the tariffs on Canadian goods not covered by the USMCA.
29fba5a9ea: The U.S. Navy bombards Wonsan almost without interruption from February 1951 to the armistice. It is the longest naval siege in the U.S. Navy's recent history.
2a2a3db146: Washington imposes new countervailing duties on softwood lumber, reviving a trade dispute that has lasted several decades.
2a435140c3: The US-led coalition launches the ground offensive against Iraqi forces in Kuwait and southern Iraq. Fighting stops after about a hundred hours.
2a4398f9a7: Guantánamo detainees hidden from the ICRC

The Camp Delta manual signed by General Geoffrey Miller provides for denying some detainees any Red Cross visit and for two weeks of isolation to facilitate interrogation. Published by WikiLeaks in 2007.
2a5ad71bec: USAID Office of Transition Initiatives in Caracas
After the coup, USAID opens an Office of Transition Initiatives (OTI) in Caracas, which funds opposition associations and parties through contractors.
2a66dac23e: Horacio Cartes sanctioned by the Treasury
OFAC freezes the assets of former president Cartes and his companies, accusing him of corruption and ties to Hezbollah, which he denies.
2a82aafdfa: Kissinger's green light to the Argentine junta
Kissinger tells Argentine minister Guzzetti that if things have to be done, they should be done quickly. The declassified record shows a green light for the repression.
2a9c12edc6: Taiwanese U-2 shot down at Baotou
A U-2 of the “Black Cats” is shot down in Inner Mongolia. Pilot Chang Liyi, captured, is held for seventeen years.
2aaf552668: Obama expels 35 diplomats, closes two Russian properties and sanctions the GRU and the FSB in retaliation for interference in the U.S. presidential election.
2ab567c715: New strike campaign in southern Iran
The United States launches a series of strikes against the Revolutionary Guards in southern Iran, returning to military action after the sanctions phase.
2ab9a6a413: The head of the CIA's Western Hemisphere Division recommends considering “the elimination of Fidel Castro.” Allen Dulles approves the memo. The Church Committee cites it in 1975.
2abd24bc63: After the invasion, Operation Just Cause gives way to Promote Liberty: the American army oversees the setting up of the new government and its security forces until 1994.
2abf0707d8: Two billion USAI for the anniversary
A $2 billion USAI package including drones and ammunition for artillery and HIMARS, announced a year after the invasion.
2abf4da071: At Washington's request, Canada arrests Huawei's chief financial officer for evading sanctions on Iran. Beijing denounces economic hostage-taking.
2ad639f40c: Consul Archer Blood denounces a “selective genocide” by the Pakistani army. Nixon and Kissinger maintain their support for Yahya Khan during the massacres, which kill hundreds of thousands.
2adabdeff2: Israel uses American cluster bombs against populated areas. Reagan suspends their deliveries in July, the State Department finding a violation of the sales agreements likely.
2afd8ce765: Cruise missiles target an industrial complex near Baghdad; one of them crashes into the al-Rashid Hotel and kills two civilians. The Pentagon attributes it to a malfunction.
2b148eefc6: North Korean MiGs shoot down a US Navy EC-121 electronic intelligence aircraft on a listening mission off North Korea. All 31 crew members die.
2b44ead95d: Marines in Shanghai Facing the Japanese
American forces land to protect American interests during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
2b52f33e69: Death of Gul Rahman at the Salt Pit
An Afghan detainee dies of hypothermia, chained half-naked to the concrete floor of the CIA's secret prison. No prosecutions.
2b77542c80: During the 1955 parliamentary elections, the CIA pays about a million dollars to the Masyumi party to counter Sukarno and the Communists.
2b8225a22a: From January 1944 to April 1945, Allied air forces based in Italy, including the US air force, bomb Maribor, an industrial centre under German occupation. Nearly half of the city is flattened and hundreds of civilians are killed.
2b8cc3c4df: Listening station at the Bangkok embassy
The NSA map published by Der Spiegel in 2013 lists the U.S. embassy in Bangkok among the Special Collection Service sites tasked with intercepting communications.
2b9f0f0247: The hidden count of civilian deaths

While the Pentagon said it did not count civilians killed, its war logs record 66,081 civilian deaths from 2004 to 2009. Iraq Body Count finds 15,000 previously unknown deaths in them. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
2ba19b706e: A $1 billion package ($350 million in drawdown and $650 million USAI) including Harpoon coastal systems and howitzers.
2ba32973c4: After the failure of the Islamabad talks, the US Navy imposes a blockade on any ship entering or leaving Iranian ports. The Pentagon puts Iran's oil losses at $4.8 billion as of May 1.
2bb95e7d7c: This detainee dies during a CIA interrogation, suspended by his arms behind his back. His body on ice appears in the Abu Ghraib photos. No agent is prosecuted.
2bbae4e6eb: Announced during a visit by Lloyd Austin to Kyiv, this $100 million drawdown includes artillery and ammunition.
2bc09f7239: An October 2006 NSA memo shows that a senior U.S. official handed over 200 numbers, including those of 35 unnamed foreign leaders, which were then tapped. Revealed by The Guardian in October 2013.
2bd026125a: US Army helicopters sink three Iranian boats in the Gulf, killing several sailors, during Operation Prime Chance.
2bfba2ca6d: Obama signs the Ukraine Freedom Support Act. The law authorizes new sanctions against Russia's defense and energy sectors and up to $350 million in military aid to Ukraine.
2c17fc65bd: During Zelensky's visit, Biden announces $5.5 billion in drawdowns and $2.4 billion USAI, including JSOW glide bombs.
2c188d9a63: With the active backing of Washington, opposed to any reinforcement, the Security Council reduces the UN mission in Rwanda to 270 men as the massacres spread.
2c21ed55d4: The Philippine Commission authorizes provincial governors to forcibly regroup the population of areas where “bandits” operate, legalizing the camps used during the war.
2c4456b535: NATO aircraft, including U.S. F-16s, bomb a convoy of Albanian refugees: about 70 dead. NATO acknowledges its error.
2c49bf7f04: Press investigations claim that Washington funded and encouraged the union of the centrist parties behind Herbert Blaize, who wins the December 1984 elections.
2c8264e71e: Nixon and Kissinger encourage Jordan and Iran to transfer American combat aircraft to Pakistan during the war with India, in violation of American law.
2ca6c2abec: A warning to the Condor regimes against assassinations abroad is not delivered, on instructions relayed in Kissinger's name. Orlando Letelier is killed shortly afterward.
2cbb6a5f10: Alleged green light for the Iraqi invasion

According to notes from Alexander Haig's 1981 trip, Saudi prince Fahd reportedly told him that Carter had given Saddam Hussein a “green light” via Saudi Arabia. Iran accuses Washington; Carter's officials deny it and no direct proof has been published.
2ccc69b045: School of the Americas in the Canal Zone
The U.S. Army opens a training center for Latin American military personnel, the future “School of the Americas.” Several of its former students go on to lead dictatorships or commit massacres.
2cf9258ac6: Drums buried on a former Kadena site contain dioxin and herbicides. Former soldiers say Agent Orange was stored in Okinawa. The Pentagon denies it.
2d0055d54a: Refusal to extradite Sánchez de Lozada
The United States rejects the extradition request for the former Bolivian president, prosecuted for the October 2003 crackdown that left about sixty dead. A Florida jury finds him liable in 2018.
2d168ae575: The SEC reveals that United Brands, formerly United Fruit, paid 1.25 million dollars to Honduran officials to reduce a banana tax. General López Arellano is overthrown.
2d2d986f61: After the RAF, American aircraft hit Dresden on February 14 and 15. Between 18,000 and 25,000 people die according to the 2010 historical commission.
2d33d654e1: Arrested with CIA support, the alleged leader of Jemaah Islamiyah disappears for three years into the agency's secret prisons before Guantánamo, where he is still held without a final trial.
2d38ac43f3: Sanctions on VEB and Russian debt
After the recognition of the Donbas republics, Washington sanctions VEB and Promsvyazbank and bans trading in Russian sovereign debt.
2d58f60514: Washington announces that no country will be able to buy Iranian oil without facing sanctions from May 2, in order to bring Iranian exports to zero.
2d7bb3b8ea: Ahead of the Constituent Assembly election, the Treasury sanctions thirteen Venezuelan civilian and military officials.
2d9121146f: Aircraft funded by Plan Colombia and partly flown by U.S. contractors spray glyphosate on coca crops. Ecuador takes the matter to the International Court of Justice in 2008 over cross-border damage.
2d918f8063: With no agreement with Paul Singer's funds, a New York court prevents Argentina from paying its other creditors: the country falls into selective default.
2db282c8e6: Victoria Nuland says the United States has invested more than $5 billion since 1991 to support democracy in Ukraine. Moscow cites this figure as proof of the funding of the Maidan.
2db4edeaf4: A $2.3 billion package ($150 million in drawdown and $2.2 billion USAI) including Patriot and NASAMS interceptors.
2dd5e6409c: Hong Kong networks smuggle out hundreds of dissidents after Tiananmen. Beijing and several accounts mention CIA and MI6 help, never confirmed.
2de370296f: Bucharest summit: promise of NATO membership
Under pressure from Washington, the summit declares that Ukraine and Georgia “will become members of NATO.” Moscow sees a direct threat.
2e02dbdf25: Trump signs an executive order declaring Nicaragua a threat to national security and sanctions Vice President Rosario Murillo.
2e1cddf72e: Lists of communists handed to the army
Diplomats from the US embassy, including Robert Martens, hand the army lists of thousands of communist cadres. The 1965-1966 massacres kill at least 500,000 people.
2e2df219ad: American Aircraft Shot Down Over a Sugar Mill

A small aircraft from Florida explodes while attacking the España sugar mill. The American pilot Robert Ellis Frost dies. Cuba accuses Washington of letting these raids leave from its soil; Washington expresses regret and denies any responsibility.
2e7b82a936: 5G memorandum imposed against Huawei in Romania

Klaus Iohannis signs with Donald Trump a 5G memorandum that excludes suppliers “subject to control by another state”. The US ambassador to the EU later tells Bucharest that the goal is a Romania “without Huawei”.
2e81ac2444: An executive order by Donald Trump bars Venezuela and PDVSA from refinancing their debt on US markets. Economists blame it for worsening the crisis.
2e95f117f4: The inhabitants of Enewetak are transferred to Ujelang Atoll to free their atoll for tests. They will not return until 1980.
2ebbb562ec: At Washington's request, the OAS votes to have its members break diplomatic and trade relations with Cuba. Only Mexico refuses to implement the decision.
2f0c7fb384: In reprisal for an alleged plot against George H. W. Bush in Kuwait, 23 cruise missiles target Baghdad. Some fall on a residential neighborhood and kill the artist Leila al-Attar.
2f131ae2b7: According to the New York Times and Snowden documents published in 2015, the NSA penetrates North Korean networks as early as 2010 via China and Malaysia and implants spyware in them.
2f259413f1: Moscow bans the National Endowment for Democracy, funded by Congress, which supported Russian NGOs. It is the first organization hit by the 2015 law.
2f2a4e8078: New $800 million package with 72 155 mm howitzers, 144,000 shells and more than 120 Phoenix Ghost drones.
2f5570c8d3: After a meeting with Zelensky at the White House, Trump says he prefers not to deliver Tomahawk cruise missiles, which he deems needed by the United States.
2f777ca434: Washington has credit from the Eximbank, the World Bank and the IDB blocked for Allende's Chile, while maintaining aid to the army.
2fb28377f7: Liberia grants Firestone up to one million acres for 99 years, at six cents an acre. The agreement also imposes a $5 million loan from a Firestone-linked company, which reinforces American financial control.
2fbd86eb90: NATO cluster bombs fall on the market and near the hospital: about fifteen civilians killed. NATO acknowledges an error.
2fe4939544: A March 1964 State Department memorandum states that American agents “assiduously cultivated” the Baathist student organization whose strike at the University of Baghdad triggered the February 8, 1963 coup.
2fe60f7444: RB-47 Shot Down in the Barents Sea
An American reconnaissance aircraft is shot down by a Soviet fighter near the Kola Peninsula. Two survivors are held in Moscow until 1961.
300862f7d0: After the armistice, the US Third Army occupies a zone of the Rhineland around Koblenz, where it sets up its headquarters. American troops remain there until early 1923.
3012a5b265: After the failure of PBFORTUNE, Eisenhower approves a new plan to overthrow Árbenz, entrusted to the CIA with a budget of several million dollars. The CIA's internal history declassified in 1997 details it.
301e75e9fb: Talaat Fouad Qassem handed to Egypt
This Gamaa Islamiya leader is abducted in Croatia and handed to Egypt in an operation set up with the CIA, then disappears. It is one of the first extraordinary renditions.
3065149421: Sidewinder missiles secretly supplied by the United States allow Taiwanese F-86s to shoot down Chinese MiGs. It is the first air combat won with missiles.
3078ee0211: Documents show that Washington knew of the preparations and welcomed them. A direct CIA role, asserted by John Stockwell, remains debated.
307ac623e6: Carter breaks diplomatic relations and bans exports to Iran, then imports on 17 April.
307c4986b8: General James Van Fleet takes charge of the American military mission (JUSMAPG), which advises the Greek general staff until the Communists' defeat in 1949.
3090baa546: Two guided bombs pierce an air-raid shelter in the Amiriyah district and kill more than 400 civilians, mostly women and children. The Pentagon says it targeted a command center.
309be43df9: During the Constitutionalist War, Marines land on Nicaragua's Caribbean coast, officially to protect foreigners.
309c67ad48: More than a hundred American B-24s bomb Taipei, then a Japanese colony. The raid kills about 3,000 people, mostly civilians.
30b99f2b21: The United States opens a base at Manas airport for the war in Afghanistan. It closes in 2014 after years of disputes with the Kyrgyz authorities.
310818dee1: American soldiers kill about 70 Italian and German prisoners. A sergeant is convicted; a captain is acquitted.
3126db041b: Iraqi troops enter Erbil with the KDP and dismantle the Iraqi National Congress base. Opponents linked to the CIA are executed; Washington then evacuates thousands of allies to Guam.
312f385d01: A strike on Arg Square shatters the Hall of Mirrors of the UNESCO-listed Golestan Palace. In Isfahan, Chehel Sotoun Palace and Naqsh-e Jahan Square are also hit. More than 130 heritage sites are damaged in 40 days.
313c01ba7d: George W. Bush imposes safeguard duties of 8 to 30% on imported steel, which mainly hit Europe. The WTO rules them illegal in November 2003; under threat of European retaliation, Washington lifts them in December 2003.
313eccd685: American bombers that had lost their target mistakenly hit Nijmegen, a city in an occupied country: about 800 dead.
3142384544: RIAS During the East Berlin Uprising

The American sector's radio broadcasts the strikers' demands and the call to demonstrate on June 17. East Germany accuses Washington of having fomented the uprising, which the archives do not confirm.
3177464efc: The Johnson administration helps Forbes Burnham rig the first elections after independence, which he wins against Cheddi Jagan. Documented by historian Stephen Rabe.
3192e3725f: The Treasury sanctions the mayor of Ventspils for corruption under the Global Magnitsky Act, along with the Ventspils free port and three associations.
31b9da31c4: Threats against the port of Sassnitz
Three US senators threaten the management of the port of Mukran with “financial destruction” if it continues to serve the Nord Stream 2 project.
31c0a7dd26: National City Bank Takes Over the Bank of Haiti
New York's National City Bank buys the National Bank of the Republic of Haiti, which manages the Treasury. The New York Times investigation “The Ransom” (2022) details its role in the occupation.
31e9e43d34: Berlusconi and Ban Ki-moon eavesdropped on
WikiLeaks publishes NSA intercepts targeting Silvio Berlusconi and a conversation between Ban Ki-moon and Angela Merkel on climate.
31eca866fc: Atlacatl soldiers kill six Jesuits, their housekeeper and her daughter. Most of the officers implicated had been through the School of the Americas.
327aa8dfb8: Marco Rubio orders Panama to reduce Chinese influence over the canal, which Trump threatens to take back. Panama then leaves the Belt and Road Initiative.
3298d52753: Belgian stay-behind network SDRA8 and STC/Mob

After the Italian revelations, Brussels acknowledges two clandestine “stay-behind” networks, SDRA8 (army) and STC/Mob (State Security), coordinated with the CIA and MI6 within NATO. A parliamentary commission of inquiry examines them in 1990-1991; they are dissolved.
32bc270041: Hoover and the Fall of Béla Kun
Herbert Hoover's American Relief Administration makes food aid conditional on the departure of the Communist regime, then of Archduke Joseph. Its delegate T. T. C. Gregory claimed this role.
32e9c468d4: Trump says Cuba “has no money left” and mentions a “friendly takeover” of the island if its leaders do not yield, in the midst of the oil blockade.
33350c13d9: The 40 Committee approves hundreds of thousands of dollars for the daily El Mercurio, the main opposition media outlet. More payments follow in 1972.
3342997dad: A joint US-Nigerian operation against the Islamic State in West Africa kills Abu-Bilal al-Minuki, presented by Trump as the organization's global number two.
3348266f77: Scorched Earth on Jeju With American Advisers
From November 1948 to early 1949, the South Korean army burns the villages of Jeju's interior and massacres their inhabitants. American military advisers oversee and follow the campaign.
3361070d72: Raid on the Iranian office in Erbil
U.S. forces capture five Iranians at the Iranian liaison office in Erbil. Washington accuses them of belonging to the Quds Force and holds them until 2009.
337687a285: Oleg Penkovsky, CIA and MI6 Source
This GRU colonel passes thousands of documents on Soviet missiles, useful during the Cuban crisis. Arrested in October 1962, he is executed in 1963.
337e301ac8: Shell fired at the Palestine Hotel
A U.S. tank fires on the hotel housing the foreign press and kills cameramen José Couso and Taras Protsyuk. The army cites a suspected sniper.
33a0da1342: Barclays enters into a deferred prosecution agreement for transactions with Cuba, Iran, Libya, Burma and Sudan.
33c87a14c7: Operation “Whitetamale” gives the NSA the emails of senior officials of Mexico's Secretariat of Public Security, including diplomatic talking points. Revealed by Der Spiegel in October 2013.
340810808c: The United States blocks a draft calling for a halt to the Israeli offensive in Gaza launched after the capture of soldier Gilad Shalit.
342e39d46e: Aristide leaves Haiti on a plane chartered by Washington and says he was “kidnapped.” The United States maintains that he left of his own free will.
344aa8b4b3: The State Department opens nearly $5 million in grants for European groups fighting “censorship” and immigration in the name of “Western civilizational heritage.”
3471303697: A $275 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition, shells and anti-tank missiles.
347b2f53b1: CIA radio calling for an uprising
The Voice of Free Iraq, a station funded and operated by the CIA, calls on Iraqis to rise up against Saddam Hussein at the end of the Gulf War.
34832e3ca4: Samar Hassan's parents killed in Tal Afar
Soldiers fire on a car approaching a checkpoint at nightfall and kill a couple. Photos of their blood-covered daughter, taken by Chris Hondros, go around the world.
3490d964de: American B-24s drop their bombs on the Gorla district of Milan. The primary school is hit and 184 children are killed along with their teachers.
34a8658932: Allied aircraft, including the US 15th Air Force based in Italy, begin bombing Budapest, targeting industry and railway stations. The 1944 raids cause many civilian casualties in the Hungarian capital.
34cd8fef96: American aircraft bomb and strafe the village of Sanseong-dong, far from the front, and kill dozens of civilians. The South Korean Truth and Reconciliation Commission confirms the attack in 2008.
34d7823ab2: A $2.5 billion package ($1.25 billion in drawdown and $1.22 billion USAI) including air defense and artillery ammunition.
34e9553769: General Zia overthrows Bhutto. Bhutto had accused Washington of wanting his downfall because of his nuclear program, citing a threat from Kissinger. No American role in the coup is proven.
34f032140c: Donald Trump recognizes Morocco's sovereignty over Western Sahara, against the UN position, in exchange for the normalization of relations between Rabat and Israel.
34fb90ea54: Veto after the assassination of Sheikh Yassin
The United States blocks a draft condemning the assassination of Hamas's founder by an Israeli missile on March 22 in Gaza, which also killed several passersby.
3525aa9590: The Treasury places Vice President Tareck El Aissami on the drug traffickers list under the Kingpin Act and freezes his assets.
352c0c2f6d: The Treasury sanctions the founder of Georgian Dream, accused of undermining democracy for the benefit of Moscow, after a disputed parliamentary election.
353b6c0e6b: The ransomware, attributed to North Korea, infects more than 200,000 computers, including those of Britain's NHS, using EternalBlue, a stolen and leaked NSA tool.
35586dc5e8: Military training of the Rwandan army
Before the First Congo War, American military personnel train the army of the Rwandan Patriotic Front, whose commanders are also trained in the United States.
356bc15e6c: A first group of 49 Afrikaners arrives in the United States as refugees, while other admissions are frozen. Washington takes up the narrative of a persecution of white farmers, rejected by Pretoria.
358a79ceb9: At the expiry of a 30-day deadline set by Blinken and Austin, Washington judges that Israel is not violating US law, even though NGOs report a worsening situation, and maintains arms deliveries.
35feac56df: The FBI uses the brothers Morris and Jack Childs, American Communist Party officials, to obtain information from the Kremlin until 1977. The FBI has released the files.
361850d4c4: Influence strategy toward minorities in France

A cable from Ambassador Charles Rivkin describes a “minority engagement strategy”: diplomats in the banlieues, young people invited to the embassy, funded projects, in order to sway French society. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
3620bfc4be: American aircraft take part in the NATO strike on the Serb airfield at Udbina, used to attack the Bihać pocket. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
3626ca2d28: A mass poisoning causes several deaths. Journalist H. P. Albarelli sees it as a CIA LSD experiment. This thesis is rejected by most historians and toxicologists.
362ea48745: The Treasury sanctions two Iranian companies, including HormuzSafe, that sell mandatory “insurance” to ships crossing Hormuz, along with eight shadow-fleet shipowners.
36303b84e7: Thai Kaw Taw Group in Laos

With CIA backing, Thai Marshal Sarit creates an advisory group, Kaw Taw, which supplies artillery, gunners and advisers to Phoumi Nosavan against Kong Le. The Thai Police Aerial Reinforcement Unit (PARU), sponsored by the CIA, also operates in Laos.
364318f928: In exchange for access to the Berbera base, Washington provides military aid to Siad Barre's regime throughout the 1980s.
36bcb5ce8b: Dmitri Polyakov, FBI and CIA Spy
This GRU general informs American services for about 25 years. Betrayed by Aldrich Ames and Robert Hanssen, he is executed in 1988.
36d4158eb7: Ten years of hacking according to Qihoo 360
The Chinese company accuses the CIA of having hacked Chinese aviation, oil and government agencies from 2008 to 2019, using Vault 7 tools.
36d8916941: American Civil Administration of the Ryūkyūs
The United States Civil Administration (USCAR) replaces the military government and rules Okinawa and the Ryūkyūs until 1972. Washington multiplies bases there, some of which house nuclear weapons.
36e89dd625: During the Quemoy crisis, the Joint Chiefs push for nuclear strikes on Chinese bases. A secret study revealed by Daniel Ellsberg in 2021 shows it.
36eae06e3e: Graphika and Stanford expose a network of fake pro-American accounts targeting Central Asia, Iran and Afghanistan. The Pentagon then orders an audit.
36fce2bf33: Washington designates the Revolutionary Guards as a proliferator and their Quds Force as a supporter of terrorism.
36fd4bc6b4: Navy SEALs kill Osama bin Laden at his residence, without notifying Pakistan. The body is buried at sea.
3723c7d5b9: Aerodynamic program: the CIA parachutes agents and materiel to Ukrainian nationalists and protects their representative Mykola Lebed. Documents declassified in 2007.
373e29e270: Washington deports to a Salvadoran mega-prison about 240 Venezuelans accused without trial of belonging to Tren de Aragua. They are freed in July 2025 in an exchange with Caracas.
3741f007b8: The cruiser USS Vincennes shoots down an Iranian civilian Airbus: 290 dead. Washington compensates Iran in 1996 without acknowledging responsibility.
374542942b: The Biden administration tells a court that Mohammed bin Salman, now prime minister, enjoys immunity in the lawsuit filed by Khashoggi's fiancée.
375b3a5c24: From April 19 to 21, 1925, Marines land at La Ceiba, a banana stronghold, during political unrest.
3786c288ef: Kennedy authorizes a vast program of sabotage, propaganda and destabilization against Cuba, led by Edward Lansdale. It was revealed by the Church Committee.
378c29ebd3: The CIA distributes in Nicaragua a comic-style booklet that teaches acts of sabotage: puncturing tires, clogging toilets, cutting power lines.
379e1da7b4: The Sicily region withdraws authorisation for the US Navy's MUOS satellite station, built in a nature reserve; the courts then order a seizure. Work resumes after a health report and new authorisations.
37fb115bc0: George W. Bush's first operation against Iraq: U.S. and British aircraft strike air defense sites near Baghdad, outside the usual no-fly zones.
381326cc69: An AC-130 fires on villages in Uruzgan where a wedding is taking place. About 48 dead according to Afghan authorities; the military cites anti-aircraft fire.
382d7328a6: NSA assistance to the Saudi police
An April 2013 memo provides for “direct analytic and technical support” to the Saudi Ministry of Interior on “internal security.” Revealed by The Intercept in July 2014.
3854975293: Strike on the Kunduz tanker trucks
On the orders of a German officer, U.S. F-15s bomb two hijacked trucks surrounded by villagers. More than 90 dead, many of them civilians.
385f5854d2: A Saudi-led coalition strike kills 97 civilians in a market. Human Rights Watch identifies a U.S.-made guided bomb.
3867effabc: Cornered by the army, Vargas kills himself. His testament letter accuses “international groups” allied with the opposition. No direct American role is established.
387702c053: A US Treasury letter warns that those in charge of INSTEX, created by France, Germany and the United Kingdom to trade with Iran, risk sanctions.
388d3d2d58: Washington sanctions more than a hundred officials of the Ortega-Murillo regime and their relatives after the death in custody of Indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera.
389def1e26: After military aid is suspended over the DeVine affair, the CIA continues to fund Guatemalan military intelligence, according to the Intelligence Oversight Board in 1996.
38a72ae7f6: An engineer in military aviation, Tolkachev delivers to the CIA from 1979 to 1985 secrets about Soviet radars. Betrayed, he is arrested in 1985 and executed in 1986.
38ac013688: Neo-fascist coup attempt aborted during the night. Declassified documents show that the American embassy had gotten wind of the preparations. American support remains alleged.
38afb9714e: The Yankee test releases 13.5 megatons, the second most powerful in American history.
38cd13fdeb: Sergeant Robert Bales kills 16 villagers, including nine children, in two villages. He is sentenced to life in prison.
38ceac12d8: The National Security Strategy speaks of a “civilizational erasure” of Europe and advocates “cultivating resistance” to its trajectory within European nations.
38dc79753c: Donald Trump announces 50% tariffs on Brazilian goods and justifies them by the judicial “witch hunt” against Jair Bolsonaro.
38eb899906: During a meeting with Zelensky in Paris, Biden announces a $225 million package including Stingers and HIMARS ammunition.
38ecf68770: Garrisons on Bases Ceded by London
American troops guard the air and naval bases obtained from the United Kingdom in exchange for destroyers. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
38fb077395: Failed landing carried out with the US company Silvercorp; two former US soldiers are captured. Washington denies any involvement.
391fe60cbc: B-52 and B-1 bombers near Venezuela
US strategic bombers fly show-of-force flights off the Venezuelan coast.
3948c0a1b3: Washington recognizes the president of the National Assembly as interim president and coordinates the international campaign to oust Maduro.
395f397057: Washington makes its aid conditional on an austerity plan designed by American economist George Eder, which freezes wages and slows the 1952 revolution.
39865a7173: End of the Baltic Security Initiative
The Pentagon announces the end of “Section 333” military aid, including the Baltic Security Initiative (more than a billion dollars since 2021). Senators of both parties protest.
39ac984f7f: The detention center at Bagram base holds thousands of people without trial, up to 3,000 in 2012. Authorities there acknowledge abuse and deaths in custody.
39d6e10688: Orders from the 25th Division and the 1st Cavalry Division prescribe treating civilians approaching the lines as enemies. An Air Force memo refers to strafing columns of refugees.
39e92596a2: Repression on Jeju Under American Government

The April 3, 1948 uprising is suppressed by the police and militias under the authority of the American military government. The 2003 South Korean commission estimates deaths from all the events at 25,000 to 30,000.
39ee0cb896: According to Der Spiegel, the NSA has penetrated the Qatari network's protected internal communications.
39f16d21ca: The CIA arms boats crewed by Cuban exiles to cut the supply lines of the rebels and of Che Guevara's column coming from Tanzania.
3a05787467: The New York Times reveals that U.S. agents transported and laundered millions of dollars of Mexican cartel money in undercover operations.
3a0c5630c1: TV Martí broadcast from a military aircraft
To get around jamming, an Air Force EC-130 “Commando Solo” aircraft broadcasts TV Martí over international waters. A civilian aircraft, “Aero Martí,” takes over in 2006.
3a26591984: Bombing of the Hanoi and Haiphong depots
First American strike on the oil depots around the two main cities of the North.
3a3652de44: Ambassador Spruille Braden openly backs the opposition to Perón. Perón turns it into an electoral slogan: “Braden or Perón.”
3a38e7713a: NSC Studies Secret Support Against Kassem

At a National Security Council meeting, the CIA and the Pentagon argue for more active action. A study provides for covert aid to Egyptian efforts to overthrow Kassem and for preparing a replacement team.
3a5a0c8fef: Missiles fired by the U.S. Navy hit the town of Dhobley, near the Kenyan border, to kill Saleh Ali Nabhan, who survives. Local authorities report civilian casualties.
3a66042a06: Johnson hails the regime within hours
While Goulart is still in Brazil, Lyndon Johnson sends his “warmest good wishes” to interim president Ranieri Mazzilli, in effect legitimizing the coup.
3abab2f6cb: For the first time since 1997, Washington judges that Colombia has “demonstrably failed” in the fight against drugs, while keeping an aid waiver.
3ae3086665: An Itavia DC-9 crashes off Ustica: 81 dead. Italian justice retains the theory of a missile fired during an air battle involving NATO aircraft, including American or French planes. Nothing is established.
3ae7e70e6e: Nearly a thousand 8th Air Force bombers hit central Berlin. Thousands of civilians are killed.
3b1f2f5d17: Arms deliveries to the junta resume
Nixon lifts the partial embargo on heavy weapons decided after the 1967 coup. Washington arms the Greek dictatorship in the name of NATO until its fall in 1974.
3b3116bed7: The United States places armed guards on all trains and posts ships on both sides of the isthmus to prevent Colombian troops from landing. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
3b59730a83: ZTE cut off from US components
The Commerce Department bars US companies from supplying the Chinese group, which comes close to shutting down before a deal in June.
3b64fbd936: Hafizullah Amin accused of being a CIA agent
Soviet officials claim that Afghan leader Hafizullah Amin works for the CIA, a justification for Operation Storm-333, which kills him on 27 December 1979. No public proof establishes this.
3b66b0ca6d: The U.S. Navy expropriates about two-thirds of the island to set up a firing range and an ammunition depot. The inhabitants are pushed back to the center of the island.
3b747d788f: Immunity agreement on the ICC signed by Bucharest

Amid the American campaign to shield its nationals from the International Criminal Court, Romania becomes the first country to sign a so-called “Article 98” agreement. The EU, which it wants to join, criticises the move.
3b8c943a7b: The Homeland Security secretary urges Poles to elect Karol Nawrocki and links his election to the continuation of the US military presence.
3b9d3e5d73: The Washington Post reveals in 2014 that the NSA obtained in 2010 the right to spy on the BJP, then in opposition, among six foreign parties.
3bafdaf9c6: A $250 million drawdown of AIM-9M missiles, HIMARS ammunition and demining equipment.
3be5af4e60: The Associated Press reveals a network of secret prisons run by the Emirates, where torture is common. US military personnel took part in interrogations there, with no evidence that they witnessed the abuse.
3beaf23aa4: The Trump administration sanctions the state oil company Cupet, as the fuel blockade paralyzes the Cuban economy.
3c08868f31: FRAPH leader paid by the CIA
Journalist Allan Nairn reveals that Emmanuel “Toto” Constant, founder of the FRAPH paramilitary squad, was a paid CIA informant. American officials confirm it.
3c11d91f0a: Washington designates more than 500 targets, its largest wave of sanctions since 2022, after the death of Alexei Navalny in custody.
3c2035bf4c: The U.S. Air Force flies Reaper drones from this Ethiopian airport for missions in Somalia. The base, revealed by the Washington Post, closes in 2016.
3c297794de: Kodama Yoshio Employed by the CIA

According to American archives released in the 2000s, the CIA entrusts Kodama Yoshio, a suspected former war criminal, with a tungsten smuggling operation from China. The operation fails and Kodama keeps the funds.
3c40ede569: John Kerry says that the Egyptian army, by overthrowing Morsi, “restored democracy.” Two weeks later, the Rabaa massacre kills more than 800 according to Human Rights Watch.
3c69409efe: The Red Brigades kidnap and then kill Aldo Moro. Steve Pieczenik, a State Department envoy to the crisis committee, claimed in 2008 to have worked to ensure he was not saved. His statements are disputed.
3c6b432d19: PSYOP operations at the Soviet borders
Under Reagan, American bombers and ships multiply approaches to the borders of the USSR to test its defenses and unsettle it. A CIA historian, Benjamin Fischer, has documented them.
3c873f17b2: American aircraft pound for hours a column of Iraqi vehicles and civilians fleeing Kuwait toward Basra. The death toll remains disputed, as does the legality of the attack.
3cbaba61cf: A secret cable asks the Asunción embassy for fingerprints, irises and DNA of political figures, including presidential candidates, and the call records of Cuban, Venezuelan and Bolivian diplomats. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
3cc34d3201: Iran's Supreme Leader is killed in his office in the Israeli-American strikes of the first day, along with dozens of senior officials. Trump later demands a role in choosing his successor.
3ccb90f374: Discovered by Kaspersky, mainly in Iran. The Washington Post attributes it to a U.S.-Israeli operation targeting the Iranian nuclear program.
3cd561fae3: A South Korean force supervised by American advisers combs the Jiri Mountains against the guerrillas. Thousands of people are killed, including many civilians.
3cd7d01dcd: Barack Obama signs a law that authorizes sanctions against Venezuelan officials accused of repression during the 2014 protests.
3ceb5ac311: Secretary of State Cyrus Vance proposes to the OAS a peace force to prevent a Sandinista victory after Somoza's departure. The OAS refuses.
3cfdd0597c: Operation Gold: the CIA and MI6 dig a tunnel to tap the Soviet army's lines. Known from the start to Moscow thanks to George Blake, it is discovered in April 1956.
3d0ca882df: Scrolling messages on the U.S. mission
The U.S. Interests Section in Havana displays lighted messages against the government on its facade. Cuba retaliates by erecting a forest of flags to hide them.
3d128c7d2d: A Philippine army air raid kills more than ten suspected Abu Sayyaf and Jemaah Islamiyah militants. Philippine officials cited by the AP mention U.S. guidance kits; the army later denies their use.
3d144e810c: Libyan prisoners turned against Gaddafi, including Khalifa Haftar, were trained in Chad with CIA help. When Habré falls, Washington evacuates them.
3d1896f3f3: A rust epidemic strikes the main Cuban sugarcane variety. Cuba sees an American biological aggression. The accusation is not proven.
3d1b865428: U.S. soldiers burn two corpses in front of a village to provoke the Taliban. An Australian network broadcasts the footage. Soldiers receive disciplinary sanctions.
3d3dc72170: A Marine EA-6B aircraft flying too low severs the cable: 20 dead. The American court-martial acquits the crew; two officers are punished for destroying the flight video.
3d489badc6: Police, including Border Patrol units trained with American help, and militias kill dozens of students. The American role beyond that training is not established.
3d568641ad: The Treasury sanctions Minister of the Revolutionary Armed Forces Álvaro López Miera and the special Black Berets unit for the repression of the July 11 protests.
3dafbab55b: Special forces kill five civilians, including two pregnant women. According to The Times of London, soldiers dug the bullets out of the bodies; Admiral McRaven apologizes.
3dbedcff12: Strikes on Tehran and southern Iran
In the midst of the ceasefire, the United States strikes several military sites in southern Iran and in Tehran, in response to fire on US warships.
3dd1861a0c: Naha Mayor Removed by the Occupier

The American civil administration of the Ryūkyūs changes the regulations to remove Senaga Kamejirō, mayor of Naha elected in 1956 and an opponent of the bases. He is also stripped of his eligibility rights.
3de829c4cd: The CIA arms and trains Syrian rebels with Saudi Arabia, for about a billion dollars. Some of the weapons end up with jihadist groups. Trump ends it in 2017.
3defe8a5af: An American High Commissioner in Haiti
Marine General John H. Russell is appointed high commissioner. He rules in practice with President Louis Borno, elected in 1922 by an appointed Council of State, without a parliament.
3dfc4565b8: After the attack on Aramco facilities, the Treasury designates the Central Bank of Iran under counterterrorism sanctions.
3e1febc902: Ambassador Adolf Berle publicly supports holding free elections. Vargas sees this as interference; the army deposes him on October 29, 1945. Historians debate the real weight of the speech.
3e26fbc633: Colonel Carlos Enrique Díaz, who succeeds Árbenz, promises to fight Castillo Armas. CIA officers and Ambassador Peurifoy demand his departure. He is replaced by a junta within two days.
3e491ccda3: Three CIA technicians are arrested while planting microphones in the offices of the Chinese news agency Xinhua. They are released in 1963 in the exchange of Bay of Pigs prisoners.
3e5edc160d: A drone kills a suspected al-Qaeda official in a village. Young Yemeni Farea al-Muslimi, from Wessab, testifies before the U.S. Senate about the fear sown in the village.
3e6b55daff: Beijing accuses Washington and the NED of fomenting the protests. Local NGOs received NED funds; no US direction has been shown.
3e725bf206: Washington bans most exports to Cuba, except food and medicine.
3e812c7349: Before the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, CIA Director Allen Dulles calls the situation in Iraq the “most dangerous in the world,” because of the weight of Communists around Kassem.
3e87f4fee0: FBI meets the Lava Jato prosecutors
An FBI and U.S. Justice Department delegation meets the Lava Jato prosecutors without going through Brazil's Ministry of Justice, The Intercept and Agência Pública reveal in 2020.
3e8b917ed4: Vice President Mike Pence and Prime Minister Jüri Ratas sign a text reserving 5G for “trusted” suppliers, in effect against Huawei, as part of the American campaign among allies.
3ed4f1b339: American Ships for Juan Vicente Gómez
After Gómez takes power while Cipriano Castro is in Europe, Washington sends warships off Venezuela and re-establishes relations with the new regime.
3ef78e62ae: Wrongful deportation of Kilmar Abrego García

This Salvadoran, protected by a court ruling, is sent to CECOT. The administration admits an “administrative error”; the Supreme Court demands that it “facilitate” his return, which takes place in June so that he can be tried.
3f087959f7: Washington backs the “Act of Free Choice”, in which 1,025 hand-picked delegates vote under duress for union with Indonesia. Declassified American documents show the result was known in advance.
3f20049625: Marco Rubio declares Ambassador Ebrahim Rasool persona non grata, after he criticized the Trump movement.
3f213cd1bc: Threat of a “return to the Stone Age”
Musharraf claims in 2006 that Richard Armitage threatened to bomb Pakistan “back to the Stone Age” if it did not ally with Washington. Armitage denies using those words.
3f2d95d9f2: After the Tampico incident, Marines take the port and occupy it for seven months to weaken Huerta. More than 150 Mexicans are killed.
3f459066f1: Israeli aircraft bomb the PLO headquarters near Tunis and kill dozens of people. Reagan first calls the raid “legitimate”, then Washington abstains on the resolution condemning it.
3f5341dcbe: During Shaba II, the US Air Force transports the Belgian troops and French equipment engaged to save Mobutu's regime.
3f71d267e7: Washington announces a new round of sanctions under the chemical weapons law against FSB officials involved in the poisoning of Alexei Navalny.
3f7999195b: Green Berets execute Thái Khắc Chuyên, a Vietnamese agent suspected of double-dealing. The prosecution is dropped when the CIA refuses to let its agents testify.
3f9a0efd2c: NGO investigations, including by Americas Watch, describe murders, torture and rapes of civilians by the Contras funded by Washington.
3fac476c2f: The Treasury sanctions companies involved in building the Kerch bridge and subsidiaries of Gazprom and of Russian banks already targeted.
3fb9de3d5d: MACV-SOG launches secret ground raids by American and South Vietnamese commandos along the Ho Chi Minh Trail in Laos (later Prairie Fire).
3fc268734b: CNCERT accuses US intelligence of having exploited a Microsoft Exchange flaw to penetrate a major Chinese military group in 2022 and 2023.
3feadea3dd: Paid articles in the Iraqi press
The Los Angeles Times reveals that the military pays Iraqi newspapers, via the Lincoln Group, to publish favorable articles written by military personnel. The Pentagon confirms.
3ffdb77a78: American plan on Euroclear's Russian assets

According to the published text of the American 28-point peace plan, 100 billion dollars of frozen Russian assets would go to a Washington-led reconstruction of Ukraine, which would receive half of the profits. Most of it is held at Euroclear, which the EU wanted to mobilise.
4015d4a086: Start of the trade war with China
First 25% tariffs on $34 billion of Chinese imports. Beijing retaliates the same day; the escalation later affects hundreds of billions.
4020525c7b: Kerry report on Contras and drugs
A Senate subcommittee concludes that Contra-linked networks trafficked cocaine and that American agencies tolerated it.
4038a65172: Standing alone against fourteen, the United States blocks a draft asking Israel to give up confiscating land in East Jerusalem.
405a93c23e: After complaints targeting American officials, including Tommy Franks, Donald Rumsfeld threatens to block funding for the new NATO headquarters in Brussels. Belgium restricts its universal jurisdiction law in August 2003.
4091b3a9df: Having defected to the West in Berlin in December 1953, this Polish security colonel is taken in charge by the CIA. Radio Free Europe broadcasts some 140 programmes of his revelations in 1954-1955, which shake the regime.
4097cee809: First U-2 Overflight of the USSR
The CIA's first U-2 overflies Moscow and Leningrad. The flights continue until 1960 despite Soviet protests.
40bb36ae22: Mohamedou Ould Slahi handed over to Jordan
Handed over by Mauritania, Slahi is transferred by the CIA to Jordan, then to Bagram and Guantánamo, where he is tortured. Released in 2016 without being charged.
40bc4ffd44: China's Ministry of State Security accuses the NSA of having attacked the center that provides the country's official time.
40c09b52a7: The US Treasury sanctions the Colombian president, whom Trump calls a drug trade leader, after his criticism of the strikes.
40d195324e: The State Department issues a statement hostile to any PCI participation in the Italian government, in the midst of the “historic compromise” negotiations.
40d7341249: Colonel Chang Hsien-yi, a CIA informant, defects to the United States with documents on Taiwan's secret nuclear weapons program, which is subsequently dismantled under American pressure.
40d8bac240: Siemens pays $800 million to the United States
The German group settles foreign bribery charges under the FCPA; the total fine reaches $1.6 billion with German authorities.
40e31be3b2: General Arthur MacArthur announces the strict enforcement of General Order No. 100: civilians who aid the guerrillas lose all protection. Deportations, destruction of property and executions become permissible.
4118cb0a77: National Guard Led by the Marines
The Marines create and command the Nicaraguan National Guard, deployed against Sandino. Anastasio Somoza takes it over in 1933, when the Americans leave.
413de5f7a2: Declassified documents show that the Ford administration was ready to support the independence of the Azores if the communists took power in Lisbon. Informal contacts are made with associates of the Azores Liberation Front.
4142f2662e: Diệm deposes Bảo Đại with 98.2 percent of the vote, advised by Lansdale. In Saigon, he obtains more than 600,000 votes for about 450,000 registered voters.
4148cee1bc: Two insurgents trying to surrender are killed by the Apache “Crazyhorse 18” after a military lawyer judged that one “cannot surrender to an aircraft.” Same crew as “Collateral Murder.” Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
416574ffb7: The leaked documents show that Washington also spies on Ukraine, Israel's Mossad and the Egyptian president.
416d5711f1: Poisoned Handkerchief for an Iraqi Colonel

The Church Committee reports that in 1960 the CIA considered “incapacitating” an Iraqi colonel with a handkerchief impregnated with a toxic agent. The colonel is later shot in Baghdad, unrelated to the CIA according to the agency.
41713e5baf: The NGO HRANA counts 3,636 deaths in Iran due to the strikes as of April 7, including 1,701 civilians. Estimates differ widely depending on the source.
417359b8c1: The Bell Act makes reconstruction aid conditional on granting Americans equal rights over the Philippines' resources and ties the peso to the dollar. The Philippine Constitution has to be amended.
41930d8cd3: Multinational Force and Observers in the Sinai

Reagan deploys military personnel in the Multinational Force and Observers tasked with monitoring the implementation of the Egyptian-Israeli peace treaty. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
41e4474439: According to El Mundo, the NSA gathered data on 60 million calls in Spain in one month. The NSA says they came from Spanish services.
41f1a8e924: Maduro and Cilia Flores appear before a federal court in Manhattan and plead not guilty to narco-terrorism.
420ef56ed7: Men paid by the DEA abduct physician Humberto Álvarez Machaín in Mexico to try him in the United States. The Supreme Court upholds the procedure in 1992. He is acquitted.
421691d678: The same day, Bravo Company kills dozens of civilians in a neighboring hamlet. The Peers Commission confirms it, with no convictions.
421de4fa93: Holden Roberto Paid by the CIA
The leader of the Angolan FNLA movement receives CIA subsidies from the Kennedy administration on, according to the work of John Marcum and the testimony of John Stockwell.
422212333a: Sent by his brother, Robert Kennedy presses Goulart to remove Communists and nationalists from his entourage. The meeting is recorded in American archives (FRUS).
4226ae02f6: In Miami, Trump signs a memorandum that restricts individual travel and bans transactions with the military conglomerate GAESA. The list of prohibited Cuban entities follows in November.
4248e0b1dc: Credit Suisse agrees to pay $536 million for transactions with Iran and other countries under U.S. embargo.
42747627f4: US air strikes and artillery crush an assault by pro-government forces and Russian mercenaries of the Wagner group near a gas field. Between several dozen and more than a hundred attackers are killed.
428a32a3b0: Archives and agent Miles Copeland describe CIA contacts with the coup plotters. The new regime ratifies the passage of the Tapline pipeline.
42a1533af9: A Mongoose plan provides that, if John Glenn's orbital flight fails, evidence would be fabricated blaming Cuba for electronic interference. It appears in the declassified Mongoose documents.
42a1fececb: Rape of a girl at the Melgar base

The mother of a 12-year-old girl accuses U.S. Sergeant Michael Coen and a contractor of raping her at the Melgar base. Covered by immunity, they are tried neither in Colombia nor in the United States.
42af0780b7: Battle of Saigon Against the Bình Xuyên
Diệm's army crushes the Bình Xuyên militia. Backed by Lansdale, Diệm prevails while envoy Lawton Collins was urging Washington to replace him.
42b7c42d73: During the Yemeni civil war, Kennedy deploys fighters to Saudi Arabia to deter the Egyptian air force supporting the Republicans.
42d0dab4a2: Return of Residents to Contaminated Rongelap
The inhabitants are resettled on Rongelap while the atoll remains contaminated, and are followed as a study group. They will leave the island in 1985.
4303740b33: The CIA transfers several detainees from its secret prisons to separate facilities on the base, then removes them in spring 2004, ahead of a Supreme Court decision. The Senate torture report confirms it.
4339039191: Ayios Nikolaos eavesdropping funded by the NSA

Snowden's documents show that the British station at Ayios Nikolaos, in the Dhekelia base, intercepts Middle Eastern internet and telecommunications for the Tempora programme. The NSA funds half of it.
434a80d9c6: Support for rebels against the Derg
Rebel groups opposed to Mengistu's Marxist regime receive American support, the nature of which remains unclear. When the USSR drops Addis Ababa in 1990, Washington continues to back them.
435100c0f8: The State Department presses President Duda to block the law that would force the American company Discovery to sell the TVN channel. Duda vetoes it on 27 December, citing investment treaties with the United States.
43838818a7: Biden authorizes a new $200 million drawdown of anti-tank and anti-aircraft weapons and ammunition for Ukraine.
43887bb042: CHDS advises the Honduran coup plotters

According to The Intercept (2017), officials of the Center for Hemispheric Defense Studies, attached to the Pentagon, help Honduran officers justify the legality of the coup against Zelaya and meet U.S. lawmakers.
43928aa5f9: Tribal leaders' convoy bombed in Paktia
U.S. aircraft destroy a convoy on its way to Karzai's inauguration, on false intelligence. Dozens dead. The Pentagon maintains it struck Taliban.
43a973bfc2: The ambassador to Nicaragua requests about $65 million more over four years to fund parties, NGOs and groups opposed to Daniel Ortega, through the next presidential election. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2011.
43adff5dc1: Washington sanctions eight justices of the Supreme Tribunal of Justice after their decision to assume the powers of the National Assembly.
43b1db12eb: A U.S. Air Force U-2 overflies Sakhalin during a sampling mission. Washington apologizes after the Soviet protest.
43c5c8e21e: President Kasavubu dismisses the prime minister. The American embassy and the CIA station had pushed for this dismissal, according to archives and Larry Devlin's memoirs.
43d12ada7c: Rape and Murder of Six-Year-Old Yumiko
A six-year-old girl is abducted, raped and killed by Sergeant Isaac Hurt. Sentenced to death by an American court-martial, his sentence is reduced and he is sent back to the United States.
440769a1a2: After the loss of two CIA aircraft, Eisenhower agrees to have fighters supplied to the rebels through Nicaragua. They immediately resume the bombing.
440e653ab8: The Treasury blacklists Russia's two largest oil groups, which account for about half of the country's output.
442c5f3179: The United States co-signs the protocol that imposes a heavy indemnity on China and the stationing of foreign troops, including the 15th Infantry Regiment in Tianjin from 1912.
442db76ead: Coordinated sanctions at the Hiroshima G7
During the G7 summit, Washington sanctions more than 300 individuals, entities, vessels and aircraft linked to the Russian war effort.
443e01f397: Commerce tightens the October 2022 restrictions and blocks the sale of AI chips such as Nvidia's A800 and H800.
4479271f1d: A few days before the presidential election, Ambassador Manuel Rocha warns Bolivians that U.S. aid is at risk if they elect Evo Morales, who then gains further ground at the polls.
44a41ab2f8: Office of Special Plans at the Pentagon

A Pentagon cell produces its own analyses of links between Iraq and al-Qaeda. In 2007, the inspector general finds these analyses “inappropriate” and contrary to the conclusions of the intelligence community.
44aebd2bf8: After fighting with U.S. special forces, strikes kill dozens of villagers in the Zerkoh valley according to the UN and Afghan government investigation.
44c3275f4f: The Treasury accuses ABLV, Latvia's third-largest bank, of money laundering and of aiding North Korea and proposes cutting it off from the dollar. The ECB declares it failing on 23 February and it is liquidated. FinCEN withdraws the measure in 2024.
44d64aa66b: First PURL package paid by the Netherlands
NATO announces the first package of American weapons, about €500 million paid by the Netherlands, including Patriot parts and missiles. The Nordic countries follow the next day.
4506ec181f: After Madrid refuses the use of the Rota and Morón bases against Iran, Trump threatens to cut off all trade with Spain. In July, he announces having ordered the cutoff.
4527d8dc54: The CIA trains Honduran military officers with its “Human Resource Exploitation Training Manual”, inspired by the 1963 KUBARK manual. It describes coercive methods.
457e692fc5: Cuba put back on the terrorism list
On his inauguration day, Trump reverses the removal of Cuba from the list of state sponsors of terrorism, decided by Biden six days earlier in exchange for prisoner releases.
4590b178aa: Truman declares a state of emergency, freezes Chinese assets and bans all trade with Communist China. The embargo lasts until 1971.
45a22bcbe2: The Marines land in Mogadishu to secure humanitarian aid, the first step of an engagement that turns into a war against the militias.
45b3794a7a: The CIA treats a box of Castro's favorite cigars with botulinum toxin. It is handed to an intermediary in 1961, with no known result. The fact is established by the Church Committee.
45b873f8ef: Under Ambassador John Negroponte, the annual human rights reports on Honduras downplay disappearances, according to the Baltimore Sun's 1995 investigation.
45c6d6fe1b: The United States blocks a draft demanding that Israel drop any threat to expel Yasser Arafat, after the Israeli decision to “remove” him.
45dde05f1c: On the first day, a strike on a Defense Council meeting kills Revolutionary Guards chief Mohammad Pakpour, Defense Minister Aziz Nasirzadeh and Ali Shamkhani. The Israeli army claims the attack, carried out in the joint campaign.
45e8b4b41b: An employers' strike by transport operators paralyzes the country for weeks. The CIA funds private-sector groups that support it, according to the Church Committee.
461dc848dd: American bombers raze the abbey, where no German soldiers were entrenched. Civilians who had taken refuge there die.
46230464ee: On the day the Italian armistice is announced, American B-17s target Kesselring's German headquarters at Frascati. The town centre is flattened and hundreds of inhabitants are killed.
463a2e5193: Drone strike on a seminary in Hangu
A CIA strike targets a religious seminary outside the tribal areas and kills several people described as members of the Haqqani network.
46603d0d4b: Quadrant Funded by the CIA Network
The Australian magazine Quadrant is born with the support of the Congress for Cultural Freedom, whose secret funder was the CIA, as became known in 1967.
468690e2f0: A $270 million package including four HIMARS and up to 580 Phoenix Ghost drones.
469c881394: A British record notes that in Washington “the intelligence and facts were being fixed around the policy” of war. The authentic document is published by the Sunday Times in 2005.
46acf0495a: American forces forcibly hand over Soviet prisoners and refugees to the USSR, many of whom refuse to return. Several commit suicide during the transfers from Dachau and Plattling.
46b50d254e: A raid by American bombers aiming at the Rennes marshalling yard hits residential districts and causes hundreds of civilian casualties. It is one of the deadliest bombings the city suffered.
46c1539c43: Plan Patty Against Fidel and Raúl Castro

According to Havana, conspirators linked to the CIA planned to kill Raúl Castro in Santiago and Fidel in Havana on July 26, 1961, then stage an attack on Guantánamo. The plan is documented only by Cuban sources.
46c2577b5e: Built with the US Army, the base is used for Contra logistics. Human remains are exhumed there in 2001; it is accused of having served as a detention center.
46cae1e1a3: Sidewinder missiles for the Royal Navy
Caspar Weinberger's Pentagon delivers AIM-9L air-to-air missiles decisive for the British Harriers. Weinberger is knighted by London in 1988.
46d46f1bcd: Burmese Freedom and Democracy Act embargo
The law bans all imports of Burmese products. According to unions and NGOs, tens of thousands of women textile workers lose their jobs, an effect disputed by supporters of the sanctions.
4707f903fa: The Justice Department demands from Microsoft emails hosted in its Irish data centre, outside mutual legal assistance. Dublin reminds the Supreme Court that the mutual assistance route exists; the 2018 CLOUD Act settles the case in Washington's favour.
470915e42f: American special forces teams in civilian clothes train the Royal Lao Army. The operation becomes White Star in 1961, in uniform.
473c900fcd: Funds from the AFL union federation, then from the CIA, paid through Irving Brown, support the birth of Force Ouvrière against the Communist-dominated CGT.
4740a34204: Otto Reich and the opposition before the coup

Assistant Secretary of State Otto Reich and other officials met in the preceding months with opposition figures, including Pedro Carmona. Washington says it dissuaded them from any coup; Reich subsequently backs the new government.
4741883e56: During the clash between the Jordanian army and the fedayeen, Nixon puts the 6th Fleet on alert and solicits an Israeli threat against the Syrian tanks that entered Jordan.
47597b9195: Trump in the Honduran presidential race
Trump urges a vote for Nasry Asfura, threatens to cut aid in case of defeat and announces a pardon for former president Juan Orlando Hernández, convicted of drug trafficking.
475ecfcc6d: Faced with the offensive of the Libyan-backed GUNT rebels, Reagan grants emergency military aid to the regime of Hissène Habré, whose political police tortures opponents.
475fc9fb24: Senator Harry Byrd's amendment authorizes the import of Rhodesian chrome despite mandatory UN sanctions against Ian Smith's white regime. The United States violates the embargo until its repeal in March 1977.
4794baa44d: The Security Council adopts a text drafted by Washington that caps refined petroleum products at 500,000 barrels a year. UN agencies later report effects on humanitarian aid.
47ca2c5d8b: Mike Pence and Andrzej Duda sign a joint declaration on 5G security, aimed at excluding Chinese equipment makers such as Huawei, at the heart of the American pressure campaign.
47db245f95: Almunia, UNICEF and Doctors of the World
According to the Snowden documents, GCHQ and the NSA target European commissioner Joaquín Almunia, UNICEF, Doctors of the World and the Israeli prime minister's office.
47e3e71d16: Gustavo Petro refuses two military planes carrying deportees. Trump announces 25% tariffs and sanctions; Bogotá gives in within hours.
47f83ce693: Savimbi received at the White House
Ronald Reagan receives the UNITA leader and promises him effective support. Covert CIA aid, including Stinger missiles, fuels the Angolan civil war.
4821a8f2f2: CIA Pilots at Dien Bien Phu
American pilots of Civil Air Transport, a CIA company, resupply the entrenched camp. James McGovern and Wallace Buford are shot down. France decorates them in 2005.
48239aeba3: First US strike against Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb in southern Libya. AFRICOM announces two militants killed.
4837f831a4: Reagan signs a presidential “finding” authorizing the CIA to arm the Contras against the Sandinista government. The war kills tens of thousands.
483b9d988a: The trial of László Rajk names Noel Field as head of an American espionage network. Journalist Stewart Steven claims in 1974 that Allen Dulles manipulated the affair to provoke purges; historians dispute this thesis.
48a4c11841: Destruction of the B1 bridge in Karaj

The US military destroys the B1 bridge, the highest in the Middle East, citing military use. Eight civilians are killed and 95 wounded, including families celebrating Sizdah Bedar. A second strike allegedly targeted rescuers.
48b0813d82: Operation Pocket Money: US Navy aircraft mine Haiphong and the ports of the North.
48d24bb373: Veto on the annexation of the Golan
Washington blocks a draft providing for measures against Israel, which had just annexed the Syrian Golan Heights in December 1981.
48dab9db95: On the night of March 13–14, 1945, USAAF B-29s set fire to central Osaka. The raid kills nearly 4,000 people and opens a series of attacks on the city.
48fc03a736: According to a British memo revealed by lawyer Philippe Sands, Bush raises with Blair the idea of flying a U2 aircraft painted in UN colors over Iraq to draw fire and justify the war.
490c6c6217: Washington accuses Vice President Hugo Velázquez of corruption and bars him from a visa. He announces his resignation, then stays in office.
49115268c8: The assassination of the Liberal leader triggers the Bogotazo during the Pan-American conference. His daughter Gloria Gaitán accuses the CIA of organizing the killing; no evidence has been produced.
4911b7115d: Saddam Hussein's trial opens before the Iraqi High Tribunal, created under the occupation and funded and advised by a U.S. office, the Regime Crimes Liaison Office. NGOs criticize its lack of independence.
