49190157f1: Airbus contract lost in Saudi Arabia
According to the European Parliament's report on Echelon (2001), NSA intercepts helped Boeing and McDonnell Douglas beat Airbus on a Saudi contract.
4924a2b6b2: NSM-20 report on arms to Israel
The State Department finds it “reasonable to assess” that US weapons were used in violation of humanitarian law, but considers Israeli assurances credible and does not suspend deliveries.
4950ad2498: American customs reveals an undercover operation against money laundering in Mexican banks, conducted without notifying Mexico City, which denounces a violation of its sovereignty.
495569396d: Military aid cut for refusing immunity
Croatia refuses to sign an agreement shielding Americans from the ICC. Washington cuts about 19 million dollars of military aid, as announced by Ambassador Rossin. Aid resumes in 2006.
495bb7033f: Authorized by Biden, Ukraine fires ATACMS missiles at Russia for the first time, at an ammunition depot in the Bryansk region.
49736789c3: After Trump's refusal to certify the nuclear deal, the Treasury designates the Revolutionary Guard Corps under counterterrorism Executive Order 13224.
49e760df11: The Treasury sanctions Chief Executive Carrie Lam and ten Hong Kong and Chinese officials for the repression in Hong Kong.
4a118dddeb: Van Vliet report on Katyń suppressed

A witness to the Katyń exhumations, Colonel Van Vliet writes a report in 1945 pointing to Moscow. The document disappears at the Pentagon. The Congressional Madden Committee (1952) concludes that American officials suppressed the evidence.
4a18251956: The US Coast Guard seizes a second tanker loaded with Venezuelan crude, the Centuries.
4a1d51c800: The Treasury and the State Department sanction nearly 400 individuals and entities in Russia and third countries that supply goods to the Russian military industry.
4a2b4858a3: Death of Juozas Lukša, CIA envoy
The partisan leader, parachuted in by the CIA in 1950, is killed by the MGB after being lured into a trap by Jonas Kukauskas, an agent of a second group dropped by the CIA and turned by the Soviets.
4a491b00bc: Faced with the mercenaries' revolt, Johnson sends Mobutu three military transport aircraft and their crews, prompting protests in the Senate.
4a656039cb: Sanctions after an Iranian missile test
The Treasury sanctions 25 individuals and entities linked to Iran's ballistic program and the Quds Force after a missile test.
4a90fe04e6: Israeli-American strikes heavily damage Gandhi Hospital, in northern Tehran. The WHO director calls the incident “extremely alarming.”
4aa3ad45da: 25% duties on olive oil and wine
In the Airbus dispute, Washington hits Spanish bottled olive oil, wine and cheese with 25% duties. Spain is targeted as one of the four countries that subsidise the aircraft maker.
4ab1d8c104: Edward Lansdale, a CIA officer, advises Defense Secretary Magsaysay against the Huk insurgency. He mixes military operations and psychological warfare, including staging the victims of a “vampire.”
4acc88c520: The Treasury sanctions Al-Haq, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights and Al Mezan, which sent the ICC files on Israeli crimes.
4acfe5856d: Veto on the status of Jerusalem
Alone against fourteen, the United States blocks a draft declaring invalid any decision on the status of Jerusalem, after Trump's recognition of the city as Israel's capital.
4ad7398c09: Zelensky says Washington is making security guarantees conditional on a Ukrainian withdrawal from the entire Donbas. A US official denies it. The United States had set a June deadline for an agreement.
4ade9c024a: AFRICOM carries out four strikes against the Islamic State in southwestern Libya and announces more than forty fighters killed.
4aeadefe08: The CIA sets up its largest station outside Langley on the University of Miami campus. It runs hundreds of agents and commando raids against Cuba from there.
4b06b9982b: According to Yahoo News (2021), Mike Pompeo's CIA considers abducting, or even killing, Julian Assange, who has taken refuge at the Ecuadorian embassy. The CIA does not deny it.
4b35b726af: The military government imposes a land registration law that eases the expansion of large American sugar mills in the East at the expense of peasants without titles.
4b3713d1ef: Seymour Hersh accuses the US Navy on the basis of an anonymous source; Washington denies it. The German investigation targets a Ukrainian commando, one suspect being arrested in Italy in 2025.
4b3c983ada: French rumors at the time attribute CIA support to the putschists. No document has established it, and Kennedy offers his support to General de Gaulle.
4b46e2881e: Zelensky announces the arrival in Ukraine of the first American M1 Abrams tanks.
4b5334014e: After the Norwegian revelations about “Surveillance Detection Units”, the Danish PET acknowledges having known since 2004 of surveillance carried out by the American embassy around its premises.
4b77b40dbb: Washington applies the Magnitsky Act to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who is presiding over Bolsonaro's trial for attempted coup.
4b8bfafd5d: Backed by Washington, the IMF grants Russia a 10.2 billion dollar credit three months before the election. The disbursements help Yeltsin pay overdue wages and pensions.
4ba3a0a081: Missiles fired by a drone hit a wedding procession; 12 dead according to Human Rights Watch, which finds that some were civilians.
4bacb93fce: Biden quadruples tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles to 100%, and raises those on chips, steel and solar panels.
4bb946192d: The United States launches an air campaign against Iranian positions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, closed by Tehran since the start of the war.
4bdcb79d5b: The Pentagon suspends shipments of Patriot interceptors, shells and missiles for F-16s, citing its stocks; Trump orders part of the deliveries resumed a week later.
4bf14f2003: WHO counts 20 attacks on health care
The WHO counts more than 20 attacks on Iranian health facilities since March 1, during the Israeli-American campaign.
4c0bc7a213: Special forces helicopters strafe a convoy and kill Nabhan, a suspect in the 2002 attacks in Kenya, before taking away his body.
4c0f4da025: Tax on buyers of Venezuelan oil
Executive Order 14245 authorizes a 25% tariff on imports from any country that buys Venezuelan oil.
4c1cc993da: The State Department invokes an emergency to sell Israel nearly 14,000 tank shells without congressional review. It does so again on December 29 for 155 mm shell components.
4c67f7dbe3: According to the 2009 Seimas inquiry, the CIA and Lithuanian State Security fit out a first building in Vilnius as early as 2002. The commission concludes that it was not used to hold prisoners.
4c6fe7b51b: Biden authorizes the delivery of cluster munitions, banned by a convention that neither Washington nor Kyiv has ratified. Allies protest.
4c7152b8c5: A $1.2 billion USAI package for air defense systems and ammunition.
4c797f58cb: A Polish intelligence officer, Michał Goleniewski (“Sniper”) gives the CIA Polish and Soviet secrets from 1959, then goes over to the United States in January 1961. Warsaw sentences him to death in absentia.
4c9c35f4c6: The ATF lets about 2,000 weapons pass into the hands of traffickers linked to Mexican cartels. The Justice Department inspector general condemns the operation in 2012.
4ca073cc25: The United States and Arab allies strike the Islamic State and the Khorasan Group in Syria, without Damascus's consent.
4cc98804b8: RB-47 Overflight of the Kola Peninsula
An RB-47E piloted by Harold Austin photographs airfields on the Kola Peninsula. Chased and hit by MiGs, it makes it back to England.
4cd0a39049: The State Department creates a task force to expand Internet access not controlled by the Cuban state. Havana sees it as a tool of subversion.
4d0512e28b: Turnberry agreement imposed on the EU
Under the threat of 30%, the European Union accepts 15% tariffs on most of its exports and pledges to buy energy and invest in the United States.
4d1176a7f8: The Treasury freezes Cuban assets in the United States and bans all transactions with Cuba, including travel expenses. These regulations still underpin the embargo.
4d144f71ab: Strike on a drone station at Bandar Abbas
CENTCOM shoots down four Iranian drones and then strikes their ground control station near Bandar Abbas airport. The Guards retaliate against a US air base.
4d34a59c2a: A cable from Ambassador William Brownfield published by WikiLeaks details a five-point strategy, funded by USAID, to “penetrate” Chávez's base, “divide Chavismo” and isolate him.
4d3caed283: The DEA and American border guards oversee anti-drug operations in the Andes, notably in Bolivia and Peru. The program lasts until 1994.
4d3cc3c240: About 7,000 American soldiers invade the island after the assassination of Maurice Bishop. The UN General Assembly condemns the intervention.
4d429b9468: Record fine for Odebrecht and Braskem
The two groups plead guilty before U.S. courts and agree to about $3.5 billion in penalties, shared among the United States, Brazil and Switzerland. Odebrecht will not recover.
4d4c946a20: American submarines spy for years on Soviet naval ports and tests, sometimes inside its territorial waters. Seymour Hersh reveals the program in 1975.
4d4e13df58: US support for the siege of Marawi

US special forces provide intelligence, aerial surveillance and technical support to the Philippine army against groups allied with the Islamic State. The fighting and bombing leave the city destroyed.
4d5b04bfa0: Marines land and occupy the country until 1934. Washington controls customs, finances and the gendarmerie.
4d5fe275f9: The Johnson administration approves a food loan announced a few weeks before the elections, to favor Forbes Burnham without appearing to intervene. Reported by historian Stephen Rabe.
4d63f0d9dc: A CIA telex, attributed to the head of its Asia division Ted Shackley, warns ASIO that Whitlam threatens intelligence cooperation, a few days before his dismissal. No link with the governor-general's decision is proven.
4d6ba748dc: Enercon spied on by the NSA

According to the press cited by the European Parliament, the NSA allegedly intercepted data from wind turbine maker Enercon for the benefit of an American competitor. The United States acknowledged nothing.
4d75a6f7ca: From September 10 to 15, 1924, Marines land again in Honduras during the civil war, after the March intervention in Tegucigalpa.
4d838250a4: Military aid to the Salvadoran army
Washington funds, arms and advises the Salvadoran army during the civil war, which kills about 75,000 people, mostly civilians.
4d841a981b: SACO, Alliance with Dai Li's Secret Police
The U.S. Navy signs the SACO agreement with Dai Li, head of the Kuomintang secret police, and trains his agents. Beijing later presents his Chongqing prisons as a “SACO camp.”
4d86ac0c3b: The 1.8 million metadata records attributed to the NSA were captured in Somalia by Dutch military intelligence, equipped by the NSA for the fight against piracy, and then shared. Revealed by NRC in 2014.
4d898e9eba: Pentagon documents leaked on Discord reveal eavesdropping on advisers to the South Korean president about shells supplied to Ukraine.
4d8aa1526f: New sanctions on the Cuban economy
Washington sanctions nine Cuban state companies in mining, metallurgy and construction, including the Ministry of Construction, in addition to the oil blockade.
4d9e0f417f: Castro's former mistress Marita Lorenz claims to have received pills from the CIA to poison him, which she says she hid in a jar of cream where they dissolved. The account is supported only by her testimony.
4db2df9eaf: AUKUS: the “contract of the century” broken

The announcement of the AUKUS pact leads Australia to abandon Naval Group's 12 submarines, a €56 billion contract, in favor of US or British nuclear-powered submarines. Paris recalls its ambassadors to Washington and Canberra.
4dbe3bfe47: The Supreme Court recognizes the right of Guantánamo detainees to challenge their detention before federal courts, a right Congress had sought to remove.
4dcb54e5d3: Bombing of the Plain of Jars
The bombing empties the region of its inhabitants. Refugees describe years spent in caves. The US Senate hears their testimony in 1970.
4deda587f1: More than 150 innocents held at Guantánamo

Detainee files show that the military knew that at least 150 men, including an 89-year-old Afghan and a 14-year-old boy, had no business being there. Some were held over a Casio watch. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2011.
4df1087898: The 4th Marine Regiment lands in Shanghai to protect the International Settlement. It remains there until 1941.
4e0eee5d29: Fire at the El Encanto Department Store

An arson fire destroys Havana's largest department store and kills an employee, Fe del Valle. Cuba attributes it to a network of opponents linked to the CIA. The American role is not publicly established.
4e112d68ea: The partisan Juozas Lukša is dropped into Lithuania with two companions to reinforce the anti-Soviet armed resistance. Historians attribute the operation to the CIA.
4e367e67d9: GAO finds the aid freeze illegal
The Government Accountability Office concludes that the Trump administration's suspension of aid to Ukraine violated the Impoundment Control Act.
4e38a38da1: Treaty on the Brdy missile-defence radar
Prague signs with Washington the installation of a radar of the American missile shield, while 60 to 70% of Czechs oppose it according to polls. Obama abandons the project in September 2009.
4e5c86d39b: Former national security adviser Robert McFarlane and Oliver North travel to Tehran with missile parts to negotiate the release of the hostages in Lebanon.
4e63db4e3b: The overthrown prime minister surrenders the day after the coup. The Zahedi government, installed by the CIA and MI6, imprisons him along with several of his ministers.
4e7a250153: Two explosive-laden drones target Maduro during a parade. Caracas blames Colombia and financiers who took refuge in the United States; Washington denies any involvement.
4e7db808f1: According to Le Monde, the NSA collected data on more than 70 million communications in France in one month and targeted Alcatel-Lucent and Wanadoo.
4ea5368e21: Creation of the “Free Albania” National Committee
The CIA and MI6 gather anti-Communist exiles in the “Free Albania” National Committee, the political front for their infiltration operations. The files were declassified in 2006.
4f02d3ec92: The Colombian army kills the FARC's number two on Ecuadorian territory. According to the Washington Post (2013), a secret CIA program supplied Bogotá with the GPS-guided bombs.
4f06151a95: Martial Law After the Damien Strike
A strike by students at the Damien agricultural school spreads across the country. High Commissioner Russell proclaims martial law; the Marines subsequently fire on demonstrators at Les Cayes.
4f1dbe66c8: Executive Order 13685 bans all U.S. trade and investment in annexed Crimea.
4f1de076d5: After his death, the Marines photograph Charlemagne Péralte's body tied to a door and circulate the image to discourage resistance. It instead becomes a nationalist icon.
4f1ff58856: The State Department gives Guaidó authority over Venezuelan government accounts held at the New York Federal Reserve and other US banks.
4f247203d2: The CIA, with Canada, gets six American diplomats out of Iran under the cover of a fake film crew. The CIA's role was made public in 1997.
4f26ea761d: The same TV Globo report shows that the NSA read messages from Enrique Peña Nieto when he was a candidate.
4f3ee7fa67: Three months after the withdrawal from the nuclear deal, Washington reinstates sanctions on Iran's automotive sector, metals and purchases of dollars.
4f7ccb7aa4: Kennedy imposes a naval blockade to stop Soviet deliveries. It is the moment closest to nuclear war.
4f8e69b6bf: The first thermonuclear bomb, of 10.4 megatons, vaporizes the islet of Elugelab at Enewetak.
4f8f4337c7: Four Serbian aircraft shot down in Bosnia
American NATO F-16s shoot down four Bosnian Serb aircraft that were violating the no-fly zone. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
4f9a6cf538: Green light to strike inside Russia
Biden authorizes Ukraine to strike military targets on Russian territory near Kharkiv with American weapons; Blinken confirms it on May 31.
4fba3a857e: A US strike south of Baghdad kills four members of the Popular Mobilization Forces. Washington says it targeted fighters preparing drone attacks.
4fcf5b1d39: Trump authorizes sanctions on staff of the International Criminal Court who investigate Americans or allies without their consent.
4fdf407860: The Treasury sanctions the Central Bank of Venezuela and cuts its access to dollar transactions.
4ff4cb8916: The Philippine Commission, appointed by Washington, passes Act No. 292: advocating independence, even peacefully, becomes punishable by heavy prison sentences.
5007e4fb74: Beijing accuses the NED and its institutes of having financed and orchestrated the protests, and sanctions them. The NED openly funds Hong Kong groups; its role in the protests has not been established.
50149883bb: A B-52 collides with a tanker aircraft. Two of the four thermonuclear bombs break apart and contaminate the village's farmland with plutonium.
5014c018a3: AWACS and F-15s against Libya in Chad
Reagan deploys two AWACS, eight F-15 fighters and logistical support to help Chad against Libyan and rebel forces. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
50731b5f8b: Eleven dead in three boat strikes
Southern Command announces three strikes on vessels described as drug-trafficking boats, two in the eastern Pacific and one in the Caribbean: eleven dead.
507ef97cb1: The Marines forbid government troops to attack Bluefields, held by Estrada's rebels, who subsequently take power.
509a3e66ee: Order 13662 and sanctions against Bank Rossiya
Executive Order 13662 opens the way to sectoral sanctions. The Treasury freezes the assets of Bank Rossiya and Putin associates, including Gennady Timchenko and the Rotenberg brothers.
50cba8c843: Two days after Stanleyville, American C-130s drop Belgian paratroopers on Paulis, held by the Simba, to free hostages.
50d10c1907: Clinton freezes Taliban assets in the United States and bans trade with the areas they control, in order to obtain the handover of bin Laden.
50db13cd4a: The CIA buys the airline Civil Air Transport. It supplies the Nationalists, drops agents into China and becomes Air America.
50e12295e6: WIROGUE, another CIA agent, tries to recruit QJWIN into an “execution squad.” The Church Committee reports it, with no established link to Lumumba's death.
50ef0b4849: Massive bombing of the caves where bin Laden is located, with Afghan militias on the ground. The Senate will conclude in 2009 that the refusal to send troops let him escape to Pakistan.
5112c4748a: WikiLeaks publishes a list of numbers of the chancellery and German ministries targeted by the NSA for decades.
512acb79bb: The United States blocks the recommendation to admit the State of Palestine as a full member of the UN, backed by twelve Council members.
512b172339: During the first Taiwan Strait crisis, Dulles and Eisenhower publicly state that tactical nuclear weapons could be used against China.
512d2eaa67: The military stages the rescue of soldier Jessica Lynch and officials describe her fighting to the end. In 2007, she herself tells Congress that this heroic account was false.
5153ea49b0: A U.S. Marine mission trains François Duvalier's Haitian army until 1963, as he installs his dictatorship.
515cf5ab57: After Washington withdraws its support, a US Air Force aircraft takes Jean-Claude Duvalier and his family to France. A military council led by General Namphy takes power.
516e216173: An epidemic forces the slaughter of about half a million pigs. In 1977, Newsday claims that a CIA-linked source introduced the virus. The CIA denies it.
51896906d8: Marines fight the peasant guerrillas of the East. Torture and summary executions are examined by a U.S. Senate commission in 1921–22.
51aa3f8205: A general strike against Jagan is secretly funded by the CIA via American unions. The official FRUS series confirms the covert action.
51ab33b985: The New York financial regulator fines the Italian bank 235 million dollars, accused in particular of having processed between 2002 and 2006 more than 11 billion dollars of transactions for Iranian clients and other sanctioned entities.
51ade067fa: UCA witness questioned by the FBI
Lucía Barrera de Cerna, a witness to the Jesuit massacre, is taken to Miami and subjected to FBI interrogations in the presence of a Salvadoran officer, until she recants.
51e3b72776: Klaus Barbie Recruited by the CIC

The U.S. Army's Counter Intelligence Corps (CIC) employs the former head of the Lyon Gestapo as an informant and shields him from French requests. A Justice Department report acknowledges this in 1983.
51ed5c4aa9: Cover-up of the My Lai massacre
The massacre is stifled by the chain of command until Seymour Hersh's revelations. The Peers Commission establishes the cover-up and implicates dozens of officers.
51f386c399: After the coup, an international consortium takes control of Iranian oil production. The American majors obtain 40 percent, with the support of Washington, which limits antitrust prosecutions to that end.
51f7f45e4e: US special forces capture in Libya a suspect in the 2012 Benghazi attack and take him to the United States, where he is convicted.
5212179984: Iran placed on the terror list
Washington designates Iran a state sponsor of terrorism, which bans arms sales and aid and requires opposing its international loans.
521f976857: Scott Bessent launches an “economic D-Day” to cut off Iran's last resources and threatens third countries with secondary sanctions. More than 60 entities and ships are sanctioned.
52500288f8: China's CVERC claims that the Volt Typhoon group, attributed to Beijing by Washington, is a US disinformation campaign, then accuses the NSA of using false flags.
52550ec705: The black budget published by the Washington Post based on the Snowden documents shows intensive surveillance of Pakistan, its nuclear weapons and its leaders.
525f6bab73: The coalition provides air support for the Iraqi army's recapture of Mosul. An AP investigation estimates more than 9,000 civilians killed, by all sides.
526aec5d86: CIA analyst Brian Latell presents senators with a portrait of Aristide as “unstable” and under treatment. These claims, picked up by his opponents in Congress, are later refuted.
5273d30b5b: AB InBev pays 6 million under the FCPA
The SEC accuses the Belgian brewer of illicit payments by its Indian subsidiary and of a confidentiality clause deterring a whistleblower. AB InBev settles the case for about 6 million dollars.
5288476681: Washington and London indict two Libyan agents, Abdelbaset al-Megrahi and Lamin Fhimah, for the Lockerbie bombing. Megrahi is convicted in 2001; his guilt remains contested by some experts and by relatives of victims.
52889260a3: Washington cancels the visa of the sitting Colombian head of state, whom it accuses of having received Cali cartel money.
5293e40e7e: Syrian internet cut by the NSA

According to Edward Snowden, interviewed by Wired in 2014, an attempt by the TAO unit to implant software in a core router of a Syrian provider knocked it out and caused the outage. No published document supports this.
52ad945ae4: In retaliation, Beijing closes the US consulate in Chengdu, accusing it of interfering in China's internal affairs, notably in Tibet.
52afe673a1: The United States blocks the return of the Czechoslovak monetary gold looted by the Nazis in order to obtain compensation for nationalised American property. Congress rejects an agreement in 1974. The gold is returned only in 1982.
52be3c789d: The press publishes a 1919 letter from General George Barnett, Marine commandant, referring to “practically indiscriminate killing of natives.” The Navy opens an inquiry that concludes they were isolated cases.
52d68f1f9c: American aircraft strike a Serb target in the exclusion zone around Sarajevo after the seizure of weapons under UN control. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
52d7f3495c: BND and BfV equipped with XKeyscore
German foreign intelligence has used the NSA's analysis tool since 2007, domestic intelligence since 2012, to “support the NSA.” Revealed by Der Spiegel in July 2013.
52fa237aa8: 20% toll at Hormuz and blockade returns
Trump announces that the United States will become the “guardians” of Hormuz and will levy 20% on all cargoes, then drops the toll the next day but reinstates the blockade of Iranian ports.
533fa4a9b7: GCHQ and NSA target lists covering 2008 to 2011 include the oil group Total and the defense contractor Thales. Revealed by The Guardian, the New York Times and Der Spiegel in December 2013.
5359b735e9: Dino Bouterse caught in a DEA trap
The son of the Surinamese president is arrested in Panama in a DEA sting and then transferred to New York, where he is convicted of trafficking and supporting Hezbollah.
5367670a85: The State Department bars from the United States Gabriel Escarrer, CEO of the Mallorca-based hotel group Meliá, and his family, under Title IV of the Helms-Burton Act, over its hotels in Cuba.
5372e72e09: Part of the spraying targets rice paddies and crops in guerrilla-held areas, to starve its fighters and the populations that support them.
5395c06b60: Washington funds Violeta Chamorro's UNO opposition through the National Endowment for Democracy. She defeats the Sandinistas.
53a0d6eb02: The State Department sanctions Arctic LNG 2, Novatek's Arctic gas project, along with dozens of companies in Russia and third countries.
53b402be04: Washington has Nicaragua sign a treaty providing for loans from New York banks secured by customs revenue, with customs placed under a collector approved by the United States. The U.S. Senate does not ratify it, but customs control is put in place.
53b43ce8b3: The CIA secretly pays about two million dollars to the centrist parties, chiefly José Napoleón Duarte, for the Salvadoran presidential election. The affair is revealed by the American press.
53c83e00df: U.S. Army Takes Over the Gehlen Organization
General Reinhard Gehlen, former head of Wehrmacht intelligence on the Eastern Front, works for the U.S. Army and then, from 1949, for the CIA, with many former SS men in his network.
53de5e8bbb: The Washington Post publishes internal interviews in which officials admit having misled the public about progress in the war for years.
53ea02f1b2: American soldiers cross the border to drive out Pancho Villa's troops who were attacking the city.
53fe0c1584: An A-4 Skyhawk armed with a B43 thermonuclear bomb falls off the carrier Ticonderoga, about 130 km from the Ryukyu Islands. The bomb is never recovered. Japan only learns of it in 1989.
540e57d14f: Four weeks after Bravo, the Romeo test reaches 11 megatons, well beyond predictions, and recontaminates Bikini Atoll.
5434659188: After health problems among its diplomats, Washington downsizes its embassy and expels 15 Cuban diplomats. In 2023, US intelligence judges the involvement of a foreign adversary very unlikely.
54377633c8: One billion in credits despite the BNL affair

Despite the investigation into the Atlanta branch of Banca Nazionale del Lavoro's clandestine loans to Iraq, the government approves one billion dollars in credit guarantees. Congress later investigates this “Iraqgate”.
5444f3b58c: Third veto on Gaza: the United States blocks an Algerian draft demanding an immediate humanitarian ceasefire, as Israel prepares the assault on Rafah.
54474afe4a: Delivery of the Mistrals to Russia suspended
After the annexation of Crimea, Paris suspends delivery of two helicopter carriers to Russia, under heavy public pressure from Washington, which had demanded that the contract be canceled.
547616b050: After Marine Le Pen's conviction and five-year ban from holding office, the State Department calls her exclusion “concerning” and Donald Trump writes “FREE MARINE LE PEN!”, speaking of a “witch hunt”.
54816a1d28: Strikes on Jurf al-Sakhar in Iraq
Two hours after the attack on Iran begins, unclaimed strikes, attributed to the United States, target Kataib Hezbollah camps at Jurf al-Sakhar, south of Baghdad.
54aed6fc1b: Ammunition drawn from the stockpile in Israel
In the middle of the Gaza war, the Pentagon authorizes Israel to draw mortar and tank shells from the U.S. stockpile prepositioned on its soil.
54e388ac55: Sanctions after the Ryanair flight hijacking
Coordinated with the EU, the United Kingdom and Canada, sanctions target 16 individuals and 5 Belarusian entities after the diversion of a Ryanair flight to arrest Roman Protasevich.
54e6bbdf7c: Handed over by the CIA to Egypt, Ibn al-Sheikh al-Libi claims that Iraq trained al-Qaeda in chemical weapons. The DIA doubted him as early as February 2002; Powell nonetheless repeats his claims. He recants, according to the Senate.
54f4e44bad: USAID strengthens the regions against Morales
An April 2007 cable describes USAID's effort to strengthen the autonomist departments as a “counterweight” to the central government: 101 grants for about $4 million. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2011.
54f95b2b20: Alone against fourteen, the United States blocks a draft demanding a ceasefire and the lifting of restrictions on humanitarian aid to Gaza.
5509f3c4d4: American special forces train a Civil Guard battalion, in a country with no army, on a former Somoza property near the Nicaraguan border.
550ec4115c: CAATSA sanction on the Chinese military
First application of Section 231 of the CAATSA law: the State Department sanctions China's Equipment Development Department for buying Russian Su-35s and S-400s.
55154e4861: Washington provides weapons, intelligence and in-flight refueling to the Riyadh-led coalition against the Houthis. The coalition's bombing kills thousands of civilians.
553333d64c: From 1992 to 1995, the CIA, through Iyad Allawi's network, directs a campaign of sabotage and bombings in Baghdad, according to former officials cited by the American press.
555dce40c9: A military court of the regime that emerged from the coup sentences Mossadegh to three years in prison. He then remains under house arrest at Ahmadabad until his death in 1967.
555e94aa6f: Four US soldiers and four Nigeriens are killed by the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara. The affair reveals to Americans the scale of their operations in Niger.
55785941dc: According to the New York Times, U.S. officials met several times in 2017 and 2018 with Venezuelan officers who were preparing a coup, without giving them material aid. Washington does not deny it.
55857fffa9: Handed over to the Katangan secessionists, he is killed in the presence of Belgian officers. The Church Committee does not conclude direct CIA involvement. The station, informed of the transfer, did not oppose it, according to historian Stephen Weissman.
558ebb449b: Barack Obama sends about a hundred special forces soldiers to advise the Ugandan army and its neighbors in the hunt for the LRA. The mission ends in 2017 without capturing Kony.
55af938318: Gora Prai strike on Pakistani soldiers
U.S. air strikes kill eleven Pakistani Frontier Corps soldiers at a border post. Islamabad denounces aggression. Washington cites self-defense.
55b21be5ba: The White House creates a group tasked with promoting the war. Chief of staff Andrew Card explains that one doesn't introduce “new products in August.” The group coordinates messaging on Iraqi weapons.
55f205659a: First thermonuclear bomb dropped from an aircraft by the United States, Cherokee releases 3.8 megatons over Bikini, in the Redwing series of 17 tests.
55f659bf45: Overthrown by the army, President Gallegos accuses the oil companies and an American military attaché of having backed the coup. Washington denies it.
55f770fa60: Brazilian communications vacuumed up by the NSA
O Globo reveals, based on the Snowden documents, that the NSA collects Brazilians' calls and emails in bulk.
5608bfd504: Operation Cedar Falls and razing of Bến Súc
The army forcibly evacuates the inhabitants of the Iron Triangle, then razes the village of Bến Súc with bulldozers and explosives.
5610d87584: Aid to the Baathist Regime During the Purge

After the coup, Washington offers material support to the new Baathist government, amid the anti-Communist purge and during abuses against rebels and Kurdish civilians. National Guard members involved had been trained in the United States.
561e9c57fe: Landings at Puerto Plata and Sosúa
During the Dominican civil war, the U.S. Navy lands sailors at Puerto Plata, Sosúa and Santo Domingo to protect American interests, according to Congress's official list.
5624f1e4c7: According to the New York Times and Der Spiegel, the NSA penetrated Huawei's servers to monitor its executives and implant backdoors.
562d515a11: Arizona Rangers cross the border to help suppress a strike by miners at the American-owned Cananea Consolidated Copper. Several miners are killed.
5644d4c239: On the initiative of the United States, the United Kingdom and France, Resolution 748 imposes an air and arms embargo to obtain the handover of the Lockerbie suspects. The sanctions are suspended in 1999.
56473accb4: The gunboat USS Nashville prevents Colombian troops from crushing the secession. Washington recognizes Panama three days later and obtains the canal by treaty.
564e00feb9: Explosion of the Freighter La Coubre
A French freighter loaded with Belgian arms explodes in Havana harbor and kills dozens. Fidel Castro accuses the United States. No public evidence has confirmed it.
5666c4ff9f: Mongoose considers paying bounties to anyone who kills or delivers Communists; Castro would be worth only 2 cents, to belittle him.
566732666e: The toppling of the Saddam Hussein statue, broadcast around the world, was organized by Marines and a psychological operations team, according to an internal Army study revealed by the Los Angeles Times.
5668ffff03: After the death of more than a hundred protesters at the Gaza border, Washington blocks a Kuwaiti draft calling for measures to protect Palestinian civilians.
567cac9c6c: A border incident degenerates into combat. American troops enter Nogales, Sonora; Mexican soldiers and civilians are killed, including the mayor.
56a9618607: Assange handed over after asylum lifted
President Lenín Moreno withdraws asylum; Assange is arrested inside the embassy and Washington unseals his indictment. His supporters link the reversal to the IMF loan granted to Quito in March.
56be8510f8: JD Vance, Witkoff and Kushner negotiate for more than 12 hours with Ghalibaf and Araghchi. Washington demands an end to all enrichment and the export of enriched uranium. Vance leaves on April 12 without a deal.
56c11c14e2: After the Nairobi and Dar es Salaam bombings, dozens of cruise missiles hit camps linked to Bin Laden (Operation Infinite Reach). Bin Laden is not hit.
56c5c92556: Arrested at JFK airport, this Canadian is sent to Syria, where he is tortured for nearly a year. A Canadian commission clears him; Ottawa compensates him.
56f163c794: The CIA sets up with Dr. Shakil Afridi a fake hepatitis B vaccination drive to obtain DNA from bin Laden's family. The Taliban later use it against polio vaccinators.
570826e621: OFAC forces Raiffeisen to back down

Under threat of US Treasury measures that could cut it off from the dollar financial system, Raiffeisen Bank International gives up buying Strabag shares linked to the sanctioned oligarch Oleg Deripaska.
57146d60a0: The Treasury adds several dozen individuals and entities, including subsidiaries of banks already targeted and companies active in Crimea, to the Ukraine-related sanctions lists.
5717f2cab0: Immunity for US military personnel in Iran
At Washington's request, the Majlis extends diplomatic immunity to US military personnel and their families. Khomeini denounces a “capitulation” and the Shah exiles him on 4 November.
57182514a6: Agent K. V. Unnikrishnan turned by the CIA

A RAW officer posted in Madras is arrested for passing to the CIA information on India's intervention in Sri Lanka, after being entrapped by an American woman agent according to the Indian investigation.
572b5f6239: A March 2009 agreement allows the NSA to pass raw intercepts, including those of U.S. citizens, to Israeli signals intelligence without prior filtering. Revealed by The Guardian in September 2013.
574727b04d: Anglo-American plot to overthrow the Syrian government with officers and tribes, canceled by the Suez crisis.
574c245826: The State Department approves the sale to Ukraine of 3,350 ERAM long-range air-to-ground missiles for about $825 million, partly funded by allies.
575c03ccc8: B-26s supplied by the CIA, painted in Cuban colors, attack three airfields two days before the landing.
575da799ec: Cables published by WikiLeaks in 2011 show that the U.S. embassy pressed the Préval government not to join the Venezuelan PetroCaribe oil agreement.
57720d6f2a: A $400 million drawdown including Bradley armored vehicles, and Patriot and HIMARS munitions.
5775785e94: The spy ship Impeccable, tracking submarines near the Yulin base, is surrounded by Chinese vessels.
577ef4e42b: American forces protect the legation and the cable station during fighting between Unionists and the government. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
57aca8552c: The day after the Constituent Assembly election, the Treasury freezes Maduro's assets, calling him a “dictator.”
57c7e680e8: Recognition of the election under the junta
Unlike most Latin American countries, Washington recognizes the election organized by the de facto regime, won by Porfirio Lobo.
57cf88f704: Arms Delivered to Honduras and Nicaragua
Washington signs military agreements with Honduras and Nicaragua and flies arms to them, while Castillo Armas's force settles in Honduras.
57ea165cd4: Evo Morales expels the U.S. agency, which he accuses of conspiring with the opposition and manipulating peasant organizations. Washington rejects these accusations.
57f60c6fd5: The US Navy bombards the inhabited island of Culebra during its exercises. Rubén Berríos and activists occupy a beach and are arrested; the Navy leaves Culebra in 1975.
5804fbbca0: U.S. military personnel humiliate, beat and torture detainees, as shown in photos revealed in April 2004. Eleven soldiers convicted; in 2024, a jury orders the contractor CACI to pay $42 million.
580aa07f6f: Eleven civilians, including children, are killed in a U.S. raid on a house. A UN rapporteur concludes they were executions; the military investigation clears the soldiers.
580d0e5302: A US law sanctions the companies laying the pipeline. The Swiss pipe-layer Allseas withdraws immediately; Berlin denounces interference.
580ff7ac33: Obama signs Executive Order 13660, which allows sanctions on those responsible for Russia's intervention in Crimea. The first people targeted are designated on March 17.
5816e9cf8a: Before veterans, Dick Cheney says there is “no doubt” that Saddam Hussein has weapons of mass destruction. Intelligence did not have that certainty.
581d20bab4: The elections planned at Geneva for July 1956 never take place. Diệm refuses them with Washington's support. Eisenhower writes that Hồ Chí Minh would have won about 80 percent of the vote.
582f0ab1e2: Ambassador Lincoln Gordon redirects Alliance for Progress aid to governors hostile to President Goulart, such as Carlos Lacerda, described as “islands of sanity.”
584c441a5c: The US Treasury backs the IMF's austerity demands on the Callaghan government. Historians have documented this role in the budget cuts imposed.
5858f3b381: Norway passes on its Afghan intercepts

A document first attributed to the NSA lists 33 million calls in one month; Norwegian intelligence says it captured them in Afghanistan and shared them with the Americans. Revealed by Dagbladet in November 2013.
585a3e39eb: Nixon has every vehicle searched at the border for three weeks to force Mexico City to fight marijuana. Border trade is paralyzed.
587f1735ba: Pressure over the Polish Holocaust law

According to Onet, Washington threatens to stop receiving President Duda and Prime Minister Morawiecki and to freeze military projects if the law is not amended. Official denials. Warsaw softens it in June 2018.
58a4e7a5b6: With the TURBINE system and QUANTUM attacks, which for example imitate Facebook or LinkedIn, the NSA and GCHQ automate the implanting of spyware, targeting millions of machines. Revealed by The Intercept in March 2014.
58b21cca6f: A cruise missile with cluster submunitions kills 41 civilians, including 21 children. Sanaa claims the strike; Amnesty and a WikiLeaks cable establish that it was American.
58b642e6c6: The 40 Committee authorizes 250,000 dollars to push the Chilean Congress not to elect Allende and to get Frei to go along with a constitutional maneuver. The maneuver fails.
58baeec2fc: First strikes of the Obama era
Three days after the inauguration, two drone strikes kill about twenty people. One hits the home of a pro-government tribal leader and kills civilians.
58bfebd55f: Six dead in a Pacific strike
A strike ordered by General Francis Donovan on a vessel suspected of drug trafficking kills six people in the eastern Pacific.
58c0f85325: The CIA puts two Egyptians expelled by Sweden on a plane to Cairo, where they are tortured. The UN Committee against Torture condemns Sweden.
58ca6307bd: A $275 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition, shells and anti-tank weapons.
5904cc7dfd: Operation Lightning Thunder against the LRA
AFRICOM advisers help plan and fund the Ugandan attack on LRA camps. The offensive fails and the LRA kills hundreds of civilians in reprisal at Christmas.
591ef7e085: Israeli aircraft kill Hassan Nasrallah with dozens of heavy bombs. According to image analyses cited by CNN and the New York Times, they include US-made BLU-109 bunker-busters.
5931b995b4: An American military court convicts the writer Fabio Fiallo for texts hostile to the occupation, as part of the press censorship imposed by the military government.
593236124e: Arrested in Karachi, this British resident is transferred by the CIA to Morocco, where he is tortured, then to Guantánamo. British courts confirm his mistreatment.
59a27f271b: In the first combat use of the stealth bomber, two F-117s drop bombs near the Río Hato barracks, before the Rangers' assault.
59acde1965: The destructive software, attributed to Russian military intelligence, paralyzes Ukraine and then companies such as Maersk and Saint-Gobain, reusing EternalBlue, a tool stolen from the NSA.
59ceb5b076: The American government launches a radio station aimed at Cuba, funded with public money. Cuba jams its broadcasts.
59d1c2939d: A secret special forces unit beats and humiliates detainees at a base at Baghdad airport. Human Rights Watch documents this abuse in 2006 based on soldiers' testimony.
59ed303028: Trump signs an executive order sanctioning Cuban government officials accused of repression and of threatening US security, in the midst of the oil blockade.
59fc1a45ad: Oliver Schmidt, former head of Volkswagen's environmental office in the United States, is arrested at Miami airport in the rigged diesel engines case. He is sentenced in December 2017 to seven years in prison.
5a115851af: CENTCOM announces it has destroyed several Iranian ships, including 16 minelayers near the Strait of Hormuz, after Trump's threat of “never before seen” retaliation.
5a512d8c21: The Joint Chiefs of Staff propose false-flag attacks, including against Americans, to justify an invasion of Cuba. Kennedy rejects the plan.
5a6b32792c: After the attack on the Pleiku base, US aircraft bomb targets in the North, including Đồng Hới.
5a7210f013: Immunity for Unit 731 in Exchange for Its Data

Washington grants immunity to Shirō Ishii and members of Unit 731, perpetrators of lethal experiments on prisoners in China, in exchange for their data on biological weapons. Declassified archives establish this.
5a8df60d2c: Raymond Davis kills two men in Lahore
A CIA contractor kills two Pakistanis in the street; a vehicle sent to extract him runs over a passerby. He is released in March after payment of “blood money.”
5a9bd4baa4: The U.S. Navy formally organizes the Yangtze Patrol, gunboats that sail up the river to protect American interests, until 1941.
5aa064b8bf: George W. Bush signs the Syria Accountability Act, which bans most U.S. exports to Syria. He implements it by executive order in May 2004.
5aa2024835: After the Jeddah talks where Kyiv accepts a proposal for a 30-day ceasefire, Washington lifts the suspension of military aid and intelligence.
5ad676c326: The National Endowment for Democracy and its institutes fund the Union of Democratic Forces and the Podkrepa trade union before the first free elections.
5aece26fed: The United States invades Iraq without a UN mandate, in the name of nonexistent weapons of mass destruction. Baghdad falls on April 9; the occupation lasts until 2011.
5af001fa13: Congress votes 27 million dollars in “humanitarian” aid to the Contras, managed by the State Department.
5af6c10c8d: After Germany's domestic intelligence classifies the AfD as extremist, Marco Rubio sees a “tyranny in disguise.” The German ministry replies: “This is democracy.”
5afc71eb42: Alstom agrees to the heaviest criminal fine ever imposed at the time under the FCPA, while negotiating the sale of its energy division to General Electric.
5b16f1f520: Eisenhower cuts the Cuban sugar import quota to almost nothing, the island's main resource.
5b1c250049: The Treasury, Commerce and the State Department sanction seven senior Russian officials, including the FSB director, and chemical-weapons-related entities after the poisoning of Alexei Navalny.
5b91155a6c: Fighter-bombers break the Toksan irrigation dam. The flood sweeps away villages and rice paddies at transplanting time, in a campaign aimed at the North's crops.
5ba2ac00d1: The IMF grants Mauricio Macri the largest loan in its history, raised to $57 billion. Mauricio Claver-Carone, a Trump adviser, later admits that Washington backed it to help Macri.
5bb7092ffa: IMSC maritime coalition in the Gulf
The United States creates the International Maritime Security Construct (Operation Sentinel), a naval coalition tasked with escorting ships in the Strait of Hormuz in the face of Iran.
5bbefe6b27: NATO bombs the headquarters of Serbian radio and television, regarded as a propaganda outlet: 16 employees killed. Amnesty International calls it a war crime.
5bc7740b79: An executive order bars Americans from investing in Chinese companies designated as linked to the military.
5bc86e28c8: The security police Supo first denies knowing of a surveillance unit at the American embassy, then acknowledges being informed of it. It is part of the network of “Surveillance Detection Units” revealed in Norway.
5be0d16f20: Two young pro-independence activists lured by an undercover agent are killed by police. The FBI's federal investigation clears them; police officers are convicted after a Puerto Rican Senate inquiry.
5c0a1f91f4: A Baltimore Sun series documents that the CIA trained and supported Battalion 316, knew of its torture and killings, and that the embassy kept silent about them.
5c0cc84688: After Moscow's recognition of the Donetsk and Luhansk republics, Biden bans all US trade and investment in these territories.
5c1647dca7: Trump adds a 25% penalty to the tariffs on India for its purchases of Russian oil, bringing the total to 50% from August 27.
5c1b2763eb: Huawei cut off from TSMC chips
Washington extends its export rules to any chip made with US tools, which deprives Huawei of its Taiwanese foundry TSMC.
5c1d74737a: Turkey creates the stay-behind structure that will become the Counter-Guerrilla, trained and funded with American help. It is accused of political violence in the 1970s.
5c3befa60b: The CIA considers spraying an LSD-like substance in the studio from which Castro gives his televised speeches. The project is abandoned. The Church Committee reports it.
5c4aad4337: About 600 American soldiers from the Canal Zone intervene in Panama to suppress the tenants' movement. There are deaths.
5c4f12460a: The 1960 legislative elections are massively rigged in favor of the right. CIA agents reportedly distributed money to influence the vote.
5c57b39072: Two weeks after Ivy Mike, a bomber drops a 500-kiloton fission bomb on Enewetak, the most powerful ever tested by the United States.
5c5ac7d0d2: Trump appoints Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry special envoy to Greenland; he welcomes the plan to make the island part of the United States. Copenhagen summons Ambassador Ken Howery.
5c5b7e6ea6: Otpor activists attend nonviolent struggle seminars in Budapest led by former U.S. colonel Robert Helvey, funded by the International Republican Institute.
5c5c888ae5: The CIA funds posters, articles and leaflets against Allende before the presidential election, with the approval of the 40 Committee. The Church Committee established this.
5c5fe64d8e: A few days after the Liquiçá church massacre, Pacific Command chief Dennis Blair meets General Wiranto and offers cooperation instead of the warning that had been planned, according to cables revealed in 1999.
5c60827029: Rose plan: joint attack with Egypt
Military component of the Flower plan according to Bob Woodward: a preventive Egyptian attack on Libya, backed by the United States, is studied to overthrow Gaddafi. President Mubarak refuses.
5caef38dc1: Alex Saab freed in exchange for Americans
Joe Biden pardons Alex Saab, exchanged for ten Americans held in Venezuela, including the two former soldiers of Operation Gideon, and for the fugitive “Fat Leonard.”
5cc79c2e7b: The poor neighborhood surrounding Noriega's headquarters burns under the strikes. Civilian deaths range from several hundred to a few thousand depending on the source.
5cd26db0da: Colonel Rabuka overthrows the government of Timoci Bavadra, which favored a nuclear-free Pacific. CIA involvement has been alleged, with no public proof.
5cd8c4d21c: The 9th Division claims nearly 11,000 enemy killed for 748 weapons seized. Newsweek (1972) estimates that thousands of the victims were civilians.
5ce575be6d: Federal justice indicts the former Cuban leader for murder and conspiracy, thirty years after the shootdown of the Brothers to the Rescue planes. The announcement accompanies the pressure campaign on Havana.
5cf2913db9: At the APEC summit, Vice President Al Gore hails the “brave people” of Anwar Ibrahim's Reformasi movement, then imprisoned. Mahathir Mohamad denounces interference.
5d31c0596f: The day after Tōjō's hanging, the occupation authorities release without trial Kishi Nobusuke, a minister in Tōjō's cabinet, as well as Kodama Yoshio and Sasakawa Ryōichi. Kishi becomes prime minister in 1957.
5d6b03bf6c: According to the New York Times, US intelligence helped Ukraine kill several Russian generals. The Pentagon denies providing intelligence for the purpose of killing generals.
5d6fca699a: Police, under the orders of Governor Blanton Winship, fire on a Nationalist parade: 19 dead. The Hays Commission concludes it was a massacre.
5d7c076cf7: Biden authorizes a $100 million drawdown to meet an urgent need for Javelin anti-tank missiles.
5dacf07743: A fake news agency founded in Lisbon by Yves Guérin-Sérac, protected by the PIDE, which trains far-right activists. Italian investigations and historians point to links with the CIA and NATO, never established.
5dad92a655: The constitutionalist army chief is mortally wounded during a kidnapping attempt. The CIA had armed another group of plotters and afterwards pays the kidnappers 35,000 dollars.
5db5d759b1: On Biden's order, aircraft strike facilities of pro-Iranian militias near al-Qaim and in Syria. The Iraqi government denounces a violation of its sovereignty.
5dc5bb7d85: In the midst of the civil war, Firestone reaches an agreement with Taylor's NPFL, which controls its plantation, and pays it taxes. A ProPublica and Frontline investigation documents these payments in 2014.
5dd78f09c0: The Alfhem Serves as a Pretext
The freighter Alfhem delivers Czechoslovak arms to Guatemala, deprived of arms by the American embargo. Washington, forewarned by the CIA, exploits the arrival to denounce a Soviet beachhead.
5dde47fb3d: At the Munich conference, the vice president criticizes the firewall against the far right, then meets the AfD leader before the parliamentary election. Berlin denounces interference.
5debbd7f24: Hatoyama falls over the Futenma base

Prime Minister Hatoyama Yukio resigns after abandoning, under pressure from Washington, the relocation of the Futenma base out of Okinawa. Cables published by WikiLeaks show senior Japanese officials encouraging Washington to give nothing away.
5df2ac19d6: US Navy aircraft strike Syrian defenses in Lebanon. Two aircraft are shot down: one pilot dies, another is captured.
5df3bac0b5: The US Treasury extends Magnitsky sanctions to Viviane Barci de Moraes and a family company, after Jair Bolsonaro's conviction.
5e02cf3832: MI6 Proposes the Coup to the CIA
Expelled from Iran, British services, including Christopher Montague Woodhouse, propose to the CIA that they overthrow Mossadegh together. Washington waits for Eisenhower's arrival to decide.
5e053c10fd: American aircraft strike Serb positions besieging the UN-protected enclave of Goražde. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
5e080cd871: $400 million USAI in the defense bill
Trump signs the 2026 defense authorization law, which provides $400 million a year for the USAI in 2026 and 2027 and requires Congress to be notified of any suspension of intelligence.
5e0ff11544: Marine Guard at the Jerusalem Consulate
A Marine consular guard is sent to Jerusalem to protect the American consul general. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
5e1bf16549: During the Nationalist insurrection, National Guard aircraft bomb Jayuya and Utuado. Puerto Rico is then a territory under American administration.
5e6f75479c: The Philippine Commission bans the display of the Philippine flag and Katipunan emblems. The ban remains in force until 1919.
5e82f95840: Sea Supply and the Thai Police
Through the front company Sea Supply, the CIA arms and trains General Phao's Thai police and creates the paratrooper unit PARU.
5e89026532: Under US direction, South Vietnamese commandos attack the North Vietnamese coast. Hanoi links these raids to the US patrols in the Gulf of Tonkin.
5ebe807477: Deutsche Bank pays $258 million, including $200 million to the New York regulator and $58 million to the Federal Reserve, for transactions with Iran, Libya, Syria, Burma and Sudan.
5ebf1ca0c4: In force this day, the Compact of Free Association sets a 150 million dollar fund for nuclear damages and extinguishes all claims by Marshall Islanders in American courts.
5ee15ca9d0: The Justice Department (Bybee memo, written by John Yoo) authorizes the CIA to use waterboarding and other methods, by narrowly redefining torture.
5efb06974b: A $500 million program to train rebels against the Islamic State collapses. In September 2015, General Austin admits that only “four or five” fighters remain active.
5f066c7da0: Program approved in 1948 to recruit Eastern European émigrés for propaganda and covert action. It takes in former Nazi collaborators.
5f35656197: A US Air Force A-10 attack aircraft on a low-altitude training flight crashes into a building. Six residents and the pilot are killed, about fifty people injured.
5f7ba1fe05: Last test of the Castle series, Nectar releases 1.69 megatons in the crater left by Ivy Mike at Enewetak.
5f7c9c0366: Trump raises the use of “economic force” to make Canada the “51st state” and calls Justin Trudeau “governor.”
5f8da31cfa: At Washington's initiative, UN Resolution 661 imposes a near-total embargo on Iraq. Maintained until 2003, it causes shortages of food and medicine.
5fa37f5e8d: The United States destroys two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island, accused of preparing mine launches toward Hormuz. Iran retaliates against bases in Jordan.
5fab39341a: Creation of the Dominican National Guard
The military government creates a National Guard led by Marines to replace the disbanded army. It will become the instrument of Trujillo's power.
5fc8b6e9ca: The Pentagon announces the withdrawal of about 11,900 troops from Germany. Donald Trump justifies it by German military spending deemed insufficient. Joe Biden freezes the measure in February 2021.
5fdc39c54e: The American submarine Gato, on a surveillance mission, collides with the Soviet nuclear submarine K-19 off the Kola Peninsula.
603b36c308: Chicken War: cognac and light trucks taxed

In retaliation for EEC duties on American chicken, Washington raises to 25% the duties on brandy (French cognac), starch, dextrin and light trucks. The measures take effect on 7 January 1964; the tax on light trucks still exists.
6056f11b0b: Creation of the Afghan Fund in Switzerland
Washington transfers $3.5 billion of frozen Afghan reserves into a fund based in Switzerland, outside the control of the Afghan central bank.
60aaf1d5ae: Kissinger pushes China to threaten India
New York, United States / Sino-Indian border
According to declassified transcripts, Kissinger suggests to Chinese representative Huang Hua troop movements toward the Indian border, promising American support against a Soviet reaction.
60cd9f1ecb: State Department officials Thomas Enders and Elliott Abrams contest before Congress the press accounts of the El Mozote massacre, confirmed in 1993 by the Truth Commission.
60d0bc1c0f: The legislature refuses a Constitution authorizing foreign ownership of land. Smedley Butler dissolves it at the head of the gendarmerie.
60d446d46d: The underwater Baker explosion heavily contaminates the lagoon and the ships. Thousands of sailors are exposed during decontamination operations.
60f55a18f4: In his State of the Union address, Bush claims that Iraq sought uranium in Africa, on the basis of forged documents. The White House acknowledges in July that the sentence should not have been included.
61006a5064: The Washington Post and the Boston Globe reveal that American agents infiltrated into UNSCOM installed wiretaps on Iraqi communications. Former inspector Scott Ritter confirms it.
610e84fe85: Factional fighting, riots and demonstrations lead American forces to protect the International Settlement from January to August 1925. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
6111c1d39b: A small force armed by the CIA enters Guatemala from Honduras. Aircraft flown by Americans bomb the capital and Puerto Barrios to give the impression of a massive offensive.
612409c1e7: Destruction of the Novi Sad bridges
NATO strikes destroy the Danube bridges in Novi Sad. Navigation is blocked and the city is cut in two for years.
6133a5273f: In reprisal for a missile fired at a US-flagged tanker, destroyers destroy the Iranian Rashadat oil platforms.
614eab02f3: A leak of VX nerve agent poisons American servicemen in Okinawa. The affair reveals the secret storage of chemical weapons on the island, removed in 1971 by Operation Red Hat.
61556f98b7: According to the New York Times, Beijing kills or imprisons 18 to 20 CIA sources between 2010 and 2012, dismantling its spy network in China.
615d42b84f: The stopgap spending bill signed by Biden provides $12.3 billion for Ukraine, part of it to replenish stocks.
6197c9890b: The junta grants the US Navy a home port near Athens for Sixth Fleet destroyers and their families. Critics see it as support for the regime; the democratic government withdraws the permission after 1974.
61c0e8545e: An aircraft chartered for the Chinese delegation to Bandung explodes in flight, 16 dead. Zhou Enlai, the target of the attack, was not on board. Beijing accuses Nationalist and American services; the CIA's role remains unproven.
61d48106d5: Before the Chamber of Deputies, Prime Minister Jacques Santer confirms the existence of a clandestine “stay-behind” network in Luxembourg, attached to the NATO coordination structures in which the CIA and MI6 sat.
61d7ce8da8: The German software company settles with the Justice Department and the SEC charges of bribery in South Africa and Indonesia, and signs a three-year deferred prosecution agreement.
61f838910f: In late August, American forces protect Americans and their interests at Kentucky Island and then at Camp Nicholson during revolutionary unrest. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
621854171f: In the early 1950s, the CIA parachutes trained émigrés into Romania to support anti-communist resistance groups, including a team near Târgu Cărbunești. Most are captured; some are executed, others turned.
621ba12c93: Start of a secret bombing campaign in northern Laos, in support of royal and Hmong forces. It lasts until 1973.
6224e3f7df: Indonesian soldiers, armed notably with American M16 rifles, kill at least 250 demonstrators at the Santa Cruz cemetery. In 1992, Congress cuts IMET military training to Indonesia.
62377c0966: The 303 Committee approves funds to support selected candidates and weaken the left in the parliamentary elections, according to the Church Committee.
62418e7de1: Maduro announces the dismantling of a plot by air force officers to bomb Caracas and accuses Washington. No public evidence of a U.S. role is provided.
6257054b4d: American forces cover the final withdrawal of UN peacekeepers from Somalia. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
629e975434: Trump removes Sudan from the list of terrorist states after the payment of $335 million to victims of attacks and Khartoum's commitment to normalize relations with Israel.
62a2d5d722: Two B-2 bombers strike two Islamic State camps southwest of Sirte. The Pentagon announces more than 80 fighters killed.
62b772693c: Operation Hardtack I in the Marshalls
From April to August 1958, more than thirty nuclear tests take place at Enewetak and Bikini, the largest series in the Pacific before the moratorium.
62be223db6: American forces land in late August and Japan comes under the authority of General MacArthur's Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. The occupation lasts until 1952, and until 1972 in Okinawa.
62eeaaaaf2: Mongoose proposes distributing in Cuba fake photos of an obese Castro seated at a feast with two women, to stoke the anger of a rationed population. The plan appears in the declassified documents.
62f57efd2a: The CIA director cables the station that Lumumba's removal must be “an urgent and prime objective” of covert action. The cable is cited by the Church Committee.
62fef382bf: Pressure before the raid on The Pirate Bay
Diplomatic cables published by WikiLeaks show that the American embassy was pressing Stockholm to act against file sharing, with the threat of a trade watch list. Police seize the site's servers.
633ba61a4a: Under U.S. pressure and in application of a European regulation, SWIFT disconnects Iranian banks, which can no longer carry out international transfers.
633c94bc74: Aid to UNITA despite the Clark Amendment
After the ban voted by Congress in 1976, CIA director George H. W. Bush acknowledges that part of the aid to the FNLA and UNITA continues.
633ddf173b: A U.S. Predator drone and French aircraft strike Gaddafi's convoy. Captured by rebels, he is lynched and killed.
634d00126b: Correa expels two diplomats, including Mark Sullivan, described as the CIA station chief, accusing them of making aid to the police conditional on oversight of its intelligence units.
63772b8689: Omar al-Faruq handed over to the CIA
Arrested in Bogor, Omar al-Faruq is handed over to the United States without legal proceedings and held at Bagram, from where he escapes in 2005. He is killed in Iraq in 2006.
63864ce2c6: American forces land to suppress a riot on American property in Nanjing. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
639a24ded5: American engineer Ben Linder, who was building a micro hydroelectric plant, is killed by Contras funded by Washington.
63dc40adb2: Train and Equip Program in Georgia
U.S. instructors train and arm Georgian battalions, officially against Chechen and al-Qaeda fighters in the Pankisi Gorge.
63de61a50e: A $625 million drawdown including four HIMARS, howitzers and ammunition.
63f8e92ae4: Secret funds for the anti-PKI movement
Ambassador Marshall Green approves the payment of 50 million rupiah to the KAP-Gestapu movement, which leads the hunt for communists. The fact appears in the FRUS archives.
63f9e2c997: The UN historical clarification commission concludes that U.S. support, including officer training, weighed on human rights violations. It attributes 93% of the abuses to the state.
64036ffe4b: Death of Abdul Wali in Asadabad
Abdul Wali dies after two days of brutal interrogation by David Passaro, a CIA contractor. Passaro is convicted in 2006, the only CIA civilian tried for abusing a detainee.
64216db4d8: A $400 million drawdown with four more HIMARS and artillery shells.
6437843a1e: President Jacobo Árbenz resigns under the pressure of Operation PBSUCCESS. His land reform affected United Fruit. The CIA has acknowledged its role.
6453d703c0: Luis Posada Carriles, a former CIA agent, and three exiles are arrested with explosives to kill Castro at the Ibero-American summit. Convicted in 2004 of endangering public safety. No evidence of a role by the U.S. government.
645eb605bb: The country loses all Internet access a few days after the Sony hack that Washington blames on it. The United States neither confirms nor denies.
646d9d84a8: Marines join the multinational force deployed in Beirut during the civil war. The mission bogs down in the fighting and ends in 1984, after the attack that kills 241 American servicemen.
6488aae664: Announced during Zelensky's visit to Washington, this drawdown includes artillery shells, including cluster munitions, and air defense.
649ec3288e: Ambassador Tom Rose cuts all contact with Włodzimierz Czarzasty, who refused to support Trump's candidacy for the Nobel Peace Prize, then raises the question of keeping American troops. Donald Tusk protests.
64ba292aac: The United States blocks a new draft from the ten elected members demanding a permanent ceasefire and the lifting of restrictions on aid, a month after the IPC confirmed famine in Gaza.
64c8ecfe55: A strike during the Rough Rider campaign hits a detention center for African migrants; 68 dead according to the Houthis. Amnesty attributes it to the United States, which says it is investigating.
64efe66f5c: Two bombs destroy a Cuban airliner: 73 dead. Luis Posada Carriles, a former CIA agent, and Orlando Bosch are named. Archives show that the CIA had wind of plans for attacks.
65021b2ba6: Attack on the minelayer Iran Ajr
American helicopters strafe the Iranian ship caught laying mines. Several Iranian sailors are killed; the ship is seized and then scuttled.
650283b732: Donald Trump threatens North Korea with “fire and fury like the world has never seen.” In September, at the UN, he speaks of its “total destruction.”
6522cc75ef: Washington acknowledges the use of tear gas in Vietnam. CS gas is later used extensively to flush occupants out of tunnels and shelters.
65546ac2ab: Nixon orders CIA director Richard Helms to prevent Allende from taking office through a military coup, without the State Department's knowledge. Helms's notes attest to it.
6554af96bf: The Syrian Democratic Forces retake Raqqa under a deluge of coalition strikes and shelling. Amnesty and Airwars count about 1,600 civilians killed; the city is 80% destroyed.
6561060360: Giulio Andreotti reveals the existence of Gladio, a clandestine “stay-behind” network set up with the CIA and NATO. The European Parliament calls in November 1990 for investigations in all the countries concerned.
6575ee0fd1: From 1948 to the early 1950s, American services in Bavaria (CIC, then CIA) send couriers recruited in refugee camps across the border. Many are arrested, imprisoned or executed.
657c1a1593: Korean Agents Parachuted Into the North
The U.S. Army and the CIA drop or land thousands of Korean agents and partisans behind the lines. Most are killed or captured.
65960d86fd: Tanker bound for Cuba turns back

According to the maritime press, a US Coast Guard vessel intercepts the tanker Ocean Mariner en route to Cuba, which turns around. It had delivered in January the last known cargo of fuel to the island.
6596848b7c: U.S. forces guard the legation in Constantinople during the First Balkan War. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
659bb021c6: American bombers carry out a massive raid on Palermo before the landing in Sicily. The historic centre is devastated and hundreds of civilians are killed.
65ae784b78: After the Balangiga attack, General Jacob Smith orders Samar turned into a “howling wilderness” and everyone over the age of ten killed. He is court-martialed in 1902 and retired.
65d4211799: A plane waits for Snowden in Copenhagen

Denmark authorises the landing of aircraft N977GA, already used for renditions, ready to bring Edward Snowden back to the United States if he were handed over. Justice Minister Søren Pind confirms it in 2016.
660720fd1d: B-52 bombs destroy much of Hanoi's main hospital and kill staff members and patients.
663be65ca8: The Treasury and the State Department target more than 200 individuals and entities, including banks and intermediaries in third countries; Commerce adds nearly 90 companies to its blacklist.
6650fee4aa: Operation Southern Watch bars Iraqi aircraft south of the 32nd parallel, extended to the 33rd in 1996. Recurrent strikes cause civilian casualties until 2003.
666387b46c: Trump signs a national security memorandum that orders Iranian oil exports to be brought to zero.
668538e647: Colonel Mobutu neutralizes the prime minister. CIA station chief Larry Devlin encouraged and funded him, according to his own memoirs.
66c4380abc: Minister Diosdado Cabello announces the arrest of foreigners, including a US serviceman, accused of preparing an attack on Maduro for the CIA. Washington denies it.
66cde9b824: A Marine patrol kills 16 women and children. Courts-martial convict two soldiers, whose sentences are quickly reduced.
66d862fb26: Washington sanctions the president of the International Criminal Court, Japanese judge Tomoko Akane, and a prosecutor's office lawyer. The ICC denounces a “flagrant attack” on its independence.
66e0e5a67d: Executive Order 14068: vodka, diamonds and seafood
Biden bans imports of Russian seafood, alcohol and diamonds and asks Congress to strip Russia of most-favored-nation status.
6725d838f1: A NATO strike on the village kills several dozen Albanian refugees. NATO says it was targeting a military position.
6739cfc2f6: So-called “Christmas” bombings by B-52s on Hanoi and Haiphong until 29 December. Hanoi counts about 1,600 civilians killed.
674a799ff2: Philips agrees to pay 62 million dollars to the SEC, which accuses it under the FCPA of irregular payments by Chinese subsidiaries to win medical equipment contracts.
6770c4dea2: Obama signs Executive Order 13661 targeting Russian officials over the annexation of Crimea. Seven senior officials, including Vladislav Surkov and Dmitry Rogozin, have their assets frozen.
677a5da6b5: A Constitution written under American control, which opens land to foreigners, is adopted by a plebiscite held under occupation.
67a9daa301: Attorney General William Barr announces the indictment of former Libyan agent Abu Agila Mas'ud, accused of building the Lockerbie bomb, on the strength of a confession made in detention in Libya.
67b85ca3ee: The Israeli army frees four hostages in a raid that kills 274 Palestinians according to Gaza's Health Ministry. US officials confirm intelligence support from the US hostage cell.
67c3040488: Abduction of the Writer Kaji Wataru

The left-wing writer Kaji Wataru is abducted by the Canon Agency, a U.S. military intelligence unit, and held incommunicado for more than a year. Released in December 1952, he testifies before the Diet.
67f0c4e457: Announced at Ramstein, this drawdown includes ammunition for HIMARS, howitzers and Humvee armored vehicles.
68079bda80: The “Algerian six” of Bosnia handed over

Despite a Bosnian court decision ordering their release, six men are handed over to U.S. forces and sent to Guantánamo. After the Boumediene ruling, a federal judge orders the release of five of them in 2008.
680d178e22: Ambassador John Peurifoy negotiates the agreement between the military junta and Castillo Armas, who takes the lead of the government. He becomes president in September with Washington's support.
6812b4a126: In spring, Roosevelt has the Navy patrol the routes to Europe. In July it escorts convoys; in September it attacks German submarines. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
6824e4d1b1: The CIA parachutes agents recruited among émigrés into the USSR until the mid-1950s. Most are arrested or turned by the Soviet services.
682ad414c2: Tehran foils a coup by officers loyal to Bakhtiar, prepared from Nojeh air base. Iran accuses the CIA, a role never established.
6840d02bee: Marco Rubio announces visa restrictions against foreign officials accused of “censoring” Americans, a measure aimed in particular at European digital regulation.
68454c2a1b: An AC-130 strafes the village. Dozens of civilians die. A Pentagon official says that “the people there are dead because we wanted them dead.”
68455c28ea: Washington sanctions Judge Tomoko Akane, ICC president, and a legal officer of the Court, bringing to nine the number of judges targeted.
6846158a7b: Trump says he may be “the one to do it” regarding an intervention in Cuba, while a naval buildup is reported off the island. Rubio says he doubts diplomacy.
689a946854: A U.S. F-15E fires two missiles at a bridge as a passenger train is crossing it. At least ten civilians are killed; NATO acknowledges the strike.
68bd9f9aa1: Ahmed Wali Karzai paid by the CIA
The New York Times reveals that the president's brother, suspected of opium trafficking, has received CIA payments for years and recruits the Kandahar Strike Force for it.
68cffc6163: Clinton directive to spy on the UN

A cable signed by Hillary Clinton asks diplomats to collect passwords, credit card numbers and biometric data on Ban Ki-moon and UN delegations. List drawn up by the CIA. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
6904f2b9af: False atrocities and list of communists
To justify the invasion, Johnson cites beheadings and the embassy publishes a list of “communists” among the rebels. Journalists and diplomats quickly show these claims to be false or exaggerated.
690ca0d020: A $350 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition, shells and HARM missiles.
69161f668d: Washington designates the Colombian cartel Clan del Golfo a foreign terrorist organization, paving the way for possible military action, according to CBS.
691f7ec258: An unpublished internal Pentagon investigation attributes the Minab strike to a “cascade of avoidable failures”: outdated intelligence, cuts to civilian-harm specialists and reliance on Palantir's Maven AI tool.
6941d8b701: After the disputed presidential election, John Kerry negotiates the agreement that makes Ashraf Ghani president and Abdullah Abdullah chief executive, without publication of the detailed results.
694a9316b8: Sanctions on Gazprom Neft and the shadow fleet
The Treasury sanctions Gazprom Neft, Surgutneftegas and more than 180 tankers of the Russian shadow fleet.
695ae81591: Capture of Vientiane by Phoumi Nosavan
After Kong Le's neutralist coup, the CIA and the Pentagon arm General Phoumi Nosavan, who retakes Vientiane and overthrows Souvanna Phouma's government.
696b2edf31: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania join NATO. Moscow sees a violation of the 1990 assurances, which Washington says it never gave in writing.
697c4b3d58: Having taken refuge in the Apostolic Nunciature, besieged and blasted with full-volume music, Noriega surrenders. He is taken away and tried in the United States.
697d40c65c: The Treasury sanctions the Moscow Exchange and extends secondary sanctions to foreign banks dealing with the Russian defense industry.
6991cdadfb: About 20,000 American soldiers land, with a UN mandate, to remove the junta and restore Jean-Bertrand Aristide to power.
69a0193402: At the end of the Cold War, the NED funds groups in the Baltic states, Armenia, Russia and Ukraine that demand more independence from Gorbachev's central authority.
69a2da10a7: During the assault on the stronghold of Christopher Coke, wanted by Washington, a U.S. surveillance aircraft films the operation. At least 69 civilians are killed. The commission of inquiry confirms the aircraft's role.
69b1680d16: A $725 million drawdown centered on HIMARS ammunition, guided shells and anti-tank weapons.
69c32a6fe7: The Sixth Fleet conducts maneuvers off Libya and flies its aircraft south of 32°30', the “line of death” proclaimed by Gaddafi. These demonstrations prepare the March clashes.
69d1ba3ff4: The State Department publishes a list of entities linked to the Cuban military and security services with which Americans may no longer deal, including hotels.
6a01046e8a: The American physician Richard Strong inoculates prisoners at Bilibid Prison with a cholera vaccine contaminated with plague. Thirteen die; an official inquiry follows.
6a208115e2: The army overthrows Allende, who dies at La Moneda. The CIA did not organize the coup, but its actions prepared the ground and it maintained ties with the plotters, according to the Hinchey Report (2000).
6a30c6744a: Black site in Thailand, Abu Zubaydah
Captured in Pakistan, Abu Zubaydah is held in a secret CIA prison in Thailand. He is subjected to 83 waterboarding sessions in August 2002, according to the 2014 Senate report.
6a357246a4: Ambassador Frank Carlucci coordinates support for the Socialists against the Communists. The American press reveals in 1975 CIA funding channeled through European parties.
6a5b91cb9b: A $550 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition and 75,000 155 mm shells.
6a5cf15915: Nixon's circle, via Anna Chennault, urges Thiệu to boycott the peace talks before the election. FBI wiretaps and Haldeman's notes attest to it.
6a7205f417: Kissinger and the second Turkish offensive

According to a declassified record, Kissinger tells Ford the day before that Turkey should not be opposed. On 14 August, Ankara launches its second offensive and occupies about 37% of the island. British archives show Washington dissuading London from intervening.
6a89532021: American aircraft bomb Iri station, far from the front, killing many civilians. The South Korean Truth and Reconciliation Commission investigated the attack.
6a900740b5: Stray American bombers drop their bombs on Zurich and Basel, in neutral Switzerland. Washington apologizes and pays compensation.
6aae7798f7: The CIA sends QJWIN, a criminal recruited in Europe, to the Congo for a mission against Lumumba. The Church Committee cannot establish what he did there.
6ad25b4cb2: An RB-57D spy plane flown by a Taiwanese pilot, in a CIA-funded program, is shot down by an SA-2 missile. It is the first victory of a surface-to-air missile.
6adee099f4: Panamanian students try to raise their flag. US troops and police open fire: some twenty Panamanians are killed.
6aff9aa3f6: After an unarmed American transport plane is shot down by Yugoslavia, Truman reinforces troops on the occupation line and aircraft in northern Italy. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
