6b143291a1: Dawson Pacts: Estrada Appointed Without a Vote
Special envoy Thomas C. Dawson judges that an election would return the Liberals to power. He has Juan José Estrada appointed by a constituent assembly, in exchange for conditions set by Washington.
6b2738a7ca: Elon Musk writes on Twitter “We will coup whoever we want.” Morales sees it as proof of a coup tied to Bolivian lithium; no US government role has been established.
6b2c57b748: American consultants work for his campaign (“Yanks to the Rescue”, Time) and the IMF releases a 10 billion dollar loan in the middle of the campaign.
6b3e161a83: Supplied by the United States under Atoms for Peace, the Pelindaba reactor runs on American highly enriched uranium. Washington thus cooperates with the apartheid regime's nuclear program.
6b54af49c5: Failed offensive of the Iraqi National Congress

The Iraqi National Congress launches an offensive from Kurdistan with the backing of a CIA officer, Robert Baer. Washington pulls out at the last moment and the operation fails, according to Baer's memoirs.
6ba7b518ab: From September 8 to 12, 1919, Marines land to maintain order in a neutral zone during an attempted revolution.
6bb756ce19: Before Congress, Donald Trump says of Greenland: “One way or the other, we're going to get it.” Nuuk and Copenhagen reject any annexation.
6bc26f4009: A DEA informant among the assassins
Several suspects in the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse had been informants for the DEA or the FBI, which these agencies acknowledged. No evidence links Washington to the order to kill.
6bdc04bbb2: A regiment mutinies at Yeosu. The recapture of Yeosu and Suncheon, planned with American advisers including James Hausman, is accompanied by mass executions of civilians.
6be06b83d2: At the start of the war, the South Korean army and police execute tens of thousands of suspected leftists enrolled in the Bodo League. American officers witness it and the archives show that the command was informed.
6c1a2aaf3b: The Paraguayan Congress grants immunity to serving U.S. military personnel. The arrival of hundreds of soldiers fuels suspicions of a base at Mariscal Estigarribia, denied by Washington.
6c4760395d: The army overthrows Jean-Bertrand Aristide. Several junta leaders, including SIN officers, were paid by the CIA, according to the American press.
6c476a6686: The US military announces it has destroyed five Iranian tankers in response to new attacks on its ships. Iran fires missiles toward Jordan.
6c66698549: The Senate's Lodge Committee hears soldiers describe the “water cure,” a form of torture by forced ingestion of water. Major Edwin Glenn receives a light sentence.
6c684cbf39: CIA Air Force Against the Simba
The CIA supplies the Congo with T-28s and B-26s flown by Cuban exiles, which bomb rebel areas. Diplomatic archives published in 2013 confirm it.
6c77b4e09e: Special forces hidden in the Pakistani army

Green Berets are secretly embedded in Pakistani units in Bajaur and then Waziristan to guide operations and drone strikes. Ambassador Anne Patterson deems their disclosure dangerous. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
6c89339f61: William Broe, head of the CIA's Latin America division, proposes to ITT that it worsen the economic crisis to push for a coup. The Senate established this in 1973.
6c9c23a661: Raid to free the embassy hostages. The operation fails in the desert: a helicopter hits an aircraft and 8 American servicemen die.
6cb3e5c2b3: American C-47 forced to land in Hungary

Soviet MiGs force a US Air Force C-47, flying from Munich to Belgrade, to land at Pápa. Budapest accuses the four airmen of espionage and then convicts them of border violation; Washington pays 120,000 dollars under protest.
6cbea98ef9: Marines set fire to the houses of a village, sometimes with Zippo lighters. Morley Safer's CBS report shocks American public opinion.
6ccc1150b4: Pressure against Huawei in the Faroes
US Ambassador Carla Sands publicly calls, in the newspaper Sosialurin, on the public operator Føroya Tele to exclude Huawei from its 5G network in favour of an American or European supplier.
6d17b5d4f4: Technip pays $338 million under the FCPA
The French oil services group settles U.S. charges of bribery in Nigeria.
6d324b79e9: According to the Washington Post, Cyber Command carries out a denial-of-service attack on the servers of North Korean military intelligence.
6d3b6b30da: A CIA drone kills tribal leader Nek Muhammad in South Waziristan. According to the Bureau of Investigative Journalism, more than 400 strikes will follow, killing between 2,500 and 4,000 people.
6d4ac050ec: Among Mongoose's tasks, Lansdale lists the study of “incapacitating” sugar workers during the harvest with biological or chemical agents. The Church Committee cites this project.
6d4b7daaa6: The Carter administration refuses the export licence for the American-origin RM8 engine, preventing Saab from selling the Viggen fighter to India, which chooses the Franco-British Jaguar.
6d4cb78409: Bombs delivered urgently for use in Lebanon
According to the New York Times, Washington speeds up shipments of guided bombs to Israel, including GBU-28 bunker-busters, during the war against Hezbollah.
6d545dd1c6: Al Jazeera office hit in Baghdad
A U.S. strike hits Al Jazeera's premises and kills journalist Tareq Ayyoub, even though the network had given its coordinates to the Pentagon.
6d68ba66fd: Sanctions against ISRO over the cryogenic engine
Washington sanctions the Indian space agency and the Russian agency Glavkosmos over a transfer of cryogenic engines, then obtains in 1993 that Moscow give up transferring the technology.
6d75e70e31: CIA program to destroy the Viet Cong infrastructure through arrests, torture and assassinations. William Colby admits to more than 20,000 deaths before Congress in 1971.
6db2f755cc: The National Guard, trained by the Marines and led by Somoza, executes Sandino. A green light from U.S. Minister Arthur Bliss Lane is alleged, with no established proof.
6dde800594: Sisson Documents: Forgeries Published by Washington
The Committee on Public Information circulates documents portraying Lenin and Trotsky as German agents. George Kennan shows in 1956 that they are forgeries.
6e1874e84b: Admiral William Caperton places Haiti under martial law. It remains in force, in various forms, for most of the occupation, with military tribunals and censorship.
6e32cbccfc: A Marine is killed at a Panamanian Defense Forces roadblock. Bush cites his death among the reasons for the invasion launched four days later.
6e363cb5ba: Transfer of 14 CIA detainees to Guantánamo
George W. Bush acknowledges the existence of the CIA's secret prisons and announces the transfer to Guantánamo of 14 detainees, including Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, who were subjected to torture.
6e3a3e2b60: At Washington's urging, the Security Council imposes the first UN sanctions against Iran's nuclear program.
6e5b95a71d: Under American pressure, Bolivia adopts a law that criminalizes most coca cultivation and creates special courts, the starting point of the Chapare “coca war”.
6e68c26dec: Communists Excluded from the Italian Government

On his return from a trip to Washington where he obtains credits, Alcide De Gasperi forms a government without Communists or Socialists in late May 1947, in line with the Truman administration's wishes.
6e71136973: Part of the counterpart funds paid by the aided countries remains at Washington's disposal. Historians establish that some of it financed the covert operations of the OPC and the CIA.
6ea6293204: Obama signs a law that sanctions foreign companies selling gasoline to Iran or working with its banks.
6ea89c538f: During maneuvers in waters claimed by Libya, two F-14s shoot down two Libyan Su-22s.
6ea9205136: ASML blocked from selling to China
According to Reuters, Washington pressures The Hague to block delivery of an EUV lithography machine to China. The Dutch license is not renewed.
6eb0a256f6: George H. W. Bush suspends arms sales and military exchanges with China. Congress writes these sanctions into law in 1990.
6ecc6c287c: Aircraft destroy the Chasan dam, flooding the rice paddies. The Kuwonga dam is attacked next in the same campaign.
6ed7172114: Drone strike on pine nut gatherers
A US drone strikes farm workers at rest in Nangarhar province. At least 30 dead according to the UN; Washington acknowledges the strike.
6ef01937a5: Veto on Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon
Two days after the invasion of Lebanon, the United States alone votes against a Spanish draft demanding an end to fighting and Israeli withdrawal under threat of measures.
6f02246359: The Commerce Department bans the export to China of advanced chips and the machines to make them, and restricts the work of Americans in the Chinese industry.
6f0b8c7cc4: The source code of the CIA's Marble framework hides the traces of its software and provides for inserting Chinese, Russian, Korean, Arabic or Persian text to mislead investigators. Revealed by WikiLeaks in Vault 7 in March 2017.
6f1a6fc6b9: Cuba accuses a State Department aircraft of spraying a pest insect, thrips palmi, over Matanzas. Washington denies it. A Biological Weapons Convention meeting in 1997 does not settle it.
6f1ae174b2: Greenland Occupied Under a Repudiated Agreement
Washington signs with Danish ambassador Henrik Kauffmann, without the approval of occupied Copenhagen, an agreement that opens Greenland to American bases. The Danish government declares it void.
6f2159bda5: Veto after the death of a UN employee
Washington blocks a draft condemning the killing of UN staff members by the Israeli army, including Briton Iain Hook in Jenin, and the destruction of a WFP warehouse.
6f347a4128: In the early 1950s, American services bury dozens of arms and explosives depots for a stay-behind network. Washington hands the list to Vienna in 1996.
6f4b73e232: Nine children killed by an A-10 in Ghazni
An A-10 aircraft strikes a house to kill an absent Taliban leader and kills nine children. The U.S. military acknowledges their deaths.
6f617d562c: At a National Security Council meeting, Eisenhower gives, according to a witness, an order understood as the elimination of Lumumba. The Church Committee reports this testimony without deciding on it.
6f7240c26e: Clinton has Cubans fleeing the island intercepted at sea and interned on the base: more than 30,000 people are held there, some for over a year, before a migration agreement in 1995.
6f7fe96e21: Overflights of neutral Austria to Lebanon
During the intervention in Lebanon, American military aircraft cross Austrian airspace from southern Germany. Under Soviet pressure, Vienna protests against this breach of its neutrality.
6f83024fd2: The Haitian-American Society for Agricultural Development, financed by the Export-Import Bank, clears thousands of hectares and evicts peasants to plant rubber. The project fails in 1944.
6f85aa4c83: U.S. special forces attack a building in Syria to target an al-Qaeda smuggler. Damascus announces 8 civilians killed; Washington confirms only unofficially.
6f8d82e161: Washington informed of “almost daily” gas use
A note to Secretary of State George Shultz reports Iraq's “almost daily” use of chemical weapons against Iran. Rumsfeld is sent to Baghdad the following month without making it a precondition.
6fa21c8ef7: After Ion Perdicaris is kidnapped by Raisuli, Theodore Roosevelt sends a squadron off Tangier to pressure the sultan. The telegram “Perdicaris alive or Raisuli dead” is made public in June.
6fa2e199c7: Destruction of the Río Negro and Ocotal bridges
CIA-trained Contras blow up two bridges in the north of the country. It is the first major attack of the war.
6fbac6f42b: A B-1 drops four bombs on a neighborhood of al-Mansour where Saddam Hussein is reported to be. He is not there; Human Rights Watch counts many civilians killed.
6ff1c4e5ce: The Latvian subsidiary of Swedbank pays 3.43 million dollars for 386 Crimea-related payments made through American correspondent banks in 2015-2016.
700947b498: In Hamdan v. Rumsfeld, the Supreme Court rules illegal the military commissions created to try Guantánamo detainees, as contrary to the Geneva Conventions.
7032defa78: After an election Washington deems not free, the Treasury sanctions the Nicaraguan public prosecutor's office and nine officials.
7038492f7f: The United States extends financing restrictions to VTB, Bank of Moscow and Rosselkhozbank, and blocks the United Shipbuilding Corporation, after the downing of flight MH17.
7040143d69: Donald Trump announces that no US official will attend the G20 summit in South Africa, citing alleged persecution of Afrikaners.
705128f236: The United States blocks a draft affirming the right of the Palestinian people to self-determination and a state, and calling for Israeli withdrawal from the occupied territories.
705528b79f: A 1965 survey finds that about one third of married Puerto Rican women aged 20 to 49 had been sterilized, often without full information on its irreversibility.
7063a3d0a6: After the arrest of a BND agent paid by the CIA, Berlin asks the U.S. station chief to leave the country.
709b9cdc9d: Disappearances blamed on special forces in Nerkh
Residents accuse a U.S. special forces unit and its interpreters of dozens of disappearances and murders. Karzai expels these forces from Wardak in February 2013. Washington denies it.
70a16026ef: Legion of Merit for Álvarez Martínez
The Reagan administration decorates General Gustavo Álvarez Martínez, head of the armed forces under whom Battalion 316 makes opponents disappear.
70a4d3378a: American bombers aiming at an Erla factory miss their target and hit the town: 936 civilians killed, including more than 200 children.
70aeb39f37: The telecoms group VimpelCom (later VEON), based in Amsterdam, agrees to pay 795 million dollars to the American and Dutch authorities for bribes in Uzbekistan, part of it under the FCPA.
7103e0a80f: Former detainees describe to the BBC and the ICRC a separate site at Bagram, the “Tor Jail,” with isolation, sleep deprivation and beatings. The Pentagon admits the existence of a screening center.
711d641fc1: According to Miles Copeland, the CIA was in contact with the officers who overthrow King Farouk. Its real role in the coup remains debated.
71258207d4: US intelligence and the sinking of the Moskva
According to NBC, US officials confirmed to Kyiv the position of the cruiser Moskva before it was hit by two Neptune missiles. The Pentagon denies any role in the decision.
714582ebf0: Soldiers of the 5th Stryker Brigade kill three Afghan civilians for sport between January and May 2010 and keep fingers as trophies. Several are convicted.
7146dd0656: Listening station at the Yangon embassy
The NSA map published by Der Spiegel in 2013 lists the U.S. embassy in Yangon among the Special Collection Service sites tasked with intercepting communications.
7148cda6fb: Embargo on computers for the nuclear program
Washington refuses to authorize the export of Control Data computers intended for French nuclear calculations. This blockage pushes de Gaulle to launch the Plan Calcul.
7157901b68: Deterrence flights against the coup plotters
During the coup attempt against Corazon Aquino, American F-4s from Clark fly over the rebel bases to deter them from using their aircraft.
716816f385: Jesse Leaf, a former CIA analyst on Iran, claims in the New York Times that the agency taught interrogation techniques to the SAVAK. The CIA denies it.
7168e18cf0: The Allied military government installs local notables, including the mafia boss Calogero Vizzini, as mayors in Sicily. The extent of any pact with the Mafia remains debated.
71700b61a5: Washington backs the assault on Parliament
Clinton backs Yeltsin, who dissolved Parliament in violation of the Constitution, then has it shelled by tanks. The fighting kills about 150 people.
71752e1469: Mobutu accuses the CIA of a plot
Mobutu expels American ambassador Deane Hinton and claims to have foiled a CIA-backed coup. Washington denies it and no public proof has been produced.
71a4494349: The Biden administration lifts the de facto ban on US military contractors in Ukraine, to maintain F-16s and Patriots. The Pentagon mentions a few dozen to a few hundred people.
71bdd41564: The Shah's political police is created with CIA help, which trains its cadres. SAVAK practices torture against opponents until 1979.
71c017458b: US submarine sinks the frigate Dena

A US nuclear submarine torpedoes the Iranian frigate IRIS Dena south of Sri Lanka, on its way back from an exercise in India. Hegseth claims the attack. The remains of 84 sailors are repatriated; 32 are rescued.
71e0600063: Biden authorizes sanctions on foreign banks that facilitate transactions for the Russian military industry.
71e92174fa: ING pays $619 million for violating embargoes
The Dutch bank is penalized for transactions with Cuba and Iran, which were subject to U.S. embargoes.
71ea0116b0: Chun Doo-hwan moves troops under combined command without American agreement to seize power. Declassified cables show that Washington protests but quickly accepts the fait accompli.
71f07dd927: Cheney and the Atta meeting in Prague
The vice president calls a meeting between 9/11 hijacker Mohammed Atta and an Iraqi agent in Prague “pretty well confirmed.” The 9/11 Commission finds no evidence of it.
7204b4f825: Nixon and Satō sign a secret note authorizing the reintroduction of nuclear weapons to Okinawa in case of crisis after its return to Japan. The document was made public in 2009.
72125dfe86: Fake rebel letter fabricated by the CIA
A CIA agent drafts a letter attributed to a communist leader offering a truce to Prime Minister Sanya Dharmasakti. Once exposed, Washington makes an official apology to Bangkok.
72129a9d87: The European Parliament concludes that the U.S.-British interception network exists and calls on Europeans to encrypt their communications.
722a0ae991: George W. Bush signs the American Service-Members' Protection Act. The law authorises “all means necessary” to free an American or an ally held by the International Criminal Court, which sits in the Netherlands.
72399ff166: More than 2,000 Latin Americans of Japanese descent, mostly from Peru, are handed over to the United States and interned to serve as bargaining chips. A federal commission acknowledges this in 1983.
7272715a67: U.S. military personnel support the Australian-led international force in East Timor (communications, logistics, intelligence). Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
7281a5e070: Strike on a minibus convoy in Uruzgan
U.S. helicopters, guided by the crew of a Predator drone, kill 23 civilians in three vehicles. McChrystal apologizes. The investigation disciplines several officers.
72888a6e11: After the appropriated funds run out, Robert McFarlane obtains from Saudi Arabia one million dollars a month for the Contras, according to the congressional Iran-Contra investigation.
72a5465461: A U.S. drone targets al-Shabaab leaders near Kismayo. It is the first known drone strike in Somalia; those that follow number in the hundreds.
72d9881fb1: The US military boards the supertanker Majestic X in the Indian Ocean, sanctioned for carrying Iranian crude. The Justice Department opens forfeiture proceedings.
72e335723c: At the Safwan talks, General Schwarzkopf allows Iraq to fly its helicopters. The regime uses them to crush the uprisings, with no American intervention. Tens of thousands die.
730d4bf5e0: First postwar nuclear test: a bomb is dropped on a fleet of target ships in Bikini lagoon.
731948370b: Uruguay breaks with Havana after a campaign of pressure and propaganda that former agent Philip Agee attributes to the CIA station in Montevideo.
735c7e1c36: According to Human Rights Watch (2008), the CIA hands over at least 14 detainees to Jordanian intelligence between 2001 and 2004, for interrogations in which torture is alleged.
7366c6a119: Human rights certification for El Salvador
Reagan certifies to Congress that El Salvador is making progress on human rights, six weeks after the El Mozote massacre, in order to maintain military aid.
736acdd18c: ITT chief executive Harold Geneen offers the CIA funds for action against Allende. The affair is revealed by journalist Jack Anderson and then by a Senate inquiry.
736d6e13bb: Arms to Israel by emergency procedure
Marco Rubio signs an emergency declaration to speed up about $4 billion in arms sales to Israel, bypassing congressional review.
737244f1c1: The Zimbabwe Democracy and Economic Recovery Act requires U.S. representatives to vote against any loan to the country in international financial institutions. Harare sees it as a cause of its crisis.
737737fa08: Reprisals after the USS Buchanan refusal
New Zealand refuses port entry to a destroyer whose nuclear armament is not declared. Washington cancels exercises, restricts intelligence sharing and freezes high-level contacts.
7382c3c104: Washington backs and funds this aid distribution system guarded by US contractors. Hundreds of Palestinians are killed near the sites, mostly by the Israeli army.
739c3b909b: Allied military government plan for France

Roosevelt, who refuses to recognise de Gaulle's provisional government, has an Allied military administration (AMGOT) of the liberated territories prepared. De Gaulle imposes his own authorities; Washington recognises the GPRF in October 1944. The scope of the project remains debated.
73a895f021: A special forces unit bombs a crowd of women and children; about 70 dead. The New York Times reveals in 2021 that the affair was covered up; the Pentagon opens an investigation.
73e9db1a97: Built by the US Air Force for about $110 million, the Agadez base launches its armed drone missions in 2019. It is evacuated in August 2024 at the junta's request.
7404b3eeca: Attack on the Spanish freighter Sierra Aránzazu
CIA-funded commandos of Artime's group strafe a Spanish freighter they mistake for a Cuban ship. The captain and two sailors are killed. The episode hastens the end of the program.
7407ac68d7: Biden authorizes a $200 million drawdown of weapons and ammunition from Pentagon stocks as Russian troops mass at the border.
743803d7d3: Executive orders against TikTok and WeChat
Trump signs two executive orders banning transactions with ByteDance and Tencent for TikTok and WeChat. Courts block their enforcement.
7454e65766: Marines use Mark 77 incendiary bombs, successors to napalm, against Iraqi positions during the invasion. The Pentagon first denied it before acknowledging it.
74a924299f: Nationalist leader Pedro Albizu Campos and other leaders are convicted by a federal court of “seditious conspiracy” and sent to the Atlanta penitentiary.
74b1a1cee4: The Luxembourg clearing house pays nearly $152 million to the Treasury for transactions in securities of the Iranian central bank.
74cb38f690: Alpha 66 Raid on the Soviet Freighter Lvov

Alpha 66 commandos attack a Soviet freighter at the port of Isabela de Sagua. Washington disavows these raids and restricts the exiles. Antonio Veciana, the group's founder, says he acted with a CIA officer.
74cd6b34bf: Despite the ceasefire, US forces strike missile launch sites and boats suspected of laying mines. The Pentagon speaks of self-defense.
74e83bd531: From 1985 to 1990, the Commerce Department approves hundreds of export licenses to Iraq, including computers and equipment usable by its weapons programs, according to congressional investigations.
74f3a90b25: The CIA and the Italian military service SIFAR sign the agreement founding Gladio, an armed clandestine anti-invasion network. Giulio Andreotti reveals its existence in 1990.
74f598f452: A Bush order freezes the assets of Lukashenko and Belarusian officials accused of rigging the March 2006 presidential election.
74fda9fb17: Hundreds of Libyan soldiers captured in Chad in 1987 are turned against Gaddafi. Under Khalifa Haftar they form an armed force trained near N'Djamena with CIA help, according to the American press.
7515de45c9: Barack Obama orders 30,000 additional soldiers to Afghanistan against the Taliban and al-Qaeda. The withdrawal of these reinforcements begins in 2011 and ends in September 2012.
751a02ab5e: The AP's 1999 investigation reports other Naktong bridges destroyed by American engineer units in August 1950 while civilians were crossing them.
7524103f3a: A U.S. soldier fires from a tank on the Reuters cameraman who was filming near Abu Ghraib prison. The army concludes that the shooting was justified.
752f370a50: Bush signs a law that funds the Belarusian opposition and independent media and provides for sanctions against the Lukashenko regime.
7558a2bcf0: Faced with a hunger strike by more than a hundred detainees, the military force-feeds them through nasogastric tubes, a practice condemned by the UN as inhuman treatment.
756078a4ae: Strikes on the Islamic State in Puntland
Donald Trump announces strikes on Islamic State leaders in northern Somalia. US strikes in the country then reach a record level in 2025.
757652d593: Strategic bombers now take off from Thailand for Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia. With Udorn, Takhli, Korat, Ubon and Nakhon Phanom, the country hosts most of the air war.
75806ed3e0: The 2016 defense authorization act creates the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative, funded with $300 million, to train and equip Ukrainian forces.
7590c66b19: Alleged counter oil shock against the USSR
Saudi Arabia sharply increases its output in late 1985 and prices collapse, depriving the USSR of foreign currency. Some authors see a plan concerted with Washington; the thesis is debated.
75a4058360: A $400 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition, shells and bridging vehicles.
75caa62bde: The Pentagon prepares strike options against the Yongbyon reactor and military reinforcements. Former Defense Secretary William Perry confirmed it. Jimmy Carter's visit defuses the crisis.
75ee4867ad: The U.S. Navy evacuates Bikini's 167 inhabitants to Rongerik to conduct nuclear tests. They suffer famine there before being displaced again.
75fbb18f08: The Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States requests an intervention, which serves as the legal basis. Several historians establish that Washington solicited and helped draft the request.
76120f53c3: According to Snowden documents published by The Intercept, the NSA analyzes the metadata of 55 million Pakistani mobile phones to designate “suspects” by algorithm.
762847f414: Naval detachments land to protect American lives and interests during the Honduran civil war. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
762c28991a: American aircraft launch a months-long interdiction campaign against North Korea's roads, bridges and railways. It fails to cut the supply of the front.
76341f48e0: Reagan imposes 100 percent tariffs on 300 million dollars of Japanese electronic products. He accuses Tokyo of not complying with the 1986 semiconductor agreement.
76484562c1: Reagan and the Point Salines airport
In a televised speech, Reagan shows aerial photos of the airport under construction and presents it as a Soviet-Cuban military base. The airport opens in 1984 for tourism.
7650f52f27: CIA headquarters authorizes its Havana station to offer $10,000 to a Cuban to arrange a fatal “accident” for Raúl Castro. The order is canceled a few hours later. The Church Committee establishes it.
766d838367: Stealth B-2s strike five underground Houthi weapons depots, their first use in this campaign.
7699cfaee7: Asked at a press conference, Truman says the use of the atomic bomb in Korea is “under consideration.” MacArthur then asks for atomic bombs.
769f2c193d: The Treasury adds Kim Jong-un to its sanctions list for human rights violations. It is the first time he has been named as a target.
76b1eb3259: Endara sworn in on an American base
Guillermo Endara is sworn in as president at Fort Clayton, an American military base, at the start of the invasion.
76ff4494ce: The American Jesuit priest accompanies a rebel column and disappears. His family accuses the Honduran army and blames the CIA and the State Department for hiding what they knew.
770a87cdae: The Pentagon confirms that MQ-9 Reaper drones are flying over Gaza to search for hostages. The information gathered is shared with Israel.
771b3819e9: Trump lifts the suspension imposed by Biden in May 2024 and authorizes the delivery of 2,000-pound MK-84 bombs to Israel.
772d4a0fe1: Assange spied on at the Ecuadorian embassy
The Spanish company UC Global, in charge of security, films Assange and his lawyers. Spanish courts investigate the transmission of this data to U.S. intelligence.
775cbf0853: Obama authorizes the use of armed Predator drones against Gaddafi's forces, notably in besieged Misrata.
776fa960a5: Marines land, then an American military government rules the country until 1924.
779179e22a: Support for Chad in the Toyota War
Washington backs Hissène Habré's regime in its 1986-1987 war against Gaddafi's Libya, which ends with the expulsion of Libyan troops from northern Chad.
779bc94044: Trump imposes 10% tariffs on all Chinese imports on the grounds of fentanyl, doubled to 20% in March.
779cd753e9: The “Iraq War Logs” record 834 deaths in “escalation of force” shootings at checkpoints from 2004 to 2009, including 681 civilians, among them at least 30 children. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
77a973b73c: The Intercept reveals that the NSA's Somalget program records nearly all mobile calls in the Bahamas.
7802f1ccc4: Hundreds of thousands of German soldiers are held in the open air by the American army. Several thousand die. The figure of one million put forward by James Bacque is rejected by historians.
7807a0e619: Abu Ghraib infant formula plant bombed
American aircraft destroy a plant that Iraq presents as a baby milk factory. Washington claims it was a biological weapons site. The point remains disputed.
782ece6e3f: According to the Sunday Times (2000), American agents trained and advised the Kosovo Liberation Army before and during the bombing. Washington denies any armed support.
7839a9b96f: A $725 million drawdown including drones, Stingers and HIMARS ammunition.
7858c045de: U.S. forces fire submunitions on urban areas, notably around Hilla and Baghdad. Human Rights Watch calls them one of the leading causes of civilian deaths in the invasion.
78634c91d1: After the banning of Solidarność, Reagan withdraws Poland's most-favoured-nation tariff, which makes its exports to the United States more expensive.
78652a8217: An Apache helicopter kills about ten men, including two Reuters employees, then fires on a minivan that had come to rescue a wounded man. The video, published by WikiLeaks in 2010, is authenticated by the military.
78e8709f7f: Ambassador Paul Trivelli publicly calls for Daniel Ortega to be defeated and U.S. officials warn against his election. Ortega wins.
78ebd1b8aa: About 20,000 American soldiers are deployed in Bosnia in the NATO force tasked with implementing the Dayton Accords. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
7928845449: Musk by video at the AfD rally in Halle
Now an adviser to Donald Trump, Elon Musk speaks by video at the launch of the AfD campaign. He says there is “too much focus on past guilt” and urges people to vote AfD.
7928f47ffb: Biden signs a law that strengthens sanctions and oversight of lending to Nicaragua, three days after Ortega's disputed reelection.
7932ee4482: CIA guides the strikes on boats
According to The Guardian, the CIA provides the intelligence used to designate the alleged trafficker boats struck by the US military in the Caribbean.
79350e6f84: Harrison Salisbury of the New York Times describes from the North the civilian destruction caused by the bombing. The Pentagon admits “accidental” damage.
793ed1b55a: Forced Labor of the Corvée in Haiti
The occupation reinstates the corvée, forced labor on roads. The abuses fuel the Caco revolt; it is officially abolished in 1918.
795cd18013: On Israeli accusations targeting a dozen employees, Washington suspends its aid to UNRWA, the main humanitarian agency in Gaza. Congress then bans it until March 2025.
797879b6d8: WikiLeaks publishes 29 Brazilian numbers targeted by the NSA, including those of Dilma Rousseff, her presidential plane and ministers.
79869cd8dc: Taiwanese U-2 Shot Down at Shangrao
A “Black Cats” U-2 is shot down in Jiangxi. Pilot Yeh Changti, captured, is held for nineteen years.
799aee76b1: State Department spokesperson Christine Shelly speaks of “acts of genocide” without using the word alone. Washington thereby avoids the obligation to act under the 1948 convention.
79b0a3c649: A year after the disputed presidential election, Washington sanctions the potash producer Belaruskali and the Belarusian National Olympic Committee.
79b0d25be0: Missiles destroy the plant that produced a large share of Sudan's medicines, presented as a chemical weapons site linked to Bin Laden. No solid proof has been provided.
79b58f19e5: Vilnius letter on the Iraq war

Ten NATO candidate countries, including the three Baltic states, support the intervention in Iraq. The text is drafted by American lobbyist Bruce Jackson, who links the signature to Washington's support for their accession.
79b6b2920e: Secretary of State James Byrnes offers Danish minister Gustav Rasmussen 100 million dollars in gold for the island, according to an official telegram. Copenhagen refuses but leaves the American bases in place.
79bdd38bc6: In his State of the Union address, Biden announces the closure of US airspace to Russian carriers.
79dc947cf3: Datu Ali Killed by an American Column
A column commanded by Captain Frank McCoy surprises and kills Datu Ali, leader of the Maguindanao resistance in the Cotabato Valley.
79df6302e2: During the crisis pitting the king against Nabulsi's nationalist government, Eisenhower sends the 6th Fleet to the eastern Mediterranean and grants $10 million in emergency aid.
79e5c98ab0: Biden extends the investment ban to 59 Chinese defense and surveillance companies, including Huawei and Hikvision.
7a0a1a5596: Threat to Iraq's account at the Fed

The State Department warns Baghdad that access to its account at the New York Federal Reserve, where its oil revenues are deposited, could be blocked if US troops are expelled, according to the Wall Street Journal.
7a13a3cc24: The U.S. Army disperses zinc cadmium sulfide over Winnipeg to simulate a biological attack, without informing the residents.
7a1e688855: Fishermen Killed on the Dokdo Rocks
American bombers use the islets as a training target and kill Korean fishermen present there. The toll remains disputed depending on the source.
7a1f6fa4de: Green light for the Turkish offensive
After a call with Erdoğan, the White House announces the withdrawal of US troops from the border. Three days later Turkey launches an offensive against the Kurds allied with Washington.
7a486e6dd9: Congressional report against Huawei and ZTE
The House intelligence committee calls Huawei and ZTE security threats and recommends excluding them from the U.S. market, without public evidence of spying.
7a53c8c9df: The designation of the Houthis as a terrorist organization takes effect despite UN warnings about famine. The Biden administration reverses it the following month.
7a5f50a3b4: According to John Foster Dulles, Washington lets Beijing know, notably through India, that it will use the atomic weapon if the armistice negotiations fail. The real effect of these threats remains debated.
7a6676c36c: With Edward Lansdale, the CIA pays funds to Cao Đài leaders, including Trình Minh Thế, and to Hòa Hảo leaders so that they rally to Ngô Đình Diệm, according to historians.
7a6fdfba9e: A $300 million drawdown including Hydra-70 rockets and artillery shells.
7a9236096d: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick says this tax “scam” “has to stop”, after Trump accused Ireland of “taking” American laboratories. Dublin fears tariffs on pharmaceuticals, its top export to the United States.
7b0abed744: CIA director John Ratcliffe confirms the suspension of intelligence sharing with Ukraine, after the suspension of arms deliveries.
7b1ac0b528: First Javelin missiles delivered to Ukraine
Kyiv confirms receipt of US Javelin anti-tank missiles, the first delivery of lethal weapons approved by the Trump administration.
7b42eb5f35: During the civil war, Marines are sent to Nanjing to protect the embassy, then to Shanghai, until 1949. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
7b5eb45a30: Despite the irregularities noted by the OAS, which calls for a new vote, the United States recognizes Hernández's reelection. The repression of protests leaves more than 20 dead.
7b6a8f9acb: The United States sets up Joint Task Force-Bravo at Palmerola base, renamed Soto Cano. It supports regional operations against Nicaragua and the FMLN.
7b714cc3f0: Soldiers rape and kill Abeer al-Janabi, 14, then kill her parents and her 6-year-old sister. Five soldiers are convicted, including Steven Green to life and three others to sentences of 90 to 110 years.
7baa15b66b: Flights to Guantánamo via Rota and Morón

According to secret documents published by El País in 2008, the Aznar government agrees in less than 24 hours that American aircraft carrying prisoners from Afghanistan to Guantánamo may stop over at the Rota and Morón bases.
7bc51e41d7: Xenophon Kalamatiano, who runs an intelligence network for the American consulate, is arrested by the Cheka during the Lockhart affair.
7bc5452924: During the peasant uprising and the “Matanza,” American and British ships anchor off Acajutla. General Martínez refuses to let them land and massacres thousands of peasants.
7bd1f74fcb: Pedro Albizu Campos publishes a letter in which this Rockefeller Institute physician claims to have killed eight Puerto Rican patients. An inquiry concludes it was a joke; the affair remains controversial.
7bd35971e0: Rapes by American Soldiers in France
After the landings, American soldiers commit hundreds of rapes documented by courts-martial. Black soldiers are overrepresented among those executed, a sign of discriminatory justice.
7bd7236326: Cartel de los Soles designated terrorist
The Treasury designates the “Cartel de los Soles,” presented as led by Maduro, as a terrorist organization. Experts doubt it exists as a structured organization.
7bde2113b3: The New York Times reveals that the U.S. Treasury has secretly accessed data from the Belgian company SWIFT since 2001. The Belgian privacy commission finds these transfers illegal.
7c0baacaa5: The CIA secretly trains hundreds of Tibetan fighters in Colorado from 1958 to 1964, before sending them back to Tibet or Nepal.
7c0c027204: The plant that Washington accuses of producing chemical weapons is hit by a fire. Libya accuses the United States, Israel and Germany of sabotage, never established.
7c15ad6485: The Treasury revokes Chevron's license in Venezuela and gives it 30 days to wind down its operations.
7c22ea2514: Funded by Washington, President Banzer's forced eradication plan militarizes the Chapare. Dozens of growers and soldiers die in the clashes.
7c2e162665: Obama's first veto: the United States stands alone in opposing a draft declaring Israeli settlements illegal, backed by more than 120 co-sponsoring countries.
7c38570c2d: Delta Force captures in Tripoli a suspect in the 1998 embassy bombings and interrogates him on a ship before taking him to New York. Tripoli protests.
7c495a8aaf: After the failure of negotiations, Washington imposes 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Ottawa retaliates in kind on September 8.
7cb6fc4710: MacArthur sends Washington a list of targets in Korea and China requiring 26 atomic bombs. The request, known from archives, is refused.
7ce6aeb759: 25% on Mexican goods in the name of the fight against fentanyl and migration, later partly suspended for goods covered by the USMCA.
7ce96e6350: According to the Snowden documents, the NSA and Australian intelligence monitor delegations there, including the numbers of Indonesian officials.
7cffd2dd91: Washington reduces the ESTA authorisation of Hungarians to one year and a single trip, citing poorly vetted mass naturalisations of non-residents. The measure is lifted in September 2025.
7d0b8e3b25: Between the two rounds, computers at the Élysée are infiltrated. L'Express accuses the United States; an NSA memo revealed by Snowden denies it and suspects another ally.
7d3282782f: During the siege of Kunduz, Washington lets Pakistan airlift out its officers, but also Taliban and al-Qaeda fighters, according to Seymour Hersh. The United States has not confirmed this.
7d5c6e6208: Murder of Michael DeVine in Guatemala
American Michael DeVine is killed by soldiers. Colonel Julio Alpírez, linked to the case, was a paid CIA informant, according to an official American report of 1996.
7d813461d8: Privateer Shot Down Over the Baltic
A U.S. Navy electronic intelligence aircraft is shot down by Soviet fighters near the Latvian coast. All ten crew members disappear.
7d961e152b: The Treasury sanctions five officials from the financial, telecommunications and military intelligence agencies accused of supporting the repression.
7da3995e97: Washington sanctions the state oil company. A CEPR study estimates tens of thousands of sanctions-related deaths; the figure is disputed.
7db0cd2508: US justice indicts Maduro and about fifteen officials, including Diosdado Cabello, for narco-terrorism and cocaine trafficking with the FARC.
7e05be40fc: Accusing the Chinese freighter Yinhe of delivering chemical precursors to Iran, the US Navy shadows it and prevents it from docking for weeks. The search at Dammam finds nothing.
7e2df71584: From 2004 to 2008, the BND passes to the NSA data captured at the Frankfurt internet node. The Bundestag inquiry establishes that European data was handed over.
7e472b1167: Sanctions on the Chinese refinery Hengli
The Treasury sanctions Hengli, a large private refinery in Dalian, for buying Iranian oil, along with about forty shipowners and vessels. Beijing retaliates with a blocking order.
7e5d4e8342: George H. W. Bush signs a presidential directive authorizing the CIA to “create the conditions” for Saddam Hussein's overthrow, according to the American press. It is the starting point of the operations of the 1990s.
7e5ebcf6e9: According to Philip Agee, a former Quito station officer, the CIA infiltrates parties, funds demonstrations and organizes attacks blamed on the left, which contributes to the president's fall.
7e71364230: Abu Hamza Rabia killed in Waziristan
A missile fired by a drone kills this al-Qaeda figure. Islamabad cites an accidental explosion, but fragments of a U.S. missile are photographed.
7e76f0e11f: A $425 million drawdown including NASAMS ammunition, armored vehicles and anti-tank missiles.
7e85a4312b: Eisenhower Orders the Fall of Sukarno
President Eisenhower instructs the CIA to overthrow Sukarno. The order paves the way for arming the regional rebellions in 1958. It is documented by declassified archives.
7e9ab0cde4: By Executive Order 13067, Bill Clinton imposes a total trade and financial embargo on Sudan. It remains in force until October 2017.
7ea44209c0: The United States seizes in the Dominican Republic a Dassault Falcon used by Maduro, bought in violation of sanctions according to them, and transfers it to Florida.
7eb3149a11: Staged Attack on a Cleric's House
According to the CIA's internal history, agents posing as Tudeh Communists attack the house of at least one cleric to turn the clergy against Mossadegh.
7ebabe1f3a: An NSA intercept reports an exchange between Mariann Fischer Boel and Japanese minister Toshikatsu Matsuoka about their red lines facing the United States in the Doha round. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2016.
7edf1fc6a3: Washington refuses the ITAR export license for a US component of the SCALP missile, which blocks the sale of these missiles and holds up a new Rafale contract with Egypt.
7eea909a6d: Veto on a ceasefire in Gaza
Alone against thirteen votes, the United States blocks a draft from the Emirates demanding an immediate humanitarian ceasefire, backed by the Secretary-General.
7f3b9df982: A CIA Predator drone kills Abu Ali al-Harithi, a suspect in the USS Cole attack, and five other men, including a U.S. citizen. First drone strike outside a war zone.
7f46631167: Alleged support for the AFDL offensive

Rwanda and Uganda, allies of Washington, launch Laurent-Désiré Kabila's rebellion; American military personnel had trained the Rwandan army. Authors, including journalist Wayne Madsen before Congress in 2001, allege direct backing. Washington denies it; nothing establishes it.
7f59fef49e: Obama has a journalist kept in prison
Obama calls President Saleh to oppose the release of Abdulelah Haider Shaye, a journalist who had revealed the U.S. role in al-Majalah. He remains detained until 2013.
7f67e3ee98: Pardon for the Panama plot's perpetrators

Outgoing president Mireya Moscoso pardons Posada Carriles and his accomplices. Three of them, U.S. citizens, return to Miami. Cuba and Venezuela accuse Washington of having obtained the pardon, which the United States denies.
7f791b3e7e: Abu Laith al-Libi killed by a drone
A CIA strike kills this al-Qaeda commander and several other people near Mir Ali.
7f7fac2f07: After US sanctions and months of pressure from Washington, London orders Huawei removed from its 5G networks by 2027.
7fa20e4ece: This GRU officer volunteers to the CIA in Vienna and becomes its first major source within Soviet military intelligence. Unmasked, he is executed in 1960.
7fd2f3b00a: The dictator is shot dead by conspirators. The CIA had supplied them with carbines via the consulate, according to the Church Committee.
7fd35834cd: Sanctions on BanCorp and Laureano Ortega
The Treasury sanctions BanCorp, a bank linked to the Ortega family, and the president's son, Laureano Ortega Murillo.
7fe5c14a11: Software hidden in Vodafone's network taps Costas Karamanlis and about a hundred officials. Press and Greek judicial investigations point to the U.S. embassy.
7feb0020df: The Treasury warns financial institutions that they risk sanctions if they deal with Chinese independent refineries that buy Iranian oil.
7ff50a0ca7: In response to an Ontario surcharge on exported electricity, Trump announces he will double tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum; Ontario suspends its measure the same day.
7ffec541f7: During Castro's visit to Chile, Cuban exiles carrying fake Venezuelan journalist credentials and a camera concealing a weapon give up on shooting. Antonio Veciana attributes the plan to his CIA contact, “Maurice Bishop”, whose role has never been corroborated.
803e3716f0: SWIFT cuts off Iran despite the EU

After the reimposition of sanctions on Iran and threats from Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin, the Belgian company SWIFT disconnects Iranian banks, despite the EU's wish to preserve the nuclear deal.
80475e0647: The law writes the embargo against Cuba into legislation and threatens sanctions on foreign companies that trade with the island. The European Union challenges it at the WTO.
80538ea09e: Russia presents Yanukovych's flight as a putsch organized by Washington; no evidence of such orchestration has been produced.
806a94d5a8: John Bolton announces that remittances to Cuba will be limited to $1,000 per quarter per person, along with the activation of Title III of Helms-Burton.
806f0eff78: U.S. F-15s strike a meeting near Ajdabiya targeting the Algerian jihadist Mokhtar Belmokhtar. Tripoli announces his death, never confirmed.
80736e7c4a: Marines land to support the Díaz government. They remain, with a brief pause, until 1933.
807399c6a5: RB-29 Shot Down Near the Kurils
An RB-29 on a photographic reconnaissance mission is shot down by Soviet fighters near Yuri Island. The eight men on board die.
8074332ab7: Mercenaries paid by the CIA in Angola

According to former CIA officer John Stockwell, the agency funds French and Portuguese mercenaries for the FNLA. Mercenaries, including the American Daniel Gearhart, are tried in Luanda; Gearhart is shot in July 1976.
8099b88cb6: Iraqi General Abed Hamed Mowhoush dies of suffocation in a sleeping bag during an interrogation. The officer responsible is given a mere reprimand.
80c0ed0a2a: Hunt for and Capture of Lumumba
Lumumba flees toward Stanleyville and is captured in early December. Station cables show it was helping the government monitor the roads to find him.
80f4aefb15: Washington spent about $65 million on democracy programs; Moscow denounces a remote-controlled revolution.
810073fdcc: More than 50,000 Marines land in North China to hold cities and railways and help the Kuomintang retake territory from the Communists.
811139a021: Green light for Iranian arms in Bosnia
Washington lets Croatia know it has “no instructions” against the transit of Iranian arms to the Bosniaks, despite the UN embargo. Congress investigates in 1996.
8161208c79: At the CIA's request, Rumsfeld orders a suspect held without registering him with the International Committee of the Red Cross, which he acknowledges in 2004. The Taguba report mentions other cases.
8184b9eb07: Nymrod database: 122 heads of state targeted
A 2009 document lists 122 foreign leaders in an NSA database, including Angela Merkel and the heads of state of Peru, Somalia, Guatemala, Colombia and Belarus. Revealed by Der Spiegel in March 2014.
81974278c1: American bombers mistakenly hit the neutral Swiss city: 40 dead. Washington pays compensation.
81995d7797: Veto on the offensive in northern Gaza
Washington blocks a draft demanding a halt to Operation “Days of Penitence,” which killed more than a hundred Palestinians in the northern Gaza Strip.
819d102934: After a revolt, Washington invokes the Platt Amendment and installs an American provisional governor, Charles Magoon, until 1909.
81d594ed6d: Thai troops in Vietnam paid for
Washington funds the pay and equipment of the “Queen's Cobras”, then of the “Black Panthers” division sent to Vietnam, as revealed by the Symington Senate hearings in 1969.
81ed642655: Foster Dulles withdraws the American offer to finance the High Dam. Nasser nationalizes the Suez Canal a week later.
81f15cb34e: After the failed coup attributed to the PKI, General Suharto takes control of the army. Researchers suggest an American role beforehand, which the published archives do not demonstrate.
8208e84ff0: Encouraged by Washington, President Eric Arturo Delvalle tries to remove Noriega. The Assembly dismisses him. The United States continues to recognize him as president.
82182884b6: American and South Korean guards fire on North Korean civilian internees demonstrating in the camp on Pongam Island. There are 85 dead.
8227f9f299: George H. W. Bush signs National Security Directive 26, which advocates normal relations with Iraq and economic incentives, despite the known gassings and weapons programs.
8230ce137f: An SMS-based social network secretly funded by USAID to stir up dissent. The AP reveals it in 2014; USAID confirms the program.
8233548642: Captain William Rogers III, who commanded the cruiser that shot down Iran Air Flight 655, receives the Legion of Merit for his command.
824eef0d47: USS Enterprise in the Bay of Bengal
Nixon sends Task Force 74, led by the aircraft carrier USS Enterprise, into the Bay of Bengal to pressure India during the Bangladesh Liberation War.
827c7895ca: Geneva talks on the eve of war

Witkoff and Kushner meet Araghchi in Geneva; Oman mentions “substantial progress” and a new meeting on March 2. Two days later, the strikes begin. Tehran accuses Washington of using the talks as cover.
8280acfa0f: Bounties for the capture of suspects
U.S. forces distribute leaflets promising thousands of dollars for any suspected al-Qaeda member. Many Guantánamo detainees were sold this way. Musharraf writes that Pakistan received millions.
82b382ed98: An audit by the U.S. inspector general concludes in 2005 that the Provisional Authority could not account for the use of $8.8 billion in Iraqi funds paid to the ministries.
82b795e66b: The CIA launches an anti-Castro propaganda radio from the Swan Islands. It presents itself as a private commercial station.
82bc03418c: Resumption of massive bombing of the North until October 1972, with guided bombs against bridges, depots and railways.
82c6e070f4: During a counternarcotics operation with the DEA, a helicopter fires on a boat and kills four civilians. A 2017 report by U.S. inspectors general criticizes the DEA.
82d24cf47d: General Hodge's troops land at Incheon and set up a military government south of the 38th parallel. It keeps the administration and police inherited from Japanese colonial rule.
82e7c80bd9: American and British bombers hit Belgrade on Orthodox Easter. Hundreds of civilians are killed.
82f21ca386: Condoleezza Rice says on CNN that we don't want the smoking gun to be “a mushroom cloud.” Iraq had no active nuclear program.
82fab9c18d: For the first time, Washington designates another state's armed force as a foreign terrorist organization.
8330cd737f: Before the end of the fiscal year, the Trump administration obligates $307 million of the $400 million appropriated for the USAI and plans to obligate the rest before September 30.
833c0fb907: Congress imposes on Puerto Rico an unelected fiscal oversight board, with the power to impose austerity and restructure debt.
836ffcf732: Settlement with French, British and US justice authorities for corruption and violations of US arms export rules (ITAR).
8390a5a5fb: Strikes on more than 80 Iranian targets
After Iranian attacks on three tankers, CENTCOM strikes more than 80 military sites on the southern coast, including Bandar Abbas and Qeshm. Trump declares the ceasefire over.
83d6dc013c: At the end of a Section 301 investigation targeting notably electronic payments and anti-corruption efforts, Washington imposes 25% tariffs on most Brazilian goods, three months before the presidential election.
83d7d78cde: Chinese authorities accuse hackers “of US origin” of having planted a backdoor in the seismic monitoring center.
840bc3558f: American daytime raid followed by a British night raid on the Bulgarian capital. Hundreds of civilians are killed.
841f9c5272: Act No. 518 equates armed resistance with brigandage, punishable by death. It allows the last independence leaders to be tried as bandits, including Macario Sakay, hanged in 1907.
84244f903c: The Treasury sanctions lawmaker Delyan Peevski and other Bulgarian figures for corruption, a rare intervention in the politics of an EU member state.
8426da0637: After Trujillo's attack on Venezuelan President Betancourt, the OAS votes sanctions. Washington breaks off relations and then suspends the Dominican sugar quota.
843405700e: NATO bombs hit a camp of Albanian refugees in Koriša. Human Rights Watch counts between 48 and 87 dead.
84373c96f0: Trump launches an intensive strike campaign against the Houthis. The first day kills at least 53 according to the Houthis. The strikes last until a ceasefire on May 6.
8439d2b977: Shelling by the battleship New Jersey
The USS New Jersey fires some 300 406-mm shells at Druze and Syrian positions. Villages are hit and the number of civilian casualties remains unknown.
84612acb2c: At the end of the Hungnam evacuation, the American army and navy blow up the port facilities so as to leave nothing to Chinese forces.
8470f95c71: After a drone attack in Erbil that wounds US soldiers, the United States strikes three Kataib Hezbollah sites. Baghdad condemns an infringement of its sovereignty.
8472ba8cf8: Trump asks Zelensky to investigate Joe Biden while blocking nearly $400 million in military aid. The affair leads to his first impeachment.
84892d4ea5: Funded Split of the Japanese Left
Eisenhower approves a CIA program to detach the moderate wing of the Socialist Party. The moderates found the Democratic Socialist Party in 1960, funded by Washington according to FRUS archives.
849bb9c179: US special forces attack the hideout of the Islamic State leader, who kills himself with an explosive vest, taking two children with him.
84c36c00df: An American cavalry troop attacks the Mexican federal army blocking its path. A dozen Americans and several dozen Mexicans, including General Félix Gómez, are killed.
84c936c4e9: New WikiLeaks documents: the NSA targets finance ministers and the major export contracts of French companies.
84cc8d3988: A presidential memorandum restores the 2017 policy: ban on transactions with GAESA, tighter travel controls and opposition to calls at the UN to lift the embargo.
84e4c1d028: The US Trade Representative opens an investigation into Brazilian practices, including the PIX payment system, a prelude to new trade sanctions.
85025e19d2: Journalist Jonathan Schell finds that most of the villages in the province have been destroyed by bombing and fires.
851653f20a: Activation of Title III of Helms-Burton
The Trump administration for the first time allows lawsuits against foreign companies that use nationalized property in Cuba.
851bad6878: Secret Psychological Strategy Board plan to reduce the power of the Italian Communist Party through political, psychological and paramilitary action. The documents are declassified.
85447de0b9: Before the 1990 presidential election, American funds for “democracy” benefit organizations close to Marc Bazin, a former World Bank official. Aristide wins by a wide margin.
854b044645: The FSB accuses the NSA of having hacked thousands of iPhones, including those of diplomats; Kaspersky documents the attack without attributing it.
85623f4350: Pressure on the Haitian presidential election
Hillary Clinton travels to Port-au-Prince to secure Michel Martelly's place in the runoff, rather than the government's candidate, on the basis of a disputed OAS report.
85b585196c: During the Lhasa uprising, two Tibetan agents trained by the CIA accompany the Dalai Lama's flight to India and remain in radio contact with the agency.
85d7d5747e: Italian courts convict 23 Americans in absentia, including 22 CIA agents, for the 2003 abduction of Abu Omar. None is extradited.
85f6f2f8be: Abbas Araghchi accuses the United States of having struck a desalination plant on Qeshm Island, depriving 30 villages of water. Washington and Israel deny it.
863054e53b: Secret funds to change the Iranian regime
On Newt Gingrich's initiative, Congress earmarks 18 million dollars for covert action against the Iranian government, according to the American press. Tehran responds with a counter-budget.
864a0f299e: Ibn al-Sheikh al-Libi handed over to Egypt
Transferred by the CIA to Egypt, he “confesses” under torture to links between Iraq and al-Qaeda, repeated by Powell at the UN. He recants; the Senate confirms it was false.
8663db7543: The USS Tautog, tracking the Soviet submarine K-108 near its Kamchatka base, collides with it. The K-108 returns to port damaged.
866a38e03b: After the US withdrawal from the nuclear deal and the reinstatement of secondary sanctions, PSA suspends its operations in Iran, its top foreign market by volume.
86b0a14186: Strike on a wedding in Kuhestak

A US strike aimed, according to CENTCOM, at the Guards hits a house where a wedding was taking place: five dead, including two children, and dozens wounded. The UN fact-finding mission calls for an end to hostilities.
86ba6d36e4: American aircraft attack the Sup'ung Dam and the plants of the North. North Korea is deprived of electricity almost entirely for two weeks.
86c0e1c78c: An $820 million package, including two NASAMS anti-aircraft systems funded by the USAI and ammunition for HIMARS.
86e3c477bc: For 52 years, American services operate an interception station in Bavaria. Under the name GARLICK, it is one of the major satellite stations of the Echelon network. The NSA hands it over to the BND in 2004.
86e5126fd6: Cuba targeted by the travel order
A Trump proclamation partially restricts the entry of Cuban nationals into the United States, including tourist and student visas.
86f48d00ee: The U.S. Navy escorts supply convoys to shelled Kinmen, and military planners prepare nuclear strike plans against mainland China.
86fc824bc9: Credit Suisse pleads guilty to aiding tax evasion and pays $2.6 billion, under threat of losing its U.S. license.
872b0ec6b2: Biden signs a law that authorizes the seizure of Russian sovereign assets held in the United States for the benefit of Ukraine.
873c2b0627: Maduro's wife, lawmaker Cilia Flores, is abducted with him and indicted in New York in an expanded indictment that also targets their son.
8757f334c0: Pressure on Rome in the Abu Omar case

Ambassador Ronald Spogli, and later Robert Gates, urge the Italian government not to forward extradition requests for the CIA agents prosecuted for the imam's abduction. None is sent. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
8770920d13: Mohammed Haydar Zammar handed over to Syria

Arrested in Morocco, this German-Syrian is transferred with CIA help to Damascus, where he is detained and interrogated at the Palestine Branch. The U.S. role is established by the press and a Bundestag inquiry.
879851a41c: Aid to Mobutu during Shaba I
Faced with the incursion of Katangese rebels, Washington sends non-lethal military equipment to Mobutu, also supported by Morocco and France.
87a642dd15: Congress authorizes the president to use armed force to defend Taiwan and the Pescadores against the People's Republic of China.
87ac788582: Washington applies the second tranche of the chemical weapons law: US banks can no longer buy Russian sovereign debt issued in rubles or in foreign currency on the primary market.
87ae22beb4: Humanitarian contracts blocked at the UN
On the sanctions committee, the United States places on hold billions of dollars of “oil-for-food” program contracts, including water and electricity equipment, according to UN figures.
87b012fe00: Khmer Serei and End of American Aid
Sihanouk accuses American services of supporting Son Ngoc Thanh's Khmer Serei, whose radio broadcasts from South Vietnam and Thailand, and renounces American aid.
87de6c5350: After a March 1959 ruling declaring American forces unconstitutional, Ambassador Douglas MacArthur II meets the chief justice of the Supreme Court. Documents declassified in 2008 reveal it. The Court overturns the ruling.
882c3cda46: With the G7 and the EU, Washington bans all transactions with the Russian central bank, freezing a large share of its foreign exchange reserves. A few Russian banks are excluded from SWIFT.
88334f7b30: At the start of the second intifada, the United States blocks the creation of a UN observer force tasked with protecting Palestinian civilians.
883533ec55: The Justice Department places Austrian president Kurt Waldheim on its watch list for his alleged role in Nazi persecutions. He is the first sitting head of state barred from entering the United States.
8844de252e: The U.S. Navy establishes a maritime quarantine and boards ships bound for Guatemala, including British and French freighters, to prevent any further arms delivery.
884aaf2dad: According to DR television, Danish intelligence helped the NSA spy on Merkel and on German, Swedish, Norwegian and French officials (2012-2014).
884bdafbd1: After the nationalization of the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, the American majors join the British boycott and refuse to buy Iranian oil. Exports collapse.
887030d47f: The White House spokeswoman says that using the military to acquire Greenland remains “always an option.” Copenhagen warns that an attack would mean the end of NATO.
889502ab89: The CIA relies on Argentine military officers of the dictatorship to train the first Contras in Honduras, according to journalistic and historical investigations.
88b1a42cb4: From 2003, the CIA carries out secret operations with Somali warlords against Islamists: abductions and assassinations, which the Islamic courts attribute to Washington.
88b7d7c673: The CIA flies unarmed Predators from Uzbekistan to locate bin Laden. One aircraft probably spots him at Tarnak. The 9/11 Commission describes these flights.
88d8ca972e: The CIA's William Harvey gives Johnny Roselli new poisoned capsules intended for Castro, via the exile Tony Varona. The Church Committee has established it.
88f683a3ed: William Taft and the Japanese prime minister record their mutual acceptance of Japanese dominance over Korea and American dominance over the Philippines. Its significance remains debated.
88fc297b76: Shock therapy advised by the West
Russia frees prices all at once on the advice of Western economists, including Jeffrey Sachs, with the backing of Washington and the IMF. Inflation exceeds 2,500 percent within the year.
8900028589: Pyongyang and Beijing accuse the United States of dropping infected insects and germs. A commission led by Joseph Needham backs them; Soviet documents published in 1998 suggest fabrication.
890748708d: Women killed gathering firewood in Kapisa
A NATO strike kills eight women and girls who were collecting firewood. NATO acknowledges the facts and expresses regret.
8927d1ac78: The New York Times reports that soldiers were told not to intervene when Afghan allies abused boys (bacha bazi). An officer is disciplined for hitting a rapist.
893e3f74eb: Bridges and power plants hit in the south

The United States strikes bridges, electrical facilities and a surveillance tower around Bandar Abbas, and extends its raids to northern Iran. Tehran counts at least 46 dead since hostilities resumed.
894de8e97d: Corporal Daniel Smith is convicted in 2006 of raping a Filipino woman, then transferred to the U.S. embassy under the VFA agreement. He is acquitted on appeal in 2009 after the complainant recants.
894f554137: Melvin Lasky founds Der Monat with funds from the American military government. The magazine then comes under the aegis of the Congress for Cultural Freedom, funded by the CIA.
8956c78bf2: Suppression of the Second Caco War
Marines crush Charlemagne Péralte's insurrection. Thousands of Haitians are killed. Navy and Senate inquiries note summary executions.
89618999e7: US strikes hit a religious complex during prayer and kill dozens of people. Washington acknowledges the strike but disputes that it was a mosque.
8978915e55: The Berger-Lellouche parliamentary report describes the extraterritoriality of U.S. law as an economic weapon against European companies.
8989ff7271: Shooting at a demonstration in Fallujah
Paratroopers of the 82nd Division open fire on a crowd demanding the reopening of an occupied school. About 17 dead according to Human Rights Watch; the army says it returned fire.
89c57e5bd3: American aircraft attack with napalm a cave sheltering refugees near Danyang. The Truth and Reconciliation Commission established the deaths of many civilians.
89cc5524f9: Secretary of State Madeleine Albright publicly admits that the United States played a significant role in the overthrow of Mossadegh, a “setback for Iran's democratic government.”
89ec956be1: Two days after a disputed presidential election, the State Department certifies that Honduras is fighting corruption and respecting human rights, unlocking funds.
89f8457d09: A $275 million drawdown of HIMARS ammunition, shells and counter-drone equipment.
8a027f1edf: Caracas plunged into darkness during the raid
During the operation against Maduro, power is cut in part of Caracas. Trump mentions “a certain expertise” of the United States and General Caine cites Cyber Command. The exact cause remains debated.
8a1326c4ef: Two weeks after his father, Anwar al-Awlaki's son, a 16-year-old U.S. citizen, is killed by a drone. The administration cites a targeting error.
8a5b3551c2: The House of Representatives approves 100 million dollars in aid to the Contras, part of it military, two days before the ICJ ruling.
8a6833c1ca: A $1.3 billion USAI package including four NASAMS systems and drones.
8a6fc51ed1: Graham law on sanctions against Russia
Trump signs the Lindsey O. Graham law that codifies and extends sanctions on Russia and provides for tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian energy. It also extends the Iran Sanctions Act.
8a7fa3bda7: Castillo is removed after trying to dissolve Congress. His supporters denounce a role for Ambassador Lisa Kenna, received the day before by the defense minister; no role has been proved.
8a8a999855: The Castle Bravo test, 15 megatons, more than double the expected yield, spreads fallout over several inhabited atolls. It is the most powerful American test.
8a8d0255f8: For the first time, American troops and Black Hawk helicopters take part in raids on cocaine laboratories in Bolivia. The deployment provokes protests.
8ab5548ee7: Nuclear sensor lost on Nanda Devi
A team from the CIA and Indian intelligence loses, in an avalanche, a plutonium-powered sensor meant to spy on Chinese nuclear tests. The device was never found.
8ab5789be6: AFRICOM confirms 63 strikes in Somalia between January and the end of May 2026 against the Islamic State and al-Shabaab, notably in the Golis Mountains. Civilian casualties are reported without clear attribution.
8ab80039e7: Arrest of Alan Gross in Cuba
This USAID contractor is arrested for secretly installing Internet access equipment. Sentenced to 15 years, he is released in 2014.
8aba995b1c: Bush authorizes millions of dollars in secret funds for the opposition to Noriega in the elections, which the regime annuls.
8acfe8618a: The CIA-funded Free Europe Committee releases tens of millions of leaflets by balloon before the elections, carrying the “ten demands” of a fictitious opposition movement.
8ae0ac50be: Jawbreaker team and suitcases of dollars
A CIA team led by Gary Schroen arrives among the Northern Alliance with $3 million in cash to buy off warlords, ahead of the offensive.
8af0e0ccf7: Biden announces $800 million in aid including 800 Stingers, 2,000 Javelins and, for the first time, Switchblade kamikaze drones.
8b0a834089: Encouraging Chinese support for Pol Pot
According to journalist Elizabeth Becker, Zbigniew Brzezinski told her he had encouraged China to support Pol Pot against Vietnam after 1979.
8b20c61571: Six billion USAI: Patriots and drones
The largest USAI package: $6 billion including Patriot and NASAMS munitions, counter-drone systems and artillery.
8b2f71eb00: Arms promised “in principle” to Siad Barre
Washington says it is ready “in principle” to supply defensive weapons to Somalia. Mogadishu sees a green light as it invades Ethiopia's Ogaden; the offer is withdrawn shortly afterward.
8b31695351: Strike on Niloufar Square in Tehran

An Israeli-American strike destroys a police station on Niloufar Square, in the middle of Tehran: at least 20 civilians killed according to Amnesty International, which calls for a war crimes investigation.
8b4ca91fa0: Cap on the price of Russian oil
The G7, at US initiative, bans the shipping and insurance of Russian oil sold above $60 a barrel.
8b55f84483: A $275 million drawdown centered on ammunition and counter-drone systems.
8b7d8cd1d1: IMF cuts off funds to Argentina
The IMF, where Washington holds a veto, suspends a $1.26 billion disbursement. The country collapses, with dozens killed in riots, then defaults.
8b8d305559: The secretary of the Supreme National Security Council is killed with his son in an Israeli strike in eastern Tehran, in the joint war. Basij chief Gholamreza Soleimani is killed the same day.
8bcea5fc7e: The owner of El Mercurio meets the CIA director and Nixon's associates to demand action against Allende, just before the presidential order for Track II.
8be535a559: FRUS archives reveal that in 1964 the CIA pays the Dalai Lama $180,000 a year, in a total budget of about $1.7 million for the Tibetan program.
8bfb4a4b3b: The State Department cancels the Colombian president's visa after his speech on a New York street calling on US soldiers to disobey.
8c0e2778b4: Biden announces the sending of 31 M1 Abrams tanks, funded by the USAI, the same day as the German agreement on Leopard 2s.
8c49f39103: In the campaign against mid-sized Japanese cities, an incendiary raid by B-29s destroys almost all of Toyama and kills thousands of inhabitants.
8c4aa85f8a: School of the Americas torture manuals
Manuals used from 1987 to 1991 recommend blackmail, torture and executions against insurgents. The Pentagon makes them public in 1996.
8c59775d7e: Clinton bans by executive order almost all American trade and investment with Iran.
8c67cb7db8: Abu Zubaydah is transferred to the CIA secret prison in Poland, where he remains until September 2003. The European Court of Human Rights establishes this in 2014 and convicts Poland.
8c8d3c4d16: Iraq removed from the terror list
The Reagan administration removes Iraq from the list of state sponsors of terrorism, opening the way to American credits and exports in the midst of the war against Iran.
8c8f176c6b: CIA drones from the Croatian coast

According to Newsweek, the CIA flies GNAT-750 drones from a base near Zadar, before and during Operation Storm. Croatian officials say they received the images; Washington speaks of “limited” sharing.
8ccbf63434: American troops seize about 160,000 pages of documents from the FRAPH and the army. Washington refuses for years to return them intact to Haiti.
8cd94eaf02: The United States, the EU, the United Kingdom and Canada announce the exclusion of selected Russian banks from the SWIFT system and measures against the Central Bank.
8cf077c0f6: After Roman judges refuse to validate the detention of migrants in Albania, Elon Musk, chosen by Trump to lead DOGE, writes that “these judges have to go”. President Mattarella recalls that Italy “knows how to take care of itself”.
8d69cd38ae: A $400 million drawdown of ammunition for Patriot, NASAMS and HIMARS and Hornet drones.
8dabbb8c71: CIA documents and former officers, revealed in 2013, show that Washington supplies Iraq with satellite images of Iranian positions while knowing it uses sarin.
8dd7fda00d: Lukashenko denounces a color revolution orchestrated from the West after his disputed reelection; he provides no proof.
8de1447706: The FBI launches operations to divide and discredit Puerto Rican independence movements, as the Church Committee will establish in 1976.
8dec64ab46: American special forces train the Atlacatl rapid-reaction battalion. It later commits several of the worst massacres of the war.
8df1e07ef4: NSA documents revealed in 2014 show that the chancellor was among the eavesdropping targets as early as 2002, at the time of his opposition to the Iraq war.
8df9dd2ca5: Cuba relisted as a terrorism sponsor
Nine days before leaving office, the Trump administration puts Cuba back among state sponsors of terrorism, which cuts the island off from much of the banking system.
8e017e2904: Tariq Aziz, 16, killed by a drone
The teenager, who had just attended an anti-drone meeting in Islamabad, is killed along with his 12-year-old cousin in a CIA strike.
8e21f9d869: Held in the United States pending extradition to Liberia, Charles Taylor escapes. He claimed in 2009 to have been helped by Americans; in 2012, the DIA confirms he was an informant for American intelligence.
8e29cc86f7: American A-10s fire depleted uranium shells at a Bosnian Serb depot. NATO confirms it in 2000. The health effects on residents remain debated.
8e53c52d8b: Trump taxes foreign automobiles, hitting first Japan, South Korea and Germany, allies of the United States.
8e5da7554b: De facto head of Fujimori's intelligence, Montesinos receives CIA support for a decade, officially anti-drug, despite accusations of torture and death squads.
8e730dc450: Washington and London sanction Cypriots and companies accused of concealing the assets of Alisher Usmanov and Roman Abramovich. Banks freeze their accounts and Nicosia invites the FBI to investigate.
8e96c3cae6: After the missile strikes on US bases in Iraq, Trump authorizes sanctions on Iran's construction, textile, mining and manufacturing sectors.
8e9d764dc9: Funding of the French War in Indochina
Washington announces military aid to France in Indochina. By 1954, the United States finances nearly 80 percent of the cost of the war against the Việt Minh.
8eb1110298: Washington sends Marines and helicopters from U-Tapao base to Cambodia without the agreement of the Thai government, which officially protests the violation of its sovereignty.
8eccd3baa9: Total threatened with ILSA sanctions over South Pars

Total signs a 2 billion dollar contract with Iran on the South Pars gas field. Washington opens a review under the ILSA law and threatens the group with sanctions, before granting a waiver in May 1998 in the face of EU opposition.
8ee0dc0f06: Clandestine Radio “La Voz de la Liberación”
The CIA broadcasts from abroad a radio station that calls itself rebel and amplifies fear of an invasion. It is a central part of Operation PBSUCCESS, according to CIA archives.
8f0522d500: About 300 American soldiers join the UN force deployed in Macedonia to prevent the war from spreading. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
8f1b1bd7cb: NATO bombs hit a residential neighborhood in Aleksinac and kill about ten civilians, according to Human Rights Watch.
8f2d618b22: Eisenhower approves a “covert action program against the Castro regime”: armed opposition, propaganda and radio. It is the origin of the Bay of Pigs.
8f5ec9a89c: End of the Venezuelan oil license
Washington lets General License 44 expire, which had eased sanctions on oil and gas, judging that Caracas did not comply with the Barbados agreement.
8f6ec82ba0: A week after the hostage-taking, Carter suspends all purchases of Iranian oil.
8f9fab9393: The army overthrows Juan Bosch, the first elected president since Trujillo. Washington suspends its aid; Bosch and several historians accuse American military attachés of having encouraged the putschists.
8fa692af68: Fall of Machado Under American Pressure
Envoy Sumner Welles pushes dictator Gerardo Machado to leave and prepares his replacement by Carlos Manuel de Céspedes.
8fa8953b5e: American commandos attack a prison camp near Hanoi, already emptied. Aircraft bomb as a diversion.
8fb146c36a: Reagan signs directive NSDD-166, which aims to drive the Soviets out of Afghanistan “by all means available”. The budget for covert aid rises sharply.
8fbeee20d2: Attempted assassination of Abdul Reza Shahlai
On the day Soleimani dies, a US strike unsuccessfully targets this Quds Force commander in Yemen, according to the Washington Post.
8ff34d20a6: A $150 million drawdown including artillery shells, counter-battery radars and jamming equipment.
90229cbcb8: State Department diplomat Viron Vaky writes that Washington tolerated and encouraged the Guatemalan army's “counter-terror”, involving murders and torture. The memo has been declassified.
90274b2393: Announced at Ramstein, a final $500 million drawdown includes anti-aircraft missiles and ammunition for F-16s.
903aef5512: Ambassador Reuben Brigety accuses South Africa of having loaded weapons for Russia onto the cargo ship Lady R. A South African inquiry concludes in September that no weapons were exported.
9053e61b18: According to the AP (2014), a USAID contractor, Creative Associates, tries to use the Cuban hip-hop scene, including the group Los Aldeanos, to stir up a movement of young dissidents.
90579cee9b: American submarines place sensors on a Soviet undersea military cable. The operation is revealed through Ronald Pelton's betrayal.
905deaf16f: About 200 U.S. military personnel are sent to Jordan in response to the war in neighboring Syria. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
9071b9b71f: In April 2019, Africa Command admits for the first time that one of its strikes killed two civilians. Amnesty had documented far more.
