In a global settlement of about $800 million, Rolls-Royce pays $170 million to the Justice Department over bribes abroad.
baab75ab4e: Escobar is shot dead by the Search Bloc, guided by intercepts from the American Centra Spike unit and backed by the DEA and American special forces.
bab04a9bff: The Washington Post and ZDF reveal that the CIA and the BND secretly owned the Swiss company and read the encrypted messages of more than 100 client countries.
bacb1b20f0: The Pentagon creates the CJTF-HOA, based in 2003 at Camp Lemonnier. The base becomes the hub of U.S. operations in the Horn of Africa, including drone strikes in Somalia and Yemen.
baeb7a8197: A 68-year-old grandmother is killed by a drone while picking vegetables in front of her grandchildren, according to Amnesty International.
baf64cef8e: CIA an “empire of hacking” according to Beijing
A report by CVERC and Qihoo 360 accuses the CIA of global cyberattacks and of having fomented “color revolutions.”
bb0bb76e8e: Trump orders a “total and complete blockade” of sanctioned tankers entering or leaving Venezuela.
bb2217737a: A 20-year-old woman is raped and killed by Kenneth Shinzato, a former Marine employed as a civilian at Kadena base. He is sentenced to life. The case revives opposition to the bases.
bb23231ac7: Military records show that herbicides, including Agent Orange, were sprayed on the Ho Chi Minh Trail in Laos, notably in 1965 and 1966.
bb2e7e1932: A CIA agent is arrested for trying to bribe a Singaporean intelligence officer. Lee Kuan Yew reveals in 1965 that Washington had given him a written apology.
bb302534bd: Coalition strikes near Manbij kill dozens of civilians fleeing the fighting. The Pentagon acknowledges 24; NGOs count more than 70.
bb3c301990: The NSA had the BND monitor European targets, including EADS, Eurocopter and French officials. The Bundestag investigates.
bb44dc30db: Vance denounces the annulment of the presidential election

At the Munich conference, Vice President JD Vance asserts that Romania annulled its presidential election on the basis of “flimsy suspicions” from its intelligence services and under “enormous pressure” from its neighbours. The Romanian far right welcomes the speech.
bb4edb2cea: Before the House, Assistant Secretary of State John Kelly states that the United States has no defense treaty with the Gulf countries, two days before the invasion of Kuwait.
bb5d02b1c8: The NSA monitors more than 1,200 email accounts linked to mobile operators, including those of the GSMA association, to find flaws in networks worldwide. Revealed by The Intercept in December 2014.
bb63d0bd58: Navy commandos land at night in Barawe to capture a shabab leader nicknamed Ikrima. Coming under fire, they withdraw without him.
bb63e4f112: From the start of the war, Washington bans all trade with North Korea under the Trading with the Enemy Act. The embargo remains in place until a partial easing in 2000.
bb7d4e2c09: NED funds for Yeltsin and the democrats

Before the 1990 Russian legislative elections, the NED funds an initiative of Paul Weyrich's Free Congress Foundation to help Boris Yeltsin and democratic candidates: training and a communications network.
bb8c7fcd86: A coalition strike hits a school sheltering displaced people near Raqqa on the night of March 20-21. The UN commission of inquiry reports up to 150 dead. The US command says it found no evidence of civilian casualties.
bbcc53b36a: Washington delivers rifles and ammunition to Admiral Kolchak's Whites via the Trans-Siberian Railway, which American troops guard.
bbde715b92: Captain Harry Knapp proclaims an American military government after President Henríquez y Carvajal refuses to cede control of finances and the army. The Marines govern until 1924.
bc0b6a33c0: Ottawa cancels the Canadian interceptor and chooses American Bomarc missiles; 14,000 jobs disappear. Many see American pressure, which the archives do not establish.
bc20b80232: Residents who returned to Bikini in the early 1970s, on the authorities' assurance, show high doses of cesium. They are evacuated again in 1978.
bc41c3585b: Policing Between Italians and Serbs at Trogir
American forces land at Trogir, at the request of the Italian authorities, to maintain order between Italians and Serbs. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
bcb53c2fa8: The International Court of Justice rules that Washington violated international law by arming the Contras and mining the ports. The United States rejects the ruling.
bcc462c6e0: Washington sanctions the Turkish defense industries agency (SSB) and its president for buying the Russian S-400 system, under the CAATSA law.
bcc91bd206: The Peruvian army crushes the MIR guerrilla bases with units trained and equipped by the United States. Witnesses and the press reported the use of napalm.
bcd40df5ce: Trump threatens escalating tariffs of up to 25% if Mexico does not curb migration. Mexico City agrees on June 7 to deploy its National Guard and take back returned asylum seekers.
bcd46c2b93: The same day as the Marinera, Southern Command forces board in the Caribbean the tanker Sophia, which left Venezuela loaded with crude, for violating the embargo.
bcd62787da: A CIA “Red Cell” memo proposes playing on compassion for Afghan women in France and on fear of refugees and terrorism in Germany to counter hostility to the war. Published by WikiLeaks in March 2010.
bce490d6c8: Collapse of the Nugan Hand Bank

The Sydney bank, which employs former American servicemen and agents and has William Colby as its lawyer, collapses after the death of Frank Nugan. Journalists, including Jonathan Kwitny, allege links to the CIA; the Stewart Royal Commission finds none.
bcf0cc53e3: The US military drops a 10-ton GBU-43 in combat for the first time, on Islamic State tunnels.
bcf4b1fbdc: A $775 million drawdown with ScanEagle drones, demining vehicles and HARM anti-radar missiles.
bd2820e7ce: The first large-scale trials of the Enovid pill are conducted on poor women poorly informed of the risks. Side effects are dismissed; three deaths are not autopsied.
bd62362d3d: Admiral Alireza Tangsiri, head of the Revolutionary Guards navy, is killed with his deputies at Bandar Abbas in an Israeli strike. The US military confirms the operation.
bd745a4c36: The CIA fires a Hellfire missile from a Predator to kill warlord Hekmatyar, its former protégé of the 1980s. He survives.
bd7f17db95: During the civil war, about 200 Marines enter the capital. Envoy Sumner Welles then negotiates the Pact of Amapala.
bd8120df8a: In summer 2012, the NSA breaks the encryption of the United Nations' internal video conferencing system; within three weeks, decoded communications rise from 12 to 458. Revealed by Der Spiegel in August 2013.
bd893065cb: After Olof Palme compares the bombings of Hanoi to Nazi crimes, the Nixon administration calls it a “gross insult”, withdraws its ambassador and refuses a new Swedish ambassador for more than a year.
bdd3e32232: On the day Bashar al-Assad falls, B-52s, F-15s and A-10s strike more than 75 Islamic State targets in central Syria.
bde6dddd2a: After a Special Group meeting where the question is raised, Edward Lansdale asks the CIA to study the “liquidation of leaders” of Cuba as part of Mongoose. The Church Committee documents this episode.
bdfe9c74ff: An ambiguous letter from Prime Minister H. C. Hansen allows the United States to store atomic bombs at Thule despite Denmark's nuclear-free policy. The affair is revealed in 1995.
be1fbcb209: Raid against Abu Sayyaf at al-Omar
Delta Force kills Abu Sayyaf, in charge of the Islamic State's oil finances, and captures his wife. The raid is announced by the Pentagon.
be532a0d52: A U.S. B-2 strikes the Chinese embassy based on a target chosen by the CIA: three Chinese journalists killed. Washington cites a map error and compensates Beijing.
be59868494: Bill Clinton authorizes the CIA to intervene in the Yugoslav presidential election to prevent Milošević from winning. The agency funds his opponents and organizes their meetings abroad.
be710f7198: Lon Nol overthrows Sihanouk, who accuses the CIA. Washington's direct role remains disputed, but the new regime is immediately recognized and armed.
be75c479b2: After a long chase, US forces seize in the North Atlantic the former Bella 1, renamed Marinera and reflagged to Russia, which was fleeing the blockade.
be7a23ca3e: Washington sends an aircraft carrier, destroyers and tankers to back the coup plotters in case of resistance. The squadron turns back as the coup has succeeded.
be9939dc7e: A $1.1 billion USAI package for 18 additional HIMARS, to be produced by industry, and counter-drone systems.
bea77ad35f: The Intercept reveals that the NSA and GCHQ stole the SIM card encryption keys of the Franco-Dutch manufacturer.
bec0f19163: A $2.6 billion package ($500 million in drawdown and $2.1 billion USAI), centered on air defense and radars.
bee82bbad7: Executive Order 13850 allows sanctions on Venezuela's gold sector, later targeted by measures against the state mining company Minerven.
bf12552218: Green light for the invasion of East Timor
The day before the invasion, Ford and Kissinger give their agreement to Suharto in Jakarta, according to a record declassified in 2001. The occupation kills between 100,000 and 200,000 people.
bf1c7d8031: Richard Helms's handwritten notes, declassified, record Nixon's order to “make the economy scream” in Chile.
bf31cedb83: George H. W. Bush's administration gets “non-lethal” aid of 49.75 million dollars passed for the Contras, who remain mobilized during the 1990 election campaign.
bf3fb8b797: Thanks to the rigged Crypto AG machines, the NSA reads Libyan messages and blames Tripoli for the La Belle discotheque bombing in Berlin, before the April 1986 strikes. Revealed in 2020.
bf437e3631: The Cuban Democracy Act tightens the embargo: it bans trade by foreign subsidiaries of American companies and penalizes ships that have called at Cuba.
bf60026698: Trump signs an executive order sanctioning the Supreme Leader and his office, after the downing of a US drone.
bf7f27c660: In the last days of the war, Israel fires millions of submunitions, some of them American. A State Department report to Congress (January 2007) concludes there were probable violations of the use agreements.
bf88abc125: Walkers discover a buried arms cache. The government acknowledges that it belongs to the clandestine stay-behind network, set up with British and American services within NATO.
bfc2521a64: An AC-130 pounds the Doctors Without Borders hospital for an hour; 42 dead. The Pentagon speaks of an error; no criminal prosecution.
bfcd196f8b: According to the New York Times (2017), Obama ordered in 2014 an intensification of cyberattacks on North Korean missile tests, many of which then fail.
bfcf34cb64: The ENI subsidiary settles for $365 million over bribes in Nigeria in the Bonny Island consortium, also prosecuted along with Technip.
bfd1e51caa: The New York Times reveals in 1986 that American services exchange intelligence with the apartheid regime, including on the ANC.
bfdaf114e6: AIFLD Claims a Role in the Coup
William Doherty, head of AIFLD, a union institute funded by USAID, says that Brazilian unionists trained by him were “intimately involved” in the overthrow of Goulart.
bfe75b202c: The Justice Department creates a unit tasked with seizing yachts, aircraft and assets of Russian oligarchs, including the yacht Amadea.
c0034d7379: Archbishop Óscar Romero asks Jimmy Carter to stop military aid to the junta, which is used for repression. Washington maintains its aid.
c0056e6534: The CIA has the Glomar Explorer built to raise the wreck of the Soviet submarine K-129. Only part of the hull is recovered.
c00ce2c583: On Easter Monday, American aircraft bomb and strafe Grosseto, including a funfair. More than a hundred civilians are killed, many of them children.
c026ba020d: The Alstom executive is arrested at JFK airport in a bribery investigation over Indonesia. He will spend more than two years in detention in the United States.
c031545a33: A U.S. strike described as targeting al-Shabaab kills, according to Galmudug authorities, about twenty of their soldiers and civilians. AFRICOM opens an investigation.
c044a5ebed: After months of annexation threats, Trump signs with Copenhagen and Nuuk an agreement with no end date: expansion of Pituffik, new areas at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig, and a veto on any non-NATO military presence.
c05314d6d9: Graphite bombs on the power grid
NATO uses graphite-fiber bombs to knock out power plants and transformers. Most of Serbia is left without electricity.
c0593caf7f: The Croatian offensive drives out about 200,000 Krajina Serbs, with murders of civilians. Washington, informed, gave a tacit green light according to diplomats and historians.
c05d58efdf: Capture and execution of Che in Bolivia

Che Guevara is captured by Bolivian rangers trained by Green Berets, then executed. CIA agent Félix Rodríguez is present. According to the archives, the execution order comes from the Bolivian command.
c06388857b: CIA Recruits the Mafia Against Castro
Through Robert Maheu, the CIA hires Johnny Roselli, Sam Giancana and Santo Trafficante to kill Castro. The Church Committee reveals it in 1975.
c063c2bf1e: Marines and the 9th Infantry Regiment take part in the assault on the Chinese city of Tianjin alongside the Eight-Nation Alliance. The city is subsequently looted.
c088a080f9: Reagan authorizes a covert action to drive out Noriega. The Senate intelligence committee worries about a risk of assassination and the project is held back, according to the American press.
c0a029f117: CIA documents declassified in 1997 contain an assassination manual and lists of dozens of Guatemalan leaders to be “eliminated.” The CIA says none was killed under this program.
c0b813f66a: Bremer dissolves the army, the security services and the Defense Ministry. Hundreds of thousands of armed men lose their jobs, which many analysts link to the rise of the insurgency.
c0bbe5da8f: Recruited by the CIA in the United States, he is dropped from Germany. Betrayed by a contact who had become a double agent, he is arrested and shot without trial in 1954.
c0d4c96781: CIA drones targeting Ayman al-Zawahiri strike houses in the village of Damadola. He is not there; about 18 civilians are killed.
c105999671: The guerrilla commander, husband of American lawyer Jennifer Harbury, disappears and is killed in detention. Colonel Alpírez, implicated, was a paid CIA informant, according to the Intelligence Oversight Board.
c1326019db: American aircraft mine Japanese ports and straits from late March 1945. Maritime traffic collapses and worsens the population's food shortage.
c1349314c8: Commerce places the chipmaker SMIC and the drone maker DJI, along with dozens of other companies, on the Entity List.
c1460f1d54: DNA of Great Lakes leaders requested
A secret cable asks the embassies in Kinshasa, Kigali, Kampala and Bujumbura for biometric data, including DNA, fingerprints and irises, of leaders of the region. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
c14a9e6352: Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International document the coalition's use of white phosphorus munitions in populated areas of Raqqa. The coalition says it uses them in accordance with the laws of war.
c16a30f1fd: About 270,000 women are sterilized, often without informed consent. Victims' associations and members of the American Congress fault USAID, which funded Peruvian family planning, for having supported the program; the agency denies having funded the abuses.
c16f946665: The PKK leader is captured in Nairobi and handed over to Turkey. U.S. intelligence helps locate him, according to the press and U.S. officials.
c17f5a6dbb: Captured in Rawalpindi on March 1, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed is subjected to 183 waterboarding sessions in a secret CIA prison, according to the Senate report.
c1a7eda52e: The OAS, whose top funder is Washington, reports irregularities that hasten Morales's fall. Morales and his supporters see it as the instrument of a coup backed by Washington. Researchers at MIT, among others, later dispute its statistical conclusions.
c1a9fa29dd: Al Jazeera office in Kabul destroyed
A U.S. strike destroys Al Jazeera's premises. The Pentagon says it targeted an al-Qaeda site.
c1bff96399: 15 million dollars for the Polish black site
According to the Washington Post, two CIA officers deliver 15 million dollars in cash, in cardboard boxes, to Polish intelligence in early 2003 for the use of the Stare Kiejkuty base.
c1df8c6a83: Human Rights Watch and Cristosal collect the accounts of Venezuelans deported by Washington to CECOT: beatings, sexual violence and deprivation over four months.
c20d837506: Guards fire on Chinese prisoners demonstrating in a camp on Jeju Island. More than 50 prisoners are killed according to UN reports.
c21ec65b0a: In his Cairo speech, Obama says that the United States played a role in the overthrow of a democratically elected Iranian government.
c23ee7b0cc: American and allied aircraft strike surface-to-air missile sites in southern Iraq, in the no-fly zone. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
c2612c18c9: Reagan sends military advisers, officially limited to 55, to train and oversee the Salvadoran army. Some are seen in combat zones.
c27dc3ab8f: Public Employees Stripped of Right to Strike

On the basis of a letter from MacArthur, the Ashida government issues Ordinance 201, which deprives civil servants of the right to strike and to bargain collectively. The measure marks the “reverse course” of the occupation.
c289e4b56a: The first stage of a Pershing II nuclear missile catches fire during assembly at Camp Redleg, on the Waldheide. Three American soldiers are killed and several injured. The accident revives protest against the Euromissiles.
c29152bc56: According to the head of Tanbreez Mining, quoted by Reuters in January 2025, American officials dissuaded him from selling the rare earths deposit to buyers linked to Beijing. He sells it to the American company Critical Metals.
c294dc5869: In the midst of the Covid-19 pandemic, Washington sanctions 18 Iranian banks, further isolating the financial sector. NGOs warn about access to medicines.
c2a2e13060: A $150 million drawdown of ammunition and anti-tank weapons.
c2a8aae8e3: Reagan's special envoy Donald Rumsfeld meets Saddam Hussein while Iraq is already using chemical weapons against Iran. Diplomatic relations resume in 1984.
c2c6e03cb5: A U.S. Navy P2V Neptune is shot down by Soviet MiGs over the Sea of Japan. One crew member dies, the others are rescued.
c2d16641e6: The CIA arms and leads thousands of Hmong fighters under General Vang Pao. This clandestine army wages war against the Pathet Lao until 1973.
c2ecbe263b: A December 30, 2008 cable shows that the State Department brought to New York an activist of the April 6 movement, who confides a plan to oust Mubarak, while protecting his identity. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2011.
c33f97fc64: After the gassing of the Kurdish city, which kills about 5,000, the State Department suggests that Iran bears part of the responsibility, which the evidence refutes.
c3521504f3: Encounter Magazine Funded by the CIA
Stephen Spender and Irving Kristol launch Encounter for the Congress for Cultural Freedom. Former CIA official Tom Braden confirms the secret funding in 1967.
c36a711648: Organized under the military government and a UN commission desired by Washington, the elections are held only in the South. The left and some nationalists boycott them. Hundreds of people die in the violence.
c36e244014: An NSA map shows that, by mid-2012, more than 50,000 computer networks are infected with its software, in Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, India, China and Russia. Revealed by NRC Handelsblad in November 2013.
c38c04043d: The plane expelling President Zelaya stops over at Soto Cano base, where U.S. troops are stationed. Washington denies having been informed.
c3b5c3aab6: Admiral Caperton has the Haitian Congress, guarded by Marines, elect Philippe Sudre Dartiguenave, a candidate willing to accept a treaty with Washington, over Rosalvo Bobo.
c3bd6c6e5b: Customs blocks all imports of cotton and tomatoes from Xinjiang, citing forced labor.
c3c160138e: ITT proposes to the White House an eighteen-point plan to keep Allende from lasting six months. A Senate subcommittee publishes it in 1973.
c3ca9dfcb3: American helicopters fire missiles at a meeting of clan elders. The ICRC counts 54 dead; the UN says 20. The attack turns the population against the Americans.
c3fb566a9c: US aircraft drop 2,000-pound bunker-buster bombs on a large ammunition depot near Mount Soffeh in Isfahan. Trump releases images of the explosions.
c3fdb1e248: Abducted in Milan by the CIA, imam Abu Omar is taken to Aviano and then to Ramstein base, from where an aircraft takes him to Egypt. The Zweibrücken prosecutor's office opens an investigation into this transit.
c42248b009: Kuomintang services execute hundreds of Communist prisoners before the fall of Chongqing. Beijing attributes it to the Sino-American “SACO complex,” an American role that is not established.
c440884466: The Treasury grants the US company Delta Crescent Energy a license to exploit oil in Kurdish areas. Mike Pompeo confirms it to the Senate. Damascus denounces a theft of its resources.
c4438bb23f: Diplomatic cables published by WikiLeaks in 2010 report on CDU-FDP coalition negotiations thanks to an informant. Helmut Metzner, chief of staff to Guido Westerwelle, admits having briefed the embassy and is dismissed.
c45e4429b4: Moscow justifies the destruction of the Korean Boeing (269 dead) by accusing it of espionage coordinated with an American RC-135. No proof has supported this claim.
c461531cd9: After two American officers are killed with an axe, a massive force backed by B-52 bombers fells the tree in the Joint Security Area, at the risk of a resumption of war.
c466c20445: Honduran police and American marshals capture trafficker Juan Ramón Matta Ballesteros and send him to the United States. Rioters set fire to an embassy annex.
c473a30106: Alfreds Riekstiņš and two other men are dropped in Latvia for American intelligence. Soviet security, informed of the operation, is waiting for them.
c477292a18: Second Major Incendiary Raid on Tokyo
On the night of May 25–26, 1945, more than 450 B-29s set fire to new districts of Tokyo. Thousands of civilians die and part of the imperial palace burns.
c47c3dcc98: The CIA funds the experiments of psychiatrist Ewen Cameron at the Allan Memorial Institute: massive electroshocks, drugs, repeated messages. Ottawa later compensates victims.
c490c94290: The Treasury sanctions the Internet Research Agency, the GRU and 19 individuals for interference in the 2016 election and the NotPetya cyberattack, under the CAATSA law.
c4c0e5692b: USAID's Office of Public Safety trains and equips thousands of Latin American police officers. Congress closes it in 1974 after accusations of teaching torture.
c4e0fcc088: Negotiations broken off over an ad
Trump ends trade talks with Canada because of an Ontario ad quoting Ronald Reagan against tariffs, then announces an additional 10%.
c50d7b737a: CIA warned of a plot against Chávez

CIA memos from early April 2002, since declassified, describe dissident officers preparing a coup against Chávez “as early as this month.” Caracas says it received no warning; Washington says it warned against any coup.
c529924359: CNN reveals that the CIA is stepping up surveillance drone flights over Mexican territory to track cartels.
c54867c873: CIA chemist Sidney Gottlieb brings station chief Larry Devlin a poison intended for the prime minister, on an instruction attributed to Eisenhower. The Church Committee establishes it in 1975.
c567f8e5c9: After the storming of a prison and the bloody repression of the crowd, the Karimov regime denounces a foreign-backed plot, then expels the K2 base and U.S. NGOs such as Freedom House. No evidence has been produced.
c56a16e4bb: Two federal grand juries, in Miami and Tampa, indict Noriega for drug trafficking. The indictment is later used to justify the invasion.
c57a26756e: Twenty-five Marines escort the U.S. consul general who has come to negotiate a treaty with Emperor Menelik II. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
c5843926ba: Veto on condemnation of the invasion
The United States vetoes a Security Council resolution deploring the invasion. The General Assembly condemns it on 2 November by a large majority.
c58eca7aa5: April Glaspie's meeting with Saddam Hussein

A week before the invasion of Kuwait, the ambassador tells Saddam Hussein that Washington has “no opinion” on inter-Arab conflicts such as his border dispute. The transcript comes from Iraq; whether it amounts to a green light remains debated.
c5957b18d8: A $988 million USAI package for HIMARS ammunition, drones and equipment maintenance.
c59f2f7c97: The NED awards a $53,400 grant to Súmate, María Corina Machado's association, which organizes the signature drive to recall Chávez. Its leaders are prosecuted over this funding.
c5a7b11281: The Iranian nuclear scientist disappears in Saudi Arabia and goes over to the CIA, which reportedly paid him $5 million according to the press. Back in 2010, he is executed in Iran in 2016.
c5bad3e0f7: The National Endowment for Democracy, funded by Congress, channels funds to Solidarity, notably via the AFL-CIO union, until the 1989 elections.
c5c8da75ce: Taiwanese U-2 shot down at Jiaxing
A U-2 of the “Black Cats” is shot down over Zhejiang by a Chinese missile. Pilot Huang Jung-pei dies.
c5d00ae20a: The United States and Israel launch nearly 900 strikes in twelve hours against Iranian missiles, defenses and leaders. It is the start of the 2026 Iran war.
c5e10f20f5: Letter announcing 30% duties on the EU
In a letter to Ursula von der Leyen, Donald Trump announces 30% duties on European products from 1 August, and more in case of retaliation. The threat leads to the Turnberry agreement.
c5ed8b56a6: Washington bans arms sales to the Republic of Cyprus, officially to promote reunification. The embargo is partially lifted in 2020, under conditions, including refusing port calls to Russian military ships.
c601901c38: CIA informed of executions under Geisel
A memo from CIA director William Colby to Kissinger reports that President Geisel authorizes the continuation of summary executions of opponents. Washington maintains its support. Revealed in 2018.
c69289c5ca: Depleted uranium shells for the Abrams
During Blinken's visit to Kyiv, the Pentagon announces a $175 million package including, for the first time, depleted uranium shells.
c6adcca529: Miami journalists paid by Radio Martí
The Miami Herald reveals that ten Florida journalists were paid by the Radio and TV Martí office. Several are fired by their newspapers.
c6af2df933: The Cuban government accuses Washington of having orchestrated the protests via social media; no evidence is provided.
c6bf089552: Second tranche: Washington sanctions Iranian oil exports and transactions with Iran's Central Bank.
c6d55f5346: The NSA's MYSTIC program collects the metadata of mobile calls in Mexico. Revealed by The Intercept in May 2014.
c6ece34ec1: The Treasury sanctions seven oligarchs, including Oleg Deripaska and Viktor Vekselberg, and twelve companies. Rusal's shares collapse and aluminum prices jump.
c72ebc566d: Cobra helicopters, F-16s and armored vehicles supplied by Washington are used in the destruction of Kurdish villages. Human Rights Watch documents these violations in 1995.
c73b16fd4b: The Tewa test, of 5 megatons and mostly fission, is one of the dirtiest of the series and contaminates Bikini Atoll again.
c75b4f6e07: The trade embargo imposed on the North is extended to all of Vietnam and to Cambodia. Washington also blocks international aid. It is lifted in 1994.
c7776b7972: A $425 million package ($125 million in drawdown and $300 million USAI), centered on ammunition and counter-drone systems.
c78ae9d5c6: After the sarin attack at Khan Shaykhun, the Treasury sanctions 271 employees of the Syrian Scientific Studies and Research Center.
c7a238bd31: Federal agents and Marines remove the protesters who were occupying the firing range and arrest more than 200. Training bombing resumes.
c7f3ca5a8c: Denmark's largest bank pleads guilty before American justice to bank fraud linked to the money laundering at its Estonian branch and agrees to a forfeiture of 2.059 billion dollars.
c7f927a432: Turkish F-16s kill 34 Kurdish villagers, most of them young smugglers. According to the Wall Street Journal, a U.S. Predator drone had spotted the group and passed the information to the Turkish army.
c82266ae70: The Treasury sanctions Antal Rogán, a minister under Viktor Orbán, for corruption. The Trump administration lifts the measure in April 2025.
c8360df3f8: The presidential election is organized and supervised by an American mission led by General Frank McCoy, with Marines at the polling stations.
c85101d99e: American F-14s intercept the Egyptian airliner carrying the Achille Lauro hijackers and force it to land in Sicily. Carabinieri and American commandos face each other on the base.
c88a16e270: The Treasury sanctions five Bulgarian figures, including former minister Rumen Ovcharov, former Finance Minister Vladislav Goranov and Russophile Nikolay Malinov, for corruption, notably in energy contracts with Russia.
c890a34fb7: Operation Menu: secret bombing of Cambodia
B-52s secretly bomb Vietnamese sanctuaries in Cambodia until May 1970. Flight reports are falsified to hide the operation from Congress.
c8e8c02a93: According to CNN, the CIA is stepping up lethal covert operations against cartels on Mexican soil, including car bombs. The agency publicly denies it.
c8ec66a41c: The governor-general dismisses Prime Minister Whitlam, who was threatening to reveal CIA links at Pine Gap. An American involvement is alleged by several authors, but not demonstrated.
c90929fe62: An American raid targeting the railway lines hits the districts around Saint-Charles station: more than 1,700 dead.
c923134b47: Washington Pushes Rhee to Step Down
During the April Revolution, Ambassador McConaughy presses Syngman Rhee to yield. Rhee resigns on April 26. A CIA-chartered aircraft takes him to Hawaii on May 29.
c92578ee9d: A commando of the National Front for the Salvation of Libya attacks Gaddafi's barracks in Tripoli and fails. The NFSL received CIA aid in the 1980s, but an American role in this attack is not established.
c92a63dba1: Unable to reach Lumumba, guarded by UN peacekeepers and the army, Larry Devlin destroys the poison brought by Sidney Gottlieb by throwing it into the Congo River, according to the Church Committee.
c95988367c: On May 29, 1945, about 450 B-29s escorted by fighters drop incendiary bombs on Yokohama in broad daylight. The raid destroys much of the city and kills thousands of civilians.
c96c99e32e: Founded in Berlin and based in Paris, it funds anti-Communist magazines and conferences, including Preuves. Its secret CIA funding is revealed in 1966–1967 and then acknowledged.
c985da260d: The largest drawdown to that date: $1 billion in ammunition for HIMARS and NASAMS, shells and Javelin missiles.
c99d54140f: Al-Hawza newspaper shut down by Bremer
Paul Bremer has the newspaper of Muqtada al-Sadr's movement closed, accused of incitement. The measure triggers demonstrations and then the Shiite uprising of April 2004.
c9c1c6bfb3: American soldiers commit rapes in occupied Germany. Estimates differ widely: about 11,000 according to criminologist J. Robert Lilly, up to 190,000 according to historian Miriam Gebhardt, whose method is disputed.
c9d223be51: First Napalm in Europe at Royan
To reduce the German pocket at Royan, American aircraft drop napalm, for the first time in Europe, on a town already devastated by the RAF.
c9d49fb251: After Incheon, American forces cross the 38th parallel and take Pyongyang on October 19, aiming at reunification by force. The advance toward the Yalu brings China into the war.
c9da6a39b0: Biden authorizes sending anti-personnel mines to Ukraine, a signatory of the Ottawa Treaty that bans them.
c9ea5fc49a: The Nation reveals that the CIA uses an underground prison beneath Somali intelligence headquarters, where detainees are interrogated without lawyers.
c9ef1a44a1: Washington sends destroyers, amphibious ships, a submarine and thousands of troops to the southern Caribbean, then F-35s to Puerto Rico, officially against cartels.
ca04dcd47c: State-linked hotels, rum and cigars banned
Trump bars Americans from staying in hotels linked to the Cuban state and from importing Cuban rum and cigars.
ca0e13f846: Two weeks before the presidential election, the State Department publishes a report accusing Perón of collusion with the Nazis. Perón is elected on February 24.
ca267ccc7a: London makes the Chagos Islands available to the United States for a military base, in exchange for a discount on Polaris missiles. Washington demands that the islands be emptied of their inhabitants.
ca6a74718f: Mandela is arrested at a roadblock. Former CIA agent Donald Rickard claimed in 2016 to have tipped off the South African police. The CIA has never confirmed it.
ca705a7be9: Sale of 80 F-14 aircraft to Iran
Iran is the only foreign country to buy the Grumman F-14 Tomcat fighter, delivered with its Phoenix missiles.
ca7e0c1844: Washington chooses London in the Falklands
After the failure of the Haig mediation, the United States backs the United Kingdom, suspends arms sales to Argentina and provides fuel, bases and intelligence.
ca854e2f54: Kennedy obtains from Harold Macmillan that he delay independence and change the voting system to keep Jagan out. The record of the meeting is declassified.
caa085d5f3: A drone kills the American preacher Anwar al-Awlaki, without trial, on the basis of a secret legal memo. Another American, Samir Khan, dies with him.
caa2016511: Captain Amadou Sanogo, who overthrows Amadou Toumani Touré, had attended several military training courses in the United States. The Pentagon acknowledges it while condemning the coup.
caa81e017b: Alongside Olaf Scholz, Joe Biden declares that if Russia invades Ukraine “there will be no longer a Nord Stream 2” and that “we will bring an end to it”. The phrase is often quoted after the sabotage of the pipeline.
caa97000a0: Der Spiegel reveals, based on the Snowden documents, that the NSA collects about 500 million communications metadata records in Germany every month.
cacd630e80: Shah Flees to Baghdad, Then Rome
After the failure of the first coup, the Shah flees. CIA headquarters orders the operation abandoned, but Kermit Roosevelt continues with Zahedi.
cace0312fc: Trump announces a new strike on a vessel that left Venezuela: three dead, described as drug traffickers without public evidence.
cad203e537: American sailors land to protect the consulate during an insurrection. The episode appears in the official list of armed interventions compiled by Congress.
cada1a51d6: Intelligence to sink the Tigers' ships
According to diplomatic cables and Sri Lankan officials, the United States provided intelligence that made it possible to sink the Tamil Tigers' arms ships.
caf751b0cb: A May 2012 NSA presentation lists the private network of the French Foreign Ministry among the networks penetrated by “man-in-the-middle” attacks. Revealed by TV Globo in September 2013.
cafb8ae72f: Defense Secretary James Mattis pushes Copenhagen to reject the bid by China's CCCC for three Greenlandic airports. Denmark finances the project itself and CCCC withdraws in 2019.
cb1035659f: In response to the DSA and the DMA, the US Trade Representative threatens fees and restrictions on European groups that it names: SAP, Siemens, DHL, Spotify, Mistral AI, Capgemini, Publicis, Amadeus.
cb13895a5d: Two aircraft carriers in the Taiwan Strait
During the Chinese missile firings around Taiwan, Washington sends the Independence and Nimitz carrier groups, the largest deployment in the region since Vietnam.
cb1fd8d84e: The CIA creates an “executive action” capability, that is, assassination, entrusted to William Harvey. Put in charge of the Mafia plot against Castro in late 1961, he takes it over in April 1962 by meeting Roselli. The Church Committee establishes it.
cb4489ee48: Strike on Abu Nabil al-Anbari in Derna
A strike by U.S. F-15s kills in Derna the Iraqi Abu Nabil al-Anbari, leader of the Islamic State in Libya, according to the Pentagon.
cb484f7a0b: Activists had been trained by NGOs funded by Washington, according to the New York Times; the regime sees a foreign hand and prosecutes American NGOs.
cb5a6f8c54: MINUSTAH seen as a bulwark against Aristide
According to a 2008 cable published by WikiLeaks, Ambassador Janet Sanderson deems the UN mission essential to U.S. interests, notably to prevent Aristide's return.
cb64109441: Execution of Filipino Guides by Waller
Marine Major Littleton Waller has eleven Filipino porters shot after a disastrous march across Samar. Tried by court-martial, he is acquitted.
cb738ef2cf: J. D. Vance's visit to Pituffik
The vice president accuses Denmark of neglecting Greenland during a visit requested by neither Nuuk nor Copenhagen.
cb7b669fac: Marines from the USS Arizona land to guard the American consulate during the Greek occupation. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
cb84d103af: The Treasury blocks Gazprombank, through which part of the payments for Russian gas passed, and some fifty other Russian banks.
cba651fa14: Stinger and covert aid to UNITA
After the repeal of the Clark Amendment in 1985, Reagan resumes covert aid to Jonas Savimbi's guerrillas, including Stinger missiles. It continues until 1991.
cbe2478bf9: Marines sent to Tripoli and Sanaa
After the Benghazi attack and anti-American protests, Marine teams reinforce the embassies in Libya and Yemen. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
cbed7ad481: After the ban on nuclear ships in New Zealand ports, Washington suspends its defense obligations toward New Zealand and cuts part of the intelligence sharing.
cbef0b257f: The code of the Hive tool shows that the CIA forged fake certificates in the name of Kaspersky Lab so that its data exfiltrations would be blamed on others. Eugene Kaspersky confirms they are fake. Revealed by WikiLeaks (Vault 8) in 2017.
cc27366d9f: Washington creates the Programs Evaluation Office, a military mission disguised as a civilian agency, to get around the ban on foreign advisers provided for at Geneva.
cc33350a10: Australian intelligence monitors exchanges between Indonesia and the U.S. law firm Mayer Brown, its lawyer in disputes with Washington (shrimp, clove cigarettes), and offers them to the NSA. Revealed by the New York Times in February 2014.
cc38628404: Aircraft of Civil Air Transport, a CIA company, bring arms and food to Kuomintang troops in Burma. According to several historians, they leave with opium destined for Bangkok traffickers.
cc4c608474: Bounty on Maduro raised to $50 million
Attorney General Pam Bondi doubles the reward for Maduro's capture, the highest ever offered by Washington.
cc729dc622: 25% on Canadian goods on the pretext of fentanyl, while Trump calls on Canada to become the “51st state.”
cc76acf248: On the eve of the general strike of February 1, 1947, prepared by the public-sector unions, MacArthur bans it by order of the Allied command. Union leaders have to call it off on the radio.
cc7b8f5ec1: Morales resigns under pressure from the army and speaks of a coup backed by Washington, which welcomes his departure; an active role has not been shown.
cc81bf0fef: The CIA makes Long Tieng the headquarters of Vang Pao's army. The base, absent from maps, becomes one of the busiest in Asia.
ccb51d4efb: The U.S. Army stations the 15th Infantry Regiment in Tianjin under the Boxer Protocol. It remains there until 1938.
ccba23aa16: Qurans and propaganda in Soviet Central Asia
The CIA funds the distribution of Qurans in Uzbek and propaganda in Soviet Central Asia, relayed by Pakistani services from Afghanistan. The episode is described by Steve Coll.
cccefa48ac: Mujahideen shoot down Soviet helicopters for the first time with CIA-supplied Stinger missiles. About 2,000 missiles will be delivered.
ccec57a4bd: Libya listed as a state sponsor of terrorism
Libya appears on the first American list of state sponsors of terrorism, which restricts aid, arms exports and sensitive goods. It is removed from it in 2006.
ccede71264: A $200 million drawdown of ammunition for air defense and artillery.
cd03cd2ccb: Envoy Henry Stimson imposes peace on the Liberals: disarmament, Díaz remaining in office, elections under American supervision. Sandino refuses.
cd18241082: A U-2 flown by Bob Ericson overflies the Semipalatinsk nuclear test site, Sary-Shagan and Tyuratam. Detected, it escapes the fighters. This flight precedes Powers's.
cd2ef4579e: George W. Bush suspends ATPDEA tariff preferences for Bolivia, blaming Morales for a lack of counternarcotics cooperation, shortly after the expulsion of Ambassador Goldberg.
cd379f1cb7: A Trump executive order bars Americans from any transaction in the Petro, the digital currency launched by Caracas to get around sanctions.
cd39efd59d: Arms delivered to Pakistan despite the embargo

In the midst of the crackdown in East Pakistan, freighters loaded with American military equipment leave for Karachi. The New York Times reveals it on 22 June 1971 and the State Department admits to earlier licenses.
cd6795252c: Seizure of the Bank of Haiti's Gold
Marines carry about $500,000 in gold from the National Bank of Haiti to New York, on behalf of the National City Bank.
cd7697607d: The Treasury sanctions Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif, chief negotiator of the nuclear deal.
cd89a96733: Columnist Jack Anderson reveals Operation Gamma Guppy: from the Moscow embassy, American services intercept the radiotelephones in Soviet leaders' cars.
cd99a54b94: Newsweek reveals in summer 1981 a CIA plan to destabilize and overthrow Gaddafi, combining disinformation and paramilitary action. Members of the House Intelligence Committee protest to Reagan.
cd9f434810: Sanctions against the IIB bank in Budapest

The Treasury sanctions the International Investment Bank, controlled by Moscow and based in Budapest, and executives including a Hungarian. The next day, Hungary announces its withdrawal; the bank leaves Budapest.
cda2a3c4b0: American businessman Sam Zemurray finances Manuel Bonilla's invasion. The Navy then imposes talks that pave the way for his presidency.
cda8088f77: Arrested in Pakistan, this Australian citizen is flown to Egypt, where he says he was tortured, then sent to Guantánamo. He is released without charge in 2005 and compensated by Australia.
cddfe2e01d: Trump proclaims on his social network that the airspace of Venezuela and its surroundings should be considered “closed in its entirety,” after warnings from US civil aviation.
ce02eceeda: Qasim is overthrown and executed. The Baathists hunt down Communists, and testimonies attribute to the CIA the supply of lists. This role remains contested.
ce1cac0beb: The State Department publicly contradicts the prime minister on the Bomarcs' nuclear weapons. The Diefenbaker government falls six days later and loses the election.
ce34f96fee: NATO bombing of the refinery and petrochemical plant releases toxic substances into the air and the Danube, according to the United Nations Environment Programme.
ce60450792: Listening station at the Jakarta embassy
An NSA map published by Der Spiegel in 2013 lists the U.S. embassy in Jakarta among the Special Collection Service sites that intercept local communications.
ce6181fe46: The American Committee on United Europe, led by former intelligence officials, pays funds partly coming from the CIA to the European Movement until 1960, according to Richard Aldrich's research.
ce70f3536c: The NSA opens an eavesdropping center in Addis Ababa with the Ethiopian regime; in 2005, 103 Ethiopians there listen to Somalia, Sudan and Yemen. Revealed by The Intercept in September 2017.
ce76fd7e7b: Jean-Paul David's anti-Communist movement distributes posters and broadcasts. Historians establish that it receives, besides French public funds, American funding.
ce94e76554: The CIA funds exile Manuel Artime's bases in Central America to launch raids against Cuba, while keeping plausible deniability. The program is documented by declassified archives.
ce9b9d31f4: The draft agreement imposed on Belgrade provides for NATO's free movement across all Yugoslav territory. Its critics see it as a text designed to be rejected.
cea714f233: IRI trains the opposition to Aristide

The International Republican Institute, funded by the U.S. government, organizes training for the Haitian opposition, sometimes in the Dominican Republic. The New York Times (2006) documents this role.
ceac186178: The State Department publishes a report accusing Cuba and the Soviet bloc of arming the FMLN. The Wall Street Journal shows in June that several of its conclusions rest on misinterpreted documents.
ceb21e88ec: Palomares: the promised clean-up never carried out
After decades of Spanish requests, Washington signs a declaration of intent to remove to Nevada the soil contaminated with plutonium in 1966. No final agreement follows and the site remains polluted.
cecaa8c8cc: The Batista brothers' holding company agrees to about $256 million in penalties for corruption in Brazil, under the FCPA.
ceee04709f: Petrobras pays $853 million to DOJ and SEC
The state-owned company settles US prosecutions linked to Lava Jato. The agreement provides that 80% of the sum goes to Brazil.
cf1042e2b7: Seventh seizure: US forces take the Sagitta, a Russian “shadow fleet” tanker owned by a sanctioned Hong Kong company.
cf1bbadb8f: A US-led coalition launches six weeks of massive bombing of Iraq and occupied Kuwait, also targeting bridges, power plants and communications networks.
cf398bcec6: F-16s strike weapons depots linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards in eastern Syria, after attacks on US troops since October 17.
cf3bf5c23b: Thousands of Allied aircraft attack rail junctions and small towns previously spared across Germany, over two days.
cf4028f204: According to The Guardian, the NSA targets 38 embassies and missions, including those of France, Italy, Greece, Japan, Mexico, South Korea and India.
cf49f37f5c: Under pressure from Washington, NATO bans the delivery of large-diameter pipes to the USSR. West Germany has to cancel the contracts of Mannesmann and other steelworks.
cf4bb4a39b: General Leonard Wood's troops attack Moros sheltering in a crater. Between 600 and 1,000 people are killed, including women and children; there are only a few survivors.
cf5003494d: Operation Odyssey Lightning: hundreds of U.S. strikes support the Misrata militias against the Islamic State in Sirte.
cf5d95596c: Fifteen dead in an Isfahan factory
According to Iranian media, an Israeli-American strike on a factory in Isfahan kills 15 people.
cf83c649c9: Emmanuel Constant protected in the United States
The FRAPH leader, arrested in the United States, is not deported to Haiti, where he is wanted for massacres. He is released and lives in New York, before being convicted in 2008 for fraud.
cf85b56ab5: At the G7, the United States bans imports of Russian gold and sanctions Rostec and dozens of defense companies.
cfaedc905b: Putin accuses Hillary Clinton of having given “the signal” for the protests against electoral fraud; no evidence is put forward.
cfd1143157: Pollution left at Clark and Subic

The bases returned in 1991-1992 remain contaminated with hydrocarbons, asbestos and PCBs. Washington considers it has no cleanup obligation; families resettled at Clark after Pinatubo link their illnesses to polluted water.
cfe57821cd: With GCHQ, the NSA copies outside the United States the data flows between Google and Yahoo data centers: millions of records a day. Revealed by the Washington Post in October 2013.
cfea175eff: The CIA prepares a first plan of arms and support for Carlos Castillo Armas with Somoza and United Fruit. The project is canceled after a leak. CIA archives have declassified it.
cff5b6c7e1: A Honduran military unit trained by the CIA and the US Army kidnaps, tortures and kills opponents. A CIA inspector general report acknowledges the ties in 1997.
cffb4f8b61: Trump pardons the former Honduran president, sentenced to 45 years for cocaine trafficking, after announcing it during the presidential campaign in which he backed Nasry Asfura.
d00dfa91ad: Washington creates the MAAG, a group of military advisers, and arms Chiang Kai-shek's regime, which governs under martial law and carries out the White Terror.
d02482009e: Washington launches a propaganda television station aimed at Cuba from a tethered balloon in Florida. Cuba jams it from the first day.
d033b839b1: U.S. F-15s strike an Islamic State camp; among the dozens of dead are two Serbian hostages, employees of the Serbian embassy.
d034ea02ea: Iranian cargo ship Touska seized by gunfire
The destroyer USS Spruance fires into the engine room of the container ship Touska to immobilize it; Marines board it and take control.
d04120e543: A small force lands at Puerto Cortés to prevent the Honduran government from seizing an American-owned railway, before being withdrawn.
d07c42433e: Guatemala asks the UN to act against the invasion. Under pressure from Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge, the Security Council refuses to put its complaint on the agenda and refers it to the OAS.
d08358cd36: The US Army funds a social science study on counterinsurgency in Latin America. The scandal breaks in Chile and the project is cancelled.
d08bef69fd: American troops occupy Chiriquí Province to “maintain order” there and remain until 1920.
d0adfc3dc8: According to Edward Snowden's documents, the NSA and GCHQ targeted in 2009 an email address of Prime Minister Ehud Olmert and Defense Minister Ehud Barak.
d0cd17ca36: The Commodity Credit Corporation program guarantees credits to Iraq to buy American agricultural products. They reach about a billion dollars a year by the end of the decade and free up foreign currency for the war effort.
d10055e460: U.S. strikes in support of Afghan and American forces kill 33 civilians according to the Pentagon, which acknowledges the facts but judges them consistent with the law.
d116fa5865: In the Airbus dispute, Washington hits Italian products with 25% duties, including Parmesan, Grana Padano, pecorino and provolone, as well as liqueurs. Italy is not a member of the consortium.
d119c3ea12: Strikes on boats extend to the Pacific, off Colombia and Ecuador. Gustavo Petro calls them murders.
d11daa7942: After the killing of four Blackwater employees, Marines besiege Fallujah. Several hundred residents die, many of them civilians, before a ceasefire in late April.
d11ffd6c9c: During the Yom Kippur War, the US Air Force delivers more than 22,000 tonnes of arms and ammunition to Israel in one month. The Arab countries respond with the oil embargo.
d1234b7898: Raids From the Islands With Western Enterprises
Under cover of the company Western Enterprises, the CIA arms and trains Nationalist guerrillas who launch raids on the Chinese coast from the islands held by Taiwan.
d125406672: The Pentagon claims that up to 250,000 Iraqi soldiers threaten Saudi Arabia. Soviet commercial satellite images, analyzed by the St. Petersburg Times, show no such concentration.
d135a862f8: According to the Australian and British press, Biden, Boris Johnson and Scott Morrison discuss the project on the sidelines of the G7, without informing Paris.
d14414085e: Magsaysay's Election Organized by the CIA
The CIA funds and covertly directs Ramón Magsaysay's presidential campaign, and he is elected by a wide margin. Agents' memoirs and historians have documented it.
d1454e7005: From July 26 to 29, the 7th Cavalry fires on refugees under a railway bridge. Survivors estimate the dead at about 400. The Army acknowledges the facts in 2001 and Clinton expresses regret.
d16e93e9c0: Madni handed over to Egypt from Jakarta
Arrested in Jakarta, Muhammad Saad Iqbal Madni is put on a Gulfstream used by the CIA to Cairo, where he says he was tortured. He is then transferred to Guantánamo, and released in 2008.
d18e247bfa: Sale of AWACS aircraft to the Shah
Despite opposition from part of Congress, Carter gets the sale of 7 AWACS radar aircraft to Iran approved. The revolution prevents delivery.
d195daf0cd: On Good Friday, the 15th Air Force bombs Treviso. More than a thousand inhabitants are killed and the historic center is largely destroyed.
d1b32cdc0d: Emergency Aid to the Zahedi Government
Eisenhower grants $45 million in emergency aid to the new government. According to Mark Gasiorowski, the CIA had already handed Zahedi about $5 million after the coup.
d1c87b6ec6: Commerce places 28 Chinese entities, including Hikvision and the Xinjiang police, on the Entity List over the repression of the Uyghurs.
d1cd86fa68: The American subsidiary of Allianz Global Investors pleads guilty to fraud over the Structured Alpha funds, which collapsed in 2020. The German insurer agrees to pay about 6 billion dollars to the authorities and investors.
d1d82c8c4c: B-24s of the US air force bomb the port and centre of Naples in broad daylight. The raid kills hundreds of civilians. It opens a series of Allied bombings that hit the city until 1943.
d1e0d4707b: After the US withdrawal from the nuclear deal and the threat of secondary sanctions, Total abandons the Iranian gas field, taken over by a Chinese group.
d1e120d78a: An Anglo-American working group drafts a plan to overthrow the Syrian government, with staged border incidents and the elimination of leaders. The document is found in 2003 in the archives of British minister Duncan Sandys.
d1e987aa42: Total pays $398 million under the FCPA
The French oil group settles U.S. charges over bribes paid in Iran.
d2227e8da8: Executive order against the International Criminal Court
Trump authorizes sanctions on the ICC after the arrest warrants targeting Benjamin Netanyahu. Prosecutor Karim Khan, then judges, are sanctioned.
d26f04cbe3: Rape of a schoolgirl in Okinawa
A Marine is arrested for the rape of a 14-year-old schoolgirl. The complaint is withdrawn and Japanese prosecutors drop the case. A U.S. court-martial sentences him to four years in prison.
d26fac16f0: Drafted in a few weeks, the National Intelligence Estimate asserts that Iraq holds chemical and biological weapons and is restarting its nuclear program. The Senate finds in 2004 that its conclusions were overstated or unfounded.
d2815fb067: Law 53, passed under a governor appointed by Washington, punishes singing a patriotic song or displaying the Puerto Rican flag for pro-independence purposes. It is repealed in 1957.
d284a526ae: Sberbank, Rostec and Arctic oil targeted
A new wave coordinated with the EU: Sberbank and Rostec see their financing restricted. Directive 4 bans the supply of technology for deepwater, Arctic and shale oil drilling.
d294561a2c: Trump sanctions Iran's iron, steel, aluminum and copper sectors, the country's second-largest source of export revenue.
d29b225811: The U.S. Army begins decrypting Soviet intelligence service cables. The program lasts until 1980 and the NSA makes it public in 1995.
d2a141c590: An internal CIA report, partially declassified in 1998, acknowledges that the agency had ties with Honduran officers involved in human rights violations.
d2a522a221: Radios and equipment for the Indonesian army
Washington supplies the Indonesian army with communications equipment during the campaign to exterminate the PKI. Cables declassified in 2017 show that the embassy follows the killings in detail.
d2e70d39b1: The Ba'ath Party overthrows President Abdul Rahman Arif. Authors, including Saïd Aburish, mention contacts with the CIA; no public document establishes an American role.
d2eac87633: The Dutch oil services group reaches a deferred prosecution agreement with the Justice Department over bribes in Brazil, Angola, Equatorial Guinea, Kazakhstan and Iraq.
d2eca550b6: When Saudi Arabia negotiates a truce between Fatah and Hamas, Washington urges Fatah to reject the plan and to continue the effort to overthrow the Haniyeh government, according to Vanity Fair.
d2f901a7f9: The Secretary of State writes to his British counterpart that Cheddi Jagan must be prevented from leading the country to independence. The letter is published in the FRUS archives.
d30ef79daf: A $200 million drawdown of ammunition and demining equipment.
d310d692af: The Treasury freezes the assets of Vladimir Putin and Sergei Lavrov, along with other members of the Russian Security Council.
d38a5bee61: Kaspersky describes a hacking group linked to Stuxnet capable of infecting hard-drive firmware; the victims are in Iran, Russia, China, India and Mali. Leaks link it to the NSA.
d38f583683: MacArthur's command orders militarists and ultranationalists removed from public life. About 200,000 people are purged, before the “reverse course” rehabilitates most of them.
d3bd3b7e80: At his trial, Omega 7 leader Eduardo Arocena states that a mission of his group introduced “germs” into Cuba in 1980. Cuba sees it as proof of the dengue epidemic; nothing links this account to the American government.
d3d116deed: During Pete Hegseth's visit, Panama signs a memorandum that authorizes a rotating deployment of US military personnel at former bases, under heavy pressure from Washington.
d3d4de479b: After Laxalt advises him to “cut and cut cleanly”, Marcos leaves the palace in American helicopters and is flown from Clark to Hawaii. Washington immediately recognizes Corazon Aquino.
d3f0703fa2: Der Spiegel publishes, based on the Snowden documents, NATO's “JPEL” list: hundreds of people to be killed or captured, including mere drug traffickers.
d4091ade1d: Pushed by Washington, London imposes proportional representation. Forbes Burnham, funded by the CIA, forms the government even though Jagan's party comes first.
d4283a49ad: Ford Argentina and the abducted workers

Right after the coup, delegates from the Ford plant are abducted and tortured inside the plant itself. In 2018, Argentine justice convicts two former managers of the American subsidiary as accomplices.
d45ab35faf: Evo Morales expels Ambassador Philip Goldberg, whom he accuses of supporting the separatist prefects of the East. Washington denies it.
d466a38da8: American forces conduct repeated military exercises in Honduras near the Nicaraguan border, which serve to intimidate Managua and to prepare facilities.
d488355da5: American ships enforce the UN embargo against the Haitian junta. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
d4887c6a0c: Saudi national Mustafa al-Hawsawi is held incommunicado and mistreated by the CIA in Lithuania in 2005-2006. The ECHR convicts Lithuania of complicity on 16 January 2024.
d48acfd134: A Senate report (Riegle, 1994) establishes that strains, including anthrax, were legally exported to Iraq between 1985 and 1989 with Commerce Department licenses.
d49b518303: This American farmer, linked to the CIA, lends his airstrips in northern Costa Rica to the Contras. He is indicted in Costa Rica in 1989 and flees to the United States.
d49d6de444: An American raid on Nice's goods station and the Saint-Roch district kills and wounds hundreds of civilians, as part of the air offensive against the rail network before the landings.
d4abcd433a: A B-52 carrying four H-bombs crashes onto the sea ice. Plutonium contaminates the area. Danish cleanup workers later seek compensation for illnesses.
d4bb43ac52: The South Vietnamese army invades southern Laos with massive American air and helicopter support. The offensive turns into a rout.
d4e214187c: Truman authorizes the transfer of complete atomic bombs to Guam, under military control, to strike China or Korea if necessary. They are later brought back without having been used.
d4f2bef0b9: Abu Khabab al-Masri killed by a drone
A CIA strike kills the al-Qaeda chemist and several other people in South Waziristan.
d518892222: Under American pressure against Huawei, Latvia signs with Washington a joint declaration on 5G security.
d51be6af8a: Lyndon Johnson announces that Bikini can be resettled. Families return, but measurements in the 1970s reveal heavy cesium contamination, and the atoll is evacuated again in 1978.
d5262de4a2: Some thirty opponents are captured, tortured and executed during “Operation Limpieza”. It is set up with the help of American public safety adviser John Longan.
d557e6e08f: Weapons and silencer supplied to Rolando Cubela

The CIA puts Cubela in touch with exile Manuel Artime, who supplies him with a rifle fitted with a silencer. Arms caches are delivered to Cuba in 1964 and 1965. The CIA breaks off contact in mid-1965, according to the Church Committee.
d55dcf5fe7: The CIA funds the opposition parties for the April 1971 municipal elections, according to the Church Committee.
d5733d9c1e: The French bank is penalized for dollar transactions with countries under U.S. embargo.
d5b4904d78: Reagan bans all trade with Libya, orders Americans to leave and freezes Libyan assets.
d5c70b03c6: B-52s based on Guam bomb the South for the first time. Arc Light carpet bombing then hits the South, Laos and Cambodia.
d5cc0a6d30: NATO acknowledges that American A-10s fired about 31,000 depleted uranium shells in Kosovo and Serbia. Their health effects remain debated.
d5cc7ddc4f: The Treasury sanctions police chief Francisco Díaz and two other officials for the repression of protests.
d5e4503262: Strike Against the Chinese Bomb Considered
Kennedy and then Johnson study military action against the Chinese nuclear program, and sound out Moscow. Declassified archives show the idea was dropped in September 1964.
d5e4fbf544: CIA and Malawian intelligence agents arrest five foreigners suspected of ties to al-Qaeda and have them expelled outside any legal process. They are later released without charges.
d5ea452ab6: A strike kills six people off Venezuela. Families in Trinidad and Tobago say two victims were Trinidadian fishermen.
d5f28dba2f: The “American Note” demanding expulsion of the Axis

Envoy David Gray hands de Valera a note demanding the expulsion of German and Japanese diplomats. According to historians, the OSS knew the move was largely political: the aim was to put neutral Ireland in the dock.
d606560237: A CIA team tasked with sabotaging the Matahambre copper mine is captured. Its leader, Miguel Orozco, confesses on Cuban television.
d65b6885b0: Sanctions after the annexation of four regions
After the proclaimed annexation of four Ukrainian regions, the Treasury sanctions 278 people, including members of Parliament, and the governor of the Central Bank.
d6c24a5aeb: A U.S. bomb hits the premises of a UN-funded demining NGO in Kabul and kills four guards. The Pentagon acknowledges the error.
d6d9af01bb: Washington obtains from the Security Council a further tightening of sanctions against Iran: an embargo on heavy weapons and inspection of ships.
d6e20b252f: U.S. forces protect the consulate in Beirut, then Ottoman, where an uprising is feared. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
d71a187d6c: Moscow accuses Washington of financing biological weapons labs in Ukraine. The labs exist, financed by a public threat-reduction program, but no evidence of weapons has been provided.
d72f5173ce: Worried about Communist influence under Kassem, the National Security Council creates a special committee on Iraq tasked with studying options, including covert ones. FRUS archives record it.
d73cf5ac29: With State Department approval, the private military company MPRI advises and trains the Croatian army, which launches a few months later the offensives against the Krajina Serbs.
d7559fb941: First strike on a boat in 2026
Southern Command destroys a vessel accused of carrying drugs in the eastern Pacific: two dead, one survivor. The strikes resume after a pause of several weeks.
d772e4aa98: Rape of a minor near Kadena
A US airman abducts and sexually assaults a girl under 16. Tokyo discloses the case only in June 2024. The Naha court sentences him to five years in prison.
d77a9775b3: Dal Molin base imposed on Vicenza

Romano Prodi accepts the extension of the American base at Dal Molin airport, judging it impossible to go back on the agreement promised to Washington. On 17 February, tens of thousands of people demonstrate; no local referendum is held.
d78076b783: Nixon sends American and South Vietnamese troops into the Parrot's Beak and the Fishhook to destroy the communist sanctuaries.
d797b1d20b: Sanctions take effect that hit any company, even foreign, doing business with the Syrian state. The UN is concerned about their effects on an already impoverished population.
d7c945aaf9: Forced sale of the Danish West Indies

Denmark signs the sale of its West Indies for 25 million dollars. According to his own memoirs, Secretary of State Robert Lansing had warned Copenhagen that Washington might occupy the islands if it refused.
d7cbbe8b46: U.S. special forces train a Colombian brigade tasked with protecting Occidental Petroleum's Caño Limón pipeline, thanks to nearly $100 million voted by Congress.
d7e2ce8789: Strikes target a Basij facility in the densely populated Resalat district and destroy three neighboring buildings: at least 16 civilians killed according to Amnesty International.
d7f3e036d9: End of Western Union transfers to Cuba
A Treasury rule bans remittances through entities linked to the Cuban military. Western Union closes its 400 Cuban branches, the main channel for family remittances.
d8485f2e31: The Combat Group Against Inhumanity, funded by American services, carries out sabotage and propaganda actions in East Germany in the early 1950s.
d861aa393d: The Commerce Department proposes an anti-dumping duty of 91.74% against La Molisana, Garofalo and eleven other pasta makers. The final rates of March 2026 are reduced to between 2.26% and 13.98%.
d89d09d624: Seizure of Iranian fuel bound for Venezuela
The Justice Department announces the seizure of the cargoes of four tankers carrying Iranian gasoline to Venezuela.
d8ae27623f: CIA Backs Candidates for the Majlis
In the 1952 Iranian parliamentary elections, the CIA backs 18 candidates of its choosing. Mossadegh suspends the vote after the election of urban deputies loyal to him.
d8ce643bcd: U.S. forces land at Bocas del Toro to protect American lives and property during the Colombian civil war. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
d8d72d8e4c: Lieutenant Colonel Isaac Zida seizes power after the fall of Blaise Compaoré. He had attended counterterrorism training funded by the Pentagon in 2012, which AFRICOM confirms to the Washington Post.
d8f36fa712: Hatoyama Ichirō Purged on the Eve of Power
The leader of the Liberal Party, winner of the April 1946 elections, is hit by a GHQ purge on the eve of his appointment. Yoshida Shigeru takes over the government in his place.
d931f2423a: According to historians Mark Gasiorowski and Ervand Abrahamian, CIA and MI6 funds reach clerics and their networks to mobilize the street against the government.
d9687f65bb: After the coup in Haiti, thousands of boat people are held on the base. More than 200 HIV-positive people are kept at Camp Bulkeley until a federal judge orders their release in 1993.
d988aa8f22: Strike on the Datta Khel jirga
A drone strikes a tribal assembly that was settling a dispute over a mine. About forty dead, mostly civilians, according to press and NGO investigations.
d9b59a4110: Rape of Shen Chong in Beijing
An American Marine rapes the student Shen Chong. Convicted by court-martial, he is acquitted on appeal in Washington. The case triggers anti-American demonstrations across China.
d9d48b26cf: A Marine artillery battery is deployed in Syria to support the offensive on Raqqa. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
d9e154f4c1: Journalist Erich Möchel, relying on a Snowden document, identifies interception facilities in a tower near the UN and a villa in Pötzleinsdorf. Washington and Vienna deny it.
d9f97956c3: After the overthrow of Mohamed Morsi on July 3, the Obama administration refuses to call it a coup, which would legally require it to suspend $1.3 billion in military aid.
d9ffade873: A U.S. strike near the Syrian border kills about forty people gathered for a wedding. The army says it targeted fighters; images confirm the celebration.
da23455b1c: Bandar Abbas naval base in flames
US strikes hit the Iranian navy headquarters at Bandar Abbas. The depot ship Makran and the destroyer Shahid Sayyad Shirazi are shown on fire. Trump announces ten Iranian ships “neutralized.”
da2c8ef4fe: U.S. soldiers execute four handcuffed Iraqi detainees and dump their bodies in a canal. Three noncommissioned officers are convicted in 2009.
da3685fbb4: Washington blames Chávez for his own fall
White House spokesman Ari Fleischer says Chávez brought about his own downfall and avoids the word “coup.” Washington distances itself from the condemnation by the other countries of the hemisphere.
da38b79661: Funded by USAID to guide the privatizations, Andrei Shleifer and Jonathan Hay invest on their own account. Sued by the American government, Harvard pays 26.5 million dollars in 2005.
da6141aba2: Fall of Askar Akayev. Opposition media received U.S. funds; a decisive role by Washington is mainly alleged by Moscow.
da7c9666a9: The NSA base in Yorkshire locates targets' phones by satellite and supports “a significant number” of “capture-kill” operations in Iraq, Afghanistan and Yemen. Revealed by The Intercept in September 2016.
da8acb747d: From May to September 1943, the US air force repeatedly bombs Foggia and its airfields. The city is largely destroyed. Death tolls vary from several thousand to nearly 20,000 depending on the estimates.
daca68aa69: Fabián Escalante, former head of Cuban counterintelligence, counts 638 plots or assassination plans against Castro. The figure is put forward only by Cuba; the Church Committee documents eight.
dacab63a4a: Marines land at Puerto Cabezas, seat of Juan Bautista Sacasa's Liberal government, and impose a neutral zone there that hampers the Liberals against Adolfo Díaz, backed by Washington.
dafe189306: The CIC gets Barbie out of Europe through the network of the priest Krunoslav Draganović, under the name Altmann. Washington expresses regret to France in 1983.
db2d7b17bd: Libyan opposition figure Abdelhakim Belhaj and his pregnant wife are arrested in Kuala Lumpur, transferred to Bangkok and then sent back to Libya by the CIA on British intelligence. Libyan archives revealed it; London apologized in 2018.
db30129792: Directive NSC 1/3 contemplates military aid and the deployment of forces in the Mediterranean if the Communists take power in Italy, legally or not. The documents are declassified.
db3a639a80: An agreement gives U.S. forces access to seven Colombian bases. The Constitutional Court invalidates it in August 2010 for lack of a vote in Congress.
db4047f48b: Trump wants to “take back” the canal
In his inaugural address, Trump says the United States will take back the Panama Canal. He had refused to rule out the use of force.
db4a3a1aa7: According to Seymour Hersh, the CIA oversees from Benghazi the shipment of Libyan weapons to Syrian rebels via Turkey. Washington denies it; the claim remains disputed.
db74941c90: CIA collaborators help the junta draft the White Book that justifies the coup by an alleged “Plan Z” of assassination by the left, according to the Church Committee.
dba6a5ff74: According to the CIA's internal history revealed in 2000, agents posing as Tudeh militants threaten clerics to turn opinion against Mossadegh.
dbbacd49e8: The Pentagon tests Agent Orange and other defoliants on the Pranburi military reservation in 1964-1965. Herbicides are also sprayed around US bases, as acknowledged by the Department of Veterans Affairs.
dbc2f00937: Eximbank loan denied to LAN Chile
The Eximbank refuses to finance the national airline's purchase of Boeings, one of the acts of the financial blockade against the Allende government.
dbcbe1bfe3: Grenades target Sukarno outside a Jakarta school and cause deaths. The Church Committee cites indications that the CIA considered assassinating him, but no link to Cikini is demonstrated.
dbd8962811: CIA-led commandos set fuel tanks on fire at Corinto. Thousands of residents are evacuated.
dbd8973e43: Kim Jong-pil founds the Korean Central Intelligence Agency after the May 1961 coup, in liaison with the CIA. The KCIA becomes the instrument of repression under Park Chung-hee.
dc002df2b1: Tariffs on allies' steel and aluminum
In the name of “national security” (Section 232), Trump taxes steel at 25% and aluminum at 10%. The European Union, Canada and Mexico are subject to them from June 2018.
dc03486121: An American lieutenant colonel fires on civilians looting a warehouse; at least eight dead. He is never prosecuted.
dc15fef46b: The Dutch bank pays $500 million for payments linked to Iran, Libya, Sudan and Cuba.
dc19770a33: Obama signs a law that sanctions Russian officials deemed linked to the death in custody of lawyer Sergei Magnitsky. Moscow retaliates by banning adoptions by Americans.
dc2a64b2cf: Air strikes on a village in Paktia. Residents and the UN report about fifty civilians killed. The Pentagon describes a Taliban compound.
dc3295202e: American troops storm a North Korean prisoner compound with armor and tear gas. Dozens of prisoners are killed.
dc36cad1ff: Bolton accuses Cuba of biological weapons
Under Secretary of State John Bolton claims that Cuba is conducting research on biological weapons. No evidence is produced and Jimmy Carter visits the targeted centers shortly afterward.
dc4f10b39a: Qatari arms to rebels with U.S. approval
According to the New York Times, Washington approves arms deliveries from Qatar to Libyan rebels, some of which reach Islamist militias.
dc587441f4: The Workers' Party speaks of an institutional coup and some see an American hand; no U.S. role is demonstrated.
dc5d3fac7d: The National Security Council adopts NSC 13/2, inspired by George Kennan. It shifts the occupation from democratization to economic recovery and anticommunism, and slows purges and reforms.
dc6e9f5a60: Bombing campaign in Cambodia that follows Menu and extends to almost the entire country. It lasts until 15 August 1973.
dc7948a70f: South Vietnamese troops accompanied by American advisers attack this border village and kill 17 civilians. Cambodia brings the matter before the UN.
dc844f4f22: The Colombian army fires on striking United Fruit workers. The American role, pressure and threat of intervention, is alleged by Jorge Eliécer Gaitán and remains debated.
dca45154e5: The inhabitants of Rongelap and Ailinginae receive the fallout from Castle Bravo and are evacuated only about two days later. Burns, thyroid cancers and miscarriages follow.
dca7d96ab8: The NSA listened to the chancellor's phone. Obama says it is no longer the case, saying nothing about the past; German prosecutors close the investigation.
dca7f7472b: First American bombing of the North, in reprisal for the Gulf of Tonkin incident, targeting naval bases and a fuel depot at Vinh.
dcb68767ec: The $3.75 billion loan requires the pound to become convertible within a year. Applied in July 1947, it causes a flight of reserves and a crisis that forces London to suspend it in August.
dcd26b4f36: The head of US Cyber Command, Paul Nakasone, confirms that his teams are conducting offensive operations in support of Ukraine.
dcd9f56aee: The CIA-funded radio begins broadcasting to Eastern Europe. The secret funding is acknowledged in 1971.
dce901cc0c: Evacuation of the Shamsi drone base
After Salala, Pakistan demands that the Americans leave this base from which the CIA launched its drones. The last personnel leave on December 11.
dceffe534b: The South Vietnamese counteroffensive, backed by B-52s and American naval artillery, razes the city and its citadel between July and September 1972.
dd0e550fd2: Washington installs Reaper drones at Mahé airport. Presented as anti-piracy, they are also used for missions in Somalia, according to cables published by WikiLeaks.
dd11cbd6e1: Washington announces about 20 million dollars of military equipment for Eritrea, Ethiopia and Uganda, which support the rebels opposed to the Khartoum regime.
dd3d7c4487: Washington sanctions judges of the International Criminal Court over investigations targeting Americans and Israel.
dd7dbaaf47: An NSA memo of December 7, 2009 plans to intercept foreign delegations during COP15 to inform U.S. negotiators. Revealed by Information and the Huffington Post in January 2014.
dd9e4c22e5: The United States alone votes against a draft condemning an Israeli soldier's attack on the Temple Mount esplanade, which killed two Palestinians on 11 April.
ddb0592e16: The CIA drops arms and materiel to the anti-Castro guerrillas in the Escambray mountains. Most of the drops fall into the hands of the Cuban army.
ddc6ead997: The law requires banks worldwide to report the accounts of U.S. citizens to the U.S. tax authorities, on pain of 30% withholding. “Accidental Americans” in Europe lose their accounts.
dde90f49cb: The president dies in a plane crash. John Perkins and others accuse the CIA; official inquiries conclude it was an accident. No public proof of an American role.
ddfc570be6: After the Kurdish exodus, the United States, the United Kingdom and France impose an exclusion zone north of the 36th parallel, without explicit UN mandate. Patrols and strikes last until 2003.
de04011a08: According to Snowden documents published by Der Spiegel, the NSA spies on the EU missions in Washington and New York and the Council headquarters in Brussels.
de072e685c: Food Parcels to Destabilize East Germany
After the uprising, Eisenhower launches a distribution of parcels to East Germans in West Berlin. The archives show the aim of keeping up agitation against the regime.
de18b8144d: The CIA and the Taiwanese air force create the 35th Squadron. Its U-2s overfly mainland China, including the Lop Nur nuclear site, until March 1968, then skirt its coasts until the unit is disbanded in 1974.
de2e508ab7: Washington sanctions the UN special rapporteur on the Palestinian territories, who denounces a genocide in Gaza.
de4023bb49: Program to shoot down light aircraft
The CIA helps the Peruvian air force spot and then shoot down small aircraft suspected of carrying drugs. Dozens of aircraft are destroyed.
de41cb763b: Kissinger receives Guzzetti in New York
Kissinger again tells the Argentine foreign minister he wishes the junta to succeed quickly. Ambassador Robert Hill protests: Guzzetti returns home “euphoric”, according to his declassified cable.
de4e4c4df7: According to the New York Times, the NSA and the CIA spied on Japanese negotiators during the auto trade dispute to help Representative Mickey Kantor.
de729107d1: In exchange for debt relief and new credits, France gives up the quotas that protected its cinema against American films. The agreement provokes a strong protest from the profession.
de74198630: US strikes kill at least 25 Kataib Hezbollah fighters in Iraq and Syria. In retaliation, protesters besiege the US embassy in Baghdad.
de81518b2b: In exchange for diplomatic recognition, Washington obtains from Obregón that land and oil reform will not apply retroactively to American interests.
de8b983f1e: Veto after the Beit Hanoun killings
