Washington blocks a draft condemning the Israeli artillery fire that killed 19 civilians of the same family in Beit Hanoun on November 8.
deb187db67: American SR-71s fly over Nicaragua and cause sonic booms over the capital, amid rumors of invasion.
deb55d014c: Arrest of Alex Saab in Cape Verde

At Washington's request, Alex Saab is arrested during a stopover in Cape Verde. Caracas, which presents him as a diplomat, denounces a kidnapping; he is extradited to the United States on October 16, 2021.
debe7e6e09: Swiss senator Dick Marty's report for the Council of Europe describes a “spider's web” of CIA flights and secret detentions with the complicity of European states.
decb4ef2b3: Dishfire: 200 million text messages a day

The NSA collects an average of 194 million text messages a day worldwide to extract contacts, movements and transactions; GCHQ queries British numbers in it. Revealed by The Guardian and Channel 4 in January 2014.
def8587c3d: The escalation brings tariffs on Chinese goods to 145%, before a truce negotiated in Geneva in May.
defd0c8b2c: Secret arms for the Iraqi Kurds
Nixon and Kissinger approve covert CIA aid, together with Iran, to Barzani's Kurds against Baghdad. The Pike Committee says it was meant to weaken Iraq, not to make them win.
defe16c581: Blackwater guards, under contract to the State Department, kill 17 Iraqi civilians. Four are convicted in 2014-2015, then pardoned by Trump in 2020.
df05d2dcba: A Biden executive order allows sanctions on sectors of the Nicaraguan economy. The Treasury immediately targets the state mining authority, a pillar of gold exports.
df2caa0416: Strikes on the Natanz nuclear site
The Natanz enrichment complex is hit twice in the Israeli-American raids. The IAEA confirms on March 3 damage to the entrance buildings of the underground plant, with no rise in radioactivity.
df4d472def: Designed with American advisers, the program forcibly regroups peasants into fortified villages, often far from their lands. It collapses in 1963.
df57dde21f: Propaganda for the Exodus to the South
Lansdale's team spreads rumors, leaflets and fake almanacs predicting misfortunes under the Việt Minh, to push Catholics in the North to flee to the South.
df5a50831b: Operation Steel Tiger on the Ho Chi Minh Trail
US aircraft bomb the Ho Chi Minh Trail in southern Laos, without any declaration or notice to the American public.
df9723064e: Barack Obama informs Congress of the deployment of about a hundred military personnel to Niger to fly surveillance drones over Mali and the Sahel.
dfa21723cd: Cuban Sugar Contaminated in Puerto Rico
Agents contaminate more than 14,000 bags of Cuban sugar bound for the USSR during a stopover in Puerto Rico. Kennedy reportedly ordered them seized. The affair is revealed by the press in 1966.
dfafb8dc34: The American press reveals that the CIA spied on the delegates of the Congress of Micronesia who were negotiating with Washington the future status of the trust territory.
dfbb92f53c: Section 211: Pernod Ricard deprived of Havana Club

Section 211 of a budget law bars asserting in the United States trademarks linked to properties confiscated in Cuba. It deprives the joint venture of Pernod Ricard and the Cuban state of the Havana Club trademark, to the benefit of Bacardi. The WTO partly condemns it in 2002.
dfc2091eb5: At the request of both parties, American troops supervise elections outside the Canal Zone. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
dfeb6fd1ca: Threat to destroy Iranian power plants and bridges

Trump threatens to destroy all of Iran's power plants and bridges if the Strait of Hormuz is not reopened, then warns that “a whole civilization will die tonight.” Legal experts see a threat of a war crime.
e017bfa355: Total asset freeze on the Venezuelan state
Executive Order 13884 blocks all property of the Venezuelan government in the United States and threatens sanctions on foreign companies that do business with it.
e01801cf33: American Michael Meiring, injured by an explosion in his hotel room, is taken out of the country by agents claiming to be from the FBI. Rodrigo Duterte, then mayor, accuses the CIA of having spirited away a bomb maker.
e019b2b564: A commando arriving from the sea attacks this fishing village in eastern Cuba: two dead and several wounded, including children. Cuba blames Alpha 66 and Washington. The American role is not proven.
e03afb6cee: The package includes for the first time 155 mm howitzers, Mi-17 helicopters, M113 armored vehicles and Switchblade drones.
e0637e8711: The NSA supplies XKeyscore to Japanese intelligence, which pays for its installations, including one in Okinawa, while spying on Japanese officials. Revealed by The Intercept and NHK in April 2017.
e06c161cbd: During the Mayaguez incident, US Navy aircraft bomb the Ream base and the port of Kompong Som.
e0b455f563: Trump rejects the seven-day plan presented by Araghchi at the UN: lifting of the blockade and oil sanctions, unfreezing of funds, then reopening of Hormuz. He calls the offer “unacceptable.”
e0cfe80fb5: Obama freezes the assets of the Libyan government and the Gaddafi family in the United States, more than $30 billion, at the start of the uprising.
e0e6fcb0bc: Permesta rebel aircraft flown by CIA agents bomb a market in Ambon and kill many civilians. Washington then denies any involvement.
e0ec95422b: A strike on a semi-submersible kills two. The two survivors, a Colombian and an Ecuadorian, are repatriated to their countries instead of being detained.
e1065920ce: According to Snowden, cited by the South China Morning Post, the NSA hacked Tsinghua University, Hong Kong's Pacnet network and Chinese mobile operators.
e108212a60: The day before the transfer of sovereignty, Bremer confirms that coalition forces and their private contractors are exempt from Iraqi justice. This immunity covers Blackwater in particular.
e121d31e48: From 1977 to 1980, the army buries radioactive test waste in a crater on Runit island, covered with a concrete dome with no sealed bottom.
e15bee5ffb: The exile Antonio Veciana says he prepared a bazooka shot at Castro from an apartment near the palace, under the direction of a CIA officer he calls “Maurice Bishop.” The plot is foiled. The House committee (HSCA) could not establish the existence of this contact.
e16713d2b8: The Institute for Social Research and Studies, funded by Brazilian businessmen and American companies, wages a massive propaganda campaign against Goulart, according to historian René Dreifuss.
e176aced0e: Trump signs the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, which makes Hong Kong's special status conditional and provides for sanctions on its leaders.
e17c3fd2e4: After a court-martial acquits a soldier who had killed a pedestrian while driving, a new accident sparks a riot. Thousands of Okinawans set fire to dozens of American vehicles.
e17e86e253: A $2.175 billion package including GLSDB long-range guided bombs (about 150 km) and ammunition.
e182c2a450: End of tariff concessions for Prague
Truman applies the 1951 law that withdraws most-favoured-nation tariff status from communist countries. Czechoslovakia, though a GATT member, loses its tariff concessions.
e1879cf143: Kandahar Strike Force kills a police chief
Members of this militia paid and supervised by the CIA attack the prosecutor's office and kill police chief Matiullah Qati, according to the New York Times.
e19599b4ae: After the secession, Marines are stationed almost continuously on the isthmus from November 1903 to January 1914 to protect American interests. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
e19f8bc000: From 1951 to 1953, the CIA parachutes 212 Chinese agents into China. According to its own internal review, 101 are killed and 111 captured.
e1bd6e7f43: As the revolution approaches, a landing force guards the consulate in Hankou. Marines are then sent to Shanghai, Nanjing, Zhenjiang and Taku. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
e1ca963693: The law requires US representatives to oppose loans from international financial institutions to Nicaragua.
e1ce1cac35: “Not one inch eastward”: Baker to Gorbachev
James Baker assures Gorbachev that NATO will not expand “one inch eastward”. Archives published in 2017 attest to these assurances, but no treaty records them.
e1e956082a: María Corina Machado received by Bush
George W. Bush receives in the Oval Office the founder of Súmate, then being prosecuted in Venezuela for receiving U.S. funds.
e1f9625380: The day after the coup, Ambassador Charles Shapiro meets Pedro Carmona, the self-proclaimed head of government. The State Department acknowledges the meeting and says it urged him to respect institutions.
e23a8675dc: Taiwanese U-2 shot down over Fujian
A U-2 of the “Black Cats” is shot down over Fujian. Pilot Lee Nan-ping dies.
e2877d21b5: General Electric absorbs Alstom's energy business
GE finalizes the acquisition of Alstom's energy division. Frédéric Pierucci and a parliamentary commission of inquiry see the effect of U.S. judicial pressure; GE and Washington dispute this.
e2b2f2af10: Fourteen Iraqi banks cut off from dollars
The Treasury and the Federal Reserve bar 14 Iraqi banks from dollar transactions, to limit transfers to Iran. The measure weighs on the dinar and on Iraqi trade.
e2edbafcf0: By the Berlin Declaration, the Allies assume supreme authority in Germany. The United States administers its occupation zone through a military government and subsequently keeps permanent garrisons there.
e2f77be5ea: The defense act signed by Obama sanctions foreign banks that deal with the Iranian central bank, to reduce Iran's oil sales.
e30303c494: The Treasury designates the Macau bank as a launderer of North Korean money. Macau freezes about $25 million and the North is cut off from the international banking system.
e30581060e: Mandela removed from the terror list
A law signed by George W. Bush finally removes Nelson Mandela and the ANC from U.S. terrorism watch lists, where they had remained since the apartheid era.
e33f77c501: Agent Wilbur Crane Eveland recounts having carried funds for President Chamoun's candidates.
e34b4e7b1a: The Federal Supreme Court suspends the foundation that Curitiba prosecutors wanted to endow with 2.5 billion reais from the settlement between Petrobras and US justice.
e35fa4328c: Left-leaning media blame Washington for the prime minister's ouster. Cables published by WikiLeaks show that Mark Arbib, an architect of the change, was secretly briefing the U.S. embassy.
e36ca14415: Arrest of former Marine Matthew Heath
Caracas arrests a former US Marine near refineries and accuses him of espionage and sabotage. Washington denies it.
e37e4e6fec: Radio Free Europe During the Uprising
Broadcasts lead Hungarian insurgents to believe in Western aid. An internal RFE review acknowledges lapses.
e3833d06b1: WikiLeaks reveals 35 NSA targets in Japan, including ministries, the Bank of Japan and Mitsubishi.
e397522b72: First major American raid on Bucharest, targeting railway stations. It causes thousands of civilian casualties.
e39921f18e: Crocus City Hall: Moscow blames Washington

After the attack claimed by the Islamic State (145 dead), FSB chief Alexander Bortnikov blames Washington, London and Kyiv, without evidence. The White House calls the accusations absurd; the United States had warned Moscow of a risk of attack.
e3bb9a150a: North Korea listed as a state sponsor of terrorism
After the bombing of Korean Air Flight 858, Washington places North Korea on its list of state sponsors of terrorism, with the accompanying sanctions. It is removed in 2008.
e3bcded2ec: UN air forces, mostly American, concentrate their bombing day and night on short sections of North Korean railways. The campaign follows the failure of Strangle.
e3c3a4926a: Captain John Pershing leads columns against the Maranao forts, including Bacolod in April and Taraca in May 1903. Hundreds of Moros are killed.
e3cb9981ff: On the day of the Baathist putsch, Robert Komer of the National Security Council writes to Kennedy that the regime change is “almost certainly a net gain” for Washington, which quickly recognizes the new authorities.
e3ea99ffbb: Bush calls for an Iraqi uprising
George H. W. Bush calls on Iraqis to overthrow Saddam Hussein. Southern Shiites and northern Kurds rise up in early March.
e44714af06: The Swedish equipment maker settles US prosecutions for corruption in several countries, under the FCPA.
e45e3f8239: American B-29s drop incendiary bombs on Hankou, then occupied by Japan. The burned district smolders for several days and thousands of Chinese civilians die.
e4632765d7: Waegwan Bridge Blown Up With Refugees
On General Hobart Gay's orders, the American army blows up the Naktong bridge at Waegwan while refugees are crossing it. Hundreds reportedly died, according to the AP's 1999 investigation.
e474cd1406: The CIA publishes two videos in Mandarin calling on disillusioned Chinese officials to deliver secrets to it.
e477867586: MACV-SOG teams conduct secret reconnaissance in neutral Cambodia (later Salem House).
e483d61243: PDVSA management, business leaders and the CTV labor federation paralyze the oil industry for two months. Caracas accuses Washington of support; the CTV received NED funds, but no direct role is established.
e497162b3d: Portugal excluded from NATO nuclear secrets

Fearing the presence of communists in government after the Carnation Revolution, Kissinger supports Portugal's removal from NATO's Nuclear Planning Group. Lisbon loses access to the Alliance's most sensitive documents.
e49f9707de: Ramaphosa ambushed in the Oval Office
Donald Trump shows Cyril Ramaphosa a video supposed to prove a “genocide” of white farmers and brandishes a photo that turns out to have been taken in the DR Congo.
e4bfe2a2a9: Noel Field is arrested in Prague, the starting point of purges in Eastern Europe. Journalist Stewart Steven argues that Allen Dulles manipulated the affair to provoke these purges. Other historians dispute this thesis.
e4c6fc549f: The White House calls Morales's forced resignation, under pressure from the army, a “significant moment for democracy.”
e4f2baf978: Murder of Jennifer Laude in Olongapo
Transgender woman Jennifer Laude is killed by Marine Joseph Scott Pemberton. Convicted of homicide in 2015 and held in a military camp, he is pardoned by Rodrigo Duterte in 2020.
e5189d35f8: A Kuomintang division lands on Dongshan Island, in Fujian, and is driven back in three days. The plan was prepared by Western Enterprises, a CIA front.
e5209aa4c3: After the disputed 2000 elections, Washington obtains a freeze on loans already approved by the Inter-American Development Bank, depriving the Aristide government of funding.
e563ca215c: The US-trained Atlacatl battalion kills about 200 civilians. The UN Truth Commission establishes it.
e57207187f: Drone strike on an al-Nujaba leader
A US drone kills Mushtaq Taleb al-Saidi, known as Abu Taqwa, commander of Harakat al-Nujaba, in the middle of Baghdad, at a Popular Mobilization Forces headquarters. The Iraqi government protests.
e58ae4c74a: American bombers target Rome's railway yards and hit the San Lorenzo district: between 1,500 and 3,000 dead depending on the source.
e5917d1893: A $450 million drawdown with four additional HIMARS rocket launchers, ammunition and patrol boats.
e5936a9b67: Carter sends General Robert Huyser to keep the Iranian army behind Shapour Bakhtiar and to study the option of a military coup. The army declares itself neutral in February.
e5ad202822: Sabotage of a track derails a train and kills three railway workers. Communist unionists are convicted, then all acquitted in 1963. Japanese authors suspect American intelligence, with no established proof.
e5adaadb12: The ban on US citizens traveling to North Korea takes effect, following the death of Otto Warmbier.
e5b6485a77: The CIA distributes money to Congolese parliamentarians to get Cyrille Adoula elected prime minister, according to American diplomatic archives published in 2013.
e640e52b6e: In retaliation for the invasion of Afghanistan, Carter suspends most grain sales to the USSR. Reagan lifts the embargo in 1981.
e6546ead5d: Marines open fire on demonstrating peasants. At least a dozen dead, depending on the source.
e66dd460e6: The Caco leader who took over from Péralte is killed by a Marine patrol. His death ends the armed insurrection against the occupation.
e6948d0cb8: The American embargo is extended to almost all trade with Cuba. It remains in force for decades and the UN General Assembly has condemned it every year since 1992.
e696d65be9: Marines and sailors take Coyotepe Hill from the troops of Benjamín Zeledón, who is killed the next day.
e6a16b2268: “Allende must be overthrown by a coup”
A cable from CIA headquarters to the Santiago station states that the “firm and continuing policy” is that Allende be overthrown by a coup. It has been declassified.
e6acc813ee: According to mission orders published by WikiLeaks in 2017, the CIA tasked its agents with gathering information on French parties ahead of the presidential election.
e6aebf2601: About 7,000 U.S. soldiers enter Kosovo as part of the NATO force, after the bombing of Yugoslavia. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
e6b4c99131: Spotted on a spying mission in waters claimed by the USSR, the USS Gudgeon is hunted for hours and forced to surface. First incident of this kind of the Cold War.
e6bf8d0d49: Visas revoked for Supreme Court justices
The State Department revokes the visas of Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who is presiding over Bolsonaro's trial, of his relatives and of other Federal Supreme Court justices.
e6deda07f8: The New York Times reveals a plan prepared under Obama to paralyze Iran's defenses, power grids and communications by cyberattack in the event of war.
e70fd53ccc: About 8,000 American soldiers under General Graves land in Siberia during the civil war and remain until 1920.
e71640490e: After Zelaya's forced resignation, Washington refuses to recognize José Madriz, chosen by the Liberal assembly. Denied recognition, he has to give way to Estrada's Conservatives in 1910.
e7504010b2: The FBI lures onto a yacht the Lebanese man suspected of a plane hijacking, arrests him in international waters and brings him back to the United States to stand trial.
e750588a10: Plan LASO and the Marquetalia assault
Under Plan LASO, designed with the United States, the Colombian army attacks the peasant enclave of Marquetalia. The FARC emerge from this offensive.
e7526fe2df: Elon Musk op-ed for the AfD
Chosen by Trump to lead the future DOGE, Elon Musk publishes in Welt am Sonntag an op-ed calling the AfD the “last spark of hope” ahead of the federal election. The head of the opinion pages resigns.
e7641c0d32: The Chinese lab Pangu Lab attributes to the Equation Group, linked to the NSA, the Bvp47 backdoor found in systems in 45 countries including China.
e78fbd8dbb: Strike on a convoy near al-Tanf
Coalition aircraft strike a convoy of pro-government Syrian forces approaching the al-Tanf base. Further strikes of the same kind follow in June.
e7a76490eb: Refusal to Commit to the Geneva Accords
The United States does not sign the Geneva final declaration and merely “takes note.” It immediately builds a separate South Vietnamese state, contrary to the spirit of the accords.
e7ffe181ba: The Treasury sanctions Chen Quanguo, the Party chief in Xinjiang, and other officials under the Magnitsky Act.
e815393544: Trump and Pezeshkian sign remotely a 14-point protocol: lifting of the blockade, reopening of Hormuz and 60 days to negotiate sanctions and the nuclear issue. It collapses in July and expires on August 17.
e8184ca005: George W. Bush announces the sending of more than 20,000 additional soldiers, mainly to Baghdad and Anbar province. 2007 is one of the deadliest years of the war.
e825374532: A $2.1 billion USAI package including Patriot munitions and Puma drones.
e839fbfbbf: The weekly Panorama claims that the NSA listened to Vatican calls before the 2013 conclave, including those of Cardinal Bergoglio. The NSA denies it.
e85601103b: Trump backs Orbán ahead of the Hungarian vote
Trump gives his “complete and total” support to Viktor Orbán ahead of the April parliamentary election. Orbán will be defeated on April 12 by Péter Magyar.
e85e96768a: Via Pakistan's ISI, CIA aid mainly benefits Islamist commanders such as Gulbuddin Hekmatyar and Jalaluddin Haqqani, future allies of Osama bin Laden. The “Afghan Arabs” benefit indirectly.
e8982c6374: The Secretary of State privately assures Pinochet of his sympathy and calls his human rights critics a minor hindrance. The record of the meeting has been declassified.
e89d69a011: The Burmese air force shoots down a PB4Y bomber that was supplying KMT troops. The seized American weapons provoke demonstrations outside the U.S. embassy in Rangoon.
e8a437a455: The United States again strikes the Natanz enrichment site. The IAEA confirms damage to the entrance buildings, with no radiological consequence.
e8b8dc7b90: Senior officials sanctioned over the FARC
The Treasury sanctions Hugo Carvajal, Henry Rangel Silva and Ramón Rodríguez Chacín, accused of helping Colombia's FARC guerrillas.
e8d737ae9b: The U.S. Air Force releases hundreds of camera-equipped balloons over the USSR and China. Moscow protests and displays the recovered balloons.
e8dcda5244: Olympic sabre champion and officer Jerzy Pawłowski is arrested for spying for a NATO country. He is sentenced to 25 years in prison. He had been working for the CIA since 1964.
e8e0be3823: Fighter jet fires on the tanker Hasna
An F/A-18 from the USS Abraham Lincoln fires on the empty Iranian tanker Hasna, which was trying to run the blockade despite warnings.
e8f8c917e5: After accusing Pyongyang of secretly enriching uranium, Washington gets the KEDO organization to halt the fuel oil promised by the 1994 Agreed Framework. The agreement collapses.
e8ffe84cbe: Vance campaigns for Orbán in Budapest
Vice President JD Vance takes part in a Viktor Orbán rally five days before the parliamentary election. Trump promises Hungary the “full economic power” of the United States if Orbán needs it.
e906055759: The American military administration expropriates farmland under Ordinance 109 to expand its bases, sometimes at bayonet point and with bulldozers. Entire villages are displaced.
e90617a103: The CIA approves project AECOB: infiltration of Latvian agents recruited in exile for espionage and contact with the “forest brothers”. Files declassified; the project is abandoned on 1 January 1958.
e91d20b6b1: About 5,000 American soldiers land in northern Russia and fight the Red Army alongside the Allies until 1919.
e94685c418: The United States, the EU, the United Kingdom and Canada sanction dozens of Belarusian officials and state companies, including potash exporters, over the repression and the migrant crisis.
e948c18c05: Rongelap evacuated by the Rainbow Warrior
With no American response, Greenpeace evacuates the inhabitants of Rongelap, who consider their atoll still contaminated. The ship is sunk two months later by the French services.
e95b1b7fdf: Trump's veto against Maliki in Iraq
Trump threatens to end all aid to Iraq if Nouri al-Maliki, candidate of the main parliamentary bloc, becomes prime minister again. Maliki denounces flagrant interference.
e997068071: Prime Minister Gilani tells the U.S. ambassador: “I don't care if they do it as long as they get the right people. We'll protest in the National Assembly and then ignore it.” Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
e9a69836f8: The Eisenhower administration suspends arms deliveries to Fulgencio Batista's regime, then at war with the Castro guerrillas. It is the first American embargo measure targeting Cuba.
e9b30e32e2: Kennedy approves a new sabotage program against Cuban power plants, refineries and factories. Raids follow for months.
e9b56c601b: Military aid to the Lon Nol regime
Washington arms and funds the Khmer Republic until its fall in April 1975, in its war against the Khmer Rouge.
e9bb4f7f81: Ronald Reagan sends Senator Paul Laxalt to press Ferdinand Marcos to reform. Shortly afterward, Marcos announces on American television an early presidential election.
e9bed5a74d: Paul Ramadier dismisses the Communist ministers. The weight of American pressure, tied to expected credits, remains debated by historians.
e9cf12fb0a: The Treasury sanctions 328 Duma members, the defense company Tactical Missiles Corporation and dozens of Russian arms companies.
e9d0bfed0d: According to Andreas Papandreou in 1990, a 1955 agreement between the CIA and the Greek army creates a clandestine armed network. Members of this network play a role in the 1967 coup.
e9d8534cf2: Dora Farms strike against Saddam Hussein
The war opens with bombs and missiles aimed at a farm where Saddam Hussein was believed to be. He was not there.
e9f52fddeb: The army ousts Manuel Zelaya, whose plane stops over at the U.S. base at Soto Cano. Washington refuses to legally call it a coup; Hillary Clinton writes that she worked to prevent his return.
e9f57113d6: US Green Berets were training Mamady Doumbouya's Guinean special forces when they overthrew Alpha Condé. Washington condemns the coup and suspends the training.
ea031676b4: Sihanouk foils a plot by this military chief backed by Thailand and South Vietnam. He accuses the CIA, whose alleged agent is expelled.
ea382c05fc: Reagan extends sanctions to the European subsidiaries and licensees of American companies to block the Urengoy-Europe pipeline. The European allies protest; the sanctions are lifted in November 1982.
ea6d853638: The New York Times reveals that the CIA has been delivering bags of cash to the president's office since 2002, tens of millions of dollars. Karzai confirms receiving “small amounts.”
ea71e60f36: Ban on investing in Iranian oil
Clinton bans American companies by executive order from developing Iranian oil, blocking a Conoco contract.
ea8be17945: The bomb kills 17 people. Investigations point to the far right. Judge Guido Salvini noted links between some of the protagonists and American intelligence, without an American role being established.
eabbac6bac: Twenty-two Uyghurs captured in Pakistan and Afghanistan are held at Guantánamo. Recognized as non-combatants, some remain there until 2013 for lack of a host country.
eb02e376da: HIMARS rockets on a house in Marjah
During Operation Moshtarak, two rockets hit a house and kill twelve civilians, including children. NATO acknowledges the error and suspends the system.
eb0aba96ee: Turkish ministers accuse the United States, where the preacher Fethullah Gülen, named as the coup's mastermind, lives. Washington denies it.
eb0af1e8ca: Washington obtains military bases in Spain in exchange for economic and military aid that consolidates the Francoist dictatorship.
eb2539b139: Deutsche Bank reaches a deferred prosecution agreement with the Justice Department and pays more than 120 million dollars for bribes paid through intermediaries (FCPA) and precious metals fraud.
eb3c34e979: A bomb kills 85 people. Neo-fascists are convicted. Links with the P2 lodge, the Italian services and, according to some authors, CIA-linked “stay-behind” networks are alleged, with no proof of an American role.
eb49ab0041: After Moïse's assassination, the “Core Group” of ambassadors, including the US ambassador, calls on Ariel Henry to form a government. He governs without an election until 2024.
eb4c8c4796: Counternarcotics aid extended to the war
Congress authorizes the use of Plan Colombia aid against guerrillas, and no longer only against drugs.
eb5afceebc: The Franco-American equipment maker settles with the U.S. Justice Department and the SEC over bribery in Costa Rica, Honduras, Malaysia and Taiwan.
eb6e75ded3: Albanian police, guided by the CIA, arrest Egyptian Islamists who are handed over to Cairo. Some say they were tortured. They are tried in 1999 in a mass trial.
eb76e82a0a: Netanyahu eavesdropped on during the Iran deal
According to the Wall Street Journal, the NSA intercepted the communications of Netanyahu and his advisers during the Iranian nuclear negotiations, including their exchanges with U.S. lawmakers.
eb7ff290a1: Expulsion of the inhabitants of Diego Garcia
The British deport the inhabitants of Diego Garcia to Mauritius and the Seychelles to build the American base. Their dogs are gassed. Construction of the base begins in 1971.
eb946c876e: The Congress for Cultural Freedom launches Preuves in Paris. CIA funding, via front foundations, is revealed in 1966–1967.
eba731cf3d: A 2010 NSA presentation targets the transactions of Visa customers in Europe, the Middle East and Africa; the “Follow the Money” branch feeds the Tracfin database. Revealed by Der Spiegel in September 2013.
ebaba08951: Ryan “Lightning Bug” reconnaissance drones fly over China from 1964. Beijing shoots down about twenty, notably over Guangxi and Hainan, and displays the wreckage.
ebb189b3d8: Hugo Banzer overthrows General Torres. American documents attest to support for his co-conspirators.
ebbd1a5e56: After the May 16, 1961 coup, the American command, at first hostile, comes around. Washington recognizes and arms Park's military regime, which lasts until 1979.
ebbf87dded: The State Department designates Horacio Cartes as “significantly corrupt” and bars him from entering the United States.
ebd0e5fcfd: A cluster bomb from the Colombian air force kills 17 civilians. The targets had been spotted with American AirScan contractors working for Occidental Petroleum.
ebe8d502e7: Syngman Rhee Brought Back by the American Army
After 33 years in exile, Syngman Rhee returns to Korea aboard an American military aircraft, with General MacArthur's support. General Hodge presents him to the public in Seoul right away.
ebfb4f3a1e: A Baathist commando, including the young Saddam Hussein, strafes Kassem's car, and he is wounded. Authors such as Saïd Aburish and Richard Sale attribute a role to the CIA, without public documentary proof.
ebfe0542a6: French aircraft bomb this Tunisian village on the Algerian border with American-made planes, killing about 70 civilians. The use of materiel supplied by Washington provokes a Franco-American crisis.
ec1c60addf: The French bank agrees to pay $8.9 billion for violating U.S. embargoes. A parliamentary report denounces the extraterritoriality of U.S. law.
ec551dc0b7: Donald Rumsfeld says on ABC that he knows the location of the weapons of mass destruction, “around Tikrit and Baghdad.” None are found there.
ec5e2b1560: The U.S. Air Force sprays herbicides on the forests and crops of the South until 1971. More than 70 million liters are dumped.
ec610e2d35: Shepherd killed by a drone in Idlib
The US command announces it has killed a senior al-Qaeda official. According to the Washington Post, the victim is Lotfi Hassan Misto, a 56-year-old shepherd. The Pentagon opens an investigation.
ec63b8d65d: The second attack on US destroyers did not take place, according to an NSA study published in 2005. It serves as a pretext for the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution.
ec83ba8c28: The Commerce Department places Huawei on the “Entity List”: US companies can no longer sell to it without a license, and Google cuts its access to Android.
ec92527235: A January 1991 military intelligence document predicts that the embargo will prevent Iraq from treating its water, with a risk of epidemics. The power plants, needed for pumping, are destroyed.
ecb529e794: A B-52 mistakenly drops its bombs on the town, held by Lon Nol's forces. The American embassy acknowledges more than 130 deaths.
ecbb9cef80: MYSTIC: mobile metadata from the Philippines
The Philippines is among the countries whose mobile call metadata the NSA collects under the MYSTIC program. Revealed by The Intercept in May 2014.
ecc376d960: Washington brings more than 1,600 German scientists to the United States, including former Nazis linked to the forced labor at Mittelwerk such as Arthur Rudolph. Their pasts are whitewashed in official files.
ece25a2ae4: USAID funds the University of Nebraska at Omaha to produce textbooks for Afghan schools in the refugee camps, filled with images of war and calls to jihad.
ed0ac7f191: Trump does not rule out force in Greenland
Asked about Greenland and the Panama Canal, Donald Trump refuses to rule out the use of force or economic pressure to take control of them.
ed0aef23da: About 2,500 American soldiers take part in the capture of Beijing against the Boxers. Allied troops loot the city in the following weeks.
ed2868b21e: AI chips restricted for the Baltic states

The American “AI diffusion” rule excludes Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania from the allies with unrestricted access. Their ministers protest on 17 January. The Trump administration rescinds the rule in May.
ed2e6279e2: Secret agreement on the reversion of Okinawa

Japan secretly agrees to pay costs that Washington was supposed to bear at the time of reversion. Journalist Nishiyama, who revealed it, is convicted. American archives declassified in 2000 confirm the agreement.
ed345a1c48: Hundreds, perhaps thousands, of Taliban prisoners die of asphyxiation in containers held by the forces of Dostum, a CIA ally. U.S. special forces were present; Washington slowed the investigation.
ed392c552a: Washington delivers to Quemoy 203 mm howitzers capable of firing nuclear shells, facing the Fujian coast.
ed3b6b4fff: The Reagan administration again bans most tourist and business travel to Cuba. The Supreme Court upholds the measure in 1984.
ed3d457a53: Marine Guard at the Seoul Legation
A Marine guard protects the American legation in Seoul during the Russo-Japanese War, from January 1904 to November 1905. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
ed420cd1b4: A US strike kills 18-year-old Nurto Kusow Omar and wounds two of her sisters near Jilib. AFRICOM acknowledges in April 2020 the death of a civilian woman.
ed70ea66ee: Griesa ruling for the vulture funds
Federal judge Thomas Griesa orders Argentina to pay $1.33 billion to the funds holding unrestructured debt, under the pari passu clause.
ed794d3b6c: The first detainees arrive at Camp X-Ray. About 780 men pass through, most without charge, outside the framework of the Geneva Conventions.
ed7bc0447b: A ten-year agreement sets up a forward operating location for the U.S. Air Force, used for Plan Colombia. Rafael Correa refuses to renew it; the Americans leave in 2009.
ed8378f18b: Press kept away from the invasion
The Pentagon bars journalists from the island for the first two days. Reporters who try to go there by boat are intercepted.
ed8dd5e62f: US forces board and seize off Venezuela the tanker Skipper, loaded with Venezuelan crude and under sanctions.
edacceaae9: CIA aircraft transfer suspects to Uzbekistan, where torture is systematic. British ambassador Craig Murray denounces the use of confessions obtained under torture.
edc0bfb68d: From 1964 to 1973, about 580,000 missions drop more than 2 million tons of bombs. Of some 270 million submunitions, nearly 80 million did not explode.
edd986a437: The CIA holds and tortures prisoners at a Polish intelligence base. The European Court of Human Rights convicts Poland in 2014.
ede2d644fe: Alleged green light for the invasion of Lebanon
Ariel Sharon presents his plans to Secretary of State Alexander Haig. Historians and diplomats accuse Haig of having given a green light; he has denied it.
ee09178b67: Aircraft of the Contra group ARDE, supplied by the CIA, bomb Managua airport. One crashes near the terminal.
ee2997fb20: After Lázaro Cárdenas expropriates the oil companies, the American and British majors organize a boycott of Mexican oil, backed for a time by Washington.
ee2cace139: Grenell presses on behalf of the Tate brothers

According to the Financial Times, Trump envoy Richard Grenell asks Romanian minister Emil Hurezeanu to return their passports to the Tate brothers, prosecuted in Romania. The minister denies having felt pressure; the Tates leave for Florida on 27 February.
ee4001079d: Wounded man finished off in a mosque
Journalist Kevin Sites films a Marine killing a wounded, unarmed Iraqi in a mosque. The military investigation leads to no prosecution.
ee68820ccc: The cruiser USS Chester brings arms and ammunition to the Liberian government in the face of the Kru uprising. The Frontier Force, led by African American officers, crushes the revolt.
ee9292f3e6: Civil Air Transport becomes Air America, secretly owned by the CIA. It carries troops, arms and supplies for the clandestine war in Laos.
ee9e8be4e8: American aircraft take part in the NATO operation enforcing the UN no-fly ban over Bosnia. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
eeab03ebda: The CIA mines the ports of Corinto, Puerto Sandino and El Bluff. Several foreign ships are damaged.
eec5cdff55: The CIA supplies by air the Kuomintang troops sheltering in Burma for incursions into Yunnan (Operation Paper). Burma files a complaint at the UN in 1953.
eec8aac939: False Defector and Lie at the UN
The CIA has a pilot who claims to have defected land in Miami. Ambassador Adlai Stevenson repeats this false version before the UN, unaware that it is false.
eed67eee42: Governor John Pershing orders the general disarmament of the Moro province. Refusals lead to the siege of Bud Dajo in December 1911, then to the Battle of Bud Bagsak in 1913.
ef0f181b5a: The occupation's press code forbids any criticism of the Allies. Information on the effects of the atomic bombs and radiation is censored until 1949.
ef53c79243: After the brief arrest of American sailors, Washington demands a 21-gun salute to the American flag. Huerta's refusal serves as the pretext for the occupation of Veracruz.
ef5ee3d595: Washington announces it is redirecting to Ukraine deliveries of Patriot and NASAMS interceptors planned for other countries.
ef6993c000: President Woodrow Wilson refuses to recognize the government of Victoriano Huerta, which emerged from the coup against Madero, and seeks to bring about its fall. This policy leads to the occupation of Veracruz in 1914.
ef7064aa0a: Inspector general's report on the coup
The State Department's Office of Inspector General concludes that the NED and the embassy funded and advised actors in the coup, with no evidence that they encouraged the coup.
ef76babe86: Documents unearthed by Human Rights Watch show that Washington trained and equipped Habré's political police, accused of tens of thousands of deaths under torture.
ef784fa06d: The US Trade Representative proposes 100% tariffs on $2.4 billion of French products to punish the digital services tax.
ef8c0fdf3c: The CIA secretly transfers the detainee to Lithuania on 17 or 18 February 2005 and removes him on 25 March 2006. The ECHR establishes this in 2018 and convicts Lithuania.
efaadc552c: After the death of 24 Pakistani peacekeepers, American AC-130s and helicopters strike General Aidid's radio station and weapons depots. These raids open the hunt for the warlord.
efab26f70b: Trump announces that any country doing business with Iran will pay 25% tariffs on its trade with the United States. A February order authorizes these taxes against buyers of Iranian goods, including China.
efd20f8f2a: A missile strike kills the al-Shabaab leader and about ten other people, including civilians according to residents.
effb896158: First Funds to the Christian Democrats
Kennedy's Special Group approves secret funding of Eduardo Frei's Christian Democratic Party, two years before the presidential election, according to the Church Committee.
f00472f26e: Barack Obama announces the deployment of about 300 military personnel to Cameroon for surveillance flights against Boko Haram, from the Garoua base.
f006a627c5: Reagan authorizes a CIA plan to overthrow Desi Bouterse. Congressional committees oppose it and it is abandoned, according to the American press.
f00c03015e: Baitullah Mehsud killed by a drone
A CIA strike kills the leader of the Pakistani Taliban, his wife and other relatives on the roof of his father-in-law's house.
f022a3271a: The Treasury and Argentina's Central Bank sign a $20 billion swap line, presented as support for Javier Milei's government before the October 26 vote.
f04693d748: Arrested in Pakistan and handed over to the Americans, this Turkish national resident in Bremen is held at Kandahar and then Guantánamo without trial. No evidence against him is found; he is released in August 2006 after an intervention by Angela Merkel.
f0504bcba6: Under the Helms-Burton Act, USAID funds opposition groups, independent journalists and the sending of books and equipment to Cuba. Hundreds of millions of dollars are devoted to it.
f065aeaa7e: The Union test releases 6.9 megatons over Bikini Atoll, in the same series as Bravo.
f06e107ff8: The CIA launches a propaganda and political action program against the USSR and the Tudeh Party, funded at about one million dollars a year according to historian Mark Gasiorowski. It will be turned against Mossadegh in 1953. Confirmed by State Department archives (FRUS, 2017).
f06ea93f7b: American aircraft begin armed reconnaissance flights over Laos, officially neutral since the 1962 Geneva Accords.
f0a4b3b3da: Independence leader Macario Sakay, who had surrendered on a promise of amnesty, is tried as a “bandit” and hanged by the American colonial authorities.
f0f3ef1a06: Kenneth Blanco, a senior US Justice Department official, cites informal cooperation with Brazilian prosecutors before the Atlantic Council, referring to Lula's conviction.
f117c94aad: The Pentagon transfers Greenland from the European command to Northern Command, responsible for the defence of US territory, on Donald Trump's orders. The decision fuels fears of annexation.
f11e1432bc: A CIA mole in Indira Gandhi's cabinet

Declassified archives show that the CIA was receiving from a source inside the Indian government the war plans discussed in cabinet meetings. Nixon and Kissinger use them to justify their support for Pakistan.
f1334fce54: The United States launches a massive bombardment of palaces, ministries and military sites in the heart of Baghdad, under the “shock and awe” doctrine meant to break the will to resist.
f14016c0ff: New York Agreement on New Guinea
Under pressure from Kennedy and American mediator Ellsworth Bunker, the Netherlands cedes Western New Guinea to Indonesia via the UN, without prior consultation of the Papuans.
f17f3a194b: Opposition candidate Arturo Cruz withdraws. American officials have acknowledged wanting to discredit the vote.
f18bef67cd: Retaliation threat over the digital tax
Incoming ambassador Tom Rose calls the Polish tax on large digital platforms “self-destructive” and announces that Trump will retaliate.
f18d8cdd8f: Congress passes the China Aid Act: about $460 million, of which $125 million usable for the military, for Chiang Kai-shek's regime in the midst of the civil war.
f191baf685: Pompeo launches Clean Network to exclude Chinese companies from networks, the cloud and cables, and presses allies to ban Huawei from 5G.
f193695ad4: The CIA plants a cache of Soviet weapons in Nicaragua, which Somoza presents as delivered by Guatemala. The setup is meant to prove Árbenz's expansionism. It is described in the CIA's declassified archives.
f1ae9e9ecd: During the Battle of Manila, American artillery helps raze the city, where Japanese troops also commit massacres. About 100,000 civilians die; the share caused by American shells remains debated.
f1c80fd96c: Thanks to the KGB shopping list delivered by Vladimir Vetrov to the DST, the CIA has deliberately faulty chips, software and plans pass to the USSR. Gus Weiss described it in a CIA journal in 1996.
f1d7457274: General Enoch Crowder arrives aboard a battleship and dictates reforms and ministers to the Cuban government, under threat of intervention.
f1e78c4330: Salvatore Giuliano's gang fires on a May Day gathering in Sicily: 11 dead. Historians, including Giuseppe Casarrubea, drawing on OSS and CIA archives, point to American links; the question remains controversial.
f1fe7f992d: Truman Doctrine: Military Aid to Greece
Truman obtains $400 million from Congress for Greece and Turkey. American arms and advisers support the Greek government army against the Communists during the civil war.
f215c0dbd6: The US military destroys a boat described as a drug-trafficking vessel from Venezuela: 11 dead. No public evidence is provided.
f219721e60: Bush deploys combat-equipped forces, including Marines landed in Monrovia, to support the West African force after Charles Taylor's departure. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
f2264351cc: British bank Lloyds TSB enters into a deferred prosecution agreement for processing payments linked to Iran and Sudan.
f22e3438d6: Sanctions after martial law in Poland
Reagan suspends Aeroflot flights, closes the Soviet purchasing commission and freezes exports of oil technology, holding Moscow responsible for the crackdown on Solidarity.
f250c1ea35: Sudan listed as a terrorist state
The State Department places Sudan on the list of state sponsors of terrorism, leading to trade and financial restrictions. The country remains on it until December 2020.
f267cea0f7: American Green Light for the Coup
At the State Department, John Foster Dulles and his brother Allen, director of the CIA, approve the TPAJAX plan. Churchill and Eisenhower give their agreement in July.
f26cf711fa: The United States leads the first phase of the strikes: more than a hundred Tomahawk missiles, fired with the British, hit air defenses, and B-2 bombers strike a base near Sirte. NATO takes over on March 31.
f28112ef05: The Federal Maritime Commission, which is investigating refusals of port calls to ships carrying cargo for Israel, considers banning Spanish-flagged ships or fining them up to 2.3 million dollars per voyage.
f2822099ee: Visiting Guatemala, Bill Clinton says that U.S. support for the military and intelligence forces responsible for the repression “was wrong.”
f2be461967: The 7th Fleet evacuates the soldiers and inhabitants of the Dachen Islands, in Zhejiang, to Taiwan, under threat from the People's Liberation Army.
f2d9eba23c: Gordon cable requesting arms and oil
Ambassador Lincoln Gordon requests the clandestine dispatch of arms, fuel and a naval force to support the coup plotters. The cable is declassified and published by the US archives.
f2f6ae008a: Supreme Court upholds the vulture funds
The Supreme Court declines to hear Argentina's appeal, making enforceable the Griesa ruling that blocks payment to restructured creditors until the holdout funds are paid.
f340c5886f: Trump signs the Uyghur Human Rights Policy Act, which requires sanctions on those responsible for the repression in Xinjiang.
f34cab6866: After President King resigns, swept away by the forced labor scandal, Washington refuses to recognize his successor Edwin Barclay until 1935, to obtain guarantees on the Firestone agreements.
f3500891e9: Authorized by Truman, a B-47 flying from Alaska photographs the Soviet Arctic bases on the peninsula. It is one of the first deep overflights of Soviet territory.
f363d35c8f: Commission for Assistance to a Free Cuba
A commission chaired by Colin Powell proposes a plan to hasten the end of the Castro regime and organize the transition. Its 2006 report includes a classified annex.
f373a44a42: Private Kenneth Markle kills with extreme violence Yun Geum-i, a woman working near Camp Casey. Sentenced to 15 years in prison by Korean justice, he is released in 2006.
f3a78edf8a: ORDEN and ANSESAL created with Washington
In the mid-1960s, General Medrano creates the ORDEN militia and the ANSESAL service with the help of American advisers, according to Allan Nairn's investigation (1984). They feed the death squads.
f3c6f4cc60: Threat of 50% duties on the EU
Judging the negotiations too slow, Donald Trump announces 50% duties on European products from 1 June. He postpones them to 9 July after a call from Ursula von der Leyen.
f3f92496a8: Washington-trained units go over to the rebels
Tuareg commanders of elite Malian units trained by the United States join the northern rebellion with men, weapons and vehicles, the New York Times reports.
f3fbbeb0ff: In November 2020, the broadcaster DR reveals that the NSA used the access cables of Danish military intelligence (FE) to spy on ministries and the manufacturer Terma. The head of the FE had been suspended in August after a whistleblower's alert.
f3ff5f7dba: First strikes ordered by Joe Biden, against facilities of pro-Iranian militias on the Iraq-Syria border, in retaliation for rocket attacks in Iraq.
f4149c456c: WikiLeaks, Libération and Mediapart publish NSA intercepts targeting Chirac, Sarkozy and Hollande. François Hollande summons the ambassador.
f425826776: A civilian security guard is killed by two bombs mistakenly dropped by an F/A-18. His death triggers a civil disobedience movement that ends with the Navy's departure in 2003.
f42a21ede4: The Vault 7 documents published by WikiLeaks show that the US consulate in Frankfurt serves as a base for CIA hackers for Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
f431769458: A CIA manual for the Contras advises “neutralizing” Sandinista officials. Its disclosure causes a scandal.
f4464987c1: Disguised Marines infiltrate the Caco leader's camp and kill him. His body, tied to a door, is photographed and displayed.
f4b0a6ab11: The Battle Act threatens to cut off American aid to countries that sell strategic goods to the Soviet bloc. It forces European allies to align with the COCOM embargo lists.
f4d3b8b93d: Reuters reveals in 2024 that Trump authorized the CIA in 2019 to run a secret influence campaign against the Chinese government on social media.
f4eaf3fb10: Under NATO command, the United States provides refueling, intelligence and strikes until the fall of Gaddafi. The civilian protection mission of Resolution 1973 becomes regime change.
f5085437aa: Moynihan neutralizes the UN on Timor
UN ambassador Daniel Patrick Moynihan writes in his memoirs that the State Department wanted the UN to prove “utterly ineffective” and that he carried this out “with no inconsiderable success”.
f50f0a3145: A Polish general staff officer, Ryszard Kukliński has been delivering thousands of Warsaw Pact documents to the CIA since 1972. The CIA exfiltrates him shortly before martial law.
f51cb203c3: Tuna Boat Daigo Fukuryū Maru Irradiated

The 23 fishermen of the Japanese tuna boat are covered in radioactive ash from Castle Bravo. Radio operator Aikichi Kuboyama dies in September; Washington pays compensation without acknowledging liability.
f52abcca6a: Blinken announces visa denials for Bangladeshis who would undermine the elections. Sheikh Hasina accuses Washington of wanting to overthrow her.
f5508f8cfc: Raid against Kim Dotcom for the FBI
At the FBI's request, New Zealand police search Kim Dotcom's house. The GCSB eavesdropping agency had spied on him illegally, as Prime Minister John Key acknowledges, apologizing.
f568970a6d: Before a congressional caucus, a teenage girl claims that Iraqi soldiers took babies out of incubators. She was the Kuwaiti ambassador's daughter, coached by Hill & Knowlton. George H. W. Bush repeats the story, which proved unfounded.
f56e527147: The Treasury sanctions an independent Shandong refinery for its purchases of Iranian oil, a first against these Chinese “teapots.”
f57d2f661f: The CIA and the BND secretly own Crypto AG, a Swiss supplier of encryption machines. During the hostage crisis, Washington reads Iranian communications. Revealed in 2020.
f5b33e4395: Singapore expels American diplomat Hank Hendrickson, accused of encouraging lawyers, including Francis Seow, to run against the PAP. Washington denies it and expels a Singaporean diplomat.
f5ce391d39: A Philippine police raid kills bomb maker Zulkifli bin Hir, known as Marwan, wanted by the FBI; 44 commandos die. The official Philippine inquiry establishes U.S. support in intelligence, drones and evacuation.
f5cfe9358d: A CIA aircraft bombs and sinks the British freighter Springfjord, wrongly suspected of carrying arms. The CIA later quietly compensates its insurer.
f5d5d40bbc: U.S. aircraft and drones strike an al-Shabaab training camp north of Mogadishu. The Pentagon announces about 150 fighters killed.
f5df9ef580: An epidemic affects more than 300,000 people and kills about 150, a majority of them children. Cuba accuses the United States of biological warfare. Nothing has proven it.
f5ed071090: During the coup attempt, Secretary of State Alexander Haig calls the situation an “internal affair”. Suspicions of prior knowledge have never been established.
f5f0304740: Somalia invasion planned in Addis Ababa

Leaked documents reveal a confidential meeting of U.S. and Ethiopian officials six months before the invasion of Somalia: Washington deems a takeover of the country by the Islamic courts unacceptable.
f6309a362a: CIA on the ground in Libya
In late March 2011, the press reveals that Obama signed a secret authorization for aid to the rebels and that CIA teams are operating in Libya to guide strikes and assess the insurgents.
f6423f7150: CIA informed of the Mayan massacres
Declassified CIA and State Department cables describe the destruction of villages by the army. The administration nevertheless tells Congress that human rights are improving.
f655ec00fd: Washington sends Vernon Walters, a close associate of General Castelo Branco since the war, as military attaché. He serves as a link with the 1964 conspirators, according to his memoirs and the archives.
f65773710c: Attorney General William Barr meets Italian intelligence chiefs in Rome, with the approval of Giuseppe Conte, to seek material on the origins of the Russia investigation. The meetings spark controversy in Italy.
f67ac7de30: After Desert Fox, the rules of engagement are relaxed. American and British aircraft strike Iraq almost daily in the no-fly zones, causing civilian casualties, the New York Times reports.
f6891dea28: During the war between Honduras and Nicaragua, Marines land at several Honduran ports, including Puerto Cortés.
f69fb90337: UNHCR and WTO eavesdropped on in Geneva

NSA selectors published by WikiLeaks show the long-term interception of the Swiss phones of the High Commissioner for Refugees' chief of staff and the WTO's director of rules. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2016.
f6a3e9f2ed: An agreement opens the port of Mombasa and Kenyan airfields to American forces for the Rapid Deployment Force, in exchange for military aid to Daniel arap Moi's regime.
f6b773abd0: Lula is jailed on the order of Judge Moro, which rules him out of the presidential race. The Workers' Party denounces persecution fueled by cooperation with Washington. His convictions are annulled in 2021.
f6cfe50979: Bush announces withdrawal from the 1972 anti-missile treaty, effective in June 2002, in order to build a missile shield. Moscow sees it as undermining its deterrent.
f71ac964c1: A month before the invasion of Guatemala, Washington signs a military assistance agreement with Honduras, which serves as a rear base for Castillo Armas's troops.
f71e28d142: HateAid leaders barred by visa ban
The State Department bars from entry Anna-Lena von Hodenberg and Josephine Ballon, who head the German NGO HateAid, accused of “censorship” for their defence of the European Digital Services Act.
f771c64146: WikiLeaks cables show that the U.S. embassy backed the contractors of Hanes and Levi's against a Haitian law raising the minimum wage to $5 a day.
f776f5ef96: After the invasion of Afghanistan, Carter confirms that the United States will not take part in the Moscow Games and draws some sixty countries into the boycott.
f786742949: George W. Bush tells Polish television that weapons of mass destruction have been found, citing two trailers presented as mobile labs. They were used to produce hydrogen.
f7a41364cc: Total collection in the Pacific for the NSA
Snowden documents published by the New Zealand Herald and The Intercept show that New Zealand's GCSB collects Pacific countries' communications in bulk and shares them with the NSA.
f7b1f7d9dc: Medvedev wiretapped at the London G20
According to The Guardian (2013), the NSA tries to intercept the calls of Russian President Dmitry Medvedev during the summit.
f7f41bf411: During the Indo-Pakistani war, the Nixon administration suspends about 87 million dollars of economic aid to India, deemed the aggressor, as part of its policy of “tilting” toward Pakistan.
f7f7e56a74: After the Iraqi Parliament's vote calling for foreign troops to leave, Trump threatens Iraq with sanctions “like they've never seen before” and demands to be reimbursed for the US bases.
f801764ce2: At the Hiroshima G7, Biden agrees that Ukrainian pilots be trained on F-16s and that allies later deliver these American aircraft.
f807ec3be0: On midterm election day, US Cyber Command cuts the Internet Research Agency's access to the Internet. Trump confirms the operation in 2020.
f826a5bf35: The Hague takes control of chipmaker Nexperia, a subsidiary of Wingtech, the day after an American rule extending the blacklist to subsidiaries. Court documents show that Washington demanded the departure of the Chinese CEO.
f826c7d2b5: The Atomic Bomb Casualty Commission, created by the United States, examines tens of thousands of survivors of Hiroshima and Nagasaki without providing them care. Many of them experienced it as experimentation.
f887e4269c: Green light for the Gwangju crackdown

Washington agrees to the withdrawal of troops under combined command to put down the Gwangju uprising. Chun Doo-hwan's army kills hundreds of civilians; declassified cables document the American role.
f890051497: Trump threatens to “obliterate” Iran's power plants, “starting with the biggest one,” if Hormuz is not reopened within 48 hours. He then pushes the deadline back five days.
f8900a3b83: Biden signs two laws: one strips Russia and Belarus of normal trade relations status, the other bans imports of Russian oil.
f8b82b9dd3: US senators and the South Stream freeze

During the visit to Sofia of Senators McCain, Murphy and Johnson, who denounce the award of the contract to a Russian consortium, Prime Minister Oresharski suspends work on the South Stream gas pipeline, already targeted by Brussels.
f8dd04be69: White House recordings show Kennedy and Ambassador Lincoln Gordon discussing the preparation of Brazilian military officers to remove Goulart, a year and a half before the coup.
f8e2e1dc20: During Operation Cast Lead, the Israeli army fires white phosphorus shells on inhabited areas. Human Rights Watch identifies M825A1 shells made in the United States.
f8eb5db1c2: Biden secures the dismissal of prosecutor Shokin
Joe Biden makes a $1 billion loan guarantee conditional on the departure of Prosecutor General Viktor Shokin, whom the Rada dismisses. The EU and the IMF also demanded his departure.
f90afe102c: To capture Maduro, the US military strikes military sites in and around Caracas, including Fuerte Tiuna. Cuba announces the death of 32 of its military personnel; Caracas reports dozens of Venezuelan dead.
f90bb305ec: Military advisers of the Andean Initiative

Bush sends military aid against drug trafficking. Between 50 and 100 advisers are in Colombia and special forces teams train the armies of the three countries. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
f91ca3c31c: Deputy Defense Secretary Paul Wolfowitz writes to European ministers to dissuade them from launching the Galileo navigation system, a competitor to GPS, citing risks to American military operations.
f929ad8f41: The Senate unanimously passes a sanctions bill after the gassing of the Kurds during the Anfal campaign. The Reagan administration opposes it and the bill dies in the House.
f93e4d5b5a: Army investigators interrogate the SS men accused of the Malmédy massacre. A Senate subcommittee acknowledges in 1949 the use of mock trials, but rejects the accusations of physical torture.
f95485382f: UN Resolution 390, backed by Washington, federates Eritrea with allied Ethiopia. John Foster Dulles justifies this choice by American strategic interest in the Red Sea rather than by the wishes of the Eritreans.
f954a786ca: Nvidia H20 chips subject to license
The Trump administration makes exports of H20 chips, designed for China, subject to a license. Sales resume in the summer.
f96b8f59b7: The Coalition Provisional Authority cancels municipal elections planned in Najaf and other cities, preferring to appoint officials, the Washington Post reports.
f99597200d: Posada Carriles acquitted in El Paso
Tried only for perjury and immigration fraud, Posada Carriles is acquitted. Washington has refused to extradite him to Venezuela, which wants him for the Cubana flight 455 bombing.
f9bce386e3: NSA at the Toronto G20 summit
According to Snowden documents published by CBC, the NSA carries out a vast spying operation during the G8 and G20 summits, with the agreement of Canadian intelligence.
f9f1fd9e38: China's CNCERT accuses US intelligence of having hacked a materials research institute and a smart energy company.
fa0073ec48: HSBC pays $1.92 billion for failures in anti-money-laundering controls and violations of U.S. sanctions.
fa01c95b8c: Biden redeploys a few hundred soldiers to Somalia against al-Shabaab, after the withdrawal ordered by Trump. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
fa33893595: The future Radio Liberty, secretly funded by the CIA, broadcasts in Russian and other Soviet languages. The funding is acknowledged in 1971.
fa5025b27f: A $125 million drawdown including anti-aircraft missiles, counter-drone equipment and anti-tank missiles.
fa6e11826e: Donald Trump says publicly that he does not rule out a “military option” in Venezuela. According to the press, he also asks his advisers about an invasion.
fa7ee98a8c: A Marine guard protects the American radio station on Russky Island, in Vladivostok Bay, until November 1922. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
fa83c9f99c: During the Battle of the Bulge, American soldiers kill about 80 German prisoners. No one is prosecuted.
fac1c35053: Sixteen members of Congress led by Claudia Tenney threaten Ireland with anti-boycott tax measures if it bans settlement products. More letters follow in October; the bill is later watered down, under American pressure according to its critics.
fac3cbde12: Washington announces delivery of HIMARS multiple rocket launchers, which allow Ukraine to strike Russian depots and command posts 80 km away.
fae774b75f: Roquefort taxed at 100% over the beef ban

To punish the European ban on hormone-treated beef, the USTR imposes 100% duties on a list aimed mainly at France: Roquefort, foie gras, truffles, Dijon mustard. The amount, 116.8 million dollars, is authorised by the WTO.
faeab91bae: The Trump administration sanctions Fatou Bensouda, who is investigating crimes committed in Afghanistan, including by Americans.
fb095a6ded: Funding of the CISL and UIL Unions
American unions and intelligence services financially support the union federations born of the split in the CGIL, to weaken the Communist-dominated union.
fb0c1fe782: A $2.5 billion package with 90 Stryker armored vehicles and 59 additional Bradleys.
fb466704cb: Wegelin, oldest Swiss bank, brought down
The first foreign bank indicted in the United States for aiding tax evasion, Wegelin pleads guilty and announces its closure after 272 years of existence.
fb484377fc: Biden signs the 2022 appropriations law, which includes $13.6 billion for Ukraine, about half of it for defense.
fb64b50903: Aiming at railway installations, American bombers from Italy hit the centre of Saint-Étienne. The raid kills nearly a thousand civilians, the heaviest toll in the city's history.
fb7d24a934: Ford approves sending arms and money to the FNLA and UNITA against the MPLA. The Senate cuts the funds in December 1975 (Tunney Amendment), then the 1976 Clark Amendment bans all aid.
fbb83bf529: The bank is penalized for dollar transactions with Cuba, Iran, Sudan and Libya.
fbc8998b39: The State Department authorizes Ambassador Lodge to signal to the South Vietnamese generals that Washington will not oppose Diệm's removal.
fbed22c074: The French cement maker pleads guilty in a New York court to having supported the Islamic State in Syria and pays $778 million.
fbf1c9688d: Marines land to protect Americans and other foreigners in Shanghai during fighting between Chinese factions. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
fbf5ecb0a1: As soon as Kabul falls, the Treasury blocks about $7 billion of the central bank's assets held in the United States and cuts dollar deliveries, causing a liquidity crisis.
fc1178627e: Report on the hidden war in Somalia
Amnesty International documents 14 civilians killed in five US strikes. AFRICOM first rejects these findings, then acknowledges in April 2019 two civilian deaths in one strike.
fc14659572: Bill Clinton signs the first part of a multibillion-dollar program, mostly military: helicopters, training and advisers for the Colombian army fighting the FARC.
fc26d42685: American bombers mistakenly hit Prague, confusing it with Dresden. About 700 dead.
fc529a0196: Congress lifts the ban, in force since 1976, on any aid to Angolan rebels. The way is open to covert aid to Jonas Savimbi's UNITA.
fc560d77ea: Death of Fabio Di Celmo in Havana

Bombs hit three hotels (Copacabana, Chateau Miramar, Tritón) and La Bodeguita del Medio. Italian tourist Fabio Di Celmo dies at the Copacabana. Salvadoran Raúl Cruz León, of Posada Carriles's network, is convicted. Cuba accuses Washington; no American role is established.
fc56137d31: The CIA, which helped create the Shah's political police, maintains close liaison with it until the 1979 revolution, despite torture documented by Amnesty International.
fc578c0f14: WikiLeaks names Afghanistan as the country whose telephone calls the NSA records and stores, in the SOMALGET program revealed by The Intercept based on the Snowden documents.
fc7f33ad7a: The Reagan administration sells military trucks and jeeps to the Guatemalan army by removing them from the list of goods subject to human-rights-related restrictions.
fc909fa210: Strikes against the Islamic State in Iraq
The United States launches air strikes in Iraq, then takes the lead of a coalition. Airwars counts thousands of civilians killed by the coalition in Iraq and Syria.
fc920d11ef: Manuel Noriega, head of Panamanian intelligence, is paid by American services for years. CIA director George Bush meets him in 1976.
fc9f57d5b7: Trump announces that soldiers will stay to “secure the oil” in Syria, and says “we're keeping the oil.” The fields in the east remain out of Damascus's reach.
fce059d051: Dozens of bodies of victims of the invasion, buried by American troops, are exhumed from a mass grave in the Jardín de Paz cemetery.
fceca54a1b: Aid cut over the Copenhagen Accord

Cables show a diplomatic offensive mixing intelligence, threats and promises of aid to rally countries to the Copenhagen Accord. Washington then cuts aid to Bolivia and Ecuador, which opposed the text. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
fd04cd408c: U.S. and British naval forces take part in the blockade imposed on Yemen by the Saudi-led coalition, which restricts the entry of food, fuel and medicine.
fd1a616b49: The “Iraq War Logs” published by WikiLeaks in 2010 show that a directive told soldiers not to investigate torture committed by Iraqi forces unless otherwise ordered.
fd4b0ee966: The Polar Sea challenges Arctic sovereignty
An American Coast Guard icebreaker transits the Northwest Passage without authorization. Ottawa responds by drawing baselines around the archipelago.
fd63b5f2e7: The CIA funds about twenty candidates in the congressional elections, according to the Church Committee report on covert action in Chile.
fd732179b8: The 8th Air Force targets the Renault factories. A large share of the bombs fall on housing and kill several hundred civilians, including spectators at a neighboring racetrack.
fd8d8e1898: The forces of Hissène Habré, armed and funded by the CIA to counter Gaddafi, take the capital and overthrow Goukouni Oueddei.
fda15e98c4: Biden signs the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act: any product from Xinjiang is presumed to be made with forced labor and barred from import.
fdb3f21378: Obama calls on Bashar al-Assad to step down and signs an order freezing the assets of the Syrian state and banning imports of Syrian oil and any U.S. investment in Syria.
fdbecb447d: The CIA sends officer Justin O'Donnell to “neutralize” Lumumba. He refuses to assassinate him and seeks to lure him out of his residence to hand him over to the authorities, according to the Church Committee.
fdc6c32bd4: B-17s of the 8th Air Force target the shipyards but hit the Bospolder-Tussendijken district. Several hundred Dutch civilians are killed.
fdcb22ef92: According to a Danish television documentary broadcast in January 2008, CIA aircraft linked to renditions stop over at Narsarsuaq. A Danish working group identifies 132 suspect aircraft; Amnesty judges the review “toothless”.
fdd20603b4: Bulgarian airspace closed to Russian aircraft
As Washington asks Greece to refuse overflight to Russian aircraft bound for Syria, Bulgaria closes its airspace to these flights. Moscow accuses the US of pressure; Sofia says it acted alone.
fddd098be0: The French government demands the departure of several Americans, including CIA agents under diplomatic cover, accused of political and economic espionage.
fdeb336a0b: Iranian oil seized in Greece for Washington

At the request of American justice, Greece seizes the Iranian cargo of the tanker Lana anchored off Euboea. Tehran retaliates on 27 May by boarding two Greek tankers in the Gulf, released in November.
fe2c09c52a: The Nationalist attack on Hankou leads to the landing of naval forces to protect Americans. A guard remains at the consulate general. Listed in Congressional Research Service report R42738.
fe3557ea70: A U.S. A-10 drops its bombs near the village, which has been subjected to training fire since 1951. Residents are injured and the Supreme Court recognizes the harm suffered in 2004. The range closes in 2005.
fe77da2e06: Targeted killing of Abu Baqir al-Saadi
A US drone hits a car in the Mashtal district of Baghdad and kills Abu Baqir al-Saadi, a Kataib Hezbollah commander. The Iraqi government denounces a flagrant violation of its sovereignty.
fe830f8886: Napalm on the Grammos and Vitsi Mountains
The Greek air force, equipped by the United States, drops napalm supplied by Washington on the Communist guerrillas during the final offensives of the civil war, in 1948–1949.
fe85461f85: General J. Franklin Bell herds the civilian population into closed zones and destroys crops and livestock outside them. Thousands of civilians die of hunger and disease, in debated proportions.
fe878478bb: Mobutu takes power for thirty years. He has been a paid CIA contact since 1960, and the CIA continues to support him.
fe8a8d365b: Halt to the Revolution Wind project
The Trump administration orders a halt to work on the wind farm of Ørsted, a group controlled by the Danish state, when it is about 80% complete. A federal judge lifts the ban in September.
fe8c5beccc: Volkswagen pleads guilty to three counts for the emissions test fraud and pays 4.3 billion dollars in criminal and civil penalties. Six German executives are indicted and an independent monitor is imposed.
fea63e662f: The army overthrows President Arosemena. Former CIA agent Philip Agee describes the groundwork laid by the Quito station.
feba0707c7: The Brazilian aircraft maker reaches an agreement with the U.S. Justice Department and the SEC over foreign bribery, under the FCPA.
febfaf53b3: Facing General Petraeus, President Saleh promises: “We'll continue saying the bombs are ours, not yours.” His deputy prime minister says he lied to Parliament. Revealed by WikiLeaks in 2010.
fed3f87780: During Track II, the CIA channels funds through an intermediary to the far-right group Patria y Libertad, according to the Church Committee.
fef7a99eca: On the night of August 15–16, Colonel Nematollah Nassiri tries to hand Mossadegh the dismissal decree. Forewarned, the government has Nassiri arrested and the coup fails.
fefe6bf6d7: Deaths of Charles Horman and Frank Teruggi
Two Americans are executed by the army after the coup. A 1976 State Department memo mentions a possible role of American intelligence.
ff0dffcf3b: A U.S. armored vehicle crushes two middle-school girls. The acquittal of the two soldiers by a U.S. court-martial triggers large demonstrations.
ff4fdc3e30: Reagan decrees a total trade embargo against Nicaragua.
ff5adad793: ETA claims the attack that kills the head of Franco's government, the day after a visit by Henry Kissinger. Authors suggest CIA complicity, without public proof.
ff72bc4230: Colonel Enrique Peralta Azurdia overthrows Ydígoras to prevent the return of former president Arévalo. Historians establish the Kennedy administration's prior agreement.
